AI.tldr: 论文提出"朴素LLM"（naive LLM）——通过训练阶段剥夺特定领域知识或刻意遗忘，使其摆脱领域固有偏见，从而产生更具新颖性的种子想法，再经更强的"导师模型"精炼为具体提案；在1B和7B模型上验证"信息更少反而更有创造力"的反直觉结论。
AI.motivation: 大模型具备互联网规模知识，本应能提供新视角，但实际倾向追随主流观点和领域内既有偏见，生成结果同质化、缺乏突破性。科学突破常源于全新视角，因此需要探索"外行视角"能否提升创造性。
AI.method: 构建"朴素模型"：通过训练时对特定主题的数据剥夺（deprivation）或刻意遗忘（intentional forgetting）使模型对该主题保持"无知"，解除既有教条的束缚，自由进行新联想与猜想；随后将朴素模型生成的种子想法交给更强的"导师模型"（mentor model）精炼为可操作的提案。在1B与7B规模模型上开展实验，与基线模型对比。
AI.result: 朴素模型生成的种子想法在新颖性和有用性上稳定优于基线模型；经导师模型精炼后，想法质量进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 与"扩大训练数据"的主流范式相反，本文证明在追求真正跳出框架的解决方案时，"更少信息"可能更具效力，为通过知识剥夺提升LLM创造力提供了可行路径。

title: FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge
summary: In financial backtesting and other point-in-time tasks, external inputs can be restricted by date, but model parameters may retain financial facts disclosed later, introducing parametric look-ahead bias. We introduce FinCutBench, a continually updated monthly financial knowledge benchmark for measuring how far a fixed model's financial knowledge extends over calendar time. The current dataset contains 9,000 Chinese and English four-option multiple-choice questions from January 2023 to September 2026, covering Chinese and U.S. markets and four categories of financial information. We construct monthly knowledge profiles using the approximate months in which the tested facts became public. After a profile passes the decline test and knot checks, we define the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level, and report the stability of the estimated date under resampling. Boundary dates and localization precision vary across models. Using the independently measured Transition Start and Boundary as fixed references for downstream sample grouping, we find clear relative declines after the Boundary in U.S. asset ranking and earnings recall for some models, while Chinese-market ranking estimates vary across models and all eight disclosure-period-paired forecast-error comparisons have unadjusted $p$ values above 0.10. The FinCut Boundary thus provides an empirical reference for the temporal scope of parametric knowledge in point-in-time financial evaluation, supporting evaluation-window selection and result interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出 FinCutBench：每月更新的金融知识基准，用固定模型随日历时间的知识曲线度量"参数化前视偏差"，并以 FinCut Boundary 给出模型参数知识的时间边界。
AI.motivation: 时点（point-in-time）任务的输入可按日期截断，但模型参数仍可能编码其后才披露的金融事实，形成参数化前视偏差，缺少可量化的时间边界。
AI.method: 构建含 9,000 道中英文四选一选择题的数据集（2023-01 至 2026-09，覆盖中美市场、四类金融信息），按事实公开的近似月份构建月度知识曲线；曲线通过下降检验与 knot 检查后，定义首次达到低水平水平的月份为 FinCut Boundary，并用重采样评估估计日期的稳定性；以下游任务分组检验。
AI.result: 边界日期与定位精度因模型而异；以 Transition Start 与 Boundary 为固定参照分组后，部分模型在美国资产排序与盈利回忆任务上于边界后出现明显相对下降；中国市场排序估计因模型而异，八个披露期配对预测误差比较的未校正 p 值均大于 0.10。
AI.conclusion: FinCut Boundary 为时点金融评估中参数化知识的时间范围提供经验参照，可支持评估窗口选择与结果解读。

title: CoRA-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation by Context Selectors Under Token Budgets
comment: Paper Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Long-Context Foundation Models
summary: Context selection can reduce input length during long-input inference but can remove evidence required to answer a query. We introduce CoRA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating evidence preservation under shared token budgets. We compare head and tail truncation, BM25, dense retrieval, dense retrieval with reranking, LLMLingua-2, and Provence across BABILong, LOONG Financial Spotlight, a custom NoLiMa diagnostic, and LongMemEval. Evidence-preservation results reveal task-dependent tradeoffs: BM25 achieves 0.921 supporting-fact recall on BABILong at 128K, dense retrieval and dense reranking each achieve 0.908 needle recall on NoLiMa at 64K, and dense retrieval achieves 0.993 answer-bearing-turn recall on LongMemEval at 64K. Evidence, token retention, and complementary reader evaluations use the same selected contexts. Reader evaluations use dataset-native answer metrics and three runs on the same questions, with paired bootstrap confidence intervals. At a 32K budget, BM25 achieves 46.20% BABILong answer accuracy and dense retrieval achieves 71.13% LongMemEval accuracy. The results show that method rankings vary across evidence types and between evidence recall and downstream accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoRA-Bench 基准，在统一 token 预算下比较多种上下文选择方法的证据保留能力，并发现方法排序随证据类型及"证据召回–下游准确率"维度而变化。
AI.motivation: 长输入推理中上下文选择可缩短输入长度，但可能移除回答查询所需的证据；现有工作缺乏在共享 token 预算下系统评估"证据保留"的基准，且对证据召回与下游准确率之间关系认识不足。
AI.method: 构建 CoRA-Bench 基准，在相同 token 预算下对比头尾截断、BM25、稠密检索、稠密检索+重排、LLMLingua-2、Provence 六类方法；在 BABILong、LOONG Financial Spotlight、自定义 NoLiMa 诊断集与 LongMemEval 上评估证据保留率、token 保留率与互补的阅读器性能；阅读器采用数据集原生答案指标，同一问题三次运行，并使用配对自助法置信区间。
AI.result: 证据保留呈任务依赖权衡：128K 下 BM25 在 BABILong 上支持事实召回 0.921；64K 下稠密检索与稠密重排分别在 NoLiMa 上达到 0.908 指针召回；64K 下稠密检索在 LongMemEval 上答案承载轮次召回 0.993。32K 预算下 BM25 在 BABILong 上答案准确率 46.20%，稠密检索在 LongMemEval 上达 71.13%。
AI.conclusion: 方法排序随证据类型而变，且证据召回与下游准确率排序并不一致；表明仅以证据召回衡量上下文选择不足，需结合下游阅读器评估。

title: Is Persona Generalization Predictable?
summary: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示人格泛化存在"on-the-line"现象：域内与域外人格率在不同超参数下呈近似的probit线性关系，且该线性关系跨模型家族与规模（Qwen、Llama）出人意料地共享；仅改变可训练参数集合（如微调层）会改变斜率，据此可预测并控制行为迁移。
AI.motivation: 人格泛化（如涌现性失准）是微调带来的跨域行为变化，但其定量规律不明，现有观察多呈孤立、意外的个案，缺乏可预测、可控制行为迁移的框架。
AI.method: 在多种微调超参数下测量域内与域外人格率，检验二者的probit线性关系及跨模型家族/规模的共享性；区分两类干预：不改变可训练参数集合的（学习率、权重衰减、训练时长）与改变可训练层的，比较其对斜率的影响。
AI.result: 域内与域外人格率遵循近似probit线性关系，且该关系跨Qwen、Llama等模型家族与规模共享。不改变可训练参数集合的超参数主要使模型沿同一直线移动，主要通过削弱域内学习来降低迁移；改变微调层则会改变斜率——仅微调后层得到更浅斜率，在保持强域内学习的同时减少域外失准。
AI.conclusion: "on-the-line"现象将孤立的人格泛化观察统一到定量框架中，为预测与控制行为迁移提供了依据，并提示微调层选择是解耦域内性能与域外行为迁移的关键杠杆。

title: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
summary: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出基于大语言模型的通用AutoML框架，通过统一数值编码NCode将架构、训练超参数与数据配比联合优化，首次实现跨任务、跨模态与大规模Diffusion Transformer的联合搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有AutoML框架领域专用，且将模型架构、训练超参数与数据比例优化彼此割裂；人工调参成本高。作者希望构建无需任务特定微调的通用、可扩展AutoML方案。
AI.method: 提出NCode统一数值编码，把多样的AutoML设计选择映射为通用离散序列，将优化过程重构为统一的排序（ranking）任务；仅用单一领域视觉任务的优化轨迹训练LLM搜索器，并借助强化学习引入思维链（CoT）推理以增强可解释性。
AI.result: 在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证与文本到图像等基准上取得SOTA；在十亿参数Diffusion Transformer的大规模联合优化中，仅用896 GPU-days即达到GenEval 0.91的SOTA成绩；展现出跨任务、跨模态与联合搜索空间的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为通用开放世界机器学习优化提供了可扩展、可泛化且可解释的路径；分析显示搜索策略由早期多样性驱动的探索转向后期锚点利用。

title: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
summary: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT

AI.tldr: 提出PORT，一种基于token级重加权的细粒度鲁棒偏好优化框架，用log概率经验CDF做仅前向的梯度范数惩罚代理，抑制噪声token。
AI.motivation: 偏好优化效果高度依赖标注质量，实际数据因标注错误与歧义而存在噪声；现有鲁棒方法在序列级处理，将整条回复统一视为对或错，但被拒回复可能含有效推理步骤，被选回复也可能有细微错误。
AI.method: PORT在token级重加权：利用token对数概率的经验累积分布函数(CDF)构造权重，作为梯度范数惩罚的高效前向传播代理，无需额外反向传播即可选择性抑制被污染的token；并给出理论分析，证明PORT通过最小化偏置项上界来降低噪声偏好标签带来的梯度偏置。
AI.result: 在多种噪声设置下的大量实验表明，PORT持续提升鲁棒性并优于现有序列级基线。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度token级重加权是应对噪声偏好标注的有效方向，PORT以低成本实现鲁棒对齐，并提供理论保证与实验验证，代码已开源。

title: A Lattice-Based HMM Approach to Aruz Scansion of Ottoman Poetry
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/MehmetETiryaki/aruz-paper. Web tool: https://mehmetemretiryaki.com/aruz
summary: Ottoman Divan poetry is composed in aruz, a quantitative meter based on the weights of syllables. The meter is sensitive to specific characters recorded in the original writing in the Arabic script. This work is concerned with automatic meter finding and scansion alignment for Ottoman Divan poetry, especially on modern Turkish spelling without the special diacritics that scholarly transliterations of Ottoman preserve. We define two tasks on this input, first identifying the meter used in the poem, and second aligning the meter's weights with the syllabification of the poem, identifying the flaws and freedoms the poet has taken along the way. We build a corpus of 52,000 lines split by poet, with scansion annotations for 500 test lines, and a robustness benchmark generated at the deviation rates measured on real web and OCR copies. Our model is a hidden Markov model over the positions of each meter, decoded over a lattice of every candidate path, and trained by EM from the printed meter, without scansion labels. On a held-out set it scans 77.6% of the test lines fully correctly, against 26.8% for the available rule-based scanner, 55.0% for a neural tagger trained with the same supervision and 63.6% for Claude Opus 5.5 few-shot. The code is open-sourced and the tool is released on the web.

AI.tldr: 本文研究奥斯曼迪万诗歌的自动格律识别与韵律对齐，针对缺少特殊变音符号的现代土耳其语拼写，构建约52,000行语料与鲁棒性基准，提出基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的方法，在无需韵律标注的情况下用EM从印刷格律训练，整行完全正确率达77.6%。
AI.motivation: 奥斯曼迪万诗歌采用基于音节轻重的阿鲁兹（aruz）格律，其判定依赖阿拉伯字母原写中记录的特定字符；而现代土耳其语拼写丢失了学术转写中保留的特殊变音符号，使自动格律识别与韵律对齐变得困难，且缺乏带标注的评测资源。
AI.method: 定义两项任务：识别诗作所用格律，以及将格律的音节权重与诗行音节化对齐并标识诗人的破格与自由。构建按诗人划分的52,000行语料，含500行测试集的韵律标注，并按真实网页与OCR副本实测的偏差率生成鲁棒性基准。模型为在每种格律各位置上建模的隐马尔可夫模型，在全部候选路径构成的格上解码，仅以印刷格律为监督、通过EM训练，无需韵律标注。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上，本方法整行完全正确扫描率为77.6%，显著优于规则扫描器的26.8%、同等监督下训练的神经标注器的55.0%，以及Claude Opus 5.5少样本的63.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将格律计量建模为HMM并用EM从印刷格律弱监督训练，可有效处理现代拼写且无变音符号的奥斯曼诗歌，性能大幅领先规则法与神经基线；代码开源，工具已上线发布。

title: Language Defaults Before Content: A Causal Layer Map of Multilingual Generation
summary: Multilingual generation requires large language models (LLMs) to determine both what to say and in what language to say it, yet these two commitments are difficult to disentangle from model outputs alone. We use translation as a controlled probe: for multi-parallel segments that a model translates well in one language direction but poorly in another, content is held fixed while language varies. Using activation patching, we write residual-stream states from successful runs into failing ones and compare content-matched states with content-independent controls, allowing us to trace content-specific and language-related signals across layers. Across three LLMs of different scales and architectures, we find a consistent three-stage pattern of multilingual generation. Intermediate layers first express a default English signal; content information becomes causally available one layer later; and the final target language is resolved only at later layers. The ordering of the English default before content also appears in a reading-comprehension task. Our sparse autoencoder analyses reveal a further dissociation: the intermediate language signal is only weakly represented by sparse features, whereas a later language distinction is clearly sparse, but resists intervention at the patched position. These results provide a mechanistic account of how language selection and content information emerge and interact during multilingual generation.

AI.tldr: 通过翻译作为受控探针，结合激活修补与稀疏自编码器分析，揭示多语言生成中"语言选择"与"内容信息"在三阶段中分离涌现的机制。
AI.motivation: 多语言生成需LLM同时决定"说什么"与"用什么语言说"，但仅从输出难以解耦这两种承诺。作者希望分离内容信号与语言信号，刻画它们在不同层中的因果作用与时序关系。
AI.method: 以翻译为受控探针：选取模型单向翻译良好、反向较差的多平行语段，实现"内容固定、语言变化"。用激活修补（activation patching）将成功运行的残差流状态写入失败运行，并与内容无关的对照比较，追踪内容特异与语言相关信号在各层的分布；辅以稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征分析。
AI.result: 在三种不同规模与架构的LLM中一致发现三阶段模式：中间层先表达默认英语信号；内容信息在晚一层变为因果可用；目标语言仅在更后层才被确定。"英语默认先于内容"的顺序在阅读理解任务中亦出现。SAE揭示进一步解离：中间语言信号仅被稀疏特征弱表示，而后期的语言区分清晰稀疏，却难以在被修补位置干预。
AI.conclusion: 该研究给出多语言生成中语言选择与内容信息如何涌现并交互的机制性解释，表明二者在层级上可分离且时序有序，为理解与调控多语言模型内部处理提供了因果证据。

title: Can Frontier Auto Researchers Reconstruct Human Research Decisions in AI?
summary: Scientific research has long been driven by substantial human effort, from reviewing prior work and identifying research gaps to designing specific solutions. Recent advances in harness-based agent systems have given rise to increasingly capable Auto Researchers, which can autonomously carry out these tasks and, increasingly, entire end-to-end research workflows. Yet despite their rapidly growing capabilities, how closely the research decisions and outputs produced by auto researchers align with those of human experts remains underexplored. We investigate this gap through the lens of research reconstruction and study: Given comparable research context, how similar are the research decisions and outputs produced by Auto Researchers to those of human researchers in AI research? To answer this question, we introduce AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity (AutoHRS), a stage-wise evaluation framework for assessing how faithfully auto researchers reconstruct human research artifacts across different stages of the scientific workflow. Using 152 ICLR oral papers as our corpus, we generate 456 research trajectories spanning different stages of the research process. Applying AutoHRS to these trajectories, we find that current Auto Researchers frequently fail to recover key research decisions and their resulting artifacts across multiple stages of the research process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AutoHRS 框架，从「研究重建」视角分阶段评测 Auto Researcher 的研究决策与产出与人类专家的相似度，基于 152 篇 ICLR oral 论文生成 456 条轨迹，发现当前 Auto Researcher 在多阶段难以复原关键研究决策及其产物。
AI.motivation: 基于 harness 的 agent 系统使 Auto Researcher 能力快速增强，甚至可端到端完成科研流程；但其研究决策与产出在多大程度上与人类专家一致仍缺乏系统考察，亟需量化这一对齐差距。
AI.method: 提出 AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity（AutoHRS）分阶段评测框架：给定可比研究背景，评估 Auto Researcher 在科学工作流各阶段重建人类研究产物的忠实程度；以 152 篇 ICLR oral 论文为语料，构建 456 条覆盖不同研究阶段的轨迹并进行评测。
AI.result: AutoHRS 评测显示，当前 Auto Researcher 在研究流程的多个阶段经常无法复现关键研究决策及其对应产物。
AI.conclusion: Auto Researcher 与人类研究者在研究决策和产出上仍存在显著差距；分阶段重建式评测可作为衡量二者对齐程度的有效手段，并为后续改进提供依据。

title: MNN-Pocket-0.3B Technical Report
summary: This technical report presents MNN-Pocket-0.3B, a compact 300M-parameter dense language model designed for efficient on-device deployment and supporting context lengths of up to 32K tokens. With an INT4 deployment footprint of only 173 MB and decoding throughput of up to 466 tokens/s on iPad Pro M5 (Metal), it can be seamlessly integrated into applications on edge devices such as smartphones and smart glasses. MNN-Pocket-0.3B is developed through the co-design of its architecture, data, training pipeline, and inference system. Hardware-aware architecture selection and dependency-aware vocabulary pruning balance model capability with on-device memory and compute constraints. A four-stage pre-training pipeline covering approximately 4.1 trillion high-quality Chinese and English tokens equips the model with broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities. This is followed by a three-stage post-training pipeline comprising instruction fine-tuning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and quantization-aware training. Finally, hardware-specific optimizations in the MNN inference engine enable fast, memory-efficient inference and long-context processing. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MNN-Pocket-0.3B achieves frontier-level performance among models of comparable size, with particularly strong results in Chinese and English knowledge and reasoning, mathematics, coding, and instruction following. It consistently outperforms similarly sized open-source models and even surpasses several 0.5B-parameter models on instruction-following benchmarks. We release MNN-Pocket-0.3B with open weights and ready-to-use MNN deployment packages. We hope it will provide a practical foundation for capable, responsive, and memory-efficient edge applications while advancing research and development in on-device language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MNN-Pocket-0.3B：一个面向端侧部署的 300M 参数稠密语言模型，支持 32K 上下文，INT4 部署仅占 173 MB，在 iPad Pro M5 上解码速度达 466 tokens/s，并以架构-数据-训练-推理协同设计在多类基准上取得同规模最优表现。
AI.motivation: 端侧设备（手机、智能眼镜）对内存、算力与延迟约束极严，而现有开源小模型往往未针对硬件协同优化，难以同时兼顾能力、上下文长度与部署效率，因此需要一个在极小参数规模下仍具备知识、推理与长上下文能力的可部署模型。
AI.method: 采用架构、数据、训练管线与推理系统的协同设计：硬件感知的架构选型与依赖感知的词表剪枝以平衡能力与端侧内存/算力；约 4.1 万亿中英高质量 token 的四阶段预训练；三阶段后训练（指令微调、多教师 on-policy 蒸馏、量化感知训练）；并在 MNN 推理引擎中做硬件特化优化以支持高效推理与长上下文。
AI.result: INT4 部署占用 173 MB，iPad Pro M5（Metal）上解码吞吐最高 466 tokens/s；在同规模模型中达到前沿水平，在中英文知识与推理、数学、代码、指令遵循上表现突出，稳定优于同尺寸开源模型，并在指令遵循基准上超过部分 0.5B 模型。
AI.conclusion: MNN-Pocket-0.3B 以开放权重和即用型 MNN 部署包发布，为端侧语言模型提供了兼顾能力、响应速度与内存效率的实用基础，并可推动端侧 LLM 的研究与开发。

title: The Deception Archive as a repository of standardized datasets for large-scale verbal deception detection research
summary: Computational advances in natural language processing and machine learning have substantially expanded the use of automated approaches in verbal deception research. However, existing verbal deception datasets remain fragmented across disciplines, as they are often difficult to identify, access, and reuse, limiting cross-study comparisons and the development of robust computational models. We present the Deception Archive, a curated and standardized repository of publicly available verbal deception datasets built upon a large-scale systematic review. Eligible datasets were retrieved, manually inspected, and standardized following a structured data curation workflow. The current repository comprises 41 publicly available datasets containing 387,995 truthful or deceptive statements. The archive represents a heterogeneous repository (e.g., in data size, topic of investigation, ground-truth, etc.) and a living resource for integrating newly available deception datasets over time. By providing centralized access to standardized datasets and accompanying metadata, the Deception Archive facilitates dataset discovery, cross-dataset validation, and reproducible evaluation of computational models.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍"Deception Archive"，一个基于大规模系统综述构建的、标准化且公开可用的言语欺骗数据集repository，目前含41个数据集、387,995条真实或欺骗性陈述。
AI.motivation: NLP与机器学习进展推动了言语欺骗研究的自动化，但既有数据集分散于各学科，难以识别、获取与复用，阻碍跨研究比较与稳健计算模型的开发。
AI.method: 基于大规模系统综述检索合格数据集，人工检查并依照结构化数据策管（curation）流程进行标准化，构建集中化、带元数据的存储库。
AI.result: 构建包含41个公开数据集、共387,995条真实/欺骗性陈述的仓库；数据集在规模、研究主题、ground-truth等方面高度异质；仓库为可持续整合新数据集的living resource。
AI.conclusion: 通过集中提供标准化数据集及元数据，Deception Archive支持数据集发现、跨数据集验证与计算模型的可复现评估。

title: SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track
summary: Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.

AI.tldr: 提出 SituRecBench，一个在高保真 3D 环境中评估前沿视觉-语言模型作为"情境化推荐助手"的交互式基准，将推荐重构为共享用户第一人称视角下的情境辅助过程。
AI.motivation: 现有研究忽视空间导航、视觉 grounding 与多轮社交交互三者叠加的复杂性；推荐系统正从静态检索转向物理环境中的交互式助手，缺乏相应评测手段。
AI.method: 构建基于高保真 3D 仿真环境（超市、家居店）的交互式基准；助手与用户共享自我中心视角，需通过对话引导偏好、将推荐 grounding 到环境中并导航指引用户至目标位置；采用统一交互协议同时评测对话质量、推荐效用与导航有效性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明前沿 VLM 在空间 grounding 与偏好引导上仍存在持续挑战，突出表现为难以将全局上下文信息与局部观测有效整合。
AI.conclusion: SituRecBench 为真实世界中情境化推荐助手的发展提供了严谨的评测基础。

title: Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (E&D). Code and dataset: https://kurbanintelligencelab.github.io/perception-not-reasoning/
summary: Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张视觉心智理论（ToM）的主要瓶颈是感知前端而非信念推理本身，并通过五条件解离协议与"感知贡献比"量化，证明结构化视觉场景状态提取才是主导瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在文本版错误信念任务上接近人类水平，但同一问题以视觉形式呈现时性能下降超20个百分点。学界主流诊断是概念性的，主张新增信念推理模块；作者认为主导瓶颈是感知性的——不是模型无法推理，而是它"看不见"。
AI.method: 提出五条件解离协议：保持推理任务不变，仅改变感知保真度，从纯视觉到纯文本共五级；用"感知贡献比"（Perceptual Contribution Ratio）量化各级保真度所弥合的视觉—文本差距份额。场景覆盖两类：Heider–Simmel 传统的抽象2D面板，以及 MuMA-ToM 与 MindPower 的自然主义3D游戏场景。评测7个VLM、约15.9万次API调用，对比真实标注脚手架与自动解析器（含前沿VLM）构建的脚手架。
AI.result: 真实标注脚手架在所有设置中显著缩小差距，在抽象面板与 MuMA-ToM 上达到或超过纯文本推理；而自动解析器（包括前沿VLM）构建的脚手架均失败。纯视觉条件下最常见的错误是"现实偏差"（reality bias），占错误信念失败的60%——模型报告物体实际所在位置，而非缺席主体所相信的位置。
AI.conclusion: 感知前端未能追踪各时刻哪些主体在场，是核心缺陷。在该协议下，结构化视觉场景状态提取（而非信念推断）是视觉ToM的主导瓶颈；改进方向应聚焦感知层面的场景状态建模，而非新增概念性推理模块。

title: When Are Nearby Experts Composable? Cross-Task Model Merging in Neural Thickets
summary: Random perturbations around a shared checkpoint can produce experts for distinct tasks, but shared origin does not ensure that their gains survive composition. We formulate expert-pair selection for joint base-relative retention, measured by strict joint success and worst-task gain with unconditional abstention accounting. An exact finite-difference decomposition and an arbitrarily small orthogonal counterexample show why proximity and orthogonality alone are insufficient. We instantiate this formulation with quality-constrained spectral selection, a fixed-budget framework combining cross-task screening, layerwise pair geometry, separate validation, and Base fallback. Across six checkpoints, 21 task pairs, and five independent perturbation pools, the procedure improves strict joint success over Top-1 averaging throughout and leads the four-method model-scale comparison on four of six checkpoints. For the five models with at least 1.5B parameters, matched quality-only, global-cosine, and spectral ranking attain 49.1%, 50.5%, and 53.1% joint success. Under this matched protocol, the spectral selector also yields the highest worst-task gain and Weak Pareto rate and the lowest regression rate. Mean worst-task gain reaches +0.61 percentage points, while 17.1% regression and 13.0% abstention show that composability remains conditional. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"共享checkpoint随机扰动得到不同任务专家"的可组合性问题，提出以严格联合成功率和最差任务增益度量专家对选择，并给出质量约束的谱选择框架。
AI.motivation: 共享起点（同一checkpoint）虽能产生各自任务上的专家，但共享来源并不保证组合后收益仍成立；仅凭参数邻近性（proximity）或正交性（orthogonality）不足以筛选出可组合的专家对，需要新的形式化选择准则。
AI.method: 将专家对选择形式化为联合基相对保留（joint base-relative retention）问题，采用严格联合成功与最差任务增益作为指标并计入无条件弃权；用精确有限差分分解与任意小的正交反例说明邻近性与正交性均不充分；据此提出固定预算的"质量约束谱选择"框架，含跨任务筛选、逐层对几何分析、独立验证与Base回退。
AI.result: 在6个checkpoint、21个任务对、5个独立扰动池上，严格联合成功率持续优于Top-1平均；在6个checkpoint中的4个上领先四方法模型规模对比。≥1.5B参数的五个模型上，仅质量、全局余弦、谱排序的联合成功率分别为49.1%、50.5%、53.1%；谱选择器的最差任务增益与Weak Pareto率最高、回归率最低，平均最差任务增益+0.61个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 谱选择在固定预算下能提升专家对的可组合性，但17.1%的回归率与13.0%的弃权率表明可组合性仍是条件性的，并非稳健保证。

title: Safeguarding Agentic AI in Radiology Workflows: A Multimodel Evaluation of Rule-based and Large Language Model-based Verification
comment: 43 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables, supplementary material included. Tobias Penzkofer and Jawed Nawabi share last authorship. Code: https://github.com/ibrarad/radiology-agent-safeguards
summary:
Purpose: To estimate how often tool-using large language model (LLM) agents record clinically relevant false or unsupported information in simulated radiology documentation and how much safeguards applied before each action reduce these errors.
  Materials and Methods: In this simulation study (October 2026), 48 synthetic, radiologist-reviewed base scenarios covered finding communication, tumor board preparation and follow-up management. Forty-three also had a misleading-information variant (91 variants). Six LLM agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B) completed each variant with permissions only, deterministic rules, and rules plus a locally run LLM checker (1638 episodes). The primary outcome was at least one executed high-severity violation per episode. Risk differences were estimated per agent at base-scenario level and, exploratorily, pooled across agents, with analyses of document access and blocks.
  Results: With permissions only, 7.3%-27.1% of episodes had a high-severity violation (pooled across agents, 19.4%). Pooled, it was 16.7% with rules (-2.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -6.1, 0.5) and 13.2% with rules plus the LLM checker (-6.2; 95% CI: -9.5, -3.0). Adding the LLM checker to rules changed it by -3.5 (95% CI: -6.3, -0.7). No difference between agents was detected (P = .43), and task success did not decrease detectably. In misleading variants, agents opened the altered document in 83% of episodes regardless of error, and 58% of erroneous statements cited it. Most blocked actions (64%-68%) would not have caused a violation and were returned for revision.
  Conclusion: Layered safeguards reduced but did not prevent high-severity errors. Errors after misleading information reflected misjudged rather than missed information.

AI.tldr: 在放射学文档模拟场景中，工具型LLM智能体在仅有权限时高严重度错误发生率为7.3%–27.1%（合并19.4%），叠加规则与本地LLM核查器可分别降低2.8和6.2个百分点，但无法消除错误；误导信息下的错误源于判断失误而非信息遗漏。
AI.motivation: 评估工具型LLM智能体在模拟放射学文书工作中记录临床相关虚假或无依据信息的频率，并量化每步操作前部署的防护措施对这类错误的削减效果。
AI.method: 模拟研究：48个经放射科医师审核的合成基础场景（涵盖所见沟通、肿瘤委员会准备、随访管理），其中43个另设误导信息变体（共91个变体）。6个LLM智能体（Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1-Sol、GLM-5.3、MiniMax M3、Gemma-4-31B、Qwen3.8-27B）在三种权限设置下完成每个变体：仅权限、确定性规则、规则+本地运行的LLM核查器，共1638个episode。主要结局为每个episode至少发生一次已执行的高严重度违规；按智能体在基础场景层面估计风险差，并探索性合并分析，另分析文档访问与拦截情况。
AI.result: 仅权限下7.3%–27.1%的episode出现高严重度违规（合并19.4%）；合并后规则组为16.7%（-2.8个百分点；95% CI：-6.1, 0.5），规则+LLM核查器组为13.2%（-6.2；95% CI：-9.5, -3.0）；在规则基础上增加LLM核查器变化为-3.5（95% CI：-6.3, -0.7）。未检出智能体间差异（P = .43），任务成功率未见明显下降。误导变体中，83%的episode打开了被篡改文档（无论是否出错），58%的错误陈述引用了该文档。被拦截的操作中64%–68%本不会导致违规，均被退回修改。
AI.conclusion: 分层防护降低了但未能杜绝高严重度错误；误导信息之后的错误反映的是判断失误，而非信息未被检索到。

title: Prune, Don't Merge: Expert Compression of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs on Multilingual Production Tasks
summary: Mixture-of-Experts language models are cheap to run per token but expensive to hold in GPU memory, which drives the cost of serving them in production. One-shot expert compression shrinks them after a single calibration pass. Its two current state-of-the-art methods are REAP for expert pruning, which deletes the least salient experts, and REAM for expert merging, which merges them into the most salient ones. Both have been evaluated only on academic benchmarks. We compare the two on five multilingual production tasks of a web-hosting company, from classification to the generation of marketing HTML email templates, with two 30B-parameter models (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 and the hybrid Mamba-attention Nemotron-3.5-Lightning) at 25% and 50% of experts removed and the same calibration data. Pruning wins: on the same rows, REAP is significantly better in 16 of 20 comparisons and REAM in 2. At 25%, REAP keeps 93.6% of Qwen3-30B's generative quality and REAM 62.5%, although on benchmarks the two are within a point for the same model. The damage concentrates in the output contract rather than the content: 89.8-95.2% of each significant loss on email templates comes from hard-gate failures such as invalid JSON, broken mobile layouts and runaway generation, and most failed non-English domain descriptions copy the prompt's English opening phrase. Cross-perplexity and logit divergence, two diagnostics from the REAP paper, also track production quality, as does the rate of repetition loops; n-gram diversity does not. We close with practical guidance for compressing MoE models for production.

AI.tldr: 在生产环境的五个多语言任务上对比一次性 MoE 专家剪枝（REAP）与专家合并（REAM）：剪枝显著更优，20 次对比中 16 次优于合并，25% 剪枝率下保留 Qwen3-30B 93.6% 生成质量而合并仅 62.5%；性能损失主要来自输出契约失效（JSON 非法、移动端布局损坏、生成失控）而非内容质量。
AI.motivation: MoE 语言模型单 token 推理成本低，但显存占用高，导致生产部署成本高。现有两种单次校准即完成的最先进专家压缩方法——REAP（专家剪枝）与 REAM（专家合并）——此前仅在校学术基准上评测，缺乏在真实生产任务上的可靠性证据，作者因此需要在工业场景中比较二者并给出实践指导。
AI.method: 在一家网络托管公司的五个生产任务（从分类到营销 HTML 邮件模板生成）上，使用两个 30B 参数 MoE 模型（Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 与混合 Mamba-attention 的 Nemotron-3.5-Lightning），在专家移除率 25% 与 50%、相同校准数据条件下，对 REAP（删除最不显著的专家）与 REAM（将不显著专家合并进最显著专家）进行同条件对比；并分析损失来源及跨困惑度、logit 散度、重复循环率、n-gram 多样性等诊断指标与生产质量的相关性。
AI.result: 剪枝占优：相同数据行上 REAP 在 20 次对比中 16 次显著更优，REAM 仅 2 次。25% 剪枝率下，REAP 保留 Qwen3-30B 生成质量的 93.6%，REAM 仅 62.5%，而基准测试上二者差距不足 1 分。损失集中于输出契约而非内容：邮件模板任务中每次显著损失的 89.8%–95.2% 来自硬性门控失败（非法 JSON、移动端布局错乱、生成失控），且多数失败的非英语领域描述会照抄提示词的英文开头短语。跨困惑度、logit 散度及重复循环率能追踪生产质量，n-gram 多样性则不能。
AI.conclusion: 在真实生产任务上，一次性专家剪枝（REAP）显著优于专家合并（REAM），且学术基准的接近表现会掩盖生产质量上的巨大差距；应以结构化输出合规性等硬约束指标作为主要评测口径，并以跨困惑度、logit 散度、重复循环率作为可用诊断信号（n-gram 多样性不适用）。论文最后给出面向生产压缩 MoE 模型的实践指导。

title: OGDA: Ontology-Grounded Data Agents for Reliable Analysis over Heterogeneous Data Lakes
summary: Full-pipeline data analysis over real-world data lakes requires LLM agents to locate and integrate information across large collections of tables with different schemas. Existing data agents follow task-specific exploration, which exhausts the context window in massive lakes. As the context fills, the agent's reasoning degrades, leading it to locate and process incorrect data files. These errors propagate into the final answer. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Ontology-Grounded Data Agent (OGDA), which utilizes a compact ontology to reduce exploration overhead and constrain data processing. OGDA constructs the ontology through agentic hypothesis testing. At each step, a proposer agent induces schemas, concepts, and relations from raw sources, and a verifier checks each proposal against the underlying data. During task execution, the ontology serves as a representation of the data lake for the agent to explore. Every data-processing action is constrained by a task graph, which the agent can extend only after observing the semantic meaning of the data. Across KramaBench and DiscoveryBench with three LLM backbones, OGDA outperforms the strongest baselines by up to 10.82 points. These results suggest that explicitly modeling the data lake is a key step toward reliable end-to-end data agents.

AI.tldr: OGDA 通过构建紧凑本体来约束数据湖探索与处理，在 KramaBench 和 DiscoveryBench 上较最强基线最高提升 10.82 分。
AI.motivation: 真实数据湖包含大量异构 schema 的表，现有数据智能体采用任务特定的探索方式，会耗尽上下文窗口；随上下文填满，推理能力退化，导致定位与处理错误文件，并将错误传播到最终答案。
AI.method: 提出 Ontology-Grounded Data Agent（OGDA）：以智能体式假设检验构建紧凑本体——proposer 智能体从原始数据源归纳 schema、概念与关系，verifier 对每个提案基于底层数据进行校验；任务执行时本体作为数据湖的表示供智能体探索，每个数据处理动作受任务图约束，智能体仅在观测到数据语义后才能扩展该图。
AI.result: 在 KramaBench 与 DiscoveryBench 上，使用三种 LLM 骨干模型，OGDA 相较最强基线最高提升 10.82 分。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模数据湖是实现可靠端到端数据智能体的关键一步。

title: Detecting AI-Authored Text in Authentic Student Writing: Evidence from PISA 2025
summary: AI-text detectors reach near-perfect scores in evaluations that contrast fully human-written texts with texts generated from researcher-designed prompts. In authentic student writing, however, AI use is voluntary and often partial. We study this setting with the PISA 2025 FLA dataset, in which 15-year-olds in Germany wrote English argumentative essays with and without access to a gpt-4o-mini-based chatbot. Keystroke, clipboard and chat logs let us trace every character of the final essay to its origin. From this provenance, we derive text- and sentence-level labels for human-written, AI-generated and mixed text, and for text written after chatbot use without traceable AI material. We evaluate a feature-based detector and a classifier on frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings, both adapted from top-ranked shared-task systems. Both separate AI from human text reliably (macro-F1 up to 0.96 for texts and 0.95 for sentences), independently of spelling errors. The feature-based detector, however, relies on lexical complexity, which a simple student-style rewriting prompt removes (AI recall 0.92 $\to$ 0.60 with gpt-4o-mini, 0.41 with Qwen3). The embedding-based detector stays robust for whole texts (AI recall $\geq$ 0.94) but not for single sentences (AI recall as low as 0.59). Mixed text falls between the two classes, and text without traceable AI material is classified as human-written in about 95\% of texts.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于 PISA 2025 FLA 数据集，利用击键、剪贴板与聊天日志对德国 15 岁学生英语议论文中每个字符溯源，构建文本级与句级的人类/AI/混合标签，评估两类主流检测器在真实自愿、部分使用 AI 场景下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 文本检测器多在"全人类文本 vs 研究者设定提示生成文本"的对比评测中接近满分，但真实学生写作中 AI 使用是自愿且常常部分的，这一设定下检测器的有效性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用 PISA 2025 FLA 数据集（德国 15 岁学生借助 gpt-4o-mini 聊天机器人撰写英语议论文），通过击键、剪贴板与聊天日志进行字符级溯源，派生文本级和句级的人类撰写、AI 生成、混合文本及"使用聊天后无可追溯 AI 材料"四类标签；评测两类源自顶尖共享任务系统的检测器：基于特征的检测器与基于冻结 Llama-3.1-8B 嵌入的分类器。
AI.result: 两类检测器均能可靠区分 AI 与人类文本（文本级 macro-F1 最高 0.96，句级 0.95），且不受拼写错误影响。但基于特征的检测器依赖词汇复杂度，简单的"学生风格改写"提示即可使其失效（gpt-4o-mini 下 AI 召回从 0.92 降至 0.60，Qwen3 下降至 0.41）。嵌入检测器在整篇文本上保持稳健（AI 召回 ≥ 0.94），但在句级失效（召回低至 0.59）。混合文本介于两类之间；无可追溯 AI 材料的文本约 95% 被判为人类撰写。
AI.conclusion: 在真实、部分 AI 使用场景下，整篇文本级检测仍较可靠，但句级检测与基于特征的方法对改写攻击脆弱；混合写作与"无痕 AI 辅助"进一步模糊了二分类边界，说明现有检测器评测范式高估了实际鲁棒性。

title: More Than Just Style: Benchmarking Personality Influence in Large Language Models
summary: In addition to the effects of explicit input prompts and instructions, large language model outputs are influenced by underlying behavioral preferences similar to human personality tendencies. These tendencies can affect how models interpret situations and make decisions. However, their influence is difficult to disentangle from the effects of model capabilities and instructions. Therefore, we introduce SPACE, a benchmark framework combining a controlled evaluation protocol with complementary datasets for personality verification, capability assessment, and hierarchical situational tasks. Controlled comparisons across guidance conditions help distinguish personality influence from measured capability changes and immediate instruction effects. Experimental results demonstrate that although prompting can shift generation style, models' internal personality tendencies are persistent and not readily overridden by opposing instructions. Furthermore, these underlying tendencies have an observable influence on LLM task performance, highlighting the need for greater attention to these characteristics and potential applications. Training code and SPACE benchmark specifications are available at https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training.

AI.tldr: 提出SPACE基准框架，通过受控评估协议与人格验证、能力评估、分层情境任务数据集，将LLM的"人格倾向"影响与能力变化和即时指令效应解耦；结果表明人格倾向具有持续性、难以被反向指令覆盖，且对任务表现有可观测影响。
AI.motivation: LLM输出除受显式提示与指令影响外，还受类似人类人格倾向的底层行为偏好影响，但这些倾向的作用难以与模型能力和指令效应区分开，因此需要一个能解耦三者影响的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出SPACE基准：由受控评估协议与三套互补数据集（人格验证、能力评估、分层情境任务）组成；通过跨多种引导条件的受控对比，分离人格影响、可测能力变化与即时指令效应。
AI.result: 提示工程可改变生成风格，但模型内部人格倾向持续存在、不易被相反指令覆盖；这些底层倾向对LLM任务表现具有可观测影响。
AI.conclusion: LLM的底层人格倾向是稳定且具行为后果的特性，应给予更多关注并探索其潜在应用；训练代码与基准规范已开源。

title: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people seek and consume information, including accounts that differ across languages and regions, especially on contested topics. Supporting diverse information seeking requires models to help users navigate competing narratives across languages and information streams. We define six capabilities necessary for diverse multilingual information seeking: three foundational capabilities for narrative inclusion, narrative exclusion, and missing narrative identification; and three higher-level capabilities for presenting diverse narratives, preserving narrative coverage under confirmatory queries, and maintaining information parity across languages. To guide the development of those information seeking capabilities, we introduce \textsc{NarrativeBench}, a benchmark comprising 1,333 news articles in 23 publication languages across 23 contested topics and 460 Reddit-grounded queries. Evaluating 14 LLMs across 24 query languages, we find that current models lack the capabilities needed to reliably navigate diverse narratives, limiting users' control over the perspectives they receive and leaving substantial gaps in exposure to competing accounts even when diversity is explicitly requested. Information access also differs across query framings and languages, risking echo chambers, linguistic filter bubbles, and information disparities that weaken the common ground needed for democratic discourse. \textsc{NarrativeBench} provides a foundation for developing information systems that give users across languages and regions agency to navigate diverse narratives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NarrativeBench 基准（23 种出版语言、23 个争议话题、1,333 篇新闻、460 条 Reddit 真实查询），界定多语言信息获取的六项能力，评测 14 个 LLM 在 24 种查询语言下的表现，发现模型普遍无法可靠呈现和均衡覆盖多元叙事。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益成为人们获取信息的中介，而不同语言与地区的信息源对争议话题存在竞争性叙事。用户需要模型帮助其跨语言、跨信息流地理解多元视角，但现有模型与评测缺乏针对此类能力的系统框架与度量手段，可能导致回声室、语言过滤气泡与信息不平等，削弱公共讨论的共同基础。
AI.method: 1) 将"多元多语言信息获取"拆解为六项能力：三项基础能力（叙事纳入 narrative inclusion、叙事排除 narrative exclusion、缺失叙事识别 missing narrative identification）与三项高阶能力（呈现多元叙事、在确认性查询下保持叙事覆盖、跨语言信息对等）。2) 构建 NarrativeBench：覆盖 23 个争议话题、23 种出版语言的 1,333 篇新闻文章及 460 条基于 Reddit 的真实查询。3) 对 14 个 LLM 在 24 种查询语言下进行评测，并按查询措辞框架与语言做对比分析。
AI.result: 现有模型普遍缺乏可靠导航多元叙事所需的能力：即使用户显式要求多样性，对竞争性叙事的暴露仍存在显著缺口，用户对所见视角的控制力受限；信息获取结果随查询表述框架和查询语言而变化，存在回声室、语言过滤气泡与跨语言信息差异的风险。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 在多语言、多叙事的信息获取上尚不可靠。NarrativeBench 为研究与开发能够赋予跨语言、跨地区用户叙事导航自主权的信息系统提供了评测基础与能力框架。

title: Unmasking Four Knapsack Problems in the Traveling Thief Benchmark
summary: The traveling thief problem (TTP) asks a thief to choose a tour and a packing together, and the benchmark of 9,720 instances of Polyakovskiy et al. (2014) is the standard test set for comparing TTP heuristics. We show that four of these instances are not TTP instances at all. Their files give a renting rate of 0.00, so the tour has no effect on the objective and each instance reduces to a 0-1 knapsack problem. One of them belongs to the 60 categorized instances on which new methods are usually compared, and on it five of nine published methods report exactly the same value. The cause is the format of the files, which keep the renting rate with two decimals, while the rule of the generator gives a rate close to 0.003 on these instances. The same rounding may shift the rate of 949 other instances by more than 1%. Since the tour and the packing used by the generator were not published, the original rates cannot be recovered. We therefore define new rates with the same rule, applied to a fully specified reference solution that we publish, and we show with a published heuristic that the corrected instances behave as TTP instances again. We also give reference results on the corrected instances and recommendations for future studies. Finally, we present ttplib, a new open-source Python library that loads any of the 9,720 instances, including the corrected ones, without downloading the whole benchmark.

AI.tldr: 论文发现TTP标准基准(Polyakovskiy et al., 2014, 9,720个实例)中4个实例因 renting rate 被文件格式截断为0.00而退化为0-1背包问题，另949个实例的费率误差超1%；作者用可复现参考解重定义费率并发布修正实例、参考结果与开源库ttplib。
AI.motivation: 该基准是TTP启发式比较的标准测试集，若其中实例本身不成立，则相关方法比较与结论的可靠性受到质疑；作者希望揭示数据缺陷的成因并给出可复现的修正方案。
AI.method: 检查9,720个实例文件中的renting rate字段（保留两位小数），识别取值为0.00的实例并分析其退化性质；通过对完全给定的参考解套用原生成器规则重新计算费率；用已发表的启发式算法验证修正后实例的TTP行为，并给出参考结果；同时开发开源Python库ttplib以支持按需加载实例。
AI.result: 4个实例并非真正的TTP实例（tour对目标无影响，等价于0-1背包），其中1个属于常被用于比较新方法的60个分类实例，9个方法中有5个在该实例上报告完全相同的结果；另有949个实例的费率因同一舍入被偏移超1%；原始费率因生成器所用tour与packing未公开而无法恢复。
AI.conclusion: 基准数据存在系统性缺陷，需在比较中谨慎使用；作者提出的修正实例与参考结果可作为后续研究的基础，并给出对未来研究的建议；ttplib提供无需下载完整基准即可加载全部实例（含修正版）的工具支持。

title: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
summary: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Infrathon 基准，用于评估前沿智能体能否在长时程内持续优化真实 AI 基础设施；150 次运行（24 小时预算、超 10,000 GPU 小时）表明模型排名随评估时程变化，且多数运行在预算后半段仍有改进，智能体可超越人工设计基线。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多为短时程，无法判断前沿智能体能否在长时间预算下持续、可信地改进真实 AI 基础设施，可能低估优化收益并误判模型相对能力。
AI.method: 构建 Infrathon：覆盖多个层级、多样化的长时程 AI 基础设施优化任务基准；对 6 个模型执行 150 次运行，每次 24 小时预算（累计 10,000+ GPU 小时）；对比不同评估时程下的模型排名，并分析智能体轨迹以识别改进障碍。
AI.result: 模型排名随评估时程变化；150 次运行中有 135 次在预算后半段继续获得改进；Claude Opus 5.5 将 KV-cache 平均压缩率由人工设计 Quant-VideoGen 编解码器的 6.82% 提升至 19.86%；轨迹分析识别出任务违规、测试不可靠与过早终止三类主要障碍。
AI.conclusion: 短时程评估会同时低估优化增益并扭曲模型相对表现；智能体可发现优于人工基线的方案。Infrathon 为构建长时程任务、评估前沿智能体与发现优质基础设施方案提供资源。

title: Lightfoot: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Exact, Model-Free Document Deletion
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) improves multi-hop question answering, but deployed systems face two costs that research comparisons rarely measure: building the graph, and removing documents from it. We present Lightfoot, a GraphRAG system in which every entity, link, fact and synonym edge is a deterministic function of per-passage extractions carrying chunk-level provenance. Indexing makes one language-model call per passage, retrieval makes none, and deleting a document is a database operation with no model calls. On the full 11,402-passage MuSiQue corpus we verify that, after deleting 10% of the documents, the graph is identical to a fresh index of the surviving documents. We compare Lightfoot with HippoRAG 2, LightRAG and fast-graphrag under identical extraction, answer and embedding models on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA. Lightfoot builds the cheapest index on all three datasets, 26-31% below HippoRAG 2 and 3-6x below LightRAG and fast-graphrag. Against HippoRAG 2 it is significantly better on MuSiQue retrieval (+2.8 points recall@5 and +4.3 recall@10 on a held-out split) and on HotpotQA answers (+7.7 points exact match), and significantly worse on 2WikiMultiHopQA (-3.9 recall@2, -8.4 F1). Deleting the same documents took LightRAG 2,187 model calls and 3.7 hours; fast-graphrag has no deletion path. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/udayallu-ml/Lightfoot-GraphRAG

AI.tldr: Lightfoot：以"逐段落抽取+块级溯源"为确定性函数的GraphRAG系统，索引每段落一次模型调用、检索零调用、删除为纯数据库操作；在MuSiQue上验证删除10%文档后图与重建索引完全一致，索引成本最低（比HippoRAG 2低26-31%，比LightRAG/fast-graphrag低3-6倍），并在部分数据集上取得更好效果。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG研究与比较普遍只关注问答精度，而忽略了两项部署成本：图构建成本与文档删除成本。作者希望提出一个可测量、低成本且支持可验证删除的GraphRAG系统，并在统一模型条件下做公平对比。
AI.method: 将实体、链接、事实、同义边全部设计为"逐段落抽取结果"的确定性函数，并保留chunk级溯源信息。索引阶段每段落仅一次LM调用，检索阶段无模型调用，删除文档转化为数据库操作（无需模型调用）。在MuSiQue（全量11,402段落）、2WikiMultiHopQA、HotpotQA上，与HippoRAG 2、LightRAG、fast-graphrag在相同抽取/作答/嵌入模型下对比。
AI.result: 删除10%文档后，图为与保留文档全新建索引完全一致。索引成本三数据集均为最低：比HippoRAG 2低26-31%，比LightRAG和fast-graphrag低3-6倍。相对HippoRAG 2：MuSiQue检索显著更优（留出集recall@5 +2.8，recall@10 +4.3），HotpotQA答案显著更优（EM +7.7）；但2WikiMultiHopQA显著更差（recall@2 -3.9，F1 -8.4）。删除同样文档：LightRAG需2,187次模型调用、3.7小时；fast-graphrag无删除路径。
AI.conclusion: 确定性与溯源设计使GraphRAG的构建与维护成本显著降低，且删除结果可被严格验证；性能表现具数据集依赖性（MuSiQue、HotpotQA占优，2WikiMultiHopQA落后）。作者呼吁将"建图成本"和"删除成本"纳入GraphRAG的标准化评测指标。

title: HumanSightBench: A Benchmark for Human Visual Perception in MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on knowledge-intensive and reasoning-based vision-language benchmark datasets, but still struggle to solve the visual questions that people can solve easily. Evaluating the differences between MLLMs and human-level visual perception is challenging due to end-to-end evaluation which combines various skills, or because we are uncertain if individual items are valid. Specifically, observed errors may reflect visual perception, language priors, background knowledge, question ambiguity, and underspecified answers. Our guideline for HumanSightBench is that we construct items that are human-easy by construction and model-hard by evaluation. HumanSightBench contains 2,876 visual questions with short answers across 7 top-level perceptual categories and 21 subcategories. We only include items that pass five inclusion gates: question clarity, answer uniqueness, visual grounding, human solvability, and text-only shortcut filtering. According to the protocol, errors are defined as incorrect answers on human-validated visual tasks with the evaluated interface. The inclusion gates are intended to reduce confounds from ambiguity and external knowledge. The best pass@3 score is 65.6% across eight evaluated MLLMs. No evaluated model exceeds 27.5% on Counting. These results identify capability gaps that are hidden by overall scores and can help future training experiments and held-out evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 HumanSightBench：2,876 道人类易解、模型困难的视觉问题基准，含 7 大类 21 子类，经五重纳入门控；八个 MLLM 最高 pass@3 仅 65.6%，Counting 子类均不超 27.5%。
AI.motivation: MLLM 在知识密集与推理型视觉语言基准上表现较强，却在人类轻松可解的视觉问题上失败。端到端评测混合多种能力，且单项有效性不确定，导致观测到的错误难以归因于视觉感知本身（可能源自语言先验、背景知识、问题歧义、答案欠定义等）。因此需要构建"构造上人类简单、评测上模型困难"的基准来干净地暴露感知差距。
AI.method: 构建 HumanSightBench，共 2,876 道短答案视觉问题，覆盖 7 个顶层感知类别、21 个子类。每道题须通过五道纳入门控：问题清晰性、答案唯一性、视觉 grounding、人类可解性、纯文本捷径过滤。错误定义为在人类验证过的视觉任务上、使用所评估接口给出的错误答案；门控旨在削减歧义与外部知识带来的混杂。评测八个 MLLM，指标为 pass@3。
AI.result: 八个被测 MLLM 中最佳 pass@3 为 65.6%；Counting 子类无一模型超过 27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 总体分数掩盖了细粒度的能力缺口；该基准可揭示被平均分隐藏的感知短板，并服务于后续训练实验与留出评测。

title: TrajLift: Lifting Memory Recall Trajectories with Latency-Modulated Heat Diffusion
summary: Verbal memory retrieval carries rich diagnostic information for Alzheimer's disease through the order, hesitation, and categorical organization of recalled words, yet computational modeling of this retrieval process remains largely unexplored. A key challenge is that timing and hierarchical structure are diagnostically entangled: the diagnostic meaning of retrieval timing depends on its hierarchical context. We propose TrajLift, a spectral framework that models verbal recall as timed trajectories on a hierarchical graph. Our central mechanism is latency-modulated heat diffusion on the semantic hierarchy, a unified operator that lifts each recalled word into a representation of both multi-scale hierarchical structure and continuous retrieval timing. Formal analysis shows that the resulting representation is first-order separable into structural and temporal components with spectral selectivity across hierarchical levels. On synthetic benchmarks requiring structure-time interaction, TrajLift stays near-perfect on deep hierarchies where all baselines fail. On real-world clinical data, we show that TrajLift outperforms diverse baselines by jointly modeling timing and semantic structure, with gains that grow as retrieval timing becomes more informative.

AI.tldr: 提出TrajLift谱框架，将言语回忆建模为层级图上的带时间轨迹，用于阿尔茨海默病诊断。
AI.motivation: 言语记忆提取的时序（停顿、时间间隔）与层级结构诊断信息相互纠缠，时序的诊断意义依赖其层级语境，现有计算建模缺乏对此的联合刻画。
AI.method: 在语义层级图上进行延迟调制的热扩散（latency-modulated heat diffusion），作为统一算子将每个回忆词映射为同时编码多尺度层级结构与连续提取时序的表示；理论上证明该表示可一阶分解为结构分量与时序分量，并在各层级上具备谱选择性。
AI.result: 在需要结构-时间交互的合成基准上，深层级场景下TrajLift接近完美而所有基线失效；真实临床数据上优于多种基线，且当提取时序信息量增大时优势扩大。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模时序与语义结构对言语回忆计算建模至关重要，TrajLift提供了具理论保障且实证有效的统一框架。

title: Phrase-Level Speculative Decoding on a Frozen Target
summary:
Speculative decoders raise throughput by banking more target tokens per forward pass, and Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark all do it the same way: more candidates that survive verification. All of them draft in the target's own vocabulary, so one node of the candidate tree is one target token, and the tokenizer makes that unit look like a constant. It is not. BPE's pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned, so no multi-word string can ever become a single token: in Qwen3-4B, "United States of America" is four tokens and no adjacent pair of them exists as one entry, so a phrase is out of reach of any method drafting in the target's vocabulary.
  We change the unit. A small MLP head reads the frozen target's hidden state and predicts a one- to three-word phrase as one entry in a separate draft vocabulary; greedy longest-match expansion maps it back into the target's own tokens, and N candidates are verified in one forward pass behind a prefix-tree mask, so the change is orthogonal to tree depth and width. The target and its tokenizer stay frozen and a candidate is accepted only while it matches the target's own argmax, so the served output is identical to greedy decoding up to floating-point tie-breaking.
  On one A5000 at batch 1, against HuggingFace generate(), a 21.94M head (0.545% of Qwen3-4B) reaches 2.391x on GSM8K, 2.444x on MATH-500 and 1.544x on MT-Bench. Because the head's output layer is one row of 257 parameters per entry, the draft vocabulary size is the parameter budget: an 8,000-entry head is 3.434M parameters, 0.0854% of the target and 64x smaller than EAGLE-3's drafter, and keeps 92.3% of the larger head's GSM8K tokens per pass. With EAGLE-3 run on same prompts and baseline, our 21.94M head is ahead of tree-16 on both maths sets and behind tree-60 on every set.

AI.tldr: 该论文将投机解码的候选单位从"目标词表中的单个token"改变为"以短语为条目的独立草稿词表"，用小型MLP头预测1-3词短语并通过最长匹配展开回目标token，在冻结目标模型与分词器、保证输出与贪心解码一致的前提下，于Qwen3-4B上实现最高2.444x加速。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码方法（Medusa、EAGLE-3、DFlash、DSpark）均在目标模型自身的词表中起草，因此候选树的一个节点等价于一个目标token，token粒度被视为常量。但BPE的分词预处理器先按空白切分、再学习合并，导致任何跨词字符串都无法成为单个token——例如Qwen3-4B中"United States of America"为4个token，任意相邻两token都不存在对应的词表条目。因此短语级候选对任何在目标词表中起草的方法都不可达，token粒度实际上是人为限制。
AI.method: 提出"改变单位"的方案：1）一个参数量约21.94M的小型MLP头读取冻结目标模型的隐藏状态，在独立的草稿词表中预测1-3词的短语作为单个条目；2）通过贪心最长匹配展开，将短语映射回目标模型自身的token序列；3）N个候选在单次前向中以前缀树掩码并行验证，因而该方法与树的深度、宽度正交；4）目标模型及其分词器保持冻结，候选仅在与目标argmax一致时才被接受，保证服务输出与贪心解码相同（仅浮点并列打破可能有差异）。此外，头部输出层每个条目仅需257个参数（一行），故草稿词表规模即参数预算。
AI.result: 在单张A5000、batch=1条件下，对比HuggingFace generate()：21.94M的头（占Qwen3-4B的0.545%）在GSM8K上达2.391x、MATH-500上2.444x、MT-Bench上1.544x。8,000条目的头仅3.434M参数（目标的0.0854%，比EAGLE-3的草稿器小64倍），仍保留较大头在GSM8K上92.3%的每轮接受token数。在相同提示与基线下与EAGLE-3比较：21.94M头在两个数学数据集上优于tree-16，但在所有数据集上均落后于tree-60。
AI.conclusion: 提升投机解码吞吐的关键可以不是"更多能通过验证的候选"，而是重新定义候选的基本单位：以短语级草稿词表替代token级起草，能在极低参数开销下获得显著加速，且与树深/树宽正交、不改变输出分布。该方法在中等树规模下具竞争力，但仍不及大规模树（tree-60），参数效率与树规模扩展之间的权衡是后续方向。

title: Path-Level Structural and Semantic Alignment for Hierarchical Multi-Label Text Classification
summary: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) requires models to capture both structural dependencies among labels and the fine-grained semantics of labels at different hierarchy levels. Existing methods often model hierarchy through prediction constraints or representations of individual labels and local relations. Structural and semantic supervision, however, are usually formulated separately. We instead use complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for both. Our framework introduces two auxiliary training objectives while retaining a standard multi-label classifier at inference. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. These targets provide graded supervision for structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths. It thereby provides context-specific label semantics beyond static label representations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent improvements: structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels.

AI.tldr: 提出以“根到节点标签路径”为共享单元统一结构监督与语义监督的HMTC框架，引入PathSimNCE层级感知对比目标与LLM生成文档条件语义描述目标作为辅助训练目标，推理时仍用标准多标签分类器。
AI.motivation: 现有HMTC方法多通过预测约束或孤立标签表示与局部关系建模层级，结构与语义监督通常分离，难以同时捕捉层级结构依赖与不同层级标签的细粒度语义。
AI.method: 以完整根到节点标签路径为统一单元：PathSimNCE用层级感知对比目标将文档表示与层级路径对齐，对结构相关路径给出分级监督，同时保留真实路径的显式监督；互补语义目标利用LLM生成同一正路径的文档条件描述，提供超越静态标签表示的上下文相关语义。推理阶段仅保留标准多标签分类器。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上取得一致提升；结构对齐在更深层级中收益更明显，语义对齐对细粒度标签带来额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 以路径为共享单元可有效联合结构与语义监督，且辅助目标不增加推理开销，二者在不同层级深度与标签粒度上呈互补性。

title: ViCLIP-OT: The First Foundation Vision-Language Model for Vietnamese Image-Text Retrieval with Optimal Transport
comment: Preprint submitted to Expert Systems with Applications
summary: Image-text retrieval has become a fundamental component in intelligent multimedia systems; however, most existing vision-language models are optimized for highresource languages and remain suboptimal for low-resource settings such as Vietnamese. This work introduces ViCLIP-OT, a foundation vision-language model specifically designed for Vietnamese image-text retrieval. The proposed framework integrates CLIP-style contrastive learning with a Similarity-Graph Regularized Optimal Transport (SIGROT) loss to enhance global cross-modal consistency and mitigate modality gap issues. Extensive experiments on three Vietnamese benchmarks (UITOpenViIC, KTVIC, and Crossmodal-3600) demonstrate that ViCLIP-OT consistently outperforms CLIP and SigLIP baselines in both in-domain and zero-shot settings. On UIT-OpenViIC, the model achieves an average Recall@K of 67.34%, improving upon CLIP by 5.75 percentage points. In zero-shot evaluation on Crossmodal-3600, ViCLIPOT surpasses CLIP by 11.72 percentage points. Embedding-space analysis further confirms improved alignment and reduced modality gap. The results indicate that integrating SIGROT provides an effective and scalable strategy for cross-modal retrieval in low-resource languages, offering practical implications for intelligent multimedia retrieval systems in Vietnamese and other underrepresented linguistic contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出面向越南语图像-文本检索的基础视觉-语言模型ViCLIP-OT，将CLIP式对比学习与相似图正则化最优传输损失(SIGROT)结合，在三个越南语基准上超越CLIP与SigLIP基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型多针对高资源语言优化，在越南语等低资源场景下表现次优；同时存在跨模态模态鸿沟(modality gap)问题，全局跨模态一致性不足。
AI.method: ViCLIP-OT框架：以CLIP式对比学习为基础，引入相似图正则化最优传输损失(SIGROT)，通过相似图约束的最优传输对齐来增强全局跨模态一致性并缓解模态鸿沟；在UIT-OpenViIC、KTVIC、Crossmodal-3600三个越南语基准上进行域内与零样本评测，并进行嵌入空间分析。
AI.result: 在三个基准上均稳定优于CLIP与SigLIP基线。UIT-OpenViIC上平均Recall@K达67.34%，较CLIP提升5.75个百分点；Crossmodal-3600零样本评测中较CLIP提升11.72个百分点；嵌入空间分析证实对齐性改善、模态鸿沟缩小。
AI.conclusion: SIGROT的引入为低资源语言跨模态检索提供了有效且可扩展的策略，对越南语及其他欠表示语言环境下的智能多媒体检索系统具有实用价值。

title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Presented as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS). Code and data: https://github.com/hanktang-research/TrialDesignBench
summary: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TrialDesignBench，一个包含617项肿瘤剂量探索临床试验、并按最新FDA监管标准配以专家验证参考设计的基准，用于评估AI辅助的试验统计设计能力；五个前沿LLM均未达到参考标准，性能差距主要源于隐性设计决定因素的推断与结构化决策树推理。
AI.motivation: AI已广泛用于临床试验流程，但试验统计设计（决定药物剂量如何在人身上测试与评估）几乎未有AI进展。LLM在生物医学知识与统计推理上具备潜力，然而FDA Project Optimus等监管与方法学变化重新定义了"合理设计"，使既往设计过时，因而缺乏合适的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建TrialDesignBench：617项I期/I-II期肿瘤剂量探索试验，每项配以与最新FDA监管倡议一致、经专家验证的参考设计；该参考标准通过对专家设计流程的形式化得到。评估五个前沿LLM，并进行消融实验定位性能差距来源。
AI.result: 五个前沿LLM均未能匹配参考标准。消融实验表明差距主要来自两方面：从试验来源推断未记录的隐性设计决定因素（提供后类别平衡准确率提升0.22），以及结构化决策树推理（提升0.24）。
AI.conclusion: TrialDesignBench为评估与提升AI辅助试验设计提供了可复现、符合当代标准的客观基准。

title: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentOPSD，一种无 critic 的递归信用分配方案，将特权自蒸馏的局部教师-学生差异通过贝叶斯证据累积分配到多轮交互的各个回合。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励强化学习把单一优势广播到整条轨迹，粒度太粗，无法定位长程多轮交互中决定成败的少数关键决策；特权自蒸馏虽提供更密集监督，但未解决如何把一组局部师生差异沿序列转化为信用的问题。
AI.method: 在每个交互回合内，将技能条件自教师与学生之间的 token 级对数概率差求和，作为证据在对数几率空间进行递归贝叶斯更新；所得修正通过一个有界且保号（保持优势符号）的乘子，将结果导出的优势重新分配到各回合。全程无需 critic。
AI.result: 以 Qwen2.5-3B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 为策略骨干，在 ALFWorld 上稳定优于 GRPO 及自蒸馏基线，7B 规模达到 89.1% 成功率；消融表明增益来自回合边界处的证据聚合以及让信念更新依赖历史，而非局部差异本身。
AI.conclusion: 局部师生差异本身不构成有效信用信号，关键在于按回合边界聚合证据并进行依赖历史的信念修正；该递归、无 critic 的信用分配机制为长程多轮智能体训练提供了细粒度且保持优势符号稳定性的监督方式。

title: DeepResearch RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Deep Research Report
summary: Empowered by Large Language Models (LLMs), deep research systems integrate online information into research reports through multi-step web searching and information synthesis. Evaluating these reports presents a significant challenge due to their long context, high information density, and domain specificity, necessitating the use of AI evaluation as a substitute for prohibitively expensive human assessment. However, few studies have examined the effectiveness of existing reward models or LLMs in understanding and evaluating such research reports. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepResearch RewardBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating reward modeling for research reports. We collect diverse report candidates from multiple agents or tool-augmented LLMs. These candidates are scored using query-specific golden rubrics, and we ensure data quality and difficulty through a combination of multi-round filtering and human verification. Our benchmark comprises preference datasets formatted as pairs, triplets, and quadruplets to test ranking capabilities across varying levels of difficulty. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current reward models handle general coherence effectively, their performance significantly degrades when evaluating research reports. Generative LLMs acting as judges demonstrate comprehensive superiority in this domain, with comparative evaluation proving more effective than direct scoring methods. We anticipate that this benchmark will serve as a vital testbed for the evaluation and advancement of research agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepResearch RewardBench，首个面向深度研究报告的奖励建模评测基准，通过查询级金标准评分规则与多轮过滤+人工校验构建成对/三元/四元偏好数据，系统评测奖励模型与LLM-as-judge的评估能力。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的深度研究系统通过多步网页检索与信息综合生成研究报告，此类报告上下文长、信息密度高、领域专属性强，人工评估代价过高，需借助AI评估替代。但现有奖励模型或LLM能否理解并评估此类报告尚缺乏研究，缺少专门基准。
AI.method: 从多个智能体或工具增强LLM收集多样化候选报告；用查询特定的金标准评分规则（golden rubrics）对候选打分；通过多轮过滤与人工验证保证数据质量与难度；构建成对、三元组、四元组三种格式的偏好数据集，以测试不同难度下的排序能力；并开展大规模实验对比奖励模型与生成式LLM评判者的表现。
AI.result: 现有奖励模型在处理一般连贯性上表现良好，但在评估研究报告时性能显著下降；生成式LLM作为评判者在该领域展现出全面优势；比较式评估（comparative evaluation）比直接打分（direct scoring）更有效。
AI.conclusion: DeepResearch RewardBench可作为评估与推进研究型智能体发展的重要测试平台，并揭示了当前奖励建模在长上下文、高信息密度研究报告评估上的不足。

title: Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs
comment: Preprint v1 (2026-10-21). 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. A corrected-prompt retrain of the REALCOUNT adaptation arms is in progress; v2 will update those results. Comments welcome
summary: Video LLMs fail conspicuously at counting how many times an object crosses the screen, a failure attributed to missing object permanence. Using construction-grounded synthetic testbeds with independently validated labels, we show this attribution is incomplete: the count signal is present but unread - linear probes decode per-window presence at 93% while global count decoding collapses to a duration confound. Concurrent work reports the same representation-output dissociation for repetition counting; we show that in exit-and-reappear event counting it is repairable: two readout-directed repairs (episode-localization supervision and a discrete event-symbol side channel) raise same-object counting from 46.7% to 65.0% (oracle 66.7%) on a chance-33% benchmark across 7B-30B systems. Transfer to an independent factory costs nothing, and an audit of the measurement apparatus exposes four data-integrity failures that had obscured the boundary. A real-video audit (REALCOUNT, n=18, blind-audited) shows the boundary persists - best 55.6% at chance 33.3% - and symbol transfer fails zero-shot. A 1-epoch in-domain adaptation bench is negative (six levers at 28-50%), but a 3-epoch schedule shows this is budget-limited for the symbol channel: with a 3-epoch schedule and sequence-disjoint oracle timelines the reader reaches 94.4% on REALCOUNT, and with the deployed detector's timelines a 2-epoch run reaches 72.2%. The residual gap is detector evidence and the reader's match to detector noise, not reader capacity: a frozen-feature boundary probe finds the signal weak (AUC 0.62 over a 0.51 permutation control) and non-transferring across clips (0.77 within-clip vs. 0.62 across windows).

AI.tldr: 视频LLM的计数失败并非单纯"缺失客体永久性"，而是"信号存在但未被读出"的表征-输出解耦；通过读出导向修复可将同物体计数从46.7%提升至65.0%（oracle 66.7%），真实视频上仍存边界，残余差距源于检测器证据与读者对检测噪声的匹配而非读者容量。
AI.motivation: 先前工作将视频LLM在"物体越屏次数计数"上的显著失败归因于缺失客体永久性，但该归因不完整。作者希望借助标签独立验证的构造式合成测试床，检验计数信号是否其实存在而只是未被正确读出，并厘清此前被测量装置缺陷所掩盖的真实边界。
AI.method: 采用构造式合成测试床，标签独立验证；用线性探针解码逐窗口物体存在性与全局计数；开展两项读出导向修复（episode定位监督、离散事件符号侧通道）；在7B–30B规模系统上评测；做独立工厂场景迁移与测量装置审计（发现四项数据完整性失效）；构建REALCOUNT真实视频盲审基准（n=18，chance 33.3%）；进行1-epoch与3-epoch域内适配对照实验，并用冻结特征边界探针（AUC 0.62，置换对照0.51；within-clip 0.77 vs across-window 0.62）分析残余差距来源。
AI.result: 线性探针逐窗口存在性解码达93%，而全局计数解码坍缩为时长混淆；两项修复将同物体计数从46.7%提至65.0%（oracle 66.7%），跨独立工厂迁移零成本；REALCOUNT上最佳55.6%（chance 33.3%），符号通道零样本迁移失败；1-epoch适配为负（六种lever 28–50%），但3-epoch下符号通道达94.4%（序列不相交oracle时间线），用部署检测器时间线时2-epoch达72.2%；冻结特征边界探针信号弱（AUC 0.62）且跨片段不迁移。
AI.conclusion: 视频LLM的计数失败是"可修复的读出问题"而非"不可修复的永久性缺失"：信号在表征层存在，需读出导向监督与充足适配预算（3-epoch）方能释放；残余差距来自检测器证据质量与读者对检测噪声的匹配，而非读者容量本身，真实视频边界仍存。

title: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
summary: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. Yet AI scientists are typically given as much task information as possible during idea generation, which can anchor generation toward familiar approaches. Inspired by the cognitive framework of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR), we propose a discovery framework that separates these two roles of information: it generates proposals under deliberately limited task information to broaden exploration, then learns from proposals previously verified on the same task and their outcomes to retain promising candidates for costly empirical evaluation. We evaluate BVSR across five proposer models and 12 scientific tasks. Limiting task information substantially increases proposal originality and non-obviousness, and produces a larger share of highly creative and high-utility proposals than existing state-of-the-art prompting-based baselines. Learning from prior proposal outcomes on the task further improves candidate selection, discarding half of the candidates while retaining most top-performing proposals. When incorporated into existing AI-scientist workflows, BVSR achieves stronger discoveries across gene expression analysis, drug response prediction, anomaly detection, scaling law discovery, and brain activity prediction. These results suggest that effective AI scientists should use information differently across stages of discovery: constrain task-specific information during exploration while exploiting accumulated empirical experience on the task.

AI.tldr: 论文提出受BVSR认知框架启发的科学发现框架：在生成阶段刻意限制任务信息以扩大探索、提升原创性，在学习阶段利用同一任务上已验证提案及其结果进行筛选，从而保留少数高潜力候选进入昂贵的实证评估。在5个提案模型与12个科学任务上验证有效性，并集成到AI科学家流程后在多个真实任务中取得更强发现。
AI.motivation: 现有AI科学家在idea生成阶段通常被给予尽可能多的任务信息，这会使生成偏向熟悉的方法（锚定效应），抑制原创性与非显而易见性。需要重新设计信息在不同发现阶段的使用方式。
AI.method: 借鉴盲变异与选择性保留（BVSR）框架，将信息角色分离为两阶段：探索阶段在受限任务信息下生成提案以拓宽搜索空间；保留阶段从同一任务上先前已验证的提案及其结果中学习，用于候选筛选。实验覆盖5个提案模型、12个科学任务，与SOTA提示基线对比，并嵌入现有AI科学家工作流进行评估。
AI.result: 限制任务信息显著提升提案的原创性与非显而易见性，高创造性、高实用性提案占比超过现有SOTA提示基线；基于既往提案结果的学习可淘汰约一半候选，同时保留大部分顶级提案；在基因表达分析、药物反应预测、异常检测、缩放律发现、脑活动预测中取得更强发现。
AI.conclusion: 有效的AI科学家应在发现的不同阶段差异化使用信息：探索时约束任务特定信息，评估筛选时充分利用累积的实证经验。

title: Text Grouping Changes Completion-Time Comparisons in Long-Form Simultaneous Speech Translation
summary: Does grouping translation updates before speech synthesis change the measured completion gap between two translators? We compare StreamAtt with its fixed-audio-history baseline on ten English-German talks. For each translation, we keep the intended text and its availability times fixed and vary how updates are grouped for synthesis. Four-second grouping increases StreamAtt's mean completion lead from 106.6 to 229.1 seconds with XTTS-v2, but reduces it from 169.5 to 146.5 seconds with Piper. Both produce shorter audio; different changes in playback idle account for the opposite effects. These directions recur on a separately selected twenty-talk panel. In continuing CosyVoice 3 sessions, grouping instead leaves paired audio unchanged and delays completion on nineteen of twenty blocks. A speech-timing comparison therefore needs to specify how text enters synthesis, not just which synthesizer is used. Recognition and automatic word timing describe the outputs, but do not establish translation accuracy or intelligibility.

AI.tldr: 在固定文本及其可用时间的前提下，将翻译更新以4秒为组打包后再合成，会使StreamAtt相对固定音频历史基线的平均完成领先量随合成器不同而方向相反：XTTS-v2下由106.6秒增至229.1秒，Piper下由169.5秒降至146.5秒。
AI.motivation: 现有同声传译语音时序评测常只报告所用合成器，而未规定文本如何进入合成。作者欲厘清"更新分组"这一被忽略的变量是否以及如何改变两种翻译系统之间测得的完成差距，从而说明评测需明确文本进入合成的接口方式。
AI.method: 以StreamAtt与其固定音频历史基线为对照，在十篇英德演讲上做受控对比：保持每个翻译的文本内容及其可用时刻不变，仅改变更新被分组送入合成的粒度（如4秒分组）。用XTTS-v2与Piper两种合成器分别测量平均完成领先量，并对播放空闲时长变化做分解分析；另在单独选取的二十篇演讲面板上重复验证方向性，并在CosyVoice 3连续会话中考察分组的影响。
AI.result: 4秒分组使StreamAtt的平均完成领先在XTTS-v2下由106.6秒升至229.1秒，在Piper下由169.5秒降至146.5秒；两者均产生更短音频，相反效果由播放空闲时长的不同变化解释。该方向性在独立二十篇面板上重现。在CosyVoice 3连续会话中，分组不改变成对音频，但在二十个块中的十九个上延迟完成。
AI.conclusion: 语音时序比较必须同时说明文本进入合成的方式，而不能仅指明所用合成器；分组效应依赖合成器且可反转系统间排序。识别与自动词级时间戳仅描述输出，不足以确立翻译准确性或可懂度。

title: BDBBQ: A Human-AI Collaborative Benchmark for Bengali Social Bias in LLMs
summary: Despite growing attention to social bias in large language models (LLMs), existing bias benchmarks provide limited coverage of culturally grounded evaluation in Bengali, particularly within Bangladesh's sociocultural context. To address this gap, we develop a bilingual extension of BanglaBBQ comprising 61,312 question-answering instances across 12 social categories in English and Bengali. The benchmark incorporates balanced answer permutations, contrasting question framings, and both ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to systematically examine model performance and stereotype-aligned bias across languages. We validate the dataset through structural checks, 220 statistical tests, and expert annotation of 150 instances by four annotators, achieving strong inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' \k{appa}=0.8349). We evaluate eight LLMs across 490,496 instances and identify five key findings. First, disambiguated contexts yield substantially greater accuracy improvements in Bengali (+36.59 percentage points) than in English (+17.71). Second, all evaluated models exhibit lower accuracy in Bengali, although Mistral-Nemo shows the smallest cross-lingual accuracy gap (5.12 percentage points). Third, stereotype-aligned bias exhibits language and model dependent variation, increasing in Bengali for Gemma 2 9B but decreasing for Mistral-Nemo. Fourth, higher accuracy does not necessarily correspond to lower stereotype-aligned bias. Finally, bias varies considerably across social categories, with Qwen 2.5 7B exhibiting stronger stereotype alignment in Bengali for Politics and Physical Appearance. These findings demonstrate that cross-lingual performance and social bias are distinct dimensions of LLM behavior and underscore the importance of culturally grounded, language-sensitive benchmarks for evaluating fairness beyond English-centric settings.

AI.tldr: 针对孟加拉语（尤其孟加拉国社会文化语境）社会偏见评测覆盖不足的问题，作者构建了双语 BanglaBBQ 扩展基准（61,312 条问答实例，12 个社会类别，英语与孟加拉语），并据此评估八个 LLM，发现跨语言表现与社会偏见是两个独立维度。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 社会偏见基准主要面向英语，缺乏在孟加拉语及孟加拉国社会文化语境下的、文化扎根的评测资源。
AI.method: 构建 BanglaBBQ 的双语扩展：61,312 条问答实例、12 个社会类别、英语/孟加拉语各一份；采用均衡答案排列、对比式提问框架、歧义与消歧上下文；通过结构检查、220 项统计检验及 4 名标注者对 150 条实例的专家标注（Fleiss' κ=0.8349）验证数据；共评测 8 个 LLM、490,496 条实例。
AI.result: 五项主要发现：(1) 消歧上下文带来的准确率提升在孟加拉语更大（+36.59 个百分点）而英语为 +17.71；(2) 所有模型孟加拉语准确率更低，Mistral-Nemo 跨语言差距最小（5.12 个百分点）；(3) 刻板印象对齐偏见随语言与模型而异，Gemma 2 9B 在孟加拉语中升高、Mistral-Nemo 降低；(4) 更高准确率并不必然对应更低偏见；(5) 偏见在社会类别间差异明显，Qwen 2.5 7B 在孟加拉语的政治与外貌类别上刻板对齐更强。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言性能与社会偏见是 LLM 行为的两个独立维度；评测公平性需要文化扎根、语言敏感的基准，不能局限于英语中心设定。

title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
summary: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 HiveMem 多模态记忆框架，通过"水平记忆扩展"（关系图邻域扩展）与"垂直证据组合"（查询自适应选择多种证据形式）两个维度协同，在三个基准上提升任务表现并将 token 消耗降低约90%。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体的交互历史不断变长，检索与利用历史信息成为长期交互的关键。现有记忆系统普遍采用"压缩记忆 + 语义检索"并在查询时暴露预设的固定表示，存在两大缺陷：一是仅依赖语义相似度易漏检相关记忆；二是忽略了不同查询对异质证据（摘要、图像、历史等）的需求差异。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：(1) 水平记忆扩展：以文本与视觉锚点将记忆片段组织为关系图，从语义检索得到的种子节点向相关邻居扩展，补全互补信息；(2) 垂直证据组合：每条被检索记忆保留多种证据形式（紧凑摘要、caption、接地视觉视图、原始图像、交互历史），由轻量可训练选择器为每条记忆独立组合一个证据子集，实现查询自适应的多模态信息利用。
AI.result: 在三个多模态记忆基准上，HiveMem 在不同基础模型上均稳定提升任务性能；与最高效的竞争性多模态基线相比，token 消耗降低约 90%。
AI.conclusion: 通过"扩大记忆覆盖广度 + 自适应调节单条记忆的证据贡献"的二维设计，可同时缓解漏检与证据异质性问题，在显著降低推理开销的前提下提升长期多模态交互性能。

title: Fairness in Explainable AI Narratives: Decomposing Social Disparities in LLM-Generated Explanations
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Code, prompts, narratives and extractions available at https://github.com/WannesVandenBulck/fairxain
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate technical explainable AI (XAI) artefacts such as SHAP into explanatory narratives (XAINs) for lay users. In high-risk domains, these explanations are often the main resource through which individuals can understand and contest adverse decisions. Yet LLMs are known to reproduce social bias, even from proxy variables alone, and fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Because XAINs are bound to a ground-truth artefact, fairness concerns not only what a narrative says and how, but also whether it is equally faithful across social groups. We introduce fairness in XAINs as a new field of research and propose a framework that generates narratives under three conditions (protected attribute disclosed, withheld, or counterfactually swapped), allowing five comparisons that pinpoint the cause of disparities. We apply it to adversely classified instances from four datasets in credit scoring, education and employment, generating narratives with five LLMs, and evaluate faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. We find significant disparities across all datasets, metric families and models, arising in two ways.
