Faithfulness disparities result from feature values: LLMs make plausible but false statements, triggered by values that are unequally distributed across social groups. Feature coverage and sentiment disparities stem from the protected attribute itself: once it is disclosed, LLMs give less explanation to, or frame more negatively the narratives of, groups that have historically been discriminated against or are stereotypically associated with worse outcomes. A more faithful model removes the faithfulness disparities, and withholding protected attributes mostly removes the others, but neither suffices on its own. Fairness in XAINs should therefore be audited separately from the predictive model and its XAI artefact.

AI.tldr: 论文首次提出并系统研究了"可解释AI叙事(XAINs)中的公平性"这一新研究方向，揭示LLM将SHAP等技术解释转换为面向普通用户的叙事时，在不同社会群体间存在忠实度、特征覆盖与情感上的显著差异，并区分了两类成因机制。
AI.motivation: 在高风险领域（信贷、教育、就业），XAINs往往是个人理解并质疑不利决策的主要渠道；而LLM已知会复现社会偏见（甚至仅凭代理变量）。既有研究关注预测模型及其XAI构件本身的公平性，却忽视了"叙事生成"环节的公平性——尤其是叙事与ground-truth解释构件绑定时，是否对各社会群体同等忠实。
AI.method: 提出XAIN公平性研究框架：在三种条件下生成叙事（受保护属性披露、隐去、反事实替换），构造五种对比以定位差异来源。应用于信贷评分、教育、就业四个数据集中被不利分类的样本，使用5个LLM生成叙事，评估忠实度、特征覆盖度与情感三项指标。
AI.result: 在所有数据集、指标族与模型上均发现显著差异，且成因有二：(1)忠实度差异源于特征值——LLM会因在群体间分布不均的特征值而作出"看似合理但虚假"的陈述；(2)特征覆盖与情感差异源于受保护属性本身——一旦披露，LLM对历史上受歧视或与被刻板关联于较差结果的群体给出更少解释或更负面的叙述框架。更忠实的模型可消除忠实度差异，隐去受保护属性可基本消除其余差异，但二者单独使用均不足。
AI.conclusion: XAINs的公平性应独立于预测模型及其XAI构件单独审计；忠实度与内容/情感层面差异来源不同，需组合干预（忠实度提升+属性隐去）方能缓解。

title: Retrieval-Grounded Multi-View Reasoning for Clinically Reliable Radiology Report Generation
summary: Chest radiograph report generation is hampered by retrieved reports that resemble the current image but are clinically inconsistent with it, and by diagnostic-label imbalance. We present RG-MVR, a retrieval-grounded framework comprising Retrieval-Augmented Evidence Grounding, which combines dense memory summaries with visually gated sparse retrieved evidence; Adaptive Multi-view Evidential Reasoning, which weights image, memory, and retrieved evidence per case; and a Clinical Prompt Learner, which models finding mention separately from positive, negative, or uncertain status. On MIMIC-CXR, RG-MVR achieved a clinical-label F1 of 0.483 and a BLEU-4 of 0.118 (IU X-ray: 0.202 and 0.110). In an exploratory external cohort of 22 examinations, clinical-label agreement declined markedly (F1, 0.071) and unsupported statements remained common, although physicians found fewer unsupported temporal comparisons (9 vs. 20 cases) and device-related statements (7 vs. 15) than with the baseline. Evidence-aware retrieval and structured diagnostic prompting may reduce specific reporting errors, but broader external validation is required.

AI.tldr: RG-MVR：融合检索增强证据接地、自适应多视角证据推理与临床提示学习的胸片报告生成框架，在MIMIC-CXR上临床标签F1为0.483，但外部队列泛化性明显不足。
AI.motivation: 胸片报告生成面临两大问题：一是检索到的报告虽与当前图像相似，却在临床上不一致；二是诊断标签类别不平衡。
AI.method: 提出检索接地的RG-MVR框架，含三部分：检索增强证据接地（稠密记忆摘要与视觉门控的稀疏检索证据结合）、自适应多视角证据推理（逐病例对图像、记忆与检索证据加权）、临床提示学习器（将所见提及与阳性/阴性/不确定状态分开建模）。
AI.result: MIMIC-CXR上临床标签F1 0.483、BLEU-4 0.118；IU X-ray上分别为0.202与0.110。在22例检查的探索性外部队列中，临床标签一致性显著下降（F1 0.071），无依据陈述仍常见，但医生发现的无依据时间对比（9 vs. 20例）与器械相关陈述（7 vs. 15例）少于基线。
AI.conclusion: 证据感知检索与结构化诊断提示有望减少特定类型的报告错误，但方法的外部泛化仍需更广泛的验证。

title: Veterans' Mental Health Crisis Severity Annotation: Do LLMs Agree More Than Human Experts?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable approach for annotating mental health and crisis-related social media content, but their reliability in safety-critical tasks remains unclear. This study evaluates LLM-based crisis-severity annotation of veteran-related social media posts against annotations from eight Veteran Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Using 149 tweets and five severity categories, we evaluate 15 open-source and 10 proprietary LLMs across eight prompt variants, examining annotation performance, inter-model agreement, prompt sensitivity, and high-severity crisis detection. Human reviewers showed higher ordinal than nominal agreement (α = 0.494), indicating that disagreements often occurred between neighboring severity levels. In contrast, selected LLMs demonstrated substantially higher inter-model consistency, with ordinal agreement (α) reaching 0.8336 under the baseline prompt. Proprietary models generally showed better agreement with expert annotations and greater stability than open-source models. GPT-5.6-Terra achieved the best overall performance, while the open-source Qwen2.5-7B showed the strongest performance in identifying Acute Crisis with Suicidal Ideation cases. However, higher model consistency did not necessarily correspond to agreement with human judgments or reliable detection of rare high-severity cases. Label-flipped demonstration experiments also revealed model-specific sensitivity to misleading in-context examples, while explanatory demonstrations did not consistently improve performance. Overall, LLMs show promise as scalable complements to expert annotation, but require careful evaluation before use in high-stakes mental health applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了25个大语言模型（15个开源+10个闭源）在8种提示变体下，对149条退伍军人相关社交媒体推文进行五级危机严重度标注的可靠性，并与8位退伍军人领域专家（SME）的标注进行对比。
AI.motivation: LLM可为心理健康与危机相关社交媒体内容提供可扩展的标注方案，但其在安全关键任务中的可靠性尚不明确，尤其在退伍军人这一高风险人群的危机严重度评估场景中缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 以8位退伍军人SME的人工标注为基准，使用149条推文与5个严重度类别，评测15个开源与10个闭源LLM在8种提示变体下的表现；分析维度包括标注性能、模型间一致性、提示敏感性以及高严重度危机（如急性危机伴自杀意念）的检测能力；并开展标签翻转与解释性示例（demonstration）实验以考察上下文示例的影响。
AI.result: 人工评审者表现出序数一致性高于名义一致性（α=0.494），说明分歧多发生于相邻严重度等级之间；LLM间一致性显著更高，基线提示下序数α达0.8336。闭源模型整体与专家标注一致性更好、稳定性更强。GPT-5.6-Terra综合表现最佳，而开源模型Qwen2.5-7B在识别"急性危机伴自杀意念"类别上表现最强。但更高的模型间一致性并不必然对应与人类判断的一致性或对稀有高严重度个案的可信检测。标签翻转示例实验显示模型对误导性上下文示例存在模型特异性敏感，解释性示例未能稳定提升性能。
AI.conclusion: LLM有望作为专家标注的可扩展补充手段，但在用于高风险心理健康应用前需经过审慎评估；模型间一致性不可替代与人类判断的一致性及罕见高危案例的检测验证。

title: ReelCache: An Efficient KV Cache Compression and Management System for Multi-Round Video Generation
comment: 18 pages total, 11 pages body plus 5 pages appendix
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models produce large KV caches during multi-round video generation. Keeping all these KV chunks would consume substantial memory, while rebuilding discarded caches would significantly delay video chunk generation. This paper presents ReelCache, a KV cache compression system for efficient multi-round, long video generation. ReelCache combines an intra-chunk compressor with an inter-chunk cache manager. The compressor applies low-rank decomposition across channels and video coding to the resulting coefficients, predicting the decomposition rank per transformer layer online to meet retained-energy targets. The cache manager shares basis directions across consecutive chunks and organizes chunk states in a tree, allowing generation branches to share historical state while supporting restoration for resume, rewind, and fork. Experiments across five video generation models show that ReelCache reduces KV storage by 14.46-21.13x relative to baselines and accelerates next-chunk generation by 1.25-3.36x, with less than 1% drop in six representative VBench metrics. GitHub: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/ReelCache

AI.tldr: ReelCache 是一个面向多轮长视频生成的自回归视频扩散 KV cache 压缩系统，结合 chunk 内低秩分解+视频编码压缩与 chunk 间树状 cache 管理，实现 14.46-21.13 倍 KV 存储压缩与 1.25-3.36 倍加速，VBench 指标损失 <1%。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在多轮、长视频生成中会产生大量 KV cache：全量保留内存开销过大，而丢弃后重建又会显著拖慢后续 chunk 的生成速度。因此需要一套兼顾存储压缩与可恢复性的 KV cache 管理方案。
AI.method: 方法分为两部分：(1) intra-chunk 压缩器：在通道维度做低秩分解，再对分解系数施加视频编码，并按 transformer 层在线预测分解秩以达成保留能量目标；(2) inter-chunk cache 管理器：在相邻 chunk 间共享基方向（basis directions），并用树结构组织 chunk 状态，使不同生成分支共享历史状态，同时支持 resume、rewind、fork 等恢复操作。
AI.result: 在五个视频生成模型上实验，KV 存储相比基线减少 14.46-21.13 倍，下一 chunk 生成加速 1.25-3.36 倍，六项代表性 VBench 指标下降均小于 1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将细粒度（秩自适应低秩分解+视频编码）压缩与粗粒度（基方向共享+树状状态管理）cache 组织相结合，ReelCache 能在几乎不损失生成质量的前提下显著降低长视频多轮生成的内存与延迟开销，为可交互式长视频生成提供了实用支撑。

title: DiffusedSplitFed: Latent Diffusion-based Obfuscation for Reconstruction-Resilient Split Federated Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Federated Learning (FL), Split Learning (SL), and Split Federated Learning (SplitFed) enable collaborative medical image analysis without sharing raw patient data. However, intermediate features and gradients exchanged during SplitFed training may reveal sensitive information through reconstruction attacks. To address this vulnerability, we propose \textbf{DiffusedSplitFed}, a SplitFed framework that integrates Latent Denoising Diffusion Models (LDDMs) at client--server split points to obfuscate transmitted representations while preserving segmentation performance. Three architectural variants (V1--V3) are developed using different combinations of dual conditioning and global feature fusion to investigate trade-offs among reconstruction resistance, segmentation accuracy, and computational complexity. Experiments on three medical imaging datasets (HAM10K, Blastocysts, and FHPsAOPMSB), supported by multiple independent runs and paired statistical analyses, demonstrate improved resistance to the evaluated image reconstruction attacks compared with Baseline SplitFed, while maintaining competitive segmentation performance. Comparisons with existing diffusion-based segmentation methods further demonstrate competitive segmentation accuracy under the evaluated settings. A conditional convergence analysis is also provided to characterize the effects of LDDM-induced gradient perturbations and local optimization on training. These findings highlight the potential of latent diffusion-based representation obfuscation for reconstruction-resilient collaborative medical image segmentation. The implementation is available at https://github.com/ChamaniS/DiffusedSplitFed.

AI.tldr: 提出DiffusedSplitFed：在SplitFed客户端-服务器切分点嵌入潜空间去噪扩散模型(LDDM)对传输表征进行混淆，在保持分割性能的同时增强抗重建攻击能力。
AI.motivation: SplitFed等协作式医学图像分析避免共享原始数据，但其传输的中间特征与梯度可被重建攻击反演出敏感患者信息，存在隐私泄露风险。
AI.method: 在客户端-服务器切分点集成LDDM对传输表征做混淆；设计V1–V3三种架构变体，通过双条件与全局特征融合的不同组合，权衡抗重建能力、分割精度与计算复杂度；并给出条件收敛性分析刻画LDDM梯度扰动与本地优化的影响。
AI.result: 在HAM10K、Blastocysts、FHPsAOPMSB三个医学影像数据集上，经多次独立运行与配对统计检验，相比Baseline SplitFed在所评估的图像重建攻击下抗性提升，且分割性能具竞争力；与现有基于扩散的分割方法相比精度相当。
AI.conclusion: 基于潜空间扩散的表征混淆是实现抗重建的协作式医学图像分割的有效途径，代码已开源。

title: From Weapons to Events: Evaluating Evidential Support in Multimodal AI for Policing
comment: 34 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; appendices include annotation guidelines, prompt templates and a datasheet
summary: Computer vision (CV) for policing has centred on recognising objects such as seized weapons, while body-worn video (BWV) is still reviewed by people, with existing AI tools using only its audio. Multimodal video AI could make BWV review faster and cheaper. At the object level, we present the KnifeHunter dataset, developed with UK law enforcement, with over 25,000 images of 543 knife classes and a protocol reflecting investigative conditions, and KHNet, a retrieval architecture fusing local and global features, which with about 125,000 distractor images attains 85.7% and 63.4% mean Average Precision (mAP) on the medium and hard protocols. At the event level, we present an evaluation protocol for video understanding pipelines, which describe a video as events and a transcript, that scores transcription, speaker attribution, event detection, temporal localisation and unsupported events. Whether each event is supported by the recording is labelled by a judge validated against blinded human labels. We apply it to complete pipelines, three 2026 omni-modal models and our hybrid NarrativeBridge-PAL-GPT-5 pipeline, on UKBWV-27, a pilot stress-test set of 27 publicly released UK BWV recordings (118 minutes). On this set the hybrid pipeline leads on five of six measures, yet it leaves 13.6% of predicted events unsupported and misattributes 27.7% of utterances, and every pipeline degrades on recordings from edited releases, long recordings and noisy audio. We propose readiness levels separating assistive tasks from those requiring verification of every output.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向执法场景中的多模态视频AI，提出物体级与事件级两类评测方案：物体级发布含25,000余张图像、543类刀具的KnifeHunter数据集及融合局部/全局特征的KHNet检索架构（加入约12.5万张干扰图后，medium/hard协议mAP为85.7%/63.4%）；事件级提出针对"事件+转写"式视频理解流水线的评测协议，并在27段英国公开BWV录像（118分钟）上评测三条端到端流水线，混合流水线在六项指标中五项领先，但仍有13.6%预测事件无支撑、27.7%话语归属错误。论文据此提出"就绪等级"以区分辅助性任务与需逐项核验的任务。
AI.motivation: 警务计算机视觉主要聚焦武器等目标识别，而随身执法录像（BWV）仍依赖人工审阅，现有AI工具仅利用音频信息。多模态视频AI有望显著降低BWV审阅的时间与成本，但缺乏贴合侦查条件的目标级基准，也缺乏对"事件级"视频理解流水线输出可信度的系统评测方法。
AI.method: 物体级：(1) 与英国执法部门合作构建KnifeHunter数据集，含543个刀具类别、25,000余张图像，并设计反映侦查条件的评测协议；(2) 提出KHNet检索架构，融合局部与全局特征，并引入约125,000张干扰图像以模拟真实检索环境。事件级：(1) 设计面向"事件+转写"式视频理解流水线的评测协议，评分维度包括转写质量、说话人归属、事件检测、时序定位与无支撑事件；(2) 每条事件是否被录像支撑由经盲测人工标注验证的评审模型判定；(3) 在UKBWV-27（27段公开英国BWV录像，118分钟）压力测试集上，对完整流水线、三个2026年全模态模型及自研NarrativeBridge-PAL-GPT-5混合流水线进行横向评测。
AI.result: 物体级：KHNet在medium与hard协议上分别达到85.7%与63.4% mAP。事件级：混合流水线在六项指标中的五项领先，但仍有13.6%的预测事件缺乏录像支撑，27.7%的话语说话人归属错误；所有流水线在剪辑版录像、长时录像与噪声音频条件下性能均出现下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态视频AI在BWV审阅中尚不足以实现全自动可信输出。论文提出"就绪等级"框架，将可辅助使用的任务与必须逐项核验输出的任务加以区分，为执法场景中AI工具的分级部署与风险管控提供依据。

title: RigidGS: Geometry-Aware Object Decoupling for Rigid-Body Interaction in 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at WACV 2027 (Applications Track). Project page: https://gyreyirisansah.github.io/rigidgs
summary: Interactive VR/MR applications demand photorealistic 3D representations that support real-time rendering and object-level manipulation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves high rendering quality, it represents scenes as unstructured, monolithic primitives. Existing object-aware 3DGS methods jointly optimize geometry and semantic states but suffer from two key failure modes: noisy foundation-model masks on complex geometry, and label-geometry coupling, in which co-optimized identity gradients mislabel boundary Gaussians. We introduce RigidGS, an end-to-end pipeline that decouples geometric learning from object identity. We propose a depth- and temporally-aware mask refinement module that addresses two complementary SAM2 failures: over-inclusion on thin structures and under-inclusion on multimodal-depth objects. We then determine object identities entirely upstream via COLMAP projection voting and freeze them during training, directing mask supervision solely toward geometric optimization. Refined masks alone substantially improve competing methods, yet a residual gap in label-geometry coupling persists that our fixed-identity design eliminates. RigidGS outperforms prior object-aware 3DGS methods on LLFF/NVOS, Mip-NeRF~360, and iNeRF360, improving segmentation and boundary IoU by 7.7 and 14.5 points on LLFF/NVOS. Finally, RigidGS enables real-time rigid-body manipulation on Meta Quest~2 without mesh extraction. Our code and project page are available at https://gyreyirisansah.github.io/rigidgs.

AI.tldr: RigidGS是一个端到端的物体感知3DGS流程，将几何学习与物体身份解耦：先用深度与时间感知模块精细化SAM2掩码，再通过COLMAP投影投票在上游确定物体身份并在训练中冻结，从而消除标签-几何耦合，并在分割/边界精度及Quest 2实时刚体操作上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 交互式VR/MR应用需要可实时渲染且支持物体级操作的高保真3D表示。3DGS渲染质量高但以无结构的整体基元表示场景；现有物体感知3DGS联合优化几何与语义状态，存在两类失效：复杂几何上基础模型（SAM2）掩码噪声大，以及标签-几何耦合导致共同优化时身份梯度污染边界高斯。
AI.method: 1) 提出深度与时间感知的掩码精化模块，针对SAM2的过度包含（细薄结构）与欠包含（多模态深度物体）两类互补失效进行修正；2) 完全在上游通过COLMAP投影投票确定物体身份，并在训练中冻结，使掩码监督仅用于几何优化；3) 端到端流程，无需网格提取即可支持刚体操作。
AI.result: 在LLFF/NVOS、Mip-NeRF 360与iNeRF360上优于先前物体感知3DGS方法，LLFF/NVOS上分割IoU与边界IoU分别提升7.7与14.5个百分点；精化掩码本身即可显著提升对比方法，但残余的标签-几何耦合差距由固定身份设计消除；在Meta Quest 2上实现实时刚体操作。
AI.conclusion: 将几何学习与物体身份解耦（掩码精化+上游固定身份）是提升物体感知3DGS分割与边界质量的有效途径，且无需网格提取即可支撑实时VR/MR刚体交互。

authors: Ronald L. P. D. de Jong
title: ATLAS: A Multi-Procedure Benchmark and Context-Aware Model for Surgical Anatomy Segmentation
summary: Recognizing anatomical structures during minimally invasive surgery (MIS) could support intraoperative navigation and improve patient safety, but progress is limited by small, single-procedure datasets and by segmentation methods developed for natural scenes. This work addresses both limitations through a new dataset and model. First, we introduce ATLAS-120k, a clip-level semantic segmentation dataset of 121,018 annotated frames from 100 surgical videos, covering 14 laparoscopic and robot-assisted procedures and 41 classes. Annotations were created with a pipeline that combines manual labeling, tracker-based propagation, and review by surgeons. Second, we propose ATLAS (Anatomy Recognition with Context Learning using Foundation Representations), a video semantic segmentation model for surgical anatomy recognition. ATLAS builds on in-domain foundation-model embeddings and adds context queries for the procedure and surgical phase, together with query propagation between frames for short-term memory. ATLAS outperforms state-of-the-art natural-image and in-domain foundation models in both segmentation accuracy and temporal consistency, achieving a Dice score of 0.70 with ViT-L while running in real time at 76.2 FPS. Ablations show that the context queries improve accuracy and that query propagation improves temporal consistency. ATLAS also generalizes well, matching a dedicated model zero-shot on CholecSeg8k and improving phase recognition on AutoLaparo over SurgeNet initialization. The model weights, dataset annotations, and annotation tool are publicly available at https://github.com/TimJaspers0801/ATLAS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ATLAS-120k大规模微创手术语义分割数据集与ATLAS视频分割模型，在精度与时序一致性上超越现有基础模型，ViT-L下Dice达0.70且76.2 FPS实时运行。
AI.motivation: 微创手术中解剖结构识别可辅助术中导航并提升患者安全，但受限于现有数据集规模小、仅覆盖单一术式，以及分割方法多为自然场景设计，进展受限。
AI.method: 构建ATLAS-120k：100段手术视频、121,018帧标注、覆盖14种腹腔镜与机器人辅助术式、41类，标注流程结合人工标注、基于跟踪器的传播与外科医生审核。提出ATLAS模型：基于领域内基础模型嵌入，引入术式与手术阶段的上下文查询，并采用帧间查询传播实现短期记忆。
AI.result: 在分割精度与时序一致性上均优于自然图像与领域内SOTA基础模型，ViT-L下Dice 0.70，实时76.2 FPS；消融显示上下文查询提升精度、查询传播提升时序一致性；零样本在CholecSeg8k上匹配专用模型，在AutoLaparo上阶段识别优于SurgeNet初始化。
AI.conclusion: 大规模多术式数据集与上下文学习式视频分割模型可有效推进手术解剖识别，兼具精度、时序稳定性和实时性，并具备良好泛化能力，代码、标注与工具已公开。

title: Same Pixels, Different Documents: Measuring Part-Level Editability in Image Vectorization
summary: Image vectorization is often evaluated by rendering fidelity, which cannot distinguish documents that render identically but support different edits. Edit-based evaluation tests outcomes, but an oracle that gathers a part's fragments can conceal the cost of selecting them. We introduce Pass@k, which tests whether a prescribed edit can succeed using objects selectable within k clicks under a specified interaction model. Eight document diagnostics characterize properties relevant to editing beyond these tasks. We assess structural sensitivity through controlled perturbations, practical relevance through designer operations, and reference dependence through alternative drawings. We evaluate twelve open and commercial methods on 211 references, with 635 edit tasks on 93 of them. In each of four reference sets, including two drawn by designers, 64-88% of oracle-passed tasks on parts composed of multiple shapes fail at Pass@1, against 6-40% for single shapes, pooling counts over configurations. Higher fidelity does not guarantee higher Pass@1, while selected diagnostics are associated with designers' effort in our study.

AI.tldr: 提出基于编辑的评估指标 Pass@k，用"k 次点击内能否完成指定编辑"衡量图像矢量化结果的可编辑性，揭示高保真不等于易编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有矢量化评估以渲染保真度为主，无法区分渲染相同但可编辑性不同的结果；而基于编辑的评估只看结果成败，用"预言机"汇总部件碎片的方式会掩盖选择这些碎片本身的成本。
AI.method: 引入 Pass@k：在指定交互模型下，检验预设编辑能否用 k 次点击可选中的对象完成；定义八项文档级诊断指标刻画编辑相关属性；通过受控扰动测结构敏感性、通过设计师操作测实用性、通过替代绘图测参考依赖；在 211 张参考图上评测 12 种开源与商用方法，其中 93 张含 635 个编辑任务。
AI.result: 在四组参考集（含两组设计师绘制）中，对由多个形状构成的部件，预言机可通过的任务有 64–88% 在 Pass@1 失败，而单一形状仅 6–40%（按配置汇总计数）；更高保真度并不保证更高 Pass@1；部分诊断指标与设计师在实际操作中的投入相关。
AI.conclusion: 选择成本应纳入矢量化评估，Pass@k 提供了更贴近实际编辑的衡量方式；渲染保真度不足以代表可编辑性，需联合诊断指标共同评估。

title: Beyond Hash Matching: AI-Based Detection of Previously Unidentified CSAM and its Legal Implications in the EU
summary: The detection of previously unidentified Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) remains a significant challenge for law enforcement authorities, online service providers, and child protection organizations, as traditional hash-matching technologies are primarily designed to identify previously verified material. This paper reviews and classifies existing AI-based technologies that could complement hash-based approaches and support the detection, analysis, and prioritization of potentially harmful content. The reviewed approaches are organized into three categories: real-time image and video analysis, image and video classification and tagging, and AI-based behavioral monitoring. A comparative analysis examines the capabilities, limitations, and potential integration of general-purpose computer vision platforms, content moderation services, and specialized CSAM detection tools within existing detection workflows. An experimental evaluation was conducted using Google Cloud Vision AI and Sightengine to investigate sexual-content classification and child-adult age estimation. The results highlight differences in classification taxonomies and outputs across providers, as well as significant limitations in age classification, particularly for adolescents. These findings highlight the importance of using AI-based assessments as complementary tools for analysis and prioritization, rather than as definitive determination of CSAM. Finally, the paper examines the relevant European Union regulatory framework, with particular attention to the EU AI Act, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), fundamental rights, transparency, accountability, and human oversight. The legal analysis highlights how regulatory obligations and safeguards may differ depending on the deployment context, potentially creating inconsistencies across interconnected detection and reporting workflows.

AI.tldr: 该文系统梳理可用于补充哈希匹配的AI检测技术，并通过Google Cloud Vision AI与Sightengine实验评估性内容分类与年龄估计能力，指出AI仅宜作辅助分析与优先级排序工具，并结合EU AI Act与GDPR讨论监管与保障要求。
AI.motivation: 传统哈希匹配技术只能识别已确认的CSAM，难以发现新型未识别内容，执法机构、在线服务商与儿童保护组织亟需可补充的AI技术手段。
AI.method: 文献综述与分类（实时图像/视频分析、图像/视频分类与标注、AI行为监测三类）；对通用计算机视觉平台、内容审核服务与专用CSAM检测工具进行比较分析；使用Google Cloud Vision AI与Sightengine开展性内容分类与儿童—成人年龄估计实验；并对EU AI Act、GDPR及基本权利、透明度、问责与人机监督等监管框架进行法律分析。
AI.result: 不同供应商在分类体系与输出上存在差异；年龄分类能力存在明显局限，尤其对青少年群体；部署情境不同会导致监管义务与保障措施不一致，可能在互联的检测与上报流程中造成衔接问题。
AI.conclusion: AI评估应作为分析与优先级排序的补充工具，而非CSAM的最终判定依据；需重视分类标准差异、年龄估计局限及跨流程监管一致性。

title: MGE: A Membership Guided Data Extraction Attack against Diffusion Models
summary: Recently, diffusion models have achieved remarkable performance in image generation. However, their inherent memory properties introduce a potential safety risk of training data leakage, i.e., data extraction attack. To illustrate such risk, we propose a membership guided extraction (MGE) framework to effectively extract training data from a pre-trained diffusion model. Our core idea is to formulate the data extraction as a conditional generation, where the condition signal is from a membership inference classifier. To improve the success rate and efficiency of MGE, we propose adversarial gradient and parallel branch decoding. Our experiments on image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our MGE can extract hundreds of images, which shows that more attention should be paid to privacy-preserving of diffusion model.

AI.tldr: 提出成员引导提取框架MGE，将扩散模型训练数据提取建模为条件生成，并以成员推断分类器信号为条件，实现数百张训练图像的有效提取。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在图像生成上性能优异，但其固有记忆特性带来训练数据泄漏（数据提取攻击）的安全风险，需要实证揭示该风险以推动隐私保护。
AI.method: 核心思路是将数据提取形式化为条件生成，以成员推断（membership inference）分类器输出的条件信号引导生成；为提升成功率和效率，进一步提出对抗梯度（adversarial gradient）与并行分支解码（parallel branch decoding）。
AI.result: 在图像生成基准上的实验表明，MGE可提取数百张训练图像。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型确实存在训练数据泄漏风险，应给予模型隐私保护更多关注。

title: Agent2BIM: A Systematic Evaluation of Reality-Capture Configurations and Prior Models for As-Built Modeling
summary: AI agents can generate as-built Building Information Models (BIMs) from reality-capture data, but the evidence required for accurate reconstruction remains unclear. This paper presents Agent2BIM, an agent-based Scan-to-BIM framework, and evaluates seven capture configurations in a research laboratory and a mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) scene. Inputs include 360° panoramas, smartphone video, smartphone LiDAR, terrestrial laser scanning (TLS), TLS with posed panoramas, and imagery supplemented by prior IFC models. Outputs are compared against TLS-verified reference models for component detection, geometric accuracy, and MEP connectivity. In the laboratory, component recall ranged from 84% to 100%, but only 9% of components reconstructed from panoramas were within 20 cm of their reference positions, compared with 86% using smartphone LiDAR. In the MEP scene, scale-free inputs recovered 11 - 43% of components, versus 75 - 93% for metric inputs. Prior IFC models improved MEP reconstruction but could propagate inaccuracies. The results highlight the complementary roles of visual and metric evidence in agent-based Scan-to-BIM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Agent2BIM 这一基于智能体的 Scan-to-BIM 框架，并在实验室与 MEP 场景中系统比较七种采集配置，揭示视觉证据与度量证据在自动重建中的互补作用。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体已能从实景采集数据生成竣工 BIM，但实现精确重建究竟需要何种证据（视觉输入还是度量输入）尚不明确，缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建 Agent2BIM 智能体式 Scan-to-BIM 框架，在实验室和 MEP 两个场景中评估七种采集配置：360° 全景图、智能手机视频、智能手机 LiDAR、地面激光扫描（TLS）、TLS 结合已知位姿全景图、以及影像辅以先验 IFC 模型；以 TLS 验证的参考模型为基准，从构件检测、几何精度与 MEP 连通性三方面对比输出。
AI.result: 实验室场景构件召回率为 84%–100%，但仅 9% 的全景图重建构件位于参考位置 20 cm 内，而智能手机 LiDAR 达 86%；MEP 场景中无尺度输入仅恢复 11%–43% 构件，度量输入为 75%–93%；先验 IFC 模型可改善 MEP 重建，但可能传播误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显视觉证据与度量证据在基于智能体的 Scan-to-BIM 中的互补角色：视觉输入利于构件识别，度量输入决定几何与尺度精度，先验模型需谨慎使用以避免误差传递。

title: ZARA: Zero-shot Animatable and Relightable 3D Avatar reconstruction from a single image
summary: Recent large human reconstruction models create remarkable animatable 3D avatars from a single image, but their appearance remains entangled with the illumination and cannot be relighted. In contrast, existing 3D relightable-avatar reconstruction methods typically require person-specific optimization. We present ZARA, a zero-shot feed-forward framework that reconstructs an animatable 3D Gaussian avatar together with its intrinsic attributes from a single image. ZARA couples a pretrained large-scale human reconstruction model with a Material Transformer to inherit geometry priors while learning material-aware Gaussian representations. To preserve localized details, we introduce Gaussian-aligned material feature fusion strategy, which injects multi-scale material features onto individual Gaussians and combines them with geometry tokens. As most human-avatar datasets lack ground-truth material maps, we use pseudo-material labels as conditioning inputs and supervision targets during training. We further introduce MatFace regularization to preserve facial structure and color in albedo prediction under unreliable facial pseudo-material supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ZARA reconstructs animatable and relightable humans within tens of seconds without person-specific optimization or post-processing, outperforming existing baselines in both relighting quality and materials generalization ability. As the ability of recovering the physically-based-rendering attributes of the human, ZARA also enables direct material editing of the avatar's appearance.

AI.tldr: ZARA是一个零样本前馈框架，可从单张图像重建可动画、可重光照的3D高斯化身及其内禀材质属性，无需个体级优化。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模人体重建模型生成的化身外观与光照纠缠、无法重光照；而可重光照化身方法多需逐个体优化，成本高。
AI.method: 将预训练大规模人体重建模型与Material Transformer耦合，继承几何先验并学习材质感知高斯表示；提出高斯对齐材质特征融合，将多尺度材质特征注入单个高斯并与几何token结合；以伪材质标签作条件输入与监督目标；引入MatFace正则，在不稳定面部伪材质监督下保持反照率预测的面部结构与颜色。
AI.result: 数十秒内完成重建，无需个体级优化或后处理；在重光照质量与材质泛化能力上优于现有基线，并支持化身的直接材质编辑。
AI.conclusion: ZARA实现了单图零样本的可动画、可重光照高斯化身重建，恢复PBR属性并支持外观材质编辑。

title: Action Transfer Across Character Body Plans in Latent-Action World Models: An Empirical Study of Animated Characters
summary: Latent-action world models learn actions from video without labels, and recent methods aim to share these actions across bodies. Transfer between 2D characters with different body structures remains underexplored. In this paper, we study whether an action learned from one character can make a character with a different body perform the same action. A cat, a blob and a human can all jump, but each moves its body in its own way. The usual transfer gain mixes body motion with screen movement and can assign a perfect score to a model that ignores its action. To address this, we introduce a transfer score that compares the correct action with wrong ones from the same source. We test five training objectives on a new synthetic benchmark of 2D cartoon characters with six body plans, the standard Sprites benchmark, and 431 selected animal and human animations from DeformingThings4D. With a fixed camera, a baseline that only copies the source's screen movement scores 0.71, as high as most learned models. In contrast, with a camera that follows the body, the best model reaches only 0.46 for an unseen animal family and 0.20 for humans. With this camera, a linear probe identifies the action class of unseen animal families with 66% to 86% balanced accuracy (chance 17%). The learned actions therefore retain information about which action is performed, but the correct action closes only part of the prediction error gap for a new character.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无需标签的潜在动作世界模型中动作跨身体结构的迁移问题，提出更严格的迁移评分，并发现现有模型虽在表征中保留了动作信息，但对新身体的预测能力有限。
AI.motivation: 2D 不同身体结构角色之间的动作迁移研究不足；传统迁移增益指标将身体运动与屏幕运动混淆，可能给忽略动作的模型打满分，无法真实反映动作迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出一种迁移评分：将正确动作与来自同一源的其他错误动作进行对比；在两类相机设置（固定相机、跟随身体的相机）下，于新构建的六种身体结构的 2D 卡通角色合成基准、标准 Sprites 基准以及从 DeformingThings4D 中筛选的 431 个动物与人类动画上测试五种训练目标，并用线性探针评估动作类别可辨识性。
AI.result: 固定相机下，仅复制源屏幕运动的基线得分为 0.71，与多数学习模型相当；跟随身体相机下，最佳模型对未见动物科仅达 0.46，对人为 0.20；线性探针在未见动物科上的动作分类平衡准确率为 66%–86%（随机为 17%）。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的潜在动作保留了动作类别信息，但正确动作仅能缩小新角色预测误差差距的一部分，说明跨身体动作迁移仍具挑战性，需更关注身体运动本身而非屏幕运动。

title: LIFT: Local Metric Alignment and Foundation-guided Propagation for Few-shot Depth Completion
summary: Few-shot depth completion aims to recover dense metric depth from sparse measurements using only a small number of target-domain annotations, offering a favorable balance between annotation cost and model adaptation. We propose LIFT, a framework that harnesses both depth and feature priors from a frozen pretrained monocular depth estimation (MDE) foundation model for few-shot depth completion. Specifically, LIFT first estimates local scale and shift parameters on a coarse grid and interpolates them into smooth, dense parameter fields, providing a spatially adaptive metric depth initialization. It then progressively refines this initialization through multi-scale depth propagation guided by foundation features. Finally, a lightweight residual decoder combines multi-level foundation features with propagation correction to refine the metric depth. Extensive experiments on NYUv2 and KITTI-DC demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art few-shot performance. The source code will soon be released.

AI.tldr: LIFT：利用冻结的单目深度估计基础模型提供的深度先验与特征先验，实现少样本度量深度补全，在NYUv2和KITTI-DC上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 少样本深度补全需在标注成本与域适应之间取得平衡，现有方法未充分利用预训练基础模型的先验知识。
AI.method: 冻结MDE基础模型；在粗网格上估计局部scale与shift并插值为平滑稠密的参数场，得到空间自适应的度量深度初始化；再经基础特征引导的多尺度深度传播逐步细化；最后由轻量残差解码器融合多层基础特征与传播修正，输出精细度量深度。
AI.result: 在NYUv2与KITTI-DC上取得SOTA的少样本深度补全性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将冻结MDE模型同时视为深度先验与特征先验来源，可高效实现少样本深度补全；源码即将开源。

title: Permute-then-Adapt: Weak-to-Strong Contrastive Image-Text Adaptation
summary: Image-text alignment models such as CLIP are typically trained with contrastive learning, where unpaired examples are treated as strict negatives. While this assumption introduces noise by penalising semantically related pairs, existing solutions often rely on heuristic similarity thresholds that lack statistical grounding and sensitivity to dataset-specific noise distributions. In this paper, we propose Permute-then-Adapt (PTA), a framework that leverages efficient weak models to identify missed positives while controlling Type-I error relative to a conditional permutation reference, up to calibration approximation error. Unlike standard distillation or arbitrary thresholding, PTA estimates a random-pairing reference distribution from the weak teacher's similarity scores and uses its upper tail, determined by $α$, to select auxiliary positives. The calibrated positive set is then trained against by a single multi-positive contrastive objective: each anchor maximises the total probability mass it assigns to its positive set. Offline calibration with the weak model adds negligible training overhead. Experiments show gains over heuristic soft-label approaches in object recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and data efficiency. Project repository: https://github.com/JinhaoLee/Permute-then-Adapt.

AI.tldr: 提出 Permute-then-Adapt（PTA）框架，用高效弱模型估计随机配对参照分布，按显著性水平 α 选取伪正样本，从而在控制 Type-I 错误的前提下修正 CLIP 类对比学习中“未配对即严格负样本”的噪声问题。
AI.motivation: CLIP 等图文对齐模型采用对比学习，将未配对样本视为严格负样本；但语义相关但未配对的样本被误判为负，引入标签噪声。现有缓解方案多依赖启发式相似度阈值，缺乏统计依据，且对数据集特有的噪声分布不敏感。
AI.method: PTA 利用高效弱模型识别被漏掉的正样本：从弱教师的相似度分数估计“随机配对”参照分布，取其由 α 决定的上尾作为统计判据筛选辅助正样本，将 Type-I 错误控制在条件置换参照水平（至多校准近似误差）。随后用单一多正样本对比目标训练——每个锚点最大化其分配给正样本集合的总概率质量。弱模型的校准为离线进行，训练开销可忽略；与标准蒸馏或任意阈值化不同。
AI.result: 在目标识别、跨模态检索与数据效率实验中，PTA 相较启发式软标签方法取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 以置换参照分布做统计校准的正样本筛选，是一种有理论依据、低开销的对比学习噪声修正方案，优于启发式阈值软标签方法。

title: They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification
summary: The task of visual reasoning relative pose identification (VRRPI) has exposed critical weaknesses in the multi-view 3D spatial reasoning capabilities of modern vision-language models (VLMs). We present a systematic analysis of VLMs' behavior in VRRPI, uncovering stable output biases where VLMs disproportionately predict specific motion patterns regardless of visual evidence. To mitigate these inherent biases, we propose self knowledge re-expression with iterative debiasing (SKR-ID), an annotation-free pipeline that adapts VLMs for VRRPI using only randomly extracted unannotated image pairs. SKR-ID transitions VLMs' output mechanism from generic next-token prediction to task-optimized classification heads. The pipeline proceeds in two stages: (1) a cold-start initialization using debiasing object-centric prompts to anchor motion inference in 2D visual evidence; and (2) a recursive logit-ranking mechanism that enforces statistical parity by using the median logit value as a dynamic threshold. Experimental evaluation across frontier VLMs on standard benchmarks demonstrates that SKR-ID significantly mitigates systematic biases. Our method improves open-source VLMs' Macro-F1 scores from 35.0-45.4% to 53.7-58.0%, without using any annotated data. These results show that SKR-ID can effectively improve 3D reasoning performance from a severely collapsed baseline. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/astudentuser/Codes_of_SKR-ID.

AI.tldr: 提出SKR-ID，一种无需标注的流水线，通过自知识重表达与迭代去偏缓解VLM在视角相对位姿识别(VRRPI)中的稳定输出偏置。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉语言模型在多视图3D空间推理（VRRPI）上表现薄弱，且存在稳定输出偏置：无论视觉证据如何都倾向预测特定运动模式。
AI.method: 将VLM输出机制从通用下一词预测转为任务优化的分类头；两阶段流程：(1) 使用去偏的物体中心提示进行冷启动初始化，将运动推断锚定于2D视觉证据；(2) 递归logit排序机制，以logit中位数为动态阈值强制统计均衡。整个流程仅用随机抽取的无标注图像对。
AI.result: 在标准基准上显著缓解系统性偏置，开源VLM的Macro-F1从35.0–45.4%提升至53.7–58.0%，且不使用任何标注数据。
AI.conclusion: SKR-ID能从不佳塌缩基线有效提升3D推理性能，证明免标注适配可纠正VLM固有偏置。

title: From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory
summary: LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Anchor，用"记忆来源决策的重放测试"作为记忆筛选准则：只有当候选记忆能显著改变来源步的决策分布、且其作用方向与来源动作的成功/失败角色一致时才予以保留，从而在冻结策略下实现经验驱动的性能提升。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长程交互中学习需要记忆机制，但仅凭"看似合理"提取的教训往往冗余，甚至强化不当行为。现有记忆构建缺少一个可操作的判据来决定某条候选记忆是否值得保留。
AI.method: 作者首先定位轨迹中的关键步骤并抽取候选记忆，然后在相同上下文下对每个来源决策分别在有/无该候选记忆时进行重放，据此发现两个现象：多数候选几乎不改变被探测的决策分布；成功与失败的来源动作都可能被强化或被抑制。基于此提出 Anchor：在保留前同时检验"分布偏移幅度"与"来源角色一致性"两个条件；被接纳的记忆用于指导后续轨迹，使冻结策略也能获得经验驱动的改进。
AI.result: 在留出的 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 任务上，相对于各主干模型的最强基线，Anchor 将成功率与平均分分别提升最多 19.9% 与 17.2%。使用 Qwen3.5-27B 时，ALFWorld 保留的记忆卡片比不过滤方案少 41%，并在 WebShop 上以更少 token 超过全部四个成本对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 以"来源决策是否被实质改变、且改变方向与来源动作角色对齐"作为记忆留存判据是有效且经济的：既能过滤冗余/误导性记忆、降低记忆开销，又能在不更新模型参数的情况下带来稳定的任务性能提升。

title: Vision Language Models for Primary Structure Threat Identification in Wildland Urban Interface Fires
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Smart Cities Conference (ISC2), Porto, Portugal
summary: Wildland urban interface (WUI) fires increasingly threaten communities and infrastructure, motivating the need for rapid visual assessment. Recent research has focused primarily on detecting fire and assessing post-event damage. However, structure-level fire threat identification during active WUI fire events remains underexplored. This study evaluates Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for this active-fire decision using two separately scored tracks: 1,824 synthetic images from 491 designed WUI scenarios and 45 frames from a controlled-burn experiment conducted in collaboration with Columbus Fire & EMS Department. Under zero-shot prompting, the model returned valid target fields for 1,808 synthetic images and 39 controlled-burn frames. Accuracy among valid outputs was 94.0% for the synthetic track and 69.2% for the controlled-burn track, compared with a 16.0% random-selection baseline for the latter. On the synthetic track, the model generally identified the intended target across varied designed WUI scenarios when the relevant fire-spread cues were visually distinct. Controlled-burn performance was well above random selection, but errors showed difficulty interpreting spatial relations in complex scenes. The dual-track protocol provides scalable stress testing in designed scenarios and a controlled-burn reference for assessing model behavior under physical fire conditions. Future work can use the synthetic data for VLM post-training and then evaluate the adapted models on larger and more diverse real WUI fire datasets.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在野地-城市界面（WUI）火灾进行中的建筑级火威胁识别能力，采用合成场景与受控燃烧实验双轨评测，零样本下合成轨有效输出准确率94.0%，受控燃烧轨69.2%（随机基线16.0%）。
AI.motivation: WUI火灾日益威胁社区与基础设施，亟需快速视觉评估；现有研究多聚焦火灾探测与事后损失评估，而对活跃WUI火事件期间结构级火威胁识别的研究不足。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为对象，设计两条独立评分的评测轨道：491个设计化WUI场景生成的1,824张合成图像，以及与 Columbus Fire & EMS 合作开展的可控燃烧实验的45帧视频；采用零样本提示，统计有效目标字段输出及其准确率，并与随机选择基线对比。
AI.result: 零样本下模型对1,808张合成图像和39帧可控燃烧图像返回有效目标字段；有效输出准确率为合成轨94.0%、受控燃烧轨69.2%，后者随机基线为16.0%。合成轨在火蔓延线索视觉显著时多数能识别预期目标；受控燃烧轨准确率显著高于随机，但错误集中于复杂场景中的空间关系理解。
AI.conclusion: 双轨协议兼顾设计场景的可扩展压力测试与物理火灾条件下的受控参考评估；未来可利用合成数据对VLM进行后训练，并在更大、更多样的真实WUI火灾数据集上评测适配模型。

title: TimeTraveler: Temporal Strategy Planning with Time Dictionary for Streaming Video Understanding
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://geppa.github.io/TimeTraveler
summary: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires models to answer user queries over continuously evolving video streams. Unlike offline video QA, SVU must handle queries whose evidence may lie in the past, appear in the current scene, or emerge only after future observations. Existing streaming video systems often rely on compact visual memories or fixed evidence-access schemes, which can lose fine-grained details and fail to adapt the answering process to the temporal intent of each query. In this paper, we propose TimeTraveler, a streaming VQA framework that performs temporal strategy planning with a Time Dictionary. Inspired by the need to search across different temporal regions of a stream, TimeTraveler stores each observed moment as a timestamp-indexed structured caption and uses this dictionary as an explicit source of queryable evidence. Given a query, TimeTraveler determines whether to recall past evidence, read the present context, or wait for future observations, and then applies a strategy-specific evidence acquisition process. Comparative experiments on streaming video QA benchmarks show that TimeTraveler improves streaming question answering by preserving fine-grained temporal evidence and selecting the appropriate temporal strategy for each query. The project page is available at https://geppa.github.io/TimeTraveler.

AI.tldr: TimeTraveler：基于"时间字典"的流式视频理解（SVU）VQA框架，将每个观察时刻存为时间戳索引的结构化描述，并针对查询做"过去/现在/未来"三类时间策略规划，按策略获取证据。
AI.motivation: 流式视频QA需处理证据可能在过往、当前场景或需等待未来观察才出现的查询；现有流式系统依赖紧凑视觉记忆或固定证据访问机制，易丢失细粒度细节，且无法根据查询的时间意图自适应调整回答过程。
AI.method: 提出TimeTraveler框架：1) 将每个观察到的时刻存储为时间戳索引的结构化文本描述，构建"时间字典"作为显式、可查询的证据源；2) 给定查询后先做时间策略规划，判断应"回忆过去证据"、"读取当前上下文"还是"等待未来观察"；3) 再执行与该策略对应的证据获取流程，最后生成答案。
AI.result: 在流式视频QA基准上的对比实验表明，TimeTraveler通过保留细粒度时间证据并为每个查询选择合适的时间策略，提升了流式问答性能。
AI.conclusion: 以显式时间戳结构化记忆＋查询级时间策略规划替代紧凑记忆与固定访问机制，是提升流式视频理解中跨时间证据利用的有效路径。

title: Preconditioned Implicit Midpoint Langevin Sampling for Non-Smooth Bayesian Imaging
summary: We introduce P-IMLA, a preconditioned implicit-midpoint Langevin sampler for high-dimensional log-concave targets with non-smooth regularization. The obstruction is that the large steps enabled by matrix preconditioning are precisely where preconditioned Euler-Maruyama inflates stationary variance. Implicit midpoint removes this surplus via a Cayley-transform identity, making P-IMLA Gaussian-exact at any step size. Beyond Gaussians, whitening transfers the sharp IMLA contraction rate to $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, and backward-error analysis gives drift-only rather than Euler-type diffusion bias under explicit smoothness assumptions. An $M$-norm Moreau envelope yields a proximal non-smooth variant with a three-term error budget. Controlled Gaussian and TV-regularized imaging experiments confirm the predicted separation: the unpreconditioned midpoint scheme retains long transients as $κ_f$ grows, whereas P-IMLA remains $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$-governed and near variance-exact.

AI.tldr: 提出预条件隐式中点 Langevin 采样器 P-IMLA，在大步长下对非光滑对数凹目标保持高斯精确性，并将收敛率由 κ_f 转嫁为 κ_eff。
AI.motivation: 矩阵预条件带来的大步长恰是预条件 Euler-Maruyama 平稳方差被放大的区域，需要一种在任意步长下无方差膨胀、且适配非光滑正则的高维采样方法。
AI.method: 采用隐式中点离散，借 Cayley 变换恒等式消除平稳方差盈余；用白化把尖锐的 IMLA 收缩率迁移到 κ_eff；通过后向误差分析在显式光滑性假设下得到仅漂移偏差而非 Euler 型扩散偏差；并基于 M-范数 Moreau 包络构造近端非光滑变体。
AI.result: 高斯与 TV 正则成像的受控实验验证了预测的分离：无预条件中点方案随 κ_f 增大出现长暂态，而 P-IMLA 保持受 κ_eff 控制并接近方差精确。
AI.conclusion: 预条件与隐式中点结合可在大步长下兼顾方差精确性与 κ_eff 主导的收敛，并通过 Moreau 包络以三项误差预算扩展到非光滑目标。

title: Mental Imagery That Matters: Curing Latent Collapse in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Mental simulation, the ability to reason by constructing and updating internal visual states, is central to flexible human cognition, but remains elusive in current multimodal large language models. Latent multimodal reasoning offers a promising route toward this capability by interleaving text with continuous visual latent blocks, allowing models to maintain internal visual workspaces without decoding them into pixels. In this paper, we ask whether these latent visual states actually matter. Through a direct perturbation analysis across representative latent-reasoning MLLMs, we find that they often do not: dropping, replacing, or shuffling generated visual latents has only minor effects on the model's own final-answer probability, while equivalent perturbations to the linguistic reasoning trace are substantially more damaging. We call this failure mode Mental Simulation Collapse (MSC): the model appears to perform interleaved visual reasoning, but routes most answer-relevant computation through text. We further diagnose that MSC follows naturally from existing training objectives: visual alignment can make generated latents resemble helper-image embeddings, but it does not require the decoder to rely on them; subsequent text-only supervision further leaves the semantic role of the latent pathway unidentifiable. To address this, we introduce AnchorSim (Anchored Mental Simulation), a contrastive distillation framework that trains models to make their generated visual latents consequential. Across multiple visual reasoning benchmarks, AnchorSim improves performance, while diagnostic re-evaluation shows that visual perturbations now meaningfully affect predictions. Our results expose a fundamental failure mode of latent multimodal reasoning and demonstrate that mental simulation must be anchored to model behavior in order to matter.

AI.tldr: 论文通过扰动分析揭示潜空间多模态推理中的"心理模拟崩溃"(MSC)：模型生成的视觉潜变量对最终答案几乎无影响，并据此提出对比蒸馏框架 AnchorSim 使视觉潜状态真正参与决策。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间多模态推理（文本与连续视觉潜块交错）被视为实现"心理模拟"的路径，但作者质疑这些视觉潜状态是否真正被模型用于推理，还是仅作装饰性存在。
AI.method: 对代表性潜推理 MLLM 进行直接扰动分析（删除/替换/打乱视觉潜变量，对比文本推理轨迹的同等扰动）；诊断 MSC 的训练目标成因；提出 AnchorSim，一种锚定式对比蒸馏框架，训练生成的视觉潜变量对输出具有因果性。
AI.result: 扰动视觉潜变量对最终答案概率影响很小，而扰动文本推理链损害显著；引入 AnchorSim 后，多个视觉推理基准上性能提升，且诊断性重评估显示视觉扰动现在能显著影响预测。
AI.conclusion: 潜多模态推理存在根本性失效模式 MSC；视觉对齐与纯文本监督使潜通路语义角色不可辨识；心理模拟必须锚定于模型行为才真正有效。

title: Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models
comment: 33 pages, including appendix and references. Code: https://github.com/UWMILab/Tiresias
summary: World models enable planning through internal simulation, while natural language provides intuitive task specification. Yet, language-conditioned world modeling remains fragmented across domains with disparate action spaces, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce LCWM, a shared task that maps an initial agent-view observation and a language instruction to an action sequence that fulfills the instruction. Its accompanying benchmark, LCWM-Bench, integrates 15 datasets across navigation, robotics, 3D gaming, and driving under a shared action interface and evaluation protocol, pairing 142,987 episodes with 428,961 instructions in three styles. We further propose Tiresias, an agent that plans via selective imagination: a language-conditioned diffusion policy generates candidate trajectories, a trajectory ranker shortlists them, and a video-pretrained world model imagines their visual consequences. A visual ranker evaluates these rollouts, complementing trajectory scores to select the final plan. Tiresias achieves competitive planning and imagination performance on LCWM-Bench. Ablations demonstrate the complementary benefits of trajectory ranking and visual verification, while experiments with alternative proposal methods show that the trained rankers remain effective beyond our diffusion policy. Together, LCWM-Bench and Tiresias provide a unified evaluation setting and an effective starting point for studying language-guided planning through world models.

AI.tldr: 提出统一任务LCWM与基准LCWM-Bench，并给出基于选择性想象的智能体Tiresias。
AI.motivation: 语言条件下的世界模型研究在跨领域（动作空间、数据集、评测协议）上高度碎片化，缺乏统一任务定义与评测基准。
AI.method: 定义LCWM任务：由初始智能体视角观测与语言指令映射到满足指令的动作序列；构建LCWM-Bench，整合导航、机器人、3D游戏与驾驶共15个数据集，统一动作接口与评测协议，含142,987条轨迹与428,961条三种风格的指令；提出Tiresias：语言条件扩散策略生成候选轨迹，轨迹排序器筛选候选，视频预训练世界模型想象其视觉后果，视觉排序器评估展开结果并与轨迹分数互补选出最终计划。
AI.result: Tiresias在LCWM-Bench上取得有竞争力的规划与想象性能；消融实验显示轨迹排序与视觉验证具有互补收益；使用替代候选生成方法时，训练得到的排序器依然有效。
AI.conclusion: LCWM-Bench与Tiresias为通过世界模型研究语言引导规划提供了统一评测环境与有效起点。

title: ClearForm: Shared-Surface Gaussian Splatting for Transparent and Opaque Scenes
summary: Transparent-interface reconstruction must recover glass surfaces even when most observed color comes from the scene behind them. We present ClearForm, a shared-planar-Gaussian method for jointly reconstructing transparent interfaces and the appearance seen through them. We identify and analyze the Geometry-Appearance Compositing Dilemma (GACD): when the same transparency-dependent alpha controls both color and geometry, revealing the background can weaken a transparent surface's contribution to geometric reconstruction. We derive its effect on plane-based depth estimation, identify a mechanism that can weaken geometric learning, and quantify the loss of interface support through controlled comparisons. To address this conflict, we develop geometry-preserving dual-opacity surface reconstruction. Shared planar Gaussians retain interface contributions in geometry compositing while modeling transmission and sparse reflection in RGB, supported by transparency-aware geometric constraints. To manage the different primitive-visibility requirements of these compositors, we introduce Dual-Evidence Lifecycle (DEL), which retains Gaussians supported by multi-view geometry or RGB reconstruction evidence. On 3D-FRONT-T, ClearForm achieves 27.05 mm Chamfer distance (CD) and 0.928 F1, compared with 59.18 mm CD for our PGSR reproduction and the reported 34 mm CD and 0.836 F1 for GLINT. On TransLab, it achieves 1.65 mm CD, 0.963 F1, and 40.14 dB PSNR. In matched ablations, dual-opacity compositing reduces CD from 59.25 to 27.09 mm, while DEL improves PSNR by 2.06 dB. Our project page is available at https://hajeongx.github.io/clearform/.

AI.tldr: ClearForm：基于共享平面高斯与双不透明度复合的透明界面重建方法，解决几何-外观复合困境（GACD），在3D-FRONT-T与TransLab上显著降低CD并提升F1/PSNR。
AI.motivation: 透明界面重建需在大部分观测颜色来自背景场景时恢复玻璃表面。作者指出同一透明度相关的alpha同时控制颜色与几何，导致揭示背景会削弱透明表面对几何重建的贡献（GACD），需专门机制化解该冲突。
AI.method: 提出共享平面高斯框架ClearForm：几何保持的双不透明度表面重建——共享平面高斯在几何复合中保留界面贡献，在RGB中建模透射与稀疏反射，辅以透明度感知几何约束；推导GACD对基于平面的深度估计的影响并量化界面支撑损失；引入Dual-Evidence Lifecycle（DEL），保留由多视角几何或RGB重建证据支撑的高斯原语，以适配两种复合器不同的可见性需求。
AI.result: 3D-FRONT-T上CD 27.05 mm、F1 0.928（对比PGSR复现59.18 mm CD、GLINT报告34 mm CD/0.836 F1）；TransLab上CD 1.65 mm、F1 0.963、PSNR 40.14 dB。匹配消融中双不透明度复合将CD从59.25降至27.09 mm，DEL使PSNR提升2.06 dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦几何与外观的透明度控制并配合双证据生命周期管理，ClearForm有效缓解GACD，在透明界面重建的几何精度与渲染质量上均优于现有方法。

title: MaRiO: Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning via Shared Observations in MLLMs
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track (poster). First two authors contributed equally
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong visual perception capabilities, but existing evaluations largely focus on single-view or multi-view settings with shared camera parameters, leaving the challenge of multi-agent collaborative scenarios underexplored. In such settings, multiple agents observe a shared environment from independent viewpoints, and reliable decisions require reasoning across these independent observations of the same environment. To study this problem, we introduce MaRiO, a benchmark for evaluating multi-agent collaborative reasoning, and evaluate 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs on it. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) tasks governed by static perception are generally easier than tasks that require transformational event sequences; (2) most models struggle to resolve cross-agent correspondences, with errors increasing with scene complexity; and (3) models show limited ability to leverage geometric cues present in the scene. As an initial step toward addressing these challenges, we explore geometry-guided synthetic view augmentation that generates intermediate transition frames between agent observations, providing auxiliary spatial context that improves performance in certain categories. Overall, our results highlight that multi-agent collaborative reasoning remains an open challenge and an important direction for multimodal embodied systems. The code is available on the project page: https://omarftt.github.io/MaRiO-page/.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体协同推理基准MaRiO，评测23个MLLM，揭示静态感知易、跨智能体对应难、几何线索利用弱三大问题，并探索几何引导的合成视角增强。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM评测多集中于单视角或共享相机参数的多视角设置，缺乏多智能体各自独立视角观察同一环境的协同推理评测，而这类场景对多模态具身系统的可靠决策至关重要。
AI.method: 构建MaRiO基准，要求模型跨多个独立视角观测推理同一共享环境；在23个先进MLLM上进行系统评测，并作为初步尝试提出几何引导的合成视角增强方法，在智能体观测之间生成中间过渡帧，提供辅助空间上下文。
AI.result: 三项关键发现：(1) 由静态感知主导的任务通常比需要变换性事件序列的任务更容易；(2) 多数模型难以建立跨智能体对应关系，且错误随场景复杂度上升；(3) 模型对场景中几何线索的利用能力有限。合成视角增强在部分任务类别上带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协同推理对现有MLLM仍是开放挑战，是多模态具身系统的重要研究方向；几何引导的视角增强作为初步方案具有潜力但尚不充分。

title: LoCo: Selective Local Competition for Discriminative Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition
comment: The paper is accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition (OV-MLR) aims to identify all queried semantic concepts present in an image. Existing methods mainly improve global image-text matching or text-side representations, leaving local prediction largely under-explored. In this paper, we revisit local prediction and reveal that it can serve as a strong discriminative branch once two properties are properly handled: spatial consistency of local visual features and compatibility-aware local competition. This perspective is motivated by local semantic sparsity: each image region is related to only a small subset of queried concepts, while compatible concepts of different granularities or types may still coexist locally. We instantiate this perspective with LoCo, a selective Local Competition framework for OV-MLR. LoCo adopts a spatially consistent visual encoder to reduce local feature entanglement, and introduces Selective Softmax to impose competition only among locally incompatible categories while preserving compatible responses. Multi-scale inference further improves local prediction at different scales. LoCo can also be ensembled with an existing global predictor to provide complementary image-level context. Experiments on four multi-label benchmarks show that standalone LoCo improves average F1-score and mAP over TagCLIP by 3.4% and 3.8%, respectively. LoCo + DualPrompt achieves the highest averages among the compared methods, with gains of 4.8% and 5.2% over TagCLIP. Our results suggest that local semantic sparsity offers a useful basis for developing more discriminative open-vocabulary multi-label recognition methods. The code is available at https://github.com/lee-plus-plus/LoCo.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视开放词汇多标签识别（OV-MLR）中的局部预测分支，指出只要处理好局部视觉特征的空间一致性与兼容性感知的局部竞争两个性质，局部预测即可成为强判别分支，并据此提出选择性局部竞争框架LoCo。
AI.motivation: 现有OV-MLR方法主要改进全局图文匹配或文本端表示，局部预测被严重忽视。作者从"局部语义稀疏性"出发：每个图像区域只与少数查询概念相关，但不同粒度或类型的兼容概念仍可能局部共存，因此需要兼顾竞争与兼容。
AI.method: LoCo框架包含：(1) 空间一致的视觉编码器，减少局部特征纠缠；(2) 选择性Softmax（Selective Softmax），仅在局部不兼容类别间施加竞争，保留兼容响应；(3) 多尺度推理提升不同尺度下的局部预测；(4) 可与现有全局预测器集成，提供互补的图像级上下文。
AI.result: 在四个多标签基准上，单独LoCo相比TagCLIP平均F1提升3.4%、mAP提升3.8%；LoCo+DualPrompt取得对比方法中最高平均值，相比TagCLIP分别提升4.8%和5.2%。
AI.conclusion: 局部语义稀疏性为构建更具判别力的开放词汇多标签识别方法提供了有效依据；代码已开源。

title: DAC-MACE: Context-Conditioned Expert Routing for Compact Scene Coordinate Regression in Camera Relocalization
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: A camera becomes an absolute pose sensor when its images can be relocalized against a prebuilt map of the scene. On mobile robots and augmented-reality devices, that map must be small and quick to build. Scene coordinate regression (SCR) stores the scene in a compact network that predicts a 3D coordinate for every pixel, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) variants extend its capacity to larger outdoor scenes. In existing MoE-based SCR, however, the router assigns each pixel to an expert from the same local descriptor that the experts regress from, so repeated facades and windows at different locations receive similar routing inputs. We present DAC-MACE, which conditions soft expert routing on recalibrated and contextualized features. A residual context adapter (RCA) reweights the channels and locations of frozen encoder features, a global context encoder (GCE) mixes them with multi-scale self-attention, and an image-level pooled descriptor is added to the router input. A dual-threshold RANSAC--Levenberg--Marquardt estimator recovers the pose. On Cambridge Landmarks, DAC-MACE attains a mean per-scene median translation error of 13.0 cm over three seeds, the lowest among the RGB-only SCR methods compared (GLACE 13.6 cm, MACE 14.4 cm), and reduces the error on the largest scene from 24 to 19 cm relative to MACE. In a cumulative study, the MoE head, GCE, RCA, and the dual-threshold estimator lower the mean error from 17.0 cm to 14.4, 14.0, 13.6, and 13.0 cm. On 7-Scenes, adding GCE to a single ACE head raises Recall@(5 cm, 5$^\circ$) from 86.56% to 87.60%.

AI.tldr: DAC-MACE 通过修正 MoE-based SCR 的路由输入，用 RCA、GCE 与图像级池化描述子对软专家路由进行条件化，并结合双阈值 RANSAC–LM 位姿估计，在 Cambridge Landmarks 上取得 RGB-only SCR 方法中最低的平均中位平移误差（13.0 cm）。
AI.motivation: 现有 MoE-based SCR 中，路由器与专家共享同一局部描述子作为输入，导致重复立面、窗户等在不同空间位置产生相似路由输入，路由区分度不足，限制了大规模户外场景下的精度。作者希望让路由依据更具全局判别性的特征。
AI.method: 提出 DAC-MACE：残差上下文适配器（RCA）对冻结编码器特征进行通道与位置重加权；全局上下文编码器（GCE）通过多尺度自注意力进行特征混合；将图像级池化描述子追加到路由器输入，实现基于重校准与上下文化特征的软专家路由条件化；位姿由双阈值 RANSAC–Levenberg–Marquardt 估计器求解。
AI.result: Cambridge Landmarks 上三次随机种子平均的逐场景中位平移误差为 13.0 cm，优于 GLACE（13.6 cm）与 MACE（14.4 cm）；最大场景误差由 MACE 的 24 cm 降至 19 cm。消融累积显示 MoE 头、GCE、RCA、双阈值估计器依次将平均误差从 17.0 cm 降至 14.4、14.0、13.6、13.0 cm。7-Scenes 上为单 ACE 头加入 GCE 使 Recall@(5 cm, 5°) 从 86.56% 提升至 87.60%。
AI.conclusion: 改进路由输入的特征质量与上下文信息（而非仅增加专家容量）是提升 MoE-based SCR 位姿回归精度的有效途径，各组件均有正贡献，且方法在室内外基准上均具通用性。

title: A Privacy-Aware Deep Learning Benchmark for Facial Emotion Recognition
summary: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) traditionally relies on raw RGB images, introducing privacy risks, sensitivity to illumination variations, and susceptibility to identity-confounding visual shortcuts. As an alternative, this work proposes a lightweight, privacy-aware pipeline using exclusively geometric representations-facial landmarks (478 points) and blendshapes (52 coefficients, ARKit standard)-eliminating persistent raw video storage. Six neural architectures trained from scratch on fused CREMA-D and RAVDESS datasets were benchmarked against an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 baseline under a 5-fold subject-independent cross-validation protocol. Geometric models consistently outperformed the pixel baseline on unseen subjects with 12-124 times fewer parameters, while demonstrating superior robustness on subtle emotional expressions such as sadness. Ablation studies reveal that blendshapes capture the primary discriminative signal, while landmarks provide essential complementary spatial topology. These results demonstrate that compact geometric representations preserve affective semantics, eliminate downstream transfer learning dependency on visual backbones, and enable efficient, privacy-aware emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出仅使用面部几何表征（478个关键点+52个ARKit blendshape系数）的轻量隐私友好表情识别流程，在CREMA-D与RAVDESS融合数据集上以5折受试者独立交叉验证，六种几何模型在参数少12–124倍的情况下优于ImageNet预训练ResNet50基线。
AI.motivation: 传统FER依赖原始RGB图像，带来隐私风险、光照敏感以及身份混杂的视觉捷径（shortcut）问题，并需持久存储原始视频。
AI.method: 以纯几何表征（landmarks 478点、blendshapes 52系数，ARKit标准）替代像素输入；在融合的CREMA-D+RAVDESS数据集上从零训练六种神经架构，与ImageNet预训练ResNet50对比，采用5折受试者独立交叉验证；并做消融研究分析两类表征贡献。
AI.result: 几何模型在未见受试者上一致优于像素基线，参数量少12–124倍；对悲伤等细微表情鲁棒性更佳；消融表明blendshapes承载主要判别信号，landmarks提供必要的互补空间拓扑信息。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑几何表征可保留情感语义，摆脱下游任务对视觉骨干网络的迁移学习依赖，实现高效且隐私友好的情感识别。

title: Reliability-Aware Benchmarking of Self-Supervised Learning in Histopathology Under 1-10% Label Regimes
comment: Oral presentation, CIBB 2026 (21st International Conference on Computational Intelligence Methods for Bioinformatics and Biostatistics, Rome, Italy). 6 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/alicemkyn/ssl-histopath-reliability
summary: Expert annotation in digital pathology is expensive, and low-label regimes remain common in realistic histopathology workflows. Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a practical way to learn transferable representations from unlabeled pathology images, but performance-only evaluation can hide unreliable confidence behavior under domain shift. We present a reliability-aware benchmark of SimCLR, BYOL, and an MAE-inspired masked-reconstruction baseline on PatchCamelyon (PCam; 96x96) and PANDA (prostate cancer) under 1%, 5%, and 10% labeled regimes with frozen-encoder linear probing. To address common single-run concerns, ResNet-18 results are repeated over 3 splits x 3 seeds (n=9) and ViT-B/16 over 1 split x 3 seeds (n=3) under practical compute constraints, with mean+/-std reporting and per-run logs. Beyond AUROC, accuracy, and F1-score, we report Expected Calibration Error and Brier score, OOD confidence diagnostics for cross-dataset PCam<->PANDA scoring, federated-vs-centralized SimCLR comparisons on PCam, and cross-dataset transfer to colorectal histology tiles. SSL improves label efficiency on the more controlled PCam task, while PANDA's noisier patch-level proxy can remain near coin-flip with higher variance. The study highlights that histopathology SSL should be assessed not only by ranking performance but also by calibration, robustness, and transparent reproducibility diagnostics before clinical interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可靠性感知的自监督学习基准，在PCam与PANDA两个组织病理数据集上，以1%/5%/10%低标签率、冻结编码器线性探测方式比较SimCLR、BYOL与类MAE掩码重建基线，并额外报告校准误差、Brier分数、OOD置信度诊断、联邦与集中式对比及跨数据集迁移。
AI.motivation: 数字病理专家标注成本高，低标签场景普遍；自监督学习可从无标注图像学习可迁移表征。但仅用性能指标评估会掩盖域偏移下不可靠的置信度行为，缺乏对校准性、鲁棒性与可复现性的系统评估。
AI.method: 在PatchCamelyon（96x96）与PANDA（前列腺癌）上，于1%、5%、10%标注率下采用冻结编码器线性探测，比较SimCLR、BYOL与MAE式掩码重建基线；ResNet-18采用3划分×3种子（n=9），ViT-B/16采用1划分×3种子（n=3），报告均值±标准差与逐次运行日志；指标包括AUROC、准确率、F1，并加入ECE、Brier分数、PCam↔PANDA跨数据集OOD置信度诊断、PCam上联邦与集中式SimCLR对比，以及向结直肠组织切片数据集的跨域迁移。
AI.result: SSL在较可控的PCam任务上提升标签效率；PANDA的patch级代理标签噪声更大，性能可能接近随机猜测（coin-flip）且方差更高。跨域迁移与OOD诊断显示仅凭排序类性能不足以反映置信可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 组织病理自监督学习在用于临床解读前，不应仅以排序性能评估，还须同时考察校准性、鲁棒性与透明的可复现性诊断。

title: SurvAD: How Anomalies Survive Diffusion Reconstruction
summary: Diffusion-based anomaly detectors reconstruct a test image towards normality, yet how much of an anomaly survives, its leak, remains uncharacterized. We show that a first-order deterministic sampler obeys an exact recursion along the anomaly, whose continuous limit is a survival law. The anomaly decays exponentially as the noise falls, at a rate set by the retention $r$, the share the model keeps on the states it visits. Because $r$ depends on the noise level and not on the step count, one measured path predicts the leak of other step counts, samplers and schedules from a nearby start to within a few hundredths, on four diffusion models and real defects. The law also shows that the leak's growth over steps is exposure bias and that normal details obey the same law, so changing the path or the training trades leak for detail error. We introduce SurvAD, which fine-tunes the reconstructor on inference-like starts and fits a comparator that adds evidence to the residual map without suppressing its ranking elsewhere. For under $2\%$ more inference time, SurvAD raises the multi-class pixel average precision (P-AP) of DeCo-Diff from $76.8$ to $80.7$ on MVTec AD and from $57.5$ to $60.0$ on VisA. It matches CostFilter-AD on the same reconstructor with $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters and, under Dinomaly's protocol, exceeds its reported P-AP on Dinomaly on both benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示扩散式异常检测中异常"泄漏"的精确递归与连续极限生存律，并提出 SurvAD 以低成本提升分割精度。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在异常检测中通过将测试图像重建为正常样本来定位缺陷，但异常有多少残留在重建结果中（即 leak/泄漏）缺乏理论刻画；同时缺少对这一残留的定量预测与利用手段。
AI.method: 证明一阶确定性采样器沿异常方向满足精确递归，其连续极限为生存律；泄漏随噪声下降呈指数衰减，衰减率由保留率 r 决定（r 仅依赖噪声水平而非步数），从而可由单条实测路径预测其他步数、采样器与调度下的泄漏。基于该律提出 SurvAD：在类推理起点上微调重建器，并拟合比较器在残差图上补充证据而不破坏其排序。
AI.result: 单路径预测在四个扩散模型与真实缺陷上对邻近起点的泄漏预测误差仅数百分之一；leak 随步数增长实为 exposure bias，正常细节遵循同一规律，改变路径或训练会在泄漏与细节误差间权衡。SurvAD 以不足 2% 额外推理时间将 DeCo-Diff 的多类像素平均精度从 76.8 提至 80.7（MVTec AD）、57.5 提至 60.0（VisA）；同等重建器下以 9 倍更少可训练参数匹敌 CostFilter-AD，并在 Dinomaly 协议下于两个基准上超过其报告的 P-AP。
AI.conclusion: 异常的泄漏由保留率决定的生存律精确控制，具有可预测性与跨采样设置迁移性；据此设计的 SurvAD 在不显著增加推理成本的前提下显著提升异常定位性能，并具备参数效率优势。但其结论仍限于一阶确定性采样器与特定数据集范围。

title: QCVS: Question-Contrastive Visual Steering for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Inference-time steering in vision-language models often entangles query-relevant reasoning dynamics with low-level perceptual noise, causing collateral degradation on correct predictions. We propose Question-Contrastive Visual Steering (QCVS) to isolate task-specific intervention directions via double-differential activation probing. By contrasting spatial layout perturbations under the target query against a generic description reference, QCVS cancels task-agnostic visual artifacts without ground-truth supervision. A dual-threshold gating mechanism then evaluates relative interaction strength and signal amplitude, selectively applying a single bounded hidden-state update only when necessary. Empirical evaluations across multiple scales of Qwen3.5 (2B to 9B) and DeepSeek-VL2 on DynaMath and We-Math demonstrate that QCVS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy gains under sparse coverage (approximately 22%-30%). Crucially, QCVS yields repair rates up to 13.98% while suppressing collateral damage down to 0.41%, proving high intervention precision and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 Question-Contrastive Visual Steering (QCVS)，用双差分激活探测分离任务相关干预方向，并配合双阈值门控做稀疏、有界的隐状态更新，实现高精度推理期引导。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型推理期引导方法将查询相关推理动态与低层感知噪声纠缠在一起，导致对原本正确的预测产生附带性能退化（collateral degradation）。
AI.method: (1) 双差分激活探测：在目标查询下对比空间布局扰动与通用描述参考，抵消与任务无关的视觉伪影，无需真值监督即可隔离任务特定干预方向；(2) 双阈值门控机制：评估相对交互强度与信号幅度，仅在必要时施加一次有界隐状态更新（single bounded hidden-state update）。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5（2B–9B）多尺度模型与 DeepSeek-VL2 上，于 DynaMath 与 We-Math 基准上，约 22%–30% 的稀疏覆盖下取得 SOTA 精度提升；修复率最高达 13.98%，附带损伤低至 0.41%。
AI.conclusion: QCVS 以无监督方式实现任务特异性方向的精准分离与选择性干预，兼顾高修复率与低附带损伤，体现高干预精度与计算效率。

title: RadAI: Gaze-Intention Fusion Pipeline for Attention-Guided Educational Videos in Chest X-Ray Interpretation
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, accepted to 2026 MIT IEEE URTC conference
summary: Chest radiograph interpretation errors often arise from failures in visual search: although trainees may correctly identify an abnormality once pointed out, they frequently fail to fixate on the relevant region, while expert search strategies (where radiologists look, in what sequence, and for how long) remain largely implicit. Eye movement modeling examples (EMME), which replay a recorded expert's gaze over the image, have been shown to improve novice detection of findings on chest radiographs, but producing one requires an eye-tracking session on that specific case, so teaching sets are limited to recorded sessions by experts. In this work, RadAI is presented, the first end-to-end framework for transforming predicted radiologist gaze into narrated instructional videos, enabling scalable gaze-guided training without collecting new eye-tracking data. Given only a chest X-ray and its report, RadAI predicts an expert fixation sequence, associates each interval of that sequence with the diagnostic finding it pursues, extracts the corresponding image region, and renders the result as an EMME-style video in which each highlighted finding is narrated with synthesized speech. RadAI is evaluated on 97 cases from the EGD-CXR dataset, assessing whether the highlighted regions correspond to annotated abnormality locations. We position this work as a framework for scalable generation of educational content for residents and medical students in the field of radiology.

AI.tldr: RadAI：首个端到端框架，将预测的放射科医师注视序列自动转化为带语音讲解的EMME式教学视频，无需新采集眼动数据，实现可扩展的注视引导式胸片阅片训练。
AI.motivation: 胸片判读错误常源于视觉搜索失败：受训者在被指出后能识别异常，但主动阅片时却不注视相关区域；而专家的搜索策略（注视位置、顺序、时长）多为隐性知识。EMME（回放专家注视轨迹）可提升新手检出率，但每例都需眼动追踪录制，教学集受限于既有专家录制数据，难以规模化。
AI.method: RadAI 仅以胸片与其报告为输入：①预测专家注视（fixation）序列；②将序列中各时间区间与所追寻的诊断发现相关联；③提取对应图像区域；④渲染为 EMME 风格视频，并对每个高亮发现配以合成语音讲解。
AI.result: 在 EGD-CXR 数据集的 97 个病例上评估，检验所高亮区域是否与标注的异常位置相符。
AI.conclusion: 该工作定位为可扩展生成放射科住院医师与医学生教学内容的框架。

title: Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) between architectural families, e.g., from a Transformer teacher to a CNN student, is difficult because the two networks learn different representations. Logits share a label space, but heterogeneous teachers differ in logit offset, scale, and sharpness, and their non-target classes are less semantically organized. Conventional logit distillation matches these values sample by sample, asking the student to imitate how another architecture expresses its predictions. We argue that a heterogeneous teacher should pass on the relational structure of its predictions, i.e., how it arranges samples relative to one another, and propose Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation (HACD) to transfer this structure. HACD maps teacher and student logits to centered, temperature-softened probability directions on a shared unit hypersphere, which removes architecture-dependent offsets and lets the temperature control how sharply peaked outputs enter the representation while keeping informative non-target classes. Each student output must then identify its own teacher target within the batch. Because every teacher target also acts as a negative for the others, HACD computes the targets on a moderately augmented view and contrasts both a moderate and a strong student view against them. HACD adds no learnable parameters and needs one teacher pass per sample. It achieves the best or second-best accuracy on 11 of 12 heterogeneous pairs on CIFAR-100, without ground-truth labels, and on 14 of 15 pairs on ImageNet-1K, improving over the reported vanilla KD results by 8.82 and 1.33 percentage points on average. Checkpoints are available at https://github.com/BTAEYANG/HACD-Heterogeneous-Asymmetric-Contrastive-Distillation; the code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出异构非对称对比蒸馏（HACD），将异构教师预测的"关系结构"而非逐样本logit值迁移给学生，无需可学习参数，在CIFAR-100与ImageNet-1K的异构师生对上均取得领先精度。
AI.motivation: 跨架构（如Transformer教师→CNN学生）知识蒸馏困难，因两网络学习不同表征。Logit虽共享标签空间，但异构教师存在logit偏移、尺度与锐度差异，且非目标类的语义组织性较弱；传统logit蒸馏逐样本匹配数值，等于要求学生模仿另一架构"如何表达"预测，而非"学到了什么"。
AI.method: HACD将教师与学生logit映射到共享单位超球面上的"中心化+温度软化"概率方向，消除架构相关的偏移，并由温度控制输出的尖锐程度，同时保留信息量丰富的非目标类；随后要求学生每个输出在batch内识别自己的教师目标（每个教师目标同时作为其他样本的负样本），即非对称对比形式；在适度增强视图上计算目标，并用中等与强两种学生视图分别与之对比。方法不增加可学习参数，每样本仅需一次教师前向。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100上12组异构师生对中11组取得最优或次优精度（无真实标签）；ImageNet-1K上15组中14组最优或次优；相较所报告的vanilla KD结果平均提升8.82与1.33个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 异构教师应传递预测的关系结构而非逐样本数值；HACD以对比式关系蒸馏实现高效的跨架构知识迁移，兼容无标签场景，且几乎无额外开销。

title: Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning
summary: Latent world models enable visual control by planning action sequences in compact representation spaces, but a gap remains between how latent dynamics are learned and how they are used for planning. First, teacher-forced training does not expose the dynamics model to the recursively predicted latent states encountered during planning. Second, sampling-based planners typically initialize action search from goal-agnostic proposals, without exploiting the action-conditioned dynamics learned by the world model. We introduce Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL) to bridge these two gaps. During training, rollout alignment exposes the forward model to its own autoregressive latent predictions, while multi-step inverse supervision trains a lightweight inverse dynamics head to infer actions from latent-state transitions. We further apply the inverse head to model-generated transitions with its parameters held fixed, encouraging predicted rollouts to retain action-relevant information. At test time, DIAL autoregressively couples the inverse and forward dynamics to construct a dynamics-informed action sequence toward the goal, which initializes the mean of the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) proposal distribution. The subsequent CEM search then refines this initialization using the standard sampling and updating procedure. Experiments across four visual control benchmarks demonstrate that DIAL outperforms existing latent world models and planning baselines in both standard and long-horizon scenarios.

AI.tldr: DIAL通过rollout alignment与多步逆动力学监督弥合潜在世界模型中"动力学学习"与"规划使用"的鸿沟，并在测试时用逆-前向动力学自回归耦合生成目标导向的动作序列以初始化CEM，在四个视觉控制基准上优于现有潜在世界模型与规划基线。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型通过紧凑表示空间中的动作序列规划实现视觉控制，但动力学学习方式与规划使用方式之间存在两处鸿沟：(1) teacher-forced训练未让动力学模型接触规划时遇到的递归预测潜状态，造成训练-测试分布不匹配；(2) 基于采样的规划器通常从与目标无关的提议分布初始化动作搜索，未利用世界模型已学到的动作条件动力学。
AI.method: 提出DIAL（Dynamics-Informed Action Learning）。训练阶段：(a) rollout alignment使前向模型暴露于自身的自回归潜预测；(b) 多步逆动力学监督训练轻量逆动力学头，从潜状态转移推断动作；(c) 将逆动力学头参数冻结应用于模型生成转移，促使预测rollout保留动作相关信息。测试阶段：自回归耦合逆动力学与前向动力学，逐步构造指向目标、由动力学启发的动作序列，用于初始化CEM提议分布的均值，再由标准CEM采样与更新流程精化。
AI.result: 在四个视觉控制基准上，DIAL在常规与长时程场景下均优于现有潜在世界模型与规划基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式对齐训练与规划的潜状态分布、并以逆动力学引导采样初始化，可有效提升潜在世界模型的规划性能，尤其在长时程任务中。

title: EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning
summary: Endoscopic diagnosis unfolds over native video, where a single positive finding during traversal of the gastrointestinal tract sets off a multi-minute chain of reasoning over location, morphology, severity and intervention. Existing endoscopy multimodal benchmarks test only static images or single-disease videos, which miss the temporal and clinical reasoning that real-world reporting demands. We introduce EndoSCOP-V, a video-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for structured endoscopy reporting and clinical reasoning. It contains 1,307 real-world endoscopy and colonoscopy videos (63.2 h; 97% 1080p) averaging about 174 s. Its 20,274 question-answer turns are instantiated deterministically from clinician-filled structured endoscopy-reporting EHRs, so no per-case annotation is synthetic or LLM-rephrased. They come from 1,033 clinician-reviewed templates, about 18 per disease, that span a clinically aligned 9-task x 30-sub-task reporting taxonomy over 54 World Endoscopy Organization (WEO) MST 3.0 diseases. 22% of procedures carry co-existing pathologies, up to six per case. A Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing protocol evaluates the dialogue turn by turn, injecting the gold answer before each subsequent turn so that per-turn reasoning is isolated from cascading dialogue errors. A panel of 15 board-certified endoscopists sets a 78% strict-accuracy baseline on 1,500 questions. Across 14 open-weight LMMs, the best 27B-class model reaches 59.8% strict accuracy, falling to 53.4% once format-trivial disease-rejection items are excluded. On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy. Sub-task analysis reveals consistent gaps in quantitative measurement, multi-variable grading and intervention reasoning on long-horizon video. Data: Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V). Code: GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V).

AI.tldr: 本文提出EndoSCOP-V，一个面向结构化内镜报告与临床推理的视频多轮评测框架，包含1,307段真实内镜/结肠镜视频（63.2小时）及20,274轮问答，答案由临床医生填写的结构化报告EHR确定性生成。
AI.motivation: 现有内镜多模态基准仅测试静态图像或单一疾病视频，缺乏真实报告中必需的时间维度与临床推理（部位、形态、严重度、干预的链式判断），无法反映真实诊断过程。
AI.method: 构建EndoSCOP-V：1,307段视频（平均约174s，97%为1080p），问答轮次由医生结构化内镜报告确定性实例化，源自1,033个经临床审核的模板（每病约18个），覆盖9任务×30子任务、54种WEO MST 3.0疾病，22%病例共存多种病变。采用马尔可夫式上下文剪枝的oracle-forcing协议逐轮注入金标准答案以隔离单轮推理。由15名认证内镜医师在1,500题上建立基线，并评测14个开源权重LMM及3个前沿闭源模型。
AI.result: 医生专家组严格准确率达78%；开源模型中最佳27B级模型为59.8%，剔除格式平凡的疾病拒判题后降至53.4%；3个前沿专有模型中最佳者在严格NDR准确率上仍落后医生23个百分点。子任务分析显示在定量测量、多变量分级与长时程视频中的干预推理上存在持续差距。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界视频内镜报告是现有多模态模型的重要短板，EndoSCOP-V提供了临床对齐、可复现的多轮评测标准，揭示模型在长时程视频临床推理上的系统性不足。

title: Reason First, Retrieve What Matters: Hypothesis-Guided Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding requires models to identify and reason over sparse, temporally distributed evidence within limited frame budgets. Existing keyframe selection methods typically retrieve query-relevant frames from a densely sampled candidate set before inference. However, global image-text matching incurs unnecessary computation when a small set of uniformly sampled frames already provides sufficient evidence. Query relevance alone may also overlook evidence that distinguishes competing answers, while one-shot selection offers no opportunity to correct earlier selection errors. We propose HypoKFS, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples keyframe selection with iterative inference by multimodal large language models (MLLMs). HypoKFS first reasons over sparsely sampled frames to construct an initial hypothesis space. The resulting answer distribution determines whether additional frame selection is needed. When needed, the retained hypotheses guide the selection of discriminative frames, followed by renewed inference and hypothesis refinement. This iterative process directs additional visual computation toward unresolved hypotheses while avoiding unnecessary global frame matching. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple MLLM backbones. HypoKFS improves accuracy by up to 6.7 percentage points and achieves 72.9% accuracy on Video-MME at only 1.3% of the reference frame-hypothesis matching cost.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、即插即用的HypoKFS框架，将关键帧选择与MLLM迭代推理耦合：先用稀疏帧建立假设空间，按答案分布决定是否补充选帧，并由保留假设引导选取判别性帧，从而把视觉计算集中于未决假设上。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解需在有限帧预算内定位稀疏、时序分散的证据。现有方法先在稠密候选集上做查询相关帧检索，但全局图文匹配在少量均匀采样帧已足够时属多余计算；且仅用查询相关性会忽略区分竞争答案的证据，一次性选择也无法纠正早期选帧错误。
AI.method: HypoKFS为training-free、plug-and-play框架：1) 在稀疏采样帧上推理构建初始假设空间；2) 由答案分布判断是否需要追加选帧；3) 需要时以保留假设引导选择判别性帧，再重新推理并精化假设；4) 迭代进行，避免全局帧匹配。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench、MLVU上，跨多个MLLM主干均取得一致提升；准确率最高提升6.7个百分点，Video-MME上达72.9%，而参考帧-假设匹配开销仅为1.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以假设驱动的迭代式关键帧选择替代一次性全局检索，可在低帧预算与低匹配成本下有效提升长视频问答性能，且与现有MLLM主干兼容。

title: ROLECUE: Diagnosing Cross-Lingual Role-Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027, Evaluations and Datasets Track
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize events in images and parse sentences, but it remains unclear when they bind visual Agent-Patient structure to linguistic semantic roles across languages whose role cues depend on morphology, word order or construction. We introduce ROLECUE, a controlled diagnostic that pairs 192 validated two-person action images with German, Turkish, Japanese, English, Korean and Bangla sentences in canonical and patient-first orders. The evaluation separates image-only role recognition, text-only role parsing, direct image-sentence matching, response-compliance behavior and an external modular composition of the model's own component predictions. Across eight recent open-weight VLMs, ROLECUE reveals a structured spectrum: some models fail visual or linguistic component tests, some largely solve the diagnostic, some collapse to constant semantic assent and several show component-joint gaps in which reliable image-only and text-only role predictions do not survive direct joint inference. The largest non-degenerate gaps reach 44.9 percentage points, with final bootstrap intervals confirming that the effect is not a point-estimate artifact. These results reveal multilingual component-joint performance gaps and acceptance biases hidden by aggregate VLM benchmarks and show why component diagnostics are necessary before interpreting joint multimodal errors.

AI.tldr: 提出 ROLECUE 诊断基准，检验视觉语言模型能否在多语言下将图像中的施事-受事结构绑定到句子语义角色，发现视觉、语言单独可靠时联合推理仍出现显著间隙。
AI.motivation: VLMs 虽能识别图像事件与解析句子，但能否把视觉 Agent-Patient 结构绑定到依赖形态、语序或构式的多语言语义角色尚不清楚；聚合基准掩盖了这一能力细节。
AI.method: 构建受控诊断 ROLECUE：192 张经校验的双人动作图像配以德语、土耳其语、日语、英语、韩语、孟加拉语的规范语序与受事先行语序句子；将评测分解为纯图像角色识别、纯文本角色解析、图文直接匹配、回答合规性，以及模型自身组件预测的外部模块化组合；在八个近期开源权重 VLM 上测试并用 bootstrap 区间验证。
AI.result: 呈现结构化谱系：部分模型在视觉或语言组件测试上失败，部分基本解决该诊断，部分退化为恒定语义附和，若干模型出现组件-联合间隙，最大非退化间隙达 44.9 个百分点，bootstrap 区间确认非点估计假象。
AI.conclusion: 揭示被聚合 VLM 基准掩盖的多语言组件-联合性能差距与接受偏差，说明在解释联合多模态错误前必须先做组件级诊断。

title: 3D Segmentation in the Clinic: A Grand Challenge
comment: 9 pages, 1 table. Published in the proceedings of the MICCAI 2007 workshop 3D Segmentation in the Clinic: A Grand Challenge
summary: This paper describes the set-up of a segmentation competition for automatic and semi-automatic extraction of the liver from computed tomography scans and the caudate nucleus from brain MRI data. This competition was held in the form of a workshop at the 2007 Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention conference.
