The rationale for organizing the competition is discussed, the training and test data sets for both segmentation tasks are described and the scoring system used to evaluate the segmentation is presented.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍2007年MICCAI会议举办的图像分割竞赛，涵盖CT肝脏与脑MRI尾状核的自动/半自动提取任务，说明了数据与评分体系。
AI.motivation: 为在医学图像分割领域建立客观、可比较的评测基准，通过竞赛形式对自动与半自动分割算法进行公平比较与评估。
AI.method: 以MICCAI 2007研讨会形式组织竞赛，面向两个分割任务——CT扫描中的肝脏提取与脑MRI中的尾状核分割，分别构建训练集与测试集，并设计统一的评分系统评价分割性能。
AI.result: 论文本身为竞赛设计说明：阐述了举办动机、描述了两项任务的训练与测试数据集，并给出了用于评估分割结果的评分系统（摘要未报告具体参赛算法性能数值）。
AI.conclusion: 该竞赛提供了一个标准化、可复现的评测框架，为医学图像分割算法的横向比较奠定基础，并为后续同类挑战赛的组织提供参考范式。

title: Disentangled Stylized Image Generation via IP-Cross-Attention Rearrangement
summary: With a solid theoretical foundation and pretraining on large-scale datasets, diffusion-based methods have achieved controllable generation leveraging text and image conditions, and generating excellent stylized images is possible using diffusion models. However, previous methods face significant challenges. First, because diffusion generation is iterative, the common approach of learning implicit style representations via cycle-consistency strategies is too costly and not well-suited to diffusion, even for LoRA-based methods. Second, decoupling style is difficult in the latent space of diffusion models. Representations of attributes are coupled in the latent space of diffusion models; thus, extracting style attributes with diffusion models usually suffers from the issue of content leakage. Furthermore, because style is hard to represent in natural language, capturing style using text prompts or textual inversion is deficient. In this paper, we propose a method for achieving disentangled stylized image generation through IP-cross-attention rearrangement, based on our experimental observations. We also propose negative content guidance, inspired by classifier-free guidance, to reduce content leakage in stylized image generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于IP-cross-attention重排的解耦风格化图像生成方法，并引入负内容引导以缓解内容泄漏。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的风格化生成存在三大问题：(1) 扩散生成是迭代过程，通过循环一致性学习隐式风格表示代价过高，且不契合扩散范式（即使基于LoRA的方法亦然）；(2) 扩散潜空间中属性表示相互耦合，风格解耦困难，提取风格属性时常发生内容泄漏；(3) 风格难以用自然语言表达，文本提示或文本反演对风格的刻画不足。
AI.method: 基于作者的实验观察，通过IP-cross-attention重排实现解耦的风格化图像生成；并借鉴classifier-free guidance提出负内容引导（negative content guidance），以降低风格化生成中的内容泄漏。
AI.result: 方法可实现解耦的风格化图像生成，并通过负内容引导减少内容泄漏（摘要未给出定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 在扩散模型框架下，通过cross-attention重排实现风格解耦、结合负内容引导抑制内容泄漏，是兼顾效果与效率的风格化生成可行路径。

title: Understanding the Effect of Visual Attention in CNNs: A Decision-Space Alignment Perspective
summary: Visual Attention enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by modulating intermediate features, yet their effects on downstream decisions remain less understood. We present a decision-space framework that models multiplicative attention as an intermediate feature perturbation and derives a first-order prediction of its effect on the target-versus-competitor classification margin. We further introduce the Decision Alignment Score (DAS) to quantify the directional alignment between the perturbation and the local margin gradient. We evaluate the framework on CIFAR-100 using SimAM and CBAM across five popular CNN backbones, ResNet-18, ResNet-20, ResNet-50, ResNet-56, and MobileNetV2. The analysis examines prediction agreement, DAS margin correlations, and downstream activation-state changes. Across most final-attention configurations, predicted and actual margin changes show good agreement, while DAS exhibits positive correlations with actual margin changes. Single-attention experiments further show that prediction agreement and DAS margin correlations depend on attention placement, with stronger associations at later stages.

AI.tldr: 提出决策空间框架，将乘性注意力视为中间特征扰动，用一阶近似预测其对目标-竞争类别间隔的影响，并引入决策对齐分数（DAS）量化扰动与局部间隔梯度的方向一致性，在CIFAR-100上验证了预测与实际间隔变化的一致性及DAS的正相关性。
AI.motivation: 注意力通过调制CNN中间特征提升性能，但其对下游决策的影响机制尚不清楚，缺乏可解释的定量分析工具。
AI.method: 将乘性注意力建模为中间特征扰动，推导其对目标-竞争类别分类间隔的一阶预测；定义决策对齐分数（DAS）度量扰动方向与局部间隔梯度的对齐程度；在CIFAR-100上使用SimAM与CBAM，覆盖ResNet-18/20/50/56与MobileNetV2五种骨干网络，分析预测一致性、DAS-间隔相关性与下游激活状态变化。
AI.result: 多数末端注意力配置下预测与实际间隔变化吻合良好；DAS与实际间隔变化呈正相关；单注意力实验表明预测一致性与DAS相关性依赖注意力插入位置，越靠后的阶段关联越强。
AI.conclusion: 该决策空间框架可为注意力对分类决策的作用提供可量化的解释，注意力位置显著影响其决策效应。

title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
summary: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 MotionGraphicsBench：含100个由专家筛选的"静态SVG+运动编辑提示"实例，配套确定性、人类可读的验证程序而非参考动画或VLM评判，用于评估LLM的空间、外观与时间复合指令遵循能力。
AI.motivation: LLM已能由静态图像与自然语言生成动效（motion graphics），但缺少能同时考核空间、外观、时序三重要求的评测方法；现有方式依赖参考动画比对或VLM打分，难以容许合法实现多样性且判定不可靠。
AI.method: 构建100个源自真实Lottie设计的实例，所有视觉元素预先给定，从而将运动生成与图形生成解耦、贴近设计师工作流；每个实例配一个确定性、人类可读的验证程序，接受多种合法实现并逐条报告提示要求通过/失败。验证程序由多智能体流水线结合人工标注动画与合成测试用例构建。评测覆盖32个模型/12家提供商的47种配置，并对15个模型在高推理强度下每实例尝试32次。
AI.result: 在180个动画的平衡测试集上，验证程序与人工判定原始一致率93.3%，高于GPT-6 Astra VLM基线的83.3%，并在通过召回与拒绝召回上均优于基线。pass@1区间为6.0%–67.7%；提高尝试次数可提升所有模型，但pass@32仍仅为38.0%–95.0%。
AI.conclusion: 基于可执行验证程序的评测比VLM评判更贴近人类判断且更具可解释性；当前模型在遵循参考姿态、实现请求的运动轨迹、协调相关事件方面仍系统性失败，复合时空指令遵循仍是明显短板。

title: Beyond Frame-Level Accuracy: Analyzing Video-Level Stability in Transformer-Based Deepfake Forensics
comment: Paper submitted to international journal of intelligent systems, Wiley publishers, accepted version of open-access paper
summary: Deepfake videos generated by advanced generative models pose serious threats to digital security, misinformation control, and media forensics. Although numerous detection methods have been proposed, their reported performances are often based on heterogeneous preprocessing pipelines, inconsistent data splits, and model-specific training protocols, hindering fair architectural comparison. This work presents a controlled and reproducible comparative study of convolutional neural networks (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0) and a transformer-based architecture (ViT-B/16) within a unified, face-centric deepfake detection framework. All models are trained using identical preprocessing, augmentation, optimization settings, and data splits on Celeb-DF v2 and FaceForensics++, and results are validated across three independent random seeds with bootstrapped confidence intervals. Experimental results show that while CNN-based models perform competitively at the frame level, their performance degrades after video-level aggregation. In contrast, ViT-B/16 demonstrates more stable video-level performance, achieving 92.8\% [95\% CI: 91.7--94.0] video-level accuracy and an AUC of 0.950 [95\% CI: 0.934--0.964] on Celeb-DF v2 (3-seed bootstrapped). Cross-dataset evaluation across the same three random seeds reveals a large, asymmetric generalization gap (AUC 0.79 FF++$\rightarrow$Celeb-DF vs. 0.64 Celeb-DF$\rightarrow$FF++), indicating that in-domain video-level stability does not transfer to unseen manipulation domains. These findings indicate that global self-attention improves robustness and video-level stability for deepfake detection within a given data domain, while highlighting the need for further work on cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 在统一预处理、数据划分与训练协议下，对ResNet-18、EfficientNet-B0与ViT-B/16进行可复现对比；ViT-B/16在视频级更稳定（Celeb-DF v2 上92.8%准确率、AUC 0.950），但跨数据集泛化差距大且不对称（0.79 vs 0.64）。
AI.motivation: 现有deepfake检测方法的报告性能基于异构预处理流程、不一致的数据划分与模型特定训练协议，导致架构间难以公平比较，作者希望提供受控、可复现的架构对比。
AI.method: 在统一的、以人脸为中心的检测框架中，对CNN（ResNet-18、EfficientNet-B0）与Transformer（ViT-B/16）使用完全相同的预处理、增强、优化设置与数据划分，在Celeb-DF v2与FaceForensics++上训练；以3个独立随机种子验证，并使用bootstrap置信区间；同时进行跨数据集评估。
AI.result: CNN在帧级具竞争力，但视频级聚合后性能下降；ViT-B/16视频级更稳定，Celeb-DF v2上视频级准确率92.8% [95% CI 91.7–94.0]、AUC 0.950 [95% CI 0.934–0.964]（3种子bootstrap）。跨数据集存在显著不对称泛化差距：FF++→Celeb-DF AUC 0.79，Celeb-DF→FF++ AUC 0.64。
AI.conclusion: 全局自注意力可在同一数据域内提升鲁棒性与视频级稳定性，但域内视频级稳定性并不能迁移至未见操纵域，跨域泛化仍需进一步研究。

title: Contrastive fine-tuning against stain and scanner bias improves robustness and downstream performance across pathology foundation models
summary: Histopathology foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse downstream tasks, yet their representations have been shown to encode scanner- and site-specific biases, creating generalization gaps and potentially limiting real-world utility. We introduce SPECTRA (Scanner and Pathology Embedding Contrastive Tuning for Robust Alignment), a model-agnostic contrastive learning post-training framework which explicitly encourages scanner- and stain-robust representations, to optimize performance and generalization on downstream applications. Using parameter-efficient LoRA adapters trained on matched multi-scanner and multi-stain whole-slide images sourced from the PLISM dataset, our method aligns spatially corresponding regions across acquisition conditions (scanner, stain), using other locations within each candidate condition as negatives. SPECTRA improved PathoROB robustness index, gene-expression prediction on HEST, slide-level classification AUC on CPTAC, and held-out PLISM retrieval for every model. Overall tile-level classification on THUNDER also improved, with exceptions for segmentation and calibration tasks. We open-source our training and evaluation codebases and release adapters and model weights for selected backbones.

AI.tldr: SPECTRA：一个模型无关的对比学习后训练框架，用LoRA适配器在PLISM多扫描仪、多染色的配对全切片图像上对齐空间对应区域，抑制组织病理基础模型中的扫描仪与站点偏倚，提升下游鲁棒性与泛化。
AI.motivation: 组织病理基础模型在下游任务表现优异，但其表征编码了扫描仪与站点特异性偏倚，造成泛化差距并限制真实场景应用。需显式鼓励扫描仪与染色鲁棒的表征。
AI.method: 提出SPECTRA（Scanner and Pathology Embedding Contrastive Tuning for Robust Alignment）：模型无关的对比学习后训练框架。采用参数高效LoRA适配器，在PLISM数据集的匹配多扫描仪、多染色全切片图像上训练；将不同采集条件（扫描仪、染色）下空间对应的区域作为正样本对齐，并以各候选条件下的其他位置作为负样本。
AI.result: 对所有模型均提升了PathoROB鲁棒性指数、HEST基因表达预测、CPTAC切片级分类AUC以及留出集的PLISM检索性能；THUNDER整体切片级分类亦提升，但分割与校准任务出现例外（性能下降）。
AI.conclusion: SPECTRA以轻量、模型无关的后训练方式有效提升组织病理基础模型的跨扫描仪/染色鲁棒性与下游泛化；同时开源训练与评估代码，并发布部分骨干网络的适配器与模型权重。局限在于对分割和校准任务并非一致增益。

title: VisProve: Learning Typed Visual Provenance for Scientific Document Question Answering
summary: Visual citations show where an answer is supported, but not how the cited content contributes to it. In scientific document question answering, a model may read a value directly, compress several observations, or combine evidence to infer a conclusion. We study typed visual provenance, where a system generates an answer together with source regions and explicit support relations. We introduce ReViE, a dataset of 3,941 questions over complete scientific documents, with page, section, and region annotations labeled as Quotation, Compression, or Inference. We further propose VisProve, which augments joint answer and provenance generation with differentiable Spatial Evidence Reading and Evidence-Answer Relation Feedback. VisProve conditions next-token prediction on localized visual evidence and its estimated support relation through a gated norm-bounded residual. On the document-disjoint ReViE test set, VisProve improves Typed-F1 from 3.52 to 5.48 and Section-F1 from 45.99 to 53.24 over joint supervised fine-tuning with the same backbone, while Page-F1 changes only marginally. These results suggest that coupling visual grounding with support relation modeling mainly improves fine-grained provenance, while the low absolute Typed-F1 reveals a substantial gap between answer generation and precise visual evidence attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReViE数据集与VisProve方法，研究"带类型的视觉溯源"（Typed Visual Provenance）：让模型在生成答案的同时给出源区域及其显式支撑关系（引用/压缩/推断）。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉引用只能说明答案"在哪里"被支撑，却无法说明被引内容"如何"支撑答案。科学文档问答中，模型可能直接读取数值、压缩多条观察，或组合证据进行推断，三类贡献需被区分，但缺少带类型标注的数据与建模方法。
AI.method: 构建ReViE数据集：3,941个覆盖完整科学文档的问题，含页面、章节、区域三级标注，区域标签为Quotation、Compression、Inference。提出VisProve：在联合答案与溯源生成框架中加入可微空间证据读取（Spatial Evidence Reading）与证据-答案关系反馈（Evidence-Answer Relation Feedback），通过门控的范数有界残差将下一个token预测条件化于局部视觉证据及估计的支撑关系。
AI.result: 在文档不相交的ReViE测试集上，相较同一骨干的联合监督微调，Typed-F1由3.52提升至5.48，Section-F1由45.99提升至53.24，Page-F1变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉定位与支撑关系建模耦合主要改善细粒度溯源性能；Typed-F1绝对数值偏低，说明答案生成与精确视觉证据归因之间仍存在显著差距。

title: PrivMark: Pixel-Space Steering against Privacy Leakage in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) routinely disclose soft-biometric attributes such as age, gender, and race in their text outputs, exposing demographic information from uploaded images to any downstream API user. Existing privacy defenses do not fit this setting: face de-identification leaves distributed soft-biometric cues intact, classifier-targeted adversarial perturbations do not transfer to open-ended generation, and stronger VLM-specific methods require retraining or runtime activation access unavailable to downstream APIs. We propose PrivMark, a framework that suppresses biometric leakage at the image level. By analyzing VLM activations, we identify two weakly aligned steering vector directions in hidden-state space, each tied to a distinct leakage behavior --- one corresponding to incidental attribute disclosure under open-ended descriptions, the other to compliance with direct biometric probes instead of refusal --- and encode both directions into a single bounded pixel perturbation, so the protected image alone enforces privacy with no invasive access to model internals at deployment. To support evaluation, we assemble BioleakBench, $1{,}600$ VQA pairs covering biometric privacy attributes under both free-form description and direct-probe protocols. Across three white-box source models, PrivMark achieves up to $85.9\%$ biometric suppression while retaining $75\%$ of clean OK-VQA utility, up to $1.4\times$ the privacy-utility tradeoff of the strongest pixel-only baseline. The same one-shot perturbations transfer consistently to seven unseen VLMs including closed-source APIs.

AI.tldr: 提出PrivMark，在图像层面通过单一像素扰动同时编码两个弱对齐的引导向量方向，抑制VLM输出生物特征泄露，并构建BioleakBench评测基准。
AI.motivation: VLM在文本输出中会无意识地泄露年龄、性别、种族等软生物特征，使上传图像的人口统计信息暴露给任意下游API用户。现有防御不适配：人脸去标识化残留分布式线索，分类器对抗扰动无法迁移到开放式生成，VLM专用方法需要重训练或运行时激活访问。
AI.method: 分析VLM激活，识别隐状态空间中两个弱对齐的引导向量方向：一个对应开放式描述下的偶发属性披露，另一个对应直接生物特征探针下的顺从而非拒答；将两方向共同编码为单个有界像素扰动，部署时仅凭受保护图像即可施加隐私约束。同时构建BioleakBench，含1600个VQA对，覆盖自由描述与直接探针两种协议。
AI.result: 在三个白盒源模型上实现最高85.9%的生物特征抑制，同时保留75%的OK-VQA干净效用，隐私-效用权衡达最强纯像素基线的最多1.4倍；一次性扰动可一致迁移到七个未见VLM，包括闭源API。
AI.conclusion: 图像级单次像素扰动可作为VLM软生物特征泄露的有效、可迁移且无需模型内部访问的隐私防护手段。

title: SRA: Spatial Reasoning Adapter via Evolving Social Interaction Graphs for Trajectory Prediction
summary: Predicting where multiple agents will move next is fundamental to autonomous driving, robotics, and any system that must share space with people safely. Modern stochastic predictors read off inter-agent interactions once from the observed past and keep that view fixed throughout the generative rollout, so the reciprocal geometric constraints that emerge as the joint future sharpens are not re-examined. We address this gap with SRA (Spatial Reasoning Adapter), a modular graph denoiser that is integrated into existing diffusion and flow-matching predictors without redesigning their generative cores. At every reverse step, SRA reads the host's current future estimate, builds a sparse Euclidean interaction graph on the predicted trajectories, and returns a residual correction to the host's decoding path. Our adapter consists of three core components: a sparse neighborhood retrieved with a learned query-key score and a geometric bias, a future-conditioned relational feature recomputed on the evolving prediction, and uncertainty-weighted message passing where confident agents act as anchors for uncertain ones. We instantiate SRA on three structurally different hosts (LED, MID, and MoFlow) across four multi-agent benchmarks: SDD, NBA, Soccer, and Football. SRA improves ADE for every host on every dataset, with average gains of 5.8% in ADE and 7.0% in FDE. A cumulative ablation shows that the three components act as one mechanism: only together do they improve every host on every sports dataset, indicating that spatial reasoning over the model's own evolving future, weighted by how far that future can be trusted, is broadly useful across denoising architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaewoo97/SRA.

AI.tldr: SRA（Spatial Reasoning Adapter）是一种可插拔的图去噪适配器，在每个反向步对宿主模型当前未来预测构建稀疏欧氏交互图并输出残差修正，在三个宿主（LED、MID、MoFlow）与四个数据集上均提升ADE/FDE。
AI.motivation: 现有随机轨迹预测器只在观测历史上一��性读取智能体间交互，此后在生成式采样过程中固定不变，无法重新审视随联合未来逐渐锐化而出现的互惠几何约束。
AI.method: 在扩散/流匹配的每个反向步，SRA读取宿主的当前未来估计，在预测轨迹上构建稀疏欧氏交互图，并向宿主解码路径返回残差修正。包含三部分：基于可学习query-key打分与几何偏置的稀疏邻域检索；在演化预测上重算的未来条件关系特征；以置信智能体作为不确定智能体锚点的、不确定性加权消息传递。不改动宿主生成核心。
AI.result: 在SDD、NBA、Soccer、Football四个多智能体基准上，SRA对三个结构不同的宿主在所有数据集上均改善ADE，平均提升ADE 5.8%、FDE 7.0%。
AI.conclusion: 累积消融表明三组件构成单一机制：仅三者同时启用时才能在全部宿主与全部体育数据集上一致提升，说明基于模型自身演化未来并按可信度加权进行空间推理，对各类去噪架构普遍有效。

title: Decoupling Direction and Magnitude: Language-Steered Flow Matching for Super-Resolution in the Dark
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 32 pages, 12 figures, and 13 tables. Code and pretrained models: https://github.com/moriyaya/DeLang-SR
summary: Image super-resolution in the dark is fundamentally challenged by extreme spatial heterogeneity: severely underexposed and noisy regions demand aggressive generative enhancement to reconstruct missing details, while relatively well-exposed areas require conservative updates to prevent hallucinated textures. Standard diffusion and flow-matching models, however, rely on globally uniform integration trajectories, making them sub-optimal for such spatially varying degradations. In this paper, we propose DeLang-SR (Degradation-Language steered Super-Resolution), a one-step flow-matching framework that explicitly decouples the restoration direction and magnitude. Rather than treating low-light corruption as arbitrary latent features, DeLang-SR translates measurable physical statistics into structured degradation language, harnessing the semantic prior of pretrained text-to-image models. The degradation-language intent, complemented by image-specific visual tokens, steers the velocity field (direction) toward restoration-relevant manifolds. Simultaneously, a continuous spatial update-strength field acts as a locally varying Euler step-size field (magnitude), applying stronger integration steps in heavily degraded shadows while enforcing conservative updates in reliable regions. Experiments on paired and real dark images, together with ablations and diagnostic analyses, show that DeLang-SR provides an effective and interpretable one-step route to super-resolution in the dark. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/moriyaya/DeLang-SR.

AI.tldr: 提出DeLang-SR：将物理退化统计转译为结构化“退化语言”，并结合空间可变的更新强度场，实现一步流匹配的暗光图像超分辨率，方向与幅度解耦。
AI.motivation: 暗光超分存在极端空间异质性：严重欠曝噪声区需强生成式增强，良好曝光区需保守更新以防幻觉纹理；而标准扩散/流匹配模型采用全局均匀积分轨迹，难以适配空间变化的退化。
AI.method: 一步流匹配框架，显式解耦修复方向与幅度：(1) 方向——将可测物理统计量转译为结构化退化语言，借助预训练文本到图像模型的语义先验，与图像特定视觉token共同引导速度场指向修复相关流形；(2) 幅度——连续空间更新强度场作为局部变化的欧拉步长场，在重退化阴影区施加更大积分步，在可靠区保持保守更新。
AI.result: 在成对与真实暗光图像上的实验，配合消融与诊断分析，表明该方法提供有效且可解释的一步暗光超分路径。
AI.conclusion: DeLang-SR通过退化语言引导与空间自适应步长实现高效、可解释的一步暗光超分，代码与预训练模型已开源。

title: S2HAND: Accuracy-Preservation Trade-Offs for Hand Specialization in Whole-Body Pose Models
comment: 39 pages, including appendices. Code and models: https://github.com/ronggong000/S2HAND
summary: Unified whole-body pose estimators jointly predict body, face, and hand landmarks, but often degrade on small, blurred, or occluded hands. Attaching a standalone hand specialist introduces extra detection overhead, coordinate alignment, and wrist-stitching artifacts. We introduce S2HAND, a hand-specialized Sapiens2-5B framework that preserves the native 308-keypoint output interface. Specifically, S2HAND-MT adapts a lightweight 0.87M-parameter pose branch to route 40 finger heatmaps while strictly preserving the shared Transformer, auxiliary task heads, and the other 268 body, foot, and face heatmaps. S2HAND-Pose further fine-tunes three Fisher-selected Transformer blocks (267.13M parameters), trading exact preservation for stronger hand recovery: it lifts macro AUC from 57.83% to 65.73% across HInt TEST, COCO WholeBody VAL, and FreiHAND EVAL, and surpasses HInt-adapted Hand5/HRNet and stitched Hand5 systems on all five Native Pipeline benchmarks. On COCO, S2HAND-Pose improves hand AP by 12.89 points and body-plus-foot AP by 0.19 points. Across a 512-image multi-task audit, it maintains 99.60% foreground segmentation agreement with the public checkpoint, with quantified normal and pointmap drift. Its 2D coordinates also lower 3D mesh error in frozen Pose2Mesh transfer, while our optional TailGuard re-cropping module cuts S2HAND-MT's severe failure rate on NewDays from 13.45% to 10.43%. S2HAND thus resolves the whole-body hand bottleneck with either exact non-hand preservation (MT) or empirically audited trade-offs (Pose).

AI.tldr: S2HAND 在 Sapiens2-5B 全身姿态框架内实现手部专门化，通过轻量热图重路由（MT）或 Fisher 选择的 Transformer 微调（Pose）提升小手/遮挡手精度，同时尽量保持原 308 关键点接口与非手任务性能。
AI.motivation: 统一全身姿态估计器虽联合预测身体、人脸与手部关键点，但在小尺寸、模糊或遮挡手部上性能显著下降；而外挂独立手部专家会带来额外检测开销、坐标对齐问题与手腕拼接伪影。
AI.method: 基于 Sapiens2-5B 构建，保留原生 308 关键点输出接口。S2HAND-MT：接入仅 0.87M 参数的轻量姿态分支，路由 40 个手指热图，严格冻结共享 Transformer、辅助任务头及其余 268 个身体/足部/人脸热图。S2HAND-Pose：进一步以 Fisher 信息选择 3 个 Transformer 块（267.13M 参数）微调，以牺牲精确保持换取更强手部恢复。另提供可选 TailGuard 重裁剪模块处理严重失败样本。
AI.result: S2HAND-Pose 将宏平均 AUC 从 57.83% 提升至 65.73%（HInt TEST、COCO WholeBody VAL、FreiHAND EVAL），并在五个 Native Pipeline 基准上均优于 HInt 适配的 Hand5/HRNet 与拼接式 Hand5 系统。COCO 上手部 AP 提升 12.89 点，身体+足部 AP 提升 0.19 点。512 张图像多任务审计中，前景分割与公开 checkpoint 一致率 99.60%，并量化了 normal 与 pointmap 漂移。2D 坐标在冻结 Pose2Mesh 迁移下降低 3D 网格误差；TailGuard 将 S2HAND-MT 在 NewDays 上的严重失败率从 13.45% 降至 10.43%。
AI.conclusion: S2HAND 以两种互补路径解决全身模型的手部瓶颈：MT 实现非手任务的精确保持，Pose 通过实证审计的折中取得更强手部精度，且两者均维持原生统一输出接口。

title: Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating for Multimodal Medical Data Fusion
summary: Multimodal fusion requires not only exchanging information across modalities but also determining which representations should participate in the interaction and how complementary cross-modal views should be combined. We introduce Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating, a fusion framework that integrates token-wise guidance, bidirectional cross-attention, and sample-specific fusion. The proposed method constructs two directional representations: an image-conditioned text representation, obtained by allowing textual tokens to query visual features, and a text-conditioned image representation formed in the reverse direction. Token-wise guidance modulates the representations before cross-attention, while an adaptive gate learns the relative contribution of the two resulting directional representations for each sample. We evaluate the approach using paired chest radiographs and radiology reports as an image-text test bed for binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification. The two cross-attention directions exhibit distinct performance characteristics, demonstrating that reversing the query and source modalities does not produce interchangeable representations. Ablation experiments further show that bidirectional interaction, adaptive gating, and token guidance provide complementary benefits. The proposed model achieves 96.05% accuracy, 96.10% F1-score, 98.37% AUC, 95.60% Sens@95Spec, and 96.51% Spec@95Sens, yielding the highest mean performance across all evaluated metrics. These findings support explicitly modeling interaction direction, token relevance, and sample-dependent integration when constructing multimodal representations.

AI.tldr: 提出引导式协同注意与自适应门控（GCAA G）融合框架，通过token级引导、双向交叉注意力和样本自适应门控构建方向性图文表示，在胸部X光-报告二分类上取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态融合不仅需跨模态交换信息，还需判定哪些表示参与交互、互补的跨模态视角如何组合；作者认为交互方向、token相关性与样本依赖的整合应被显式建模。
AI.method: 构建两个方向表示：文本token查询视觉特征得到图像条件文本表示，反向得到文本条件图像表示；token级引导在交叉注意力前调制表示；自适应门控逐样本学习两方向表示的相对贡献。以配对胸片与放射报告作为图文测试床进行正常/异常二分类。
AI.result: 两个交叉注意力方向表现出不同性能特征，说明反转查询与源模态并非可互换表示；消融显示双向交互、自适应门控与token引导收益互补。模型达96.05%准确率、96.10% F1、98.37% AUC、95.60% Sens@95Spec、96.51% Spec@95Sens，所有指标均值最高。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持在构建多模态表示时显式建模交互方向、token相关性与样本依赖的整合方式。

title: Anatomy-Preserving Unpaired Medical Image Translation via Shared Latent Anchoring
summary: Unpaired medical image-to-image translation requires synthesizing target-modality images from source-modality images without aligned supervision. Existing methods learn a direct source-to-target mapping that entangles structure preservation and appearance generation within a single model, often distorting clinically meaningful anatomy in the translated output. We argue that these two objectives should be decoupled entirely: anatomical structure should be captured independently of generation, and the generator should operate only on a frozen structural representation. To this end, we propose a two-stage framework for unpaired medical image translation. In the first stage, we learn a shared structure space by training a structure encoder-decoder on source images, target images, and structural masks jointly, using mask reconstruction to anchor the latent space to modality-agnostic anatomy. For source images without mask annotations, a target-domain memory bank provides soft structural supervision via prototype retrieval. In the second stage, a conditional flow model learns to render target-domain appearance under fixed structural conditions. This ensures the generator inherits target appearance statistics and can focus entirely on structural conditioning rather than learning appearance from scratch. We validate our framework on OCT-to-OCTA synthesis and brain MR-to-CT translation. Our method outperforms all unpaired baselines on both tasks and, despite requiring no paired supervision, also surpasses paired baselines, improving PSNR by up to 11.2% and SSIM by up to 26.4% on OCT-to-OCTA, and achieving consistent gains across whole-image, soft-tissue, and bone regions on MR-to-CT. The project repository is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 该文提出两阶段解耦框架：先学习模态无关的共享结构空间，再用条件流模型在冻结结构表示上渲染目标模态外观，在OCT-to-OCTA与MR-to-CT任务上超越无配对和有配对基线。
AI.motivation: 现有无配对医学图像跨模态翻译用单一模型学习端到端源→目标映射，将结构保持与外观生成纠缠在一起，常导致翻译结果中具有临床意义的解剖结构被扭曲。作者主张应将解剖结构捕获与外观生成彻底解耦。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段：在源图像、目标图像与结构掩码上联合训练结构编码器-解码器，以掩码重建将潜空间锚定为模态无关解剖表示；对无掩码标注的源图像，借助目标域记忆库通过原型检索提供软结构监督。第二阶段：条件流模型在固定的结构条件下学习渲染目标域外观，使生成器继承目标外观统计并专注于结构条件化。
AI.result: 在OCT-to-OCTA合成与脑部MR-to-CT翻译上均优于所有无配对基线，且无需配对监督即超过配对基线：OCT-to-OCTA上PSNR最高提升11.2%、SSIM最高提升26.4%；MR-to-CT在全图、软组织与骨区域均取得一致增益。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将结构建模与外观生成解耦是提升无配对医学图像翻译解剖保真度的有效途径，冻结结构表示+条件生成的设计可同时获得更高保真度与更强泛化性。

title: CXR-CMFA: A Cross-Modal Feature Aggregation Network for Chest X-Ray Pathology Classification
summary: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation remains challenging because subtle pathology can be obscured by overlapping anatomy, image-quality variation, and limited visual evidence in isolated radiographs. Although image-only deep learning models provide useful baselines, they discard the complementary diagnostic context available in radiology reports, while large vision-language models can be computationally expensive for practical deployment. This paper presents CXR-CMFA, a lightweight cross-modal feature aggregation network for binary CXR pathology classification. The proposed framework combines a dual-stream visual encoder, using EfficientNet-B0 for global anatomical representation and DenseNet-121 for local pathological detail, with a TF-IDF-MLP report encoder. Two fusion modules integrate these modalities: the Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module (DMSAM) uses the report embedding to gate global and local visual features, and the Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion (CGFF) module learns per-instance weights for visual and textual contributions. Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark, using the provided train, validation, and test splits, show that CXR-CMFA achieves 93.45% accuracy, 99.88% precision, 91.8% recall, 95.7% F1-score, and 99.19% AUC on the held-out test set. The model produces only four false positives among 984 normal test cases, supporting its suitability for high-specificity screening workflows. An ablation study further demonstrates a 22.47 percentage-point AUC improvement over the global-image-only variant, confirming the value of adaptive cross-modal fusion. These results indicate that compact report-conditioned fusion can provide strong discriminative performance without relying on large pretrained language models.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级跨模态特征聚合网络CXR-CMFA，融合双流视觉编码器与TF-IDF报告编码器，在MIMIC-CXR上实现高特异性二分类CXR病理识别。
AI.motivation: 单张CXR存在解剖重叠、成像质量差异与视觉证据不足等难点；纯图像模型丢掉了放射报告的互补诊断信息，而大型视觉语言模型计算开销大、难以部署。
AI.method: 双流视觉编码器（EfficientNet-B0提取全局解剖表征，DenseNet-121提取局部病理细节）+ TF-IDF-MLP报告编码器；两个融合模块：DMSAM用报告嵌入对全局/局部视觉特征做门控，CGFF学习每个样本的视觉与文本贡献权重。
AI.result: MIMIC-CXR官方划分测试集上：准确率93.45%、精确率99.88%、召回率91.8%、F1 95.7%、AUC 99.19%；984例正常样本中仅4例假阳性；消融显示较纯全局图像变体AUC提升22.47个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的报告条件化跨模态融合可在不依赖大型预训练语言模型的前提下取得强判别性能，适用于高特异性筛查流程。

title: From Video to Digital Twin: An Exploratory Study of World Models and Gaussian Splatting on In-the-Wild Video
comment: 35 pages, 14 figures. Supplementary movies and code: https://github.com/pikulsomesh/foodbank-spatial-twin
summary: Generative world models and 3D Gaussian Splatting promise to turn ordinary video into explorable 3D scenes, but little is reported on how they behave on uncurated, in-the-wild footage. We study what these models recover when the only input is a publicly available news walkthrough of a food bank warehouse, with presenters walking through every shot and no drawings, scans or site visit, and we use the result as the geometry of a digital twin. A commercial world model given 20 frames recovered camera poses and metric depth for three areas, which we fused into about 747,000 Gaussian splats for 200 credits (20 US cents). Splat models optimized locally on a CPU, at no credit cost, were photorealistic near the filmed path but degraded quickly away from it. On held-out frames, scored in pixels not covered by people, they reached 21.2 and 23.1 dB PSNR from 64 and 43 training frames, and lost 3.8 and 5.4 dB when given only the 8 frames a world model accepts. Removing the trainer's background fill and person-hull carving raised held-out PSNR, showing that cleaning the space behind moving people costs fidelity in observed pixels while its gain lies where no ground truth exists. Asking the world model to generate views of areas the video never showed failed on the provider's side twice, so extrapolation could not be evaluated and unseen space was filled by a scripted model instead. We also describe the corrections needed to turn world-model output into a valid, metric Universal Scene Description (OpenUSD) asset with its native splat schema, which serves as the only interface to a data layer, a browser viewer, Blender and NVIDIA Omniverse. The findings suggest that today's models recover the observed parts of a real scene cheaply and at metric scale, while few-view fidelity and extrapolating unobserved space remain open. The work is an exploration of these methods, not a deployed product.

AI.tldr: 以一段公开的食品银行仓库参观新闻视频为唯一输入，评估生成式世界模型与3D高斯泼溅在野外非受控素材上的重建表现，并将其用作数字孪生的几何基础。
AI.motivation: 世界模型与3DGS宣称可将普通视频转为可探索3D场景，但缺乏在非受控、野外采集素材上的实测报告；本文希望检验这些方法在仅有公开视频、无扫描/图纸/现场踏勘条件下的实际能力边界。
AI.method: 商业化世界模型输入20帧，恢复三个区域的相机位姿与度量深度并融合为约747,000个高斯泼溅（200 credits，约0.2美元）；本地CPU优化的Splat模型在64帧与43帧训练下达到21.2 dB与23.1 dB PSNR（仅在与人物不重叠的像素上评估），仅给8帧时分别下降3.8 dB与5.4 dB；消融去除背景补全与人物壳体裁剪；尝试用世界模型生成未见区域视图（两次因服务商侧失败），改用脚本化模型填充未见空间；并描述将世界模型输出转换为符合原生splat schema的有效度量OpenUSD资产的修正流程。
AI.result: 本地Splat在拍摄路径附近照片级真实，但远离路径迅速退化；去除背景补全与人物壳体裁剪后，留出帧PSNR反而提升，说明清理运动人物后方空间的代价体现在真实观测像素上，其收益只存在于无真值区域；世界模型外推未见区域两次失败，无法评估。
AI.conclusion: 现有方法能以极低成本、度量尺度恢复真实场景的可观测部分，但少视角保真度与未观测空间的外推仍是未解问题；该工作属方法探索而非已部署产品。

title: Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network for Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation
summary: The segmentation of brain tumors from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an essential step for computer-aided neuro-oncology, treatment planning and follow-up. While effective encoder-decoder representations are achieved by U-Net and Attention U-Net, the skip sections of the network can generate weak-contrast or noisy responses in the case of heterogeneous boundaries of the tumor. In this paper, we introduce a Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network (QGDL-Net) that can be used for binary tumor segmentation from FLAIR MRI slices. The proposed model is able to predict the slice quality based on contrast and SNR statistics and to fine-tune the encoder features prior to decoding by learnable quality gates. We used the 80:20 train-validation split for experiments with BraTS 2021. QGDL-Net achieved a Dice of 0.9747, IoU of 0.9506, precision of 0.9755, recall of 0.9739, F1 of 0.9747 and accuracy of 0.9982, outperforming U-Net and Attention U-Net. The EigenCAM maps and segmentation overlays provide better tumor localization and interpretable activation around the lesion regions.

AI.tldr: 提出质量门控深度学习网络QGDL-Net，依据对比度与信噪比统计预测切片质量，并用可学习质量门在解码前微调编码器特征，用于FLAIR二值肿瘤分割。
AI.motivation: U-Net与Attention U-Net的跳跃连接在肿瘤边界异质、对比度弱或噪声大时会产生弱响应与噪声，影响分割质量。
AI.method: 基于BraTS 2021的FLAIR切片做二值分割；网络由对比度与SNR统计预测切片质量，并以可学习的质量门对编码器特征进行调制后再解码；采用80:20训练-验证划分。
AI.result: Dice 0.9747、IoU 0.9506、精确率0.9755、召回率0.9739、F1 0.9747、准确率0.9982，优于U-Net与Attention U-Net；EigenCAM热图与分割叠加显示更好的肿瘤定位与可解释激活。
AI.conclusion: 引入质量感知的门控机制可有效抑制跳跃连接中的弱对比/噪声响应，提升分割性能并增强可解释性。

title: Don't Blame The Preferences: Examining The Emergence of Sycophancy in LLM Training
summary: AI sycophancy, the tendency of large language models (LLMs) to flatter users and affirm their beliefs, can undermine accuracy and contribute to misinformation, dependence, and overconfidence. Although prior work has benchmarked sycophancy in released models and proposed mitigations, its origins during training remain poorly understood. Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and DPO are often blamed, but their effects are rarely compared with earlier training stages. We investigate sycophancy across the training pipelines of three model families and three benchmarks. We find that sycophancy is largely established by the end of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), rather than introduced by preference alignment. Across all nine model benchmark combinations, SFT checkpoints attain at least 92% of preference aligned models' sycophancy scores and at least 85% of final models' scores; on average, they are about as sycophantic as final models. Preference alignment increases sycophancy in only four of nine cases, by an average of 4.2 percentage points when it does. To probe the underlying causes, we isolate model representations associated with sycophancy using mechanistic interpretability and measure their activation on training datasets from each stage. SFT datasets show roughly the same average activation as other training data but contribute substantially more examples, and the highest-scoring individual datasets all come from SFT. Our findings suggest that addressing sycophancy requires interventions throughout the training pipeline, particularly in data selection and augmentation for pre-training and SFT.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较LLM训练各阶段的谄媚（sycophancy）来源，发现谄媚主要在监督微调（SFT）结束时形成，而非偏好对齐（RLHF/DPO）引入；机制可解释性显示SFT数据集贡献了最多高激活样本。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多对已发布模型进行谄媚基准测试并提出缓解方法，但对其训练过程中的起源理解不足；RLHF、DPO等偏好对齐常被归咎，却少有与早期训练阶段的对照比较。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族、三个基准（共九个组合）上跨完整训练流程测量谄媚程度，比较SFT检查点与偏好对齐模型及最终模型；并借助机制可解释性分离与谄媚相关的模型表征，测量其在各阶段训练数据上的激活强度。
AI.result: 九个组合中，SFT检查点至少达到偏好对齐模型谄媚分数的92%、最终模型的85%，平均与最终模型相当；偏好对齐仅在4/9情形下提升谄媚，平均提升4.2个百分点。SFT数据集的平均激活与其他训练数据相近，但样本量显著更多，且得分最高的单个数据集均来自SFT。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚并非主要由偏好对齐引入，而主要形成于SFT阶段；缓解谄媚需贯穿整个训练流程的干预，尤其是预训练与SFT阶段的数据选择与数据增强。

title: Sampling Is Not Curiosity: Why LLM Agents Should Investigate
comment: Accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Position Paper Track
summary: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended tasks, very common in research scenarios where they are required to explore, investigate, or act curiously. At inference time, an LLM is a fixed map from context to next-token distribution, the pretrained weights determine the function, and only its conditioning changes as context accumulates. Mechanisms like temperature, best-of-N, tree search, or RAG vary how the distribution is sampled or what it is conditioned on, but do not update the agent's model of the environment. We argue that current LLM agents do not explore curiously; they explore stochastically. From how curiosity is understood in the RL literature, it requires a predictive structure over how the environment responds to the agent's actions, which improves online from current interaction, drives action selection through its predicted improvement, and persists beyond the context window. Additionally, in its open-ended form, the agent should intrinsically originate what to investigate. Thus, we propose a framework defining curiosity in LLM agents, reserving the term for systems that satisfy it. In doing so, we identify the research directions its implementation opens up.

AI.tldr: 论文为LLM智能体的"好奇心"提供框架性定义，主张当前LLM智能体并未进行好奇心式探索，而是随机性探索；真正的好奇心需要可在线更新、由预测改进驱动决策、且能跨上下文窗口持续的环境预测结构，并具备内在地发起探究对象的能力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体被广泛用于开放式研究任务，需主动探索与调查。但推理阶段的LLM只是"上下文→下一token分布"的固定映射，温度采样、best-of-N、树搜索、RAG等仅改变采样方式或条件信息，并不更新智能体对环境模型的理解，因此缺乏真正的好奇心机制。
AI.method: 立场/框架性论文。借鉴强化学习中的好奇心概念，提出界定LLM智能体好奇心的框架，设定若干必要条件：对环境响应动作的预测结构、从当前交互中在线改进、通过预测改进驱动动作选择、超越上下文窗口的持久性，以及开放式情形下内在地产生探究对象；据此区分"好奇心式探索"与"随机式探索"，并指出实现该框架的研究方向。
AI.result: 概念性论证：指出当前机制（温度、best-of-N、树搜索、RAG）在原理上无法产生好奇心，因为权重固定、环境模型不更新；据此给出可检验的判定标准，用于区分哪些系统可被称为具备好奇心。
AI.conclusion: 应为"好奇心"这一术语设保留条件，仅授予满足框架的系统；实现该框架将开启若干新的研究方向（如可在线更新的预测结构、持久化环境模型、内在目标生成等）。

title: D-REAL: Acceptance-Length Optimization with Unbiased Gradients for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding efficiency depends on the number of consecutively accepted draft tokens, yet token-level training objectives do not directly optimize this quantity. We introduce D-REAL (Drafter Reinforcement of Expected Acceptance Length), a post-training method that directly optimizes expected acceptance length for a fixed decoding context. D-REAL weights position-wise draft-target distributional overlap by prefix survival probabilities along a draft-sampled prefix, faithfully capturing the sequential dependence of verification on earlier proposals. By accounting for the parameter dependence of the proposal distribution, we derive an unbiased gradient estimator for this single-round objective under stochastic verification. We evaluate D-REAL on DSpark and DFlash2 with Qwen3-8B as the target model across ten benchmarks. Starting from baselines whose mean acceptance length has plateaued, one epoch of D-REAL post-training consistently improves the benchmark-averaged mean acceptance length by up to 0.23 tokens across both architectures under greedy (T = 0.0) and stochastic (T = 1.0) sampling, translating into up to a 9.4% end-to-end serving throughput improvement.

AI.tldr: D-REAL 是一种后训练方法，直接优化固定解码上下文下的期望接受长度，通过对草稿采样前缀上的前缀存活概率加权各位置的草稿-目标分布重叠，并推导出随机验证下该单轮目标的无偏梯度估计器；在 DSpark 与 DFlash2 上结合 Qwen3-8B 目标模型、十个基准上，仅一个 epoch 即将基准平均接受长度最高提升 0.23 token，端到端服务吞吐最高提升 9.4%。
AI.motivation: 推测解码的效率取决于连续被接受的草稿 token 数量，但现有的 token 级训练目标并不直接优化这一量。基线的平均接受长度已趋于平台，亟需能直接针对该指标的优化手段。
AI.method: 提出 D-REAL 后训练方法：在固定解码上下文下直接优化期望接受长度；沿草稿采样前缀，用前缀存活概率对各位置的草稿-目标分布重叠进行加权，以刻画验证对早期提议的序列依赖；计入提议分布的参数依赖性，在随机验证条件下推导该单轮目标的无偏梯度估计器。
AI.result: 在 DSpark 与 DFlash2 两种架构、Qwen3-8B 作为目标模型的十个基准上，从平均接受长度已进入平台的基线出发，一个 epoch 的 D-REAL 后训练在贪心（T=0.0）与随机（T=1.0）采样下均稳定提升基准平均接受长度，最高 0.23 token，并带来最高 9.4% 的端到端服务吞吐提升。
AI.conclusion: 直接以期望接受长度为训练目标可获得跨架构、跨采样设置的一致收益，且训练成本低（单 epoch），可将接受长度的改进有效转化为实际服务吞吐提升。

title: Beyond Query Similarity: Safety-Conditioned Cache Routing for LLM Response Reuse
summary: Semantic response caching reuses a cached response for a semantically similar query to improve LLM inference efficiency. However, query similarity alone can lead to unsafe reuse when safety conditions change. Existing approaches improve cache safety through stricter similarity checks, context-aware validation, or response verification, yet they may still miss safety conflicts between the cached response and the new request or introduce unnecessary verification overhead. We argue that safe and efficient semantic caching requires a reuse policy that makes the cached response's safety conditions explicit and uses them to guide the reuse decision with a balance between safety and utility. In this paper, we propose SafeCache, a safety-aware framework that separates candidate retrieval from safety approval and formulates semantic response reuse as a safety-conditioned routing problem. SafeCache matches each cached-response condition against the new request and aggregates the per-condition mismatches into an overall risk score. A separate contradiction guard prevents explicit conflicts from being diluted by strong matches. It further estimates matching uncertainty and calibrates the routing policy under a required unsafe-reuse target and a verifier-call budget to choose among direct reuse, selective verification, or regeneration. Experiments show that SafeCache achieves the better safety-utility trade-off among the evaluated baselines, enabling safer response reuse at comparable cache utility.

AI.tldr: 提出安全感知的语义缓存框架 SafeCache，将语义响应复用建模为"安全条件路由"问题：显式化缓存响应的安全条件并与新请求逐条匹配，聚合风险分数，辅以矛盾守卫与不确定性校准，在给定的不安全复用目标与验证器调用预算下选择直接复用、选择性验证或重新生成。
AI.motivation: 语义缓存通过复用语义相似查询的响应用于提升 LLM 推理效率，但仅依赖查询相似度会在安全条件变化时导致不安全的复用。已有方法依靠更严格的相似度检查、上下文感知校验或响应验证来提升缓存安全性，但仍可能遗漏缓存响应与新请求之间的安全冲突，或引入不必要的验证开销。作者主张安全且高效的语义缓存需要一个使安全条件显式化、并以安全与效用平衡为导向的复用策略。
AI.method: SafeCache 将候选检索与安全批准解耦，把语义响应复用形式化为安全条件约束下的路由问题：(1) 将每条缓存响应对应的安全条件与新请求逐一匹配；(2) 将各条件的失配聚合为整体风险分数；(3) 引入独立的矛盾守卫（contradiction guard），防止显式冲突被强匹配信号稀释；(4) 估计匹配不确定性，并在指定的不安全复用目标与验证器调用预算约束下校准路由策略，从而在直接复用、选择性验证、重新生成三种动作间决策。
AI.result: 实验表明，在所评估的基线中 SafeCache 取得更优的安全—效用权衡，在缓存效用相当的情况下实现更安全的响应复用。
AI.conclusion: 将安全条件显式化并用于指导复用决策的路由式框架，可在不显著牺牲缓存效用的前提下提升语义缓存的安全性；安全批准与候选检索的解耦、矛盾守卫与预算约束下的策略校准是其有效性的关键设计。

title: Tail-risk-aware Agent Safety: Constraining Tail Risks Across Multi-step LLM Agent Workflows
summary: LLM-based agents extend LLMs with tool calls, memory, planning, and retrieval to act in external environments, but they are vulnerable to attacks at different workflow steps. Existing defenses, including prompt engineering and post-training alignment, primarily improve LLM-only safety and often overlook risks that arise from multi-step execution. External verification adds guardrails to check each step separately, but it typically ignores how risks can propagate across steps. We argue that we should consider risk transitions across dependent steps through the agent workflow, rather than separate verification on a single step. In this paper, we propose \textbf{T}ail-risk-aware \textbf{A}gent \textbf{S}afety (TAS), a tail-risk-aware safety framework that models agent workflow safety as a sequence of dependent safety states and constrains the rare but extreme risks (i.e., tail risk) with a shared budget. TAS first models safety-state transitions sequentially along the workflow as an MDP to trace risk propagation, then measures a tail-sensitive risk to target rare but high-cost risks (i.e., tail risk), and constrains the risk with a shared budget to derive a step-wise safety strategy. By constraining tail risk rather than the overall average, TAS suppresses rare high-cost failures while preserving utility in normal cases. Experiments show that TAS achieves better performance compared with eleven baselines across three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TAS：将智能体工作流安全建模为依赖的安全状态序列，用MDP刻画风险传播，以共享预算约束尾部风险，实现逐步安全策略。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在多步工具调用、记忆、规划、检索中面临分步攻击；现有提示工程与后训练对齐只覆盖LLM本身安全，外部验证逐步骤独立检查，忽略风险在依赖步骤间的传播。
AI.method: 提出Tail-risk-aware Agent Safety (TAS)框架：1) 沿工作流将安全状态转移序列建模为MDP以追踪风险传播；2) 度量尾部敏感的risk以针对稀有但高代价风险；3) 用共享预算约束该风险，导出逐步安全策略（step-wise safety strategy）。
AI.result: 在三个基准上与十一个基线对比，TAS取得更优性能；通过约束尾部风险而非平均风险，抑制稀有高代价失败同时保持正常情形下的效用。
AI.conclusion: 智能体安全应从跨步骤风险转移的视角进行约束，尾部风险感知+共享预算的建模是有效且高效的逐步防护方案。

title: Keeping LLM Agents on Procedure: Executable Finite-State Control for Long-Horizon Instruction Fidelity
summary: Much of the automation handed to language-model agents is procedural: each step needs little intelligence, but a long unattended run must follow a skill or SOP stated once at the start. We show that agents drift from such procedures over long runs, and that restating the instructions or resuming a stopped agent only moves the drift to another shortcut. We study an executable finite-state machine (FSM) that keeps the workflow state outside the model's context and enforces it at three points: tool calls, state transitions and the end of the agent's turn. In a pre-registered experiment on 200-account SOP-Bench batches, Claude Haiku 4.5 with the FSM decided on average 139 accounts correctly and by the procedure, against 48 for the strongest baseline (95% CI of the difference [46, 130]), and kept this rate to the end; across three models, the gain tracked how much the plain agent drifted. Because the runtime, not the model, supplies this long-horizon reliability, the FSM can let small models carry procedural work: Haiku 4.5 with it averaged more such decisions than plain Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 38% of the cost. Analyses on SWE-bench Verified, $τ^2$-bench, and staged and cross-context workflows further suggest that reliable long-horizon automation can come from stronger execution control, not only stronger models.

AI.tldr: 将工作流状态置于模型上下文之外的可执行有限状态机（FSM），在工具调用、状态迁移与回合结束三点强制约束，使语言模型智能体在长时无监督运行中稳定遵循既定SOP。
AI.motivation: 大量交给语言模型智能体的自动化任务本质上是流程性的：单步只需少量智能，但长时间无人值守运行必须遵循一次性给出的技能或SOP。作者发现智能体在长程运行中会偏离流程，而重述指令或重启（续跑）被中断的智能体只会把漂移转移到另一种"抄近路"方式上。
AI.method: 提出一个可执行有限状态机（FSM），将工作流状态持久化在模型上下文之外，并在三个执行点进行强制校验：工具调用、状态迁移、智能体回合结束。在预注册实验中，于200账户规模的SOP-Bench批次上对比无FSM基线与FSM方案，并在SWE-bench Verified、τ²-bench、分阶段及跨上下文工作流上做进一步分析。
AI.result: Claude Haiku 4.5 + FSM 平均正确且符合流程地处理139个账户，最强基线仅48个（差值95% CI [46, 130]），且该正确率保持到运行末尾；三个模型上的增益与无FSM智能体的漂移程度正相关。Haiku 4.5 + FSM 的此类正确决策数超过原生 Claude Sonnet 4.6，成本仅为其38%。
AI.conclusion: 长程流程可靠性由运行时而非模型提供，因而小模型也可承担流程性工作；可靠的长时自动化可来自更强的执行控制，而非仅依赖更强的模型。

title: Factor Rank: A Canonical Algebraic Generalization of Tree Decision Diagrams
summary:
Tree decision diagrams (TDDs), recently introduced by Capelli et al. (SAT 2026), are representations of Boolean functions. They generalize OBDDs by replacing variable orders with vtrees. The width of a TDD counts the distinct subfunctions across each vtree cut. Counting subfunctions is blind to linear structure. We introduce algebraic tree decision diagrams (ATDDs) by replacing this count with the rank of the cut matrix. The maximum of these ranks over all cuts, the factor rank, is exactly the width of the ATDD. Every TDD can be converted into an ATDD of no greater width. An ATDD is a tree tensor network in canonical form. ATDDs are exponentially more succinct than TDDs, and quasi-polynomially more succinct than structured deterministic DNNFs. Our main result is that this gain in succinctness does not cost canonicity. ATDDs are the first strict canonical form for a rank-based representation over arbitrary vtrees. For each function and vtree there is exactly one ATDD, over the rationals and without any genericity assumption. The canonicity admits a local characterization. Whether a tree tensor network is the ATDD of the Boolean function it computes can be checked in polynomial time from its tensors alone. Equivalence checking becomes a test of syntactic equality. The operation set includes polynomial-time model counting, weighted model counting, and a test whether a tree tensor network represents a Boolean function.
  Capelli et al. asked for the complexity of changing the vtree of a TDD and suggested local vtree changes. We answer the question. After a rotation of the vtree at one node, the new ATDD differs from the old one in two tensors only. Vtree change runs in output-polynomial time both for TDDs and for ATDDs.
  We formalize and verify our core results in Lean. We provide a prototype implementation of TDD and ATDD compilers as a first empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 提出代数树判定图ATDD：以切割矩阵的秩取代子函数计数作为宽度度量，在任意vtree上实现了首个基于秩表示的严格规范形，并以Lean形式化验证核心结果。
AI.motivation: TDD以vtree替代变量序来推广OBDD，但其宽度依赖"不同子函数个数"这一计数，对线性结构不敏感，因而表示能力受限于线性结构无法被压缩。同时，Capelli等人提出的vtree变更复杂度问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 将每个vtree切割处的子函数计数替换为切割矩阵的秩，把所有切割上的最大秩定义为factor rank并作为ATDD宽度；ATDD即规范形下的树张量网络。分析其与TDD、结构化确定性DNNF的简洁性关系，给出规范性的局部刻画与多项式时间检验算法；对单节点vtree旋转分析扰动张量数量；用Lean形式化核心结论并提供TDD/ATDD编译器原型。
AI.result: 每个TDD可转换为宽度不增大的ATDD；ATDD比TDD指数级更简洁，比结构化确定性DNNF拟多项式级更简洁。每个函数与每个vtree在有理数上恰有一个ATDD、无需一般性假设；张量网络是否为其所计算布尔函数的ATDD可在多项式时间内仅由张量判定，等价性检验化为语法相等。支持多项式时间（加权）模型计数与"张量网络是否表示布尔函数"的判定。vtree单节点旋转后仅两个张量改变，TDD与ATDD的vtree变更均为输出多项式时间。
AI.conclusion: 简洁性提升不以牺牲规范性为代价：ATDD是任意vtree上基于秩的表示的首个严格规范形，兼具紧凑性、可局部检验的规范性与高效的等价检验、模型计数及vtree变更操作。

title: Hallucination-Guided Unlearning: Using Hallucination Traces to Reveal Overfitted Memories
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Selective unlearning is increasingly important for the safety and compliance of large language models. Harmful or memorized content is often entangled with useful knowledge and difficult to enumerate. We use the model's own failures to identify candidates for unlearning. We propose Hallucination-Guided Unlearning (HGU), which uses hallucinations as diagnostic signals. HGU localizes unsupported spans via evidence and internal consensus, traces a sparse set of high-responsibility MLP neurons, and edits them with compact gates under a utility-preserving KL constraint. On TOFU, HGU achieves the best MU-FE trade-off, with Avg scores of 0.7221 (forget05) and 0.7699 (forget10), and the highest SepS H-Avg (0.4382/0.4715) under mixed forget/retain prompts. On the WMDP auxiliary task, HGU yields the strongest forgetting (e.g., 14.2 on Economics) while improving Retain (52.7) and MMLU (57.2). These results suggest that tracing hallucinations enables targeted, post-hoc unlearning that better balances forgetting efficacy and general utility without full retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出幻觉引导遗忘（HGU）：以模型自身的幻觉作为诊断信号定位不可靠片段，追踪高责任MLP神经元并施加紧凑门控编辑，在KL约束下实现选择性遗忘，兼顾遗忘效果与通用能力。
AI.motivation: 选择性遗忘对大模型安全与合规日益重要，但有害或记忆化内容常与有用知识纠缠、难以枚举，缺乏可靠的定位线索。
AI.method: 利用模型自身失败（幻觉）作为诊断信号：通过证据与内部一致性定位无支撑文本片段，追踪少量高责任MLP神经元，并以紧凑门控对其进行编辑，同时施加保持效用（utility-preserving）的KL约束，实现事后（post-hoc）定向遗忘，无需全量重训。
AI.result: TOFU上取得最佳MU-FE权衡，forget05/forget10的Avg分别为0.7221/0.7699，混合遗忘/保留提示下SepS H-Avg最高（0.4382/0.4715）；WMDP辅助任务上遗忘最强（如Economics 14.2），同时Retain升至52.7、MMLU达57.2。
AI.conclusion: 追踪幻觉可支撑定向的事后遗忘，在无需全量重训的情况下更好地平衡遗忘有效性与通用效用。

title: RankShift: Evaluating Ranking Instability Across Benchmark Dimensions in Document Parsing
summary: Document parsing benchmarks are often treated as stable measures of model quality, yet rankings may depend substantially on benchmark design choices. In this work, we present RankShift, a systematic study comparing OCR and vision-language models (VLMs) under controlled variation in dataset composition, matching strategy, and scoring methodology. Using OmniDocBench as a case study, we evaluate the ranking stability of 16 models across 3 dataset configurations, 6 matching strategies, and 3 scoring metrics. We quantify rank stability using pairwise rank correlation, top-k churn, and pairwise reversal rate. Our results show that the interaction between matching strategy and ground truth format is a substantial but understudied driver of instability: scoring against OmniDocBench's JSON annotations versus its Markdown rendering yields a mean Kendall's tau of approximately 0.33 under region-level matching strategies, with individual pairs as low as tau = 0.23, compared with tau = 0.77 when each page is scored as a single concatenated string. Dataset composition produces comparable instability across page-type strata (mean tau = 0.48) and layout-type strata (mean tau = 0.49), while the cross-dataset shift from OmniDocBench to Real5's Scanning reconstruction of the same pages is more stable (tau = 0.80). Metric choice is the most stable dimension, with mean tau of approximately 0.78 across NED, BLEU, and METEOR. These findings indicate that leaderboard position is not solely a property of model capability, motivating leaderboards that report not only headline scores but also the robustness of rankings across reasonable design choices.

AI.tldr: 该文提出RankShift研究，系统检验文档解析基准（以OmniDocBench为例）排名对数据集构成、匹配策略与评分指标的敏感性，发现"匹配策略×标注格式"是最大不稳定来源，主张排行榜应同时报告排名稳健性。
AI.motivation: 文档解析基准常被当作衡量模型质量的稳定标尺，但排名可能高度依赖基准设计选择；尤其是匹配策略与标注格式的交互作用此前缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 以OmniDocBench为案例，评测16个OCR/VLM模型，在3种数据集配置、6种匹配策略、3种评分指标（NED、BLEU、METEOR）下做受控变化；用成对排名相关性（Kendall's tau）、top-k变动率、成对排名反转率量化排名稳定性，并对页面类型/版式类型分层及跨数据集（Real5扫描重建）迁移进行比较。
AI.result: 匹配策略与ground truth格式的交互是主要不稳定源：区域级匹配下JSON标注与Markdown渲染对比的平均tau≈0.33（最低0.23），而整页拼接打分为0.77；数据集构成为中等不稳定（页面类型分层tau=0.48，版式分层0.49），跨数据集迁移较稳定（tau=0.80）；指标选择最稳定（平均tau≈0.78）。
AI.conclusion: 排行榜位置并非单纯由模型能力决定；应构建不仅报告主分数、也报告跨合理设计选择排名稳健性的排行榜。

title: Can the Remaining Answers Change the Prediction? Worst-Case Stability Checks for Personalized Rating Models
summary: Missing ratings can overturn a personalized model's current prediction. For completed models with additive response scores, exact worst case bounds check all missing assignments without changing the current predictor. We evaluate this audit retrospectively in two self-triage cohorts, 108 clinicians rating three simulated psychiatric interviews, and 126 counseling demonstrations annotated by ten experts. Under shared random half histories, Fisher adaptation based on observed ratings reduces log loss relative to response frequency by 0.1071 nats in the clinician audit (95% CI [0.0867,0.1261]) and 0.0223 in counseling (95% CI[0.0121,0.0321]). The counseling test excludes target experts and source videos from training. Certification covers 5.4% and 10.5% of targets; fixed width acquisition raises coverage to 13.7% and 28.6% at the same budgets. With weights and responses held fixed, the observed-rating update also has lower loss than an affine partial update while certifying exactly the same evaluated targets. The certificate establishes agreement with the completed model, not correctness or stability at intermediate updates. These rating tasks test the method; clinical usefulness remains untested.

AI.tldr: 该文针对含可加响应评分的个性化模型，提出在观测评分下基于Fisher更新进行缺失评分的最坏情形审计与认证方法，并在两个自评/咨询队列中回溯评估其损失改进与认证覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 缺失评分可能推翻个性化模型当前的预测。已有完成模型（可加响应评分）虽可做精确最坏情形界检验，但需要在不改变现有预测器的前提下，系统地考察所有缺失赋值，从而对预测可靠性进行审计与认证。
AI.method: 对具可加响应评分的完成模型，给出不改变当前预测器的精确最坏情形界，穷举所有缺失赋值进行审计；并采用基于观测评分的Fisher自适应更新，与响应频率基线及仿射部分更新进行比较。在两个自评队列上回溯评估：108名临床医生对三段模拟精神科访谈评分，126段咨询演示由10位专家标注；采用共享随机半历史设定，咨询测试排除目标专家与源视频。另采用固定宽度采集策略提升认证覆盖率。
AI.result: 在共享随机半历史下，基于观测评分的Fisher自适应相对响应频率基线降低对数损失：临床审计中为0.1071 nats（95% CI [0.0867, 0.1261]），咨询中为0.0223（95% CI [0.0121, 0.0321]）。认证覆盖5.4%与10.5%的目标；在同等预算下，固定宽度采集将覆盖提升至13.7%与28.6%。在权重与响应固定时，观测评分更新比仿射部分更新损失更低，且认证的目标集合完全相同。
AI.conclusion: 该证书确立的是与完成模型的一致性，而非正确性或中间更新过程的稳定性；这些评分任务仅用于检验方法，临床实用性尚未验证。

title: LiveAsset: Learning Intent Assets from Corrective Interactions for Agent Runtime Control
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents acting across web applications and online services often need multi-turn corrections to align their work with users' underspecified goals and preferences. In practice, users may identify problems in the current outcome without specifying the desired result, so learning user intentions requires interpreting each correction against the agent's preceding and revised outcomes. These expectations are often connected to a particular context, making it hard to know when they apply and how to ensure the agent later acts as the user expects. To this end, we propose LiveAsset, an intent harness that learns reusable intent assets from corrective interactions and uses them for runtime control of agent execution. LiveAsset jointly interprets each correction with the agent's original and revised results to infer user intent, incrementally updating the assets while preserving earlier requirements that remain applicable. The learned requirements guide agent execution from task entry and provide criteria for runtime verification, which uses the explanations to assess applicability before each reply is delivered and directs the agent to revise the result to address unmet requirements while preserving those already satisfied. Following a learning phase in which simulated users progressively reveal requirements through multi-turn corrections, we evaluate LiveAsset using same-task replay of the original requests on π-Bench, PERMA, and Vita and cross-task transfer on PAST-Bench and SkillEvolBench. Experiments show that LiveAsset better fulfills requirements learned from corrective interactions and improves performance on these benchmarks compared with memory, skill, and rule-based harness baselines. Code is available at github.com/landian60/LiveAsset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LiveAsset，一种从多轮纠正交互中学习可复用"意图资产"(intent assets) 并在运行时控制 LLM 智能体执行的意图框架，在 π-Bench、PERMA、Vita 及 PAST-Bench、SkillEvolBench 上优于记忆、技能与规则型基线。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体跨 Web 应用执行任务时，用户目标与偏好常表述不充分，只能通过多轮纠正逐步暴露；用户往往只指出问题而不给出期望结果，意图需结合智能体原始与修订结果来推断。这些期望通常绑定特定上下文，难以判断其适用范围与后续如何满足。
AI.method: LiveAsset 将每次纠正与智能体的原始结果和修订结果联合解释以推断用户意图，增量更新意图资产并保留仍然适用的早期要求；学到的要求从任务入口起引导智能体执行，并提供运行时验证标准：每次回复交付前用解释评估适用性，若存在未满足要求则指导智能体修订结果，同时保持已满足要求不变。学习中由模拟用户通过多轮纠正逐步揭示需求。
AI.result: 在 π-Bench、PERMA、Vita 上以同任务重放原始请求评估，在 PAST-Bench 与 SkillEvolBench 上做跨任务迁移；结果显示 LiveAsset 更能满足从纠正交互中学到的要求，性能优于基于记忆、技能和规则的 harness 基线。
AI.conclusion: 从纠正交互中提炼可复用的上下文化意图资产，并配合运行时适用性判断与迭代修订，是提升智能体对齐欠定用户目标的有效途径。

title: Homeopathic Learning: Diluting poisoned fine-tuning data can strengthen its effect
summary: We study homeopathic learning, a phenomenon where poisoned training data with little effect on its own can create a hidden backdoor once clean, contrasting data is added. In our experiments, a model fine-tuned only on a "poison" dataset associated with a trait T (such as speaking German or being misaligned) does not learn T. Surprisingly, adding similarly formatted "clean" data not associated with T causes the model to learn T. This effect requires that the poison data have an identifying "trigger" feature that is absent from the clean data. We demonstrate this effect in a variety of settings: subliminal learning of backdoor behaviors, inoculation prompting of reward hacking transcripts, generalization from archaic bird names, and an MNIST classifier with mislabeled data. We propose a simple regression model as an explanation. In the poison data, the task and trigger always co-occur, and regularization favors attributing T to the task. Clean data without the trigger causes T to be attributed to the trigger instead. Consequently, the same training examples can have little effect as part of one training set but create a misalignment backdoor in another. This finding exposes a potential limitation of safety methods that audit or filter training data in isolation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"顺势学习"(homeopathic learning)现象：单独对含极少有害效果的"毒数据"微调不会学到特征T，但混入格式相似的干净数据后模型反而学到T；该效应需毒数据含有干净数据中缺失的"触发"特征。作者用简单回归模型解释，并指出孤立审查/过滤训练数据的安全方法存在局限。
AI.motivation: 现有安全方法多依赖孤立地审查或过滤训练数据，假定对数据影响的评估可单独进行。作者希望揭示这一假设的漏洞：单看无害的数据组合起来可能产生后门或错位行为。
AI.method: 在多种设置下做实验：后门行为的阈下学习、奖励黑客转录的"接种"(inoculation prompting)、古鸟类名泛化、误标数据的MNIST分类器。并提出一个简单回归模型解释机制：毒数据中任务与触发特征始终共现，正则化倾向于将T归因于任务；加入无触发特征的干净数据后，T转而归因于触发特征。
AI.result: 实验确认：仅用毒数据微调不学到T；加入格式相似的无关干净数据后反而学到T。该效应依赖毒数据具有干净数据缺失的"触发"特征。相同训练样本在不同训练集组合中，可分别表现为几乎无效或形成错位后门。
AI.conclusion: "顺势学习"表明训练数据的效果具有组合依赖性，不能孤立评估。这暴露了孤立审查或过滤数据的安全方法的潜在局限，提示需在数据组合与训练动态层面评估安全性。

title: Measuring Generative AI Content in Political Campaigns: Evidence of Rising Adoption and Non-Disclosure
summary: The use of generative AI in political campaigns has drawn public concern and policy attention. Public concerns range from distrust of candidates to skepticism about the authenticity and accuracy of political advertising, including AI-generated images and video. Nearly half of U.S. states have enacted laws that prohibit, or require disclosure of, "materially deceptive" AI-generated content (AIGC) in elections to guard against these concerns. This study measures how candidates and their campaigns produce and circulate AIGC during an election cycle. We develop two measures that estimate not only wether campaigns use AIGC, but how much they produce (magnitude) and in what forms (modality). We apply these measures to a novel dataset of text and images from the campaign websites, X accounts, and emails of 12,977 candidates for U.S. political office from 2023 to 2025. We report three findings. First, detectable AIGC from campaigns increased significantly across modalities over the observation window, and campaigns that use AIGC frequently do not disclose it. Second, incumbents' campaigns produced significantly less AIGC than challengers' campaigns. Third, candidates in states with AIGC disclosure or prohibition laws do not produce measurably less AIGC than candidates in other states. Our method and findings have implications for transparency and trust in elections, and on state laws that regulate AI use in campaigns. Because current state laws largely target mainly "materially deceptive" content, we identify additional policy mechanisms that could increase electoral transparency and improve trust as AIGC becomes more prevalent.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了衡量竞选活动使用生成式AI内容的"规模"与"模态"两项指标，应用于2023–2025年12,977名美国政治候选人竞选网站、X账号与邮件的新型文本与图像数据集，发现可检测的AIGC在各模态上显著增长、使用者多不披露、现任者产量显著低于挑战者、且州级披露或禁令法律未见显著抑制效果。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在政治竞选中的使用引发公众对候选人信任、政治广告真实性与准确性的担忧；近半数美国州已立法禁止或要求披露选举中"实质性欺骗性"AIGC，但这些法律的规制对象与实效缺乏系统的实证检验，且既有研究缺少对竞选活动AIGC产出规模与形式的多模态量化测量。
AI.method: 提出两项测量指标：其一估计竞选是否使用AIGC及其产出规模（magnitude），其二刻画其表现形式（modality，即文本、图像等）；并将该测量框架应用于2023–2025年12,977名美国政治职位候选人的竞选网站、X平台账号与电子邮件所构成的文本—图像多模态新数据集，进行跨模态、跨时间的比较分析，并对比现任者与挑战者、以及有无AIGC披露/禁止法律的州之间的差异。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：(1) 观察期内可检测的竞选AIGC在各模态上均显著增长，且频繁使用AIGC的竞选活动大多未作披露；(2) 现任者竞选活动产生的AIGC显著少于挑战者；(3) 位于设有AIGC披露或禁止法律的州的候选人，其AIGC产出并未显著少于其他州候选人。
AI.conclusion: 现有以"实质性欺骗性"内容为主要规制对象的州法未能显著抑制AIGC在竞选中的产出，方法上与实证上的发现对选举透明度与信任以及州级AI竞选监管法律具有启示；随着AIGC日益普及，需引入额外政策机制以提升选举透明度、改善公众信任。

title: Inside the Trading Loop: Markets, Models, and Moves with LLM Agents
comment: 37 pages, including appendices. Code and supporting materials available upon request
summary: We built a hybrid multi-agent trading system that combines large language model (LLM) analysts with momentum-based portfolio construction and rule-based execution. Company-news and macroeconomic agents return structured reports to a coordinator that sets stock weights and cash reserves. We evaluate the portfolio engine using its broker-recorded paper account, which operated with deterministic fallbacks, and compare LLM-enabled configurations through retrospective replays. From March 11 to August 28, 2026, the account returned 34.5%, compared with 14.4% for the S&P 500 fund SPY over the same dates. This raw return advantage came with a larger maximum drawdown. Reconstructed policies also finish above matched SPY and QQQ references when assessments are used in the same session or deferred to the next. Design comparisons examine cash authority, selective invocation, and response contracts. A constant-cash control gives a return estimate close to stance-based sizing, and shorter report contracts improve observed parsing but can change recommendations.

AI.tldr: 构建了混合多智能体交易系统（LLM分析师+动量组合构建+规则化执行），纸面账户在2026年3月11日至8月28日录得34.5%收益（同期SPY为14.4%），但最大回撤更大。
AI.motivation: 探索将LLM分析师与经典动量组合构建、规则化执行相结合的工程可行性，并在真实经纪商纸面账户与回溯重放两种评估框架下检验其表现与稳健性。
AI.method: 系统由公司新闻智能体与宏观经济智能体向协调器返回结构化报告，协调器据此设定个股权重与现金储备；组合引擎含确定性回退机制。评估采用经纪商记录的纸面账户，并通过回溯重放对比不同LLM启用配置，考察现金决策权、按需调用（selective invocation）与响应契约（response contract）等设计选择，并设置恒定现金对照组。
AI.result: 2026年3月11日至8月28日账户回报34.5%，同期SPY为14.4%，但最大回撤更大；重构策略在“同会话使用”与“延后至下一会话”两种评估时序下均高于匹配的SPY与QQQ基准；恒定现金对照组收益估计接近基于立场（stance）的仓位设定；更短报告契约提升了观测到的解析成功率，但可能改变推荐内容。
AI.conclusion: LLM多智能体架构在纸面交易中能取得超越基准的原始收益，但同时承担更高回撤风险，且收益来源部分可被简单恒定现金规则复现；报告格式与调用时机等设计细节对结果有实质影响，需在更严格的前瞻性与风险调整评估下进一步验证。

title: Perturbation Profiles of Scanpath Classifiers: What Reading, Code-Comprehension and Video Decoders Are Sensitive To
summary: When a scanpath descriptor discriminates a task, it is rarely clear what the discrimination rests on. We propose a perturbation profile for trial-level descriptors. Five transformations each destroy one stated property while preserving a listed set of invariants: fixation order, duration-position coupling, the duration distribution, orientation and handedness, and fine spatial structure. The classifier is refit, and the drop in participant-held-out AUC is the pipeline's sensitivity to that property. Because refitting lets the learner use redundant information, this describes the refitted pipeline, not what a fitted classifier used. Intervals come from a participant bootstrap that refits; in simulations at the sample sizes analysed, where the target was zero they excluded zero at a pooled rate of at most 2.5%, and they covered the target in 99.6% of 2720 cases. We profiled seven descriptors on twelve binary problems from three public datasets: reading (SB-SAT, 95 participants), program comprehension (EMIP, up to 159) and video and game viewing (GazeBase, 60). Permuting fixation order raised the AUC of a descriptor built on mean saccade amplitude on three problems (by up to 0.23), because permutation turns amplitude into a measure of spatial spread. A "comprehension" contrast that pooled two programs reached AUC 0.70 with a spread-only baseline and fell to 0.47 within one program: the profile located the confound in stimulus layout. On native versus non-native readers, recurrence was sensitive to order and to jitter at the scale of text lines but not of characters, while a two-feature duration and amplitude descriptor reached the same AUC (0.65). A graph descriptor built on the code's tokens was the strongest non-baseline descriptor on the program contrast (0.78; 0.87 with boosted trees). AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对试次级扫描路径描述子的“扰动剖面”（perturbation profile）：通过五种各自破坏单一属性而保留指定不变量的变换，重新拟合分类器，以留出参与者交叉验证AUC的下降量度量流水线对该属性的敏感性，并配合参与者自助法给出区间。作者在三个公开数据集、十二个二分类问题上剖析了七个描述子，揭示了若干描述子有效性背后的真实依赖来源。
AI.motivation: 当某个扫描路径描述子能区分任务时，研究者往往不清楚这种区分力究竟建立在什么属性之上。缺乏系统化的诊断手段，容易把由冗余信息或刺激布局等混淆因素带来的效果误认为对目标认知属性的敏感性。
AI.method: 对试次级描述子定义五类变换，每类破坏一个明确属性并保持一组列出的不变量：注视顺序、时长—位置耦合、时长分布、朝向与手性、细粒度空间结构。每次变换后重新拟合分类器，以参与者留出AUC的下降幅度作为流水线对该属性的敏感性；由于重新拟合允许学习器利用冗余信息，所得结论描述的是重拟合后的流水线，而非已拟合分类器实际使用的信息。区间由会重新拟合的参与者自助法给出。在仿真中，当目标效应为零时，区间在合并口径下最多以2.5%的比例排除零，并在2720个情形中99.6%覆盖目标。实证方面，在阅读（SB-SAT，95名参与者）、程序理解（EMIP，最多159名）以及视频与游戏观看（GazeBase，60名）三个数据集共十二个二分类问题上剖析了七个描述子。
AI.result: 置换注视顺序使基于平均扫视幅度的描述子在三个问题上的AUC升高（最高达0.23），原因是置换把幅度变成了空间散布的度量。一个合并两个程序的“理解”对比在仅用散布的基线下AUC达0.70，但在单个程序内降至0.47，剖面将混淆定位到刺激布局。在母语者与非母语者对比中，复发（recurrence）对顺序以及文本行尺度（而非字符尺度）的抖动敏感，而一个双特征的时长与幅度描述子达到相同AUC（0.65）。基于代码token构建的图描述子在程序对比上是最强的非基线描述子（0.78；使用提升树时为0.87）。在更长运行与三个随机种子下解释性结果保持稳定；在第二个学习器下，16项中有15项保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 扰动剖面为扫描路径描述子的判别依据提供了可量化、带统计区间的归因诊断：它能揭示描述子借由冗余信息或刺激布局等非目标属性获得的表观有效性，并区分不同描述子对何种结构敏感。该方法适用于检验眼动分类流水线的解释稳健性，但需注意其度量对象是重拟合后的流水线敏感性，而非单个已拟合模型的实际决策依据。

title: Represented but Not Used: Value-Policy Dissociation in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents need to choose actions whose consequences unfold over multiple future steps, yet poor decisions do not reveal whether the model failed to represent those consequences or failed to use them. Mechanistic interpretability has studied internal representations of environment state and plans, but sequential decision making also requires evaluating how candidate actions change future outcomes. Reinforcement learning formalizes this as action value. We study this computation in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, and GPT-OSS-20B across a partially observed Grid environment and WebShop, a simulated web shopping environment. We find that the relative values of candidate actions are linearly decodable from intermediate hidden states, including at states where the policy prefers a worse action. We call this gap between value representation and policy choice value-policy dissociation. To investigate how represented value relates to action selection, we compare direct interventions along the value readout direction with Natural Value Transport (NVT), a transformation learned from hidden state changes that naturally result from differences in action value. While readout-direction interventions have limited and inconsistent effects, NVT more consistently influences action preferences, particularly at later layers. We also test a closed-loop controller that uses the value readout as a sensor and NVT as an actuator, observing improvements in task outcomes. These results suggest that LLM agents can represent useful prospective value without reliably translating it into policy choice.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM智能体是否内部表征动作价值（action value）及其与策略选择的关系，发现候选动作的相对价值可从中间隐状态线性解码，但在策略选择较差动作的状态下依然成立，形成"价值-策略解离"；并通过自然价值传输（NVT）干预更一致地影响动作偏好。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需做多步后果的序贯决策，但决策失误时无法区分是模型未表征后果还是未使用后果；机制可解释性已研究状态与计划的内部表征，却缺少对"评估候选动作如何改变未来结果"（即动作价值）这一计算的研究。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct与GPT-OSS-20B上，于部分可观测Grid环境与模拟网购环境WebShop中：(1) 从中间隐状态线性解码候选动作的相对价值；(2) 比较沿价值读出方向的直接干预与自然价值传输（NVT，一种由动作价值差异自然引起的隐状态变化中学得的变换）；(3) 构建以价值读出为传感器、NVT为执行器的闭环控制器。
AI.result: 候选动作相对价值可线性解码，包括策略偏好较差动作的状态；读出方向干预效果有限且不一致，NVT在较后层更稳定地改变动作偏好；闭环控制器带来任务结果提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体能够表征有用的前瞻性价值，但未必将其可靠地转化为策略选择；价值表征与策略选择存在解离，可通过自然状态变化导出的干预（NVT）部分弥合。

title: TurnFlow: Benchmarking User-State Reasoning in Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Scene-Guided User Simulation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed through conversational interfaces, yet strong single-turn performance does not imply reliability in multi-turn settings. Multi-turn assistance requires a model to maintain an evolving representation of user requirements and to reason over it before complying with later requests. Failures can therefore be subtle: models may fail to recognize a changed constraint or hidden conflict, or recognize it without enforcing it in the final response. Existing benchmarks primarily test fully specified prompts, long-context recall, or controlled domain environments, leaving open-domain requirement reconciliation undermeasured. We introduce TurnFlow, an interactive benchmark for evaluating whether models preserve, revise, and act on user requirements across turns. TurnFlow combines adaptive user simulation with verifiable judging, allowing conversations to unfold naturally while keeping hidden requirements and pass/fail criteria controlled. In our evaluation, nine LLMs achieve overall pass rates from 42.86% to 59.59% on 490 scenarios. Performance varies substantially across challenge types: models perform well on Stateful Multi-Constraint Following but remain considerably less reliable on Scope Creep and Goal Shift. These results reveal persistent limitations in reasoning over evolving user requirements across turns.

AI.tldr: 提出交互式基准 TurnFlow，用于评测大模型在多轮对话中是否能够保持、修订并落实用户需求。
AI.motivation: 单轮表现强不代表多轮可靠：多轮助手需维护随对话演化的需求表征并在后续请求前进行推理。现有基准多测完整给定的提示、长上下文召回或受控领域环境，开放式需求协调（requirement reconciliation）评测不足。
AI.method: TurnFlow 结合自适应用户模拟与可验证判定（verifiable judging）：对话自然展开，同时由框架控制隐藏需求与通过/失败标准；覆盖多种挑战类型，如 Stateful Multi-Constraint Following、Scope Creep、Goal Shift。
AI.result: 在 490 个场景上评测 9 个 LLM，总体通过率为 42.86%–59.59%。分类型差异显著：Stateful Multi-Constraint Following 表现较好，Scope Creep 与 Goal Shift 明显较弱。
AI.conclusion: 模型在跨轮演化需求的推理与执行上仍存在系统性局限，尤其难以识别并落实变更约束与隐含冲突。

title: A Topological Encoder Decoder Framework for Temporal Graph Learning
summary: Most temporal graph learning methods reduce future prediction to discriminative inference over past interactions, focusing on edges or node labels for a largely persistent set of nodes. This view breaks down when new nodes and edges appear, since the future graph becomes a new object with changing size, composition, and structure. We address this gap by framing temporal graph prediction as an inverse topology problem. Instead of predicting edges directly, we first predict a multiscale topological descriptor of the future graph and then reconstruct a plausible future snapshot that realizes this descriptor under inductive constraints. This approach makes global structure and node churn explicit prediction targets and produces forecasted graphs that downstream tasks can evaluate without retraining. Across 14 temporal graph datasets, we evaluate our method, TOPOGED, on node, link, and graph property prediction and compare it against state-of-the-art temporal graph models. TOPOGED significantly improves node-level forecasting accuracy over the strongest baseline, with a macro average of 0.49 versus 0.05. It also outperforms baselines in 60% of graph-structure metric evaluations and substantially increases macro-average edge prediction metrics, from near-zero to 0.12. Our results show that topology-guided graph forecasting can predict inductive future snapshots whose structure supports multiple downstream evaluations.

AI.tldr: 将时序图预测重构为逆拓扑问题：先预测未来图的多尺度拓扑描述子，再在归纳约束下重建未来快照（TOPOGED）。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把未来预测简化为对历史交互的判别式推断，聚焦于边或节点标签，且假设节点集合基本固定；当出现新节点与新边时，未来图在规模、组成与结构上都是新对象，该视角失效。
AI.method: 提出TOPOGED：不直接预测边，而是先预测未来图的多尺度拓扑描述子，再在归纳约束下重建一个可行的未来图快照，使全局结构与节点更替成为显式预测目标，并输出下游任务无需重训即可评估的图。
AI.result: 在14个时序图数据集上评估节点、连边与图属性预测。节点级预测宏平均0.49，最强基线为0.05；在60%的图结构指标上优于基线；连边预测宏平均由接近0提升至0.12。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑引导的图预测能够生成归纳式未来快照，其结构可支撑多种下游评估任务。

title: Restoring General and Improving Domain-Specific Safety in Fine-Tuned LLMs Without Retraining
summary: Safety-aligned language models are known to suffer degradation in refusal behavior following domain-specific fine-tuning, even when the fine-tuning data is entirely benign. The predominant mitigation strategy, preference optimization on the fine-tuned model, is computationally expensive and requires domain-specific preference data that is often unavailable in practice. We propose SPECTRA, a training-free, weight-level method that restores refusal behavior by transferring the base model's refusal direction into the fine-tuned model's weights via an activation-aware, low-rank update, requiring no gradient-based optimization or domain-specific safety data. The low-rank design restricts the intervention to the subspace most causally active on harmful inputs, leaving benign behavior largely undisturbed by construction. Empirically, SPECTRA substantially improves refusal behavior across a comprehensive safety evaluation, while preserving general coherence, domain-specific knowledge, and producing negligible change in false refusal rates.

AI.tldr: 提出SPECTRA：一种免训练、权重层面的方法，将基座模型的拒答方向通过激活感知的低秩更新迁移到微调模型权重中，恢复安全对齐模型在良性领域微调后退化的拒答行为。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐的语言模型在领域特定微调后，即使微调数据完全良性，拒答行为也会退化。主流缓解策略（对微调模型做偏好优化）计算代价高，且依赖实践中常缺失的领域特定偏好数据。
AI.method: SPECTRA为免训练、权重层面方法：提取基座模型的拒答方向，通过激活感知的低秩更新将其迁移至微调模型权重，无需梯度优化与领域安全数据；低秩设计将干预限制在对有害输入最具因果活性的子空间内，从构造上尽量不扰动良性行为。
AI.result: 在综合安全评测中显著提升拒答行为，同时保持通用连贯性与领域知识，误拒率变化可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外训练与领域安全数据的权重级干预可有效恢复微调导致的安全退化，并在安全性与良性能力之间取得良好权衡。

title: Is Recursive Self-Improvement Safe?
comment: To appear in IEEE Intelligent Systems
summary: The phrase recursive self-improvement (RSI) refers to the idea of an AI system designing and creating another, better AI system, which in turn designs and creates an even better one, and so on. While the idea has a long history, it has always been an abstract, futuristic idea -- until recently. Today's frontier AI has attained a set of abilities, including in programming, mathematics, research, tool use, and working coherently over extended periods of time, that make RSI seem plausible. AI companies are starting to pursue it, but many of the involved people are also expressing concerns, asking whether humanity should really set this in motion and under what conditions. I will discuss the situation, argue that we do not even have clear frameworks for thinking about the likely outcomes of RSI, and do a quick game-theoretic analysis of how to choose whether to initiate RSI when another party is making the same choice.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论"递归自我改进"(RSI)从抽象设想变为现实可能性的现状，指出目前缺乏思考RSI可能后果的清晰框架，并对"是否启动RSI"的多方选择做了简要博弈论分析。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI已在编程、数学、研究、工具使用和长时段连贯工作等方面具备能力，使RSI显得可行；AI公司开始追求RSI，但从业者对其是否应被启动及在何种条件下启动存在担忧，而学界缺乏分析其后果的框架。
AI.method: 概念分析与问题梳理，结合对"一方在另一方同样面临选择时是否启动RSI"的简化博弈论建模分析。
AI.result: 论证我们尚不具备清晰框架来推断RSI的可能结果；并以博弈论视角刻画双方同时决策时的启动激励结构。
AI.conclusion: RSI已不再是纯抽象的远期设想，亟需建立评估其后果的分析框架，并在多方竞争情境下审慎考虑是否及在何种条件下启动RSI。

title: Generative Active Learning for Label-Efficient Pan-Organ Ultrasound Diagnosis
summary: Medical ultrasound (US) enables real-time, non-invasive diagnosis, yet building US-based AI systems is limited by data scarcity, costly expert annotation, and limited cross-center generalizability. Privacy constraints and instance-level reporting hinder the collection of diverse abnormal cases and frame-level labels, while repeated retraining for new centers increases computational cost. We introduce EvoDiff, a generative active learning framework that integrates diffusion modelling with information-theoretic objectives, evolutionary search, and curriculum-based sampling to select informative samples across heterogeneous US datasets. EvoDiff formulates sample selection as a generate-to-retrieve process, in which diffusion-based optimization in feature space guided by information gain produces synthetic probes, and only the real unlabeled samples retrieved by these probes are annotated and used for downstream training. Across six benchmarks covering fifteen datasets and 16,696 images, we evaluate EvoDiff on convolutional network and transformer-based foundation model. EvoDiff approaches fully supervised performance with substantially fewer labels, outperforms active learning baselines, and improves foundation model generalization under cross-domain external validation on unseen cohorts. A reader study with six radiologists indicates the potential to support clinical annotation workflows, with a model-based estimated 24% to 84% reduction in annotation workload at matched downstream performance.

AI.tldr: EvoDiff：将扩散模型、信息论目标、进化搜索与课程采样结合，把主动学习的样本选择表述为"生成—检索"过程，在少量真实标注下逼近全监督性能并提升跨中心泛化。
AI.motivation: 医学超声AI受限于数据稀缺、专家标注昂贵、跨中心泛化差；隐私约束与"实例级"报告导致异常样本与帧级标签难以收集，且新增中心需反复重训练，计算成本高。
AI.method: 提出生成式主动学习框架EvoDiff：以信息增益为引导在特征空间进行扩散优化，生成合成探针（synthetic probes）；仅检索并标注这些探针命中的真实无标签样本用于下游训练；结合进化搜索与课程式采样，在异构超声数据集间选择高信息量样本。评估覆盖6个基准、15个数据集、16,696张图像，模型侧包括卷积网络与Transformer基础模型。
AI.result: 以显著更少标签接近全监督性能，优于主动学习基线；在未见队列的跨域外部验证中提升基础模型泛化能力；六名放射科医师的阅读研究显示可支持临床标注流程，模型估计在匹配下游性能下减少24%–84%标注工作量。
AI.conclusion: EvoDiff表明"生成—检索"式主动学习可有效缓解医学超声AI的标注瓶颈与跨中心泛化问题，并具备融入临床标注工作流的潜力。
