AI.result: 全量微调下相差不到2个百分点的模型，在LIBERO-Spatial仅用50条示范时成功率差距可达3倍。π0.5比π0所需示范少2–5倍，在各预算下样本效率最高，长时程套件上差距最大。GR00T内部，N1.5在四个套件中的三个上比零样本更强的N1.6/N1.7适应更高效。冻结VLM严重损害π系列（其预训练中VLM与动作专家联合训练），而几乎不影响GR00T。验证损失在同一套件内与闭环成功率趋势一致，但低估了π0.5相对π0的样本效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 以零样本或全量微调成功率评价VLA会系统性掩盖适应效率差异，应以数据-算力预算下的成功率曲线作为标准评测维度；预训练中VLM是否与动作专家联合训练是决定适应效率的关键因素之一；验证损失只能作为套件内的相对代理指标，不能用于跨模型比较样本效率。

title: HALMES: Knowing When to Intervene in LVLM Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in multimodal tasks. Nevertheless, their outputs remain prone to object hallucinations that are inconsistent with visual content. Contrastive decoding, as a training-free inference-time mitigation approach, typically intervenes in the output distribution at every decoding step. However, such indiscriminate full-stage intervention may disrupt originally correct generations and even induce new hallucinations. To address this issue, we first analyze the relationship between internal attention features and hallucinated token segments in LVLMs, revealing that hallucination-related abnormalities already emerge progressively in preceding token segments. Based on this observation, we propose HALMES, a lightweight plug-and-play module that identifies hallucination precursor segments from attention features during generation and selectively triggers contrastive decoding. HALMES can be integrated with various full-stage contrastive decoding methods, transforming indiscriminate intervention into on-demand targeted correction. Extensive experiments across different LVLM architectures and multiple benchmarks show that HALMES further improves the hallucination mitigation performance of existing contrastive decoding methods while reducing the negative impact of full-stage intervention on normal outputs, validating the importance of modeling and selectively intervening on hallucination-prone segments.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量即插即用模块 HALMES，从注意力特征中识别幻觉前兆片段，仅在需要时触发对比解码，将全阶段无差别干预转为按需定向校正。
AI.motivation: 现有对比解码作为免训练推理期缓解方法，在每个解码步都干预输出分布；这种无差别的全程干预会破坏原本正确的生成，甚至诱发新的幻觉。作者希望先厘清内部注意力特征与幻觉 token 片段的关系，再做有选择的干预。
AI.method: 首先分析 LVLM 内部注意力特征与幻觉 token 片段的关系，发现幻觉相关异常在前序 token 片段中已逐步显现；据此设计 HALMES 模块，在生成过程中从注意力特征中识别"幻觉前兆片段"，并据此选择性地触发对比解码。该模块可与多种全阶段对比解码方法组合，实现按需的定向校正而非全程干预。
AI.result: 在不同 LVLM 架构与多个基准上的大量实验表明，HALMES 能进一步提升现有对比解码方法的幻觉缓解性能，同时降低全阶段干预对正常输出的负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 建模并选择性干预易幻觉片段是重要且有效的；将无差别全程干预转化为基于前兆片段识别的按需校正，可在保持免训练、即插即用特性的同时兼顾幻觉抑制与正常生成质量。

title: MAPA: Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation for Latent Dataset Distillation in 3D Medical Classification
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 17 pages including supplementary material
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) synthesizes a small training set from a large one, but applying it to 3D medical classification is constrained by the memory and optimization costs of synthesizing full volumetric samples. Under a storage-equivalent budget, distilling in the latent space of a frozen autoencoder reduces this cost and fits more synthetic samples (prototypes) than in voxel space. However, class-level matching, such as distribution matching, causes prototypes to concentrate in dense latent regions while underrepresenting sparser intra-class regions, a consistent imbalance that we term prototype concentration. To address this, we propose MAPA (Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation), a latent distillation method that spreads prototypes across intra-class modes while preserving class-level matching. MAPA marks these modes with fixed anchors estimated by clustering the real latents and distributes prototypes over them through a soft assignment, together with a lightweight anti-collapse regularizer and curriculum weighting that stabilize the optimization. Across five 3D medical classification tasks, MAPA improves the aggregate balanced accuracy by +4.2 points over the strongest latent baseline while using the same number of prototypes. An exploratory severity analysis on MosMedData suggests improved worst-stratum recall without loss of normal-case specificity.

AI.tldr: 提出潜空间蒸馏方法MAPA，通过模式感知的原型分配缓解"原型集中"问题，在五个3D医学分类任务上平衡准确率较最强潜空间基线提升4.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: 将数据集蒸馏（DD）用于3D医学分类时，合成完整体数据样本的内存与优化成本过高。在存储等价预算下，于冻结自编码器的潜空间中蒸馏可降低成本并容纳更多原型，但类级匹配（如分布匹配）会使原型集中于潜空间稠密区域，而低估稀疏的类内区域，形成"原型集中"（prototype concentration）的系统性失衡。
AI.method: MAPA（模式感知原型分配）：1）对真实潜变量聚类得到固定锚点以标记类内模式；2）通过软分配将原型分散到各锚点，同时保留类级匹配；3）引入轻量防坍缩正则项与课程式加权以稳定优化。
AI.result: 在五个3D医学分类任务上，原型数量相同时，MAPA的聚合平衡准确率较最强潜空间基线提升+4.2个百分点。针对MosMedData的探索性严重程度分析显示，最差分层召回率提升，同时未损失正常病例的特异性。
AI.conclusion: 在潜空间蒸馏中显式考虑类内多模式结构并均衡分配原型，可有效缓解原型集中，提升3D医学分类在类不平衡场景下的平衡性能与少数分层鲁棒性，且不增加原型预算。

title: Video-DCI: How Far Are VLM Agents from Human Viewers in Direct Video Corpus Interaction?
summary: Humans answer complex visual questions by inspecting short moments, updating what they know, and redirecting attention toward missing evidence. Existing video benchmarks, however, often provide the relevant video, evaluate only final answers or isolated localization, or permit textual shortcuts, leaving multi-round visual evidence seeking underexplored. We introduce Video-DCI, a diagnostic benchmark and functionally matched human-agent protocol for Direct Video-Corpus Interaction. It comprises DCI-Loc for temporal evidence localization and DCI-QA for end-to-end discovery, retention, and composition of cross-video evidence. In DCI-QA, videos within each pool are topically related, yet every answer requires hidden temporal evidence from multiple videos. Given only the question and video pool, humans and agents iteratively inspect bounded local windows, retain supporting evidence, and answer with cited temporal spans. Human trajectories provide reference curves for evidence acquisition and use across rounds. Experiments reveal a consistent retrieval-to-grounding gap. On DCI-Loc, frontier VLMs often retrieve and expose the reference moment, yet convert far less of this exposure into precise final citations than the human reference. On DCI-QA, the loss begins earlier and compounds across videos. Ablation studies further confirm that iterative search outperforms one-shot retrieval. Multi-round search is therefore necessary but insufficient: current agents accumulate candidates and observations more readily than precise, jointly sufficient evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Video-DCI 诊断基准及人类—智能体功能匹配协议，用于“直接视频语料交互”(DCI)，揭示当前前沿视觉语言模型在检索—定位之间存在系统性鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视频基准通常直接给出相关视频、仅评测最终答案或孤立定位，或允许文本捷径，导致多轮视觉证据寻求（检查片段、更新认知、重定向注意）这一核心能力未被充分考察。人类回答复杂视觉问题的这一过程缺乏可诊断的评测载体。
AI.method: 构建 Video-DCI 基准，含两个子任务：DCI-Loc 评测时间证据定位；DCI-QA 评测跨视频证据的端到端发现、保持与组合。DCI-QA 中每个视频池内的视频主题相关，但答案需来自多个视频的隐藏时间证据；仅给出问题与视频池，人类与智能体迭代检查有界局部窗口、保留支持证据并以引用时间跨度作答。人类轨迹提供多轮证据获取与使用的参考曲线。另做消融对比迭代搜索与一次性检索。
AI.result: 实验显示一致的“检索→定位”鸿沟：在 DCI-Loc 上，前沿 VLM 常能检索并暴露参考时刻，但转化为精确最终引用的比例远低于人类参考；在 DCI-QA 上，损失出现得更早并跨视频累积。消融表明迭代搜索优于一次性检索。
AI.conclusion: 多轮搜索是必要的但不充分：当前智能体更易累积候选与观察，而非聚合出精确且联合充分的证据。Video-DCI 为诊断多轮视觉证据寻求能力提供了可控、功能对齐的评测框架。

title: Improving the Diffusability of Motion Tokenizer
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). 26 pages, including appendix
summary: Latent diffusion models paired with a variational auto-encoder (VAE) tokenizer have shown promising performance for efficient text-driven human motion generation. However, motion latent diffusion suffers from a generation-reconstruction trade-off: simply increasing tokenizer capacity enhances reconstruction but fails to proportionally improve text-conditioned generation quality. We assume this trade-off stems from a spectral mismatch inside the VAE tokenizer: the encoder yields a latent space biased toward high frequencies, and the decoder introduces temporal artifacts. In this paper, we propose the Diffusable Motion Tokenizer (DiMoT) to improve the diffusability of the tokenizer, rather than scaling up the diffusion backbone. To improve text-conditioned optimization, Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA) leverages a pretrained diffusion model as the critic to suppress high-frequency latent energy. To preserve motion dynamics, the Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD) performs generative decoding via average-velocity prediction, enabling efficient one-step decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiMoT achieves state-of-the-art performance across various challenging text-to-motion benchmarks, yielding superior motion fidelity and text-motion alignment. Project page: https://githubhgh.github.io/dimot/.

AI.tldr: 提出DiMoT（Diffusable Motion Tokenizer），通过Critic Spectral Adaptation抑制latent高频能量、Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder实现平均速度预测的一步生成式解码，提升VAE tokenizer的"可扩散性"，从而缓解运动潜在扩散的生成-重建权衡。
AI.motivation: 文本驱动人体运动生成中，latent diffusion + VAE tokenizer存在生成-重建权衡：单纯增大tokenizer容量能提升重建，却无法同比提升文本条件生成质量。作者假设该权衡源于VAE内部的频谱失配——编码器产生的latent偏向高频，解码器引入时间伪影。
AI.method: 不扩大扩散主干，而是提升tokenizer的可扩散性。Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA)：以预训练扩散模型为critic，抑制latent中的高频能量，改善文本条件优化；Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD)：通过平均速度预测进行生成式解码，实现高效一步解码并保留运动动力学。
AI.result: 在多个具有挑战性的text-to-motion基准上达到state-of-the-art，运动保真度与文本-运动对齐均优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 从tokenizer的频谱特性与解码方式入手（而非缩放扩散骨干）可有效缓解生成-重建权衡，DiMoT验证了"提高tokenizer可扩散性"这一思路的有效性。

title: REFORM-3D: A Representation-Centric Evaluation Framework for 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 ED Track
summary: Evaluation of 3D medical foundation models is typically dominated by downstream task scores, which entangle representation quality with adaptation choices. This is especially critical in volumetric imaging, where spacing and anisotropy can substantially alter image statistics while the anatomy itself remains unchanged. We therefore introduce \textbf{REFORM-3D}, a \textbf{R}epresentation-centric \textbf{E}valuation \textbf{F}ramew\textbf{OR}k for benchmarking frozen 3D medical vision foundation \textbf{M}odels across three questions: Acquisition Robustness, asking whether features remain stable when spacing varies while anatomy is fixed; Cross-Modal Anatomical Alignment, asking whether labeled anatomical structures remain recoverable across modalities under balanced bidirectional retrieval; and Anatomical Transfer, asking whether organ identity remains recoverable from limited labeled support under case-disjoint evaluation. These are also pretraining questions, because what a 3D encoder learns depends on how volumes are geometrically presented during self-supervised pretraining. We further introduce Med3DINO encoder family, pretrained on $62.6$K unlabeled MR, CT, PET, CTA, and CBCT volumes under three explicit geometric assumptions: isotropic normalization, voxel-relative sampling, and spacing-aware resampling. Across Med3DINO and heterogeneous external encoders, REFORM-3D reveals module-specific strengths rather than a single model ordering. Within the controlled Med3DINO comparison, voxel-relative sampling yields lower embedding drift, whereas spacing-aware resampling favors anatomical transfer; semantic-transfer advantages depend on the dataset and feature type. Project link: \href{https://endarzboy.github.io/reform3d-website/}{\highlightLR{REFORM-3D}}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以表示为中心的三维医学视觉基础模型评测框架 REFORM-3D，并发布在 62.6K 无标注体数据上按三种几何假设预训练的 Med3DINO 编码器族，用于解耦"表示质量"与"下游适配策略"。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 医学基础模型评测多以下游任务分数为主导，将表示质量与适配（decoder/finetuning）选择混为一谈；在体成像中，层间距（spacing）与各向异性会显著改变图像统计量而解剖结构不变，若不固定适配策略，难以判断模型优劣来源。同时，编码器的几何预处理方式本身也是预训练问题，值得系统考察。
AI.method: 1) 提出 REFORM-3D 评测框架，对"冻结"（frozen）编码器从三个维度考察：Acquisition Robustness（解剖不变、spacing 变化下特征稳定性）、Cross-Modal Anatomical Alignment（平衡双向检索下标注解剖结构跨模态可恢复性）、Anatomical Transfer（case-disjoint 设置下、有限标注支持下的器官身份可恢复性）。2) 构建 Med3DINO 编码器族，在 62.6K 无标注 MR/CT/PET/CTA/CBCT 体数据上自监督预训练，采用三种显式几何假设：各向同性归一化、体素相对采样、spacing-aware 重采样。3) 在 Med3DINO 内部做受控对比，并与异构外部编码器一并评测。
AI.result: REFORM-3D 在 Med3DINO 及外部编码器上呈现"模块特异性优势"，而非单一模型排序。受控对比中：体素相对采样带来更低的 embedding drift（采集鲁棒性更好）；spacing-aware 重采样更有利于解剖迁移；语义迁移方面的优势则依赖数据集与特征类型。
AI.conclusion: 三维医学基础模型评测应剥离下游适配、聚焦表示本身；几何预处理策略是影响预训练表示的关键设计变量，且不同几何假设在不同能力维度上各有取舍，无法用单一指标或统一排名概括。

title: Ultra-Lightweight 3D Medical Image Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation in Label-Scarce Domains
comment: This is a four pages paper having 3 figures and is submitted to ISBI2027
summary: Mamba is a neural network architecture that reduces computational complexity, and has been shown to be effective for 3D medical image segmentation. However, existing models still remain computationally expensive. We propose compressing Mamba by distillation while achieving competitive performance. Specifically, we demonstrate compression of a 139M-parameter SegMamba-V2 teacher into a lightweight TinyUNet3D student with about 0.96M parameters, achieving about 145$\times$ compression with a performance drop of just over one Dice point. We further investigate the utility of knowledge distillation in a range of data-labeling scenarios under identical experimental settings, and show that its advantage is most prominent when labeled data is scarce. To demonstrate the generalizability of our approach, experiments are conducted on three datasets: BraTS 2023, MSD Spleen and MSD Hippocampus. The code for TinyUNet3D is publicly available at: https://github.com/2802990u/tinyunet3d-dist-kd.

AI.tldr: 通过知识蒸馏将139M参数的SegMamba-V2教师模型压缩为约0.96M参数的TinyUNet3D学生模型，实现约145倍压缩，Dice仅下降一个百分点左右；在标注数据稀缺时蒸馏优势最明显，并在三个3D医学分割数据集上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Mamba的3D医学图像分割模型虽降低了计算复杂度，但整体仍计算开销大（如139M参数），需要进一步轻量化。
AI.method: 采用知识蒸馏方法，将SegMamba-V2教师模型蒸馏到轻量级TinyUNet3D学生模型；在相同实验设置下考察不同数据标注场景对蒸馏效果的影响。
AI.result: 参数从139M压缩至约0.96M（约145倍压缩），Dice仅下降略超一个百分点；蒸馏优势在标注数据稀缺时最突出；在BraTS 2023、MSD Spleen、MSD Hippocampus三个数据集上验证了泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏可实现Mamba分割模型的高效压缩且保持竞争性性能，尤其适用于标签稀缺场景，方法具有跨数据集的泛化能力，代码已公开。

title: Representation Learning for 3D Brain Imaging: A Benchmark
summary: Many deep learning architectures for computer vision tasks rely on features extracted by a pre-trained encoder on large databases of natural 2D RGB images. However, the wide domain gap with medical images hampers the direct transfer of optimized deep learning models from computer vision to clinical applications. Recently, self-supervised pre-training and foundation models emerged as promising alternatives to mitigate these limitations. Yet, constructing such models for medical imaging faces critical challenges, including designing and adapting training strategies for large 3D volume datasets, and the need for standardized benchmarks to evaluate feature extraction performance. In this study, we propose an extensive comparison of vision encoders with a focus on 3D brain MRI. First, we consider 8 fully and self-supervised models pretrained on natural images (e.g. ResNet, DINO, CLIP) and 10 backbone architectures trained on medical images, either based on supervised (e.g. RadImageNet) or self-supervised (e.g. BiomedCLIP, SimCLR) tasks. All pre-trained encoders are evaluated on various downstream tasks to assess the representation power of their latent representations, including age and sex prediction as well as disease classification on the ADNI and PPMI datasets. Our study shows that 2D encoders pre-trained on natural images perform the most favorably, even compared to models pre-trained on more than 100k brain MRI volumes, highlighting the need for more suitable and robust methods for representation learning in 3D medical imaging. The source code for this study is publicly available at: https: //github.com/PierreFalconnier/brain-representation-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统对比了18个视觉编码器在3D脑部MRI下游任务上的表征能力，发现自然图像上预训练的2D编码器表现最佳，甚至优于用超过10万例脑MRI体数据预训练的模型，凸显3D医学影像表征学习仍需更适配的方法。
AI.motivation: 自然2D RGB图像与医学图像存在显著域差距，直接迁移预训练模型受限；自监督预训练与基础模型虽是有希望的替代方案，但3D体数据的训练策略设计与标准化评测基准仍是关键挑战。
AI.method: 构建统一基准，纳入8个在自然图像上预训练的完全监督与自监督模型（如ResNet、DINO、CLIP）及10个在医学图像上训练的骨干架构（监督如RadImageNet，自监督如BiomedCLIP、SimCLR），在ADNI与PPMI数据集上通过年龄/性别预测和疾病分类等下游任务评估其潜在表征的表达能力。
AI.result: 在自然图像上预训练的2D编码器表现最优，即使与基于超过10万例脑MRI体积训练的模型相比亦具优势。
AI.conclusion: 3D医学影像的表示学习仍缺乏适配且鲁棒的方法，需要针对体积数据设计更合适的预训练与评测方法；代码已公开。

title: Disentangling Channel Semantics in Vision Transformers via Token Decorrelation and Composition-Aware Modulation
summary: Multi-channel images encode heterogeneous channel semantics aligned over a shared spatial structure, which requires models to jointly capture globally shared structure and channel-specific variations. Recent multi-channel Vision Transformers attempt to address this challenge by augmenting the [CLS] token with memory tokens to organize multi-channel representations under varying channel compositions. However, we find that these context tokens collapse onto a few dominant channels under high inter-channel redundancy, producing redundant representations and a biased global summary that fails to reliably support composition-aware channel interpretation. We propose MuCa-ViT (Multi-Channel Composition-Aware Vision Transformer), a unified framework that addresses these limitations through two coupled mechanisms. Factorial Token Learning (FTL) enforces token-level decorrelation among context tokens, encouraging the [CLS] token to capture globally shared semantics while memory tokens preserve complementary channel-specific cues. Channel Composition-Aware Modulation (CAM) uses the FTL-refined [CLS] as a semantic anchor to generate sample-wise modulation signals, which enable composition-aware interpretation of channels within a unified backbone rather than relying on static channel embeddings. Experiments on JUMP-CP, CHAMMI, and So2Sat show that MuCa-ViT outperforms prior multi-channel ViTs across all three benchmarks, and the magnitude of improvement aligns with the inter-channel redundancy of each dataset ($ρ\in [0.19, 0.77]$), validating the diagnostic analysis that motivates our design. Our code is available at https://github.com/kimdanni/MuCa-ViT .

AI.tldr: MuCa-ViT通过因子化Token学习强制上下文Token去相关、并结合通道组成感知调制，缓解多通道ViT中上下文Token向少数主导通道坍缩的问题，在三个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多通道图像需同时建模全局共享空间结构与通道特异性差异。现有方法用memory token增强[CLS]，但在通道间高度冗余时，这些上下文Token会坍缩到少数主导通道，产生冗余表示与有偏的全局摘要，无法可靠支持组成感知的通道解释。
AI.method: 提出统一框架MuCa-ViT，含两个耦合机制：(1) Factorial Token Learning (FTL)，在上下文Token间施加Token级去相关约束，使[CLS]捕获全局共享语义、memory token保留互补的通道特异线索；(2) Channel Composition-Aware Modulation (CAM)，以FTL精炼后的[CLS]作语义锚点，生成样本级调制信号，在统一骨干内实现组成感知的通道解释，而非依赖静态通道嵌入。
AI.result: 在JUMP-CP、CHAMMI、So2Sat三个基准上均优于先前的多通道ViT；性能提升幅度与各数据集的通道间冗余度一致（ρ∈[0.19, 0.77]），验证了驱动设计的诊断分析。
AI.conclusion: 上下文Token坍缩是现有多通道ViT的关键瓶颈，Token去相关与组成感知调制可有效解决该问题；增益随冗余度变化进一步支持该诊断，代码已开源。

title: Can General-Purpose Generative AI Supply Training Data for Medical Vision Models? A Multimodal Retrospective Study
summary: Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. We evaluated Nano Banana, a general-purpose image generation and editing model, as a source of synthetic medical images for model training, subgroup augmentation, and model auditing. Methods: In this retrospective study across four imaging modalities, chest radiography, fundus photography, and CT models were trained only on synthetic images and externally validated on real-world data against real-data-trained models. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p<0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. To stress-test shortcut learning, editing a moderate tessellated pattern into fundus photographs reduced the true-class probability for central serous chorioretinopathy from 0.996 to 0.822. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.

AI.tldr: 评估通用图像生成/编辑模型Nano Banana在四种影像模态中作为合成医学图像来源的可行性，涵盖纯合成训练、混合增强与模型审计三类用途。
AI.motivation: 标注良好、多样化的医学影像数据集仍是视觉医学AI的主要瓶颈，需探索合成数据能否缓解数据约束并支持亚组增强与模型审计。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，覆盖胸片、眼底照相、CT与颈动脉超声四种模态。胸片/眼底/CT模型仅用合成图像训练，在真实数据上外部验证，并与真实数据训练模型对比；颈动脉超声模型基于私人Human Phenotype Project队列（40–75岁），比较有无合成增强。临床医生评估图像可信度；评价指标包括AUROC、AUPR、校准与决策曲线分析。
AI.result: 纯合成模型AUROC：肺炎0.877（95%CI 0.843–0.910，n=14863）、视网膜脱离0.963（0.948–0.975，n=1149）、肾结石0.711（0.600–0.823，n=4122），与真实数据训练模型相当，但校准与净获益不总是更优。合成+真实混合训练得到的颈动脉超声序数血管年龄指数可将633名外部受试者分层，亚组在BMI与血糖上差异显著（p<0.01）。在眼底图像中编辑加入中等网格状纹理使中心性浆液性脉络膜视网膜病变的真类概率由0.996降至0.822。医生引导编辑使低质量CT可信度从3.10/5升至4.30/5。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据可在模型训练、亚组代表性与受控编辑的模型测试中补充真实数据；其临床价值须结合校准、决策曲线分析与临床医生评审综合判定，而非仅依赖判别力。

title: Split and Bridge: Multimodal Generation via Diffusion Bridging
summary: Visual data are often expressed through multiple complementary modalities (e.g., images and segmentation masks), each capturing different aspects of the same underlying structure. Most existing multimodal methods adopt a top-down paradigm, learning a shared latent variable through joint training from scratch, which limits scalability. We propose Split and Bridge (SnB), a bottom-up framework for multimodal generation that couples pretrained unimodal diffusion models at sampling time. Rather than learning a unified latent space, SnB generates coherent multimodal samples by following a shared diffusion trajectory up to a split point and then branching into modality-specific trajectories guided by a bridge module. This design enables plug-and-play reuse of powerful pretrained models without joint training, making it scalable and easily adaptable. Across standard benchmarks (PolyMNIST, CelebAMask-HQ) and more complex settings (PIE-Bench++, ROCO), SnB achieves a strong balance between sample quality and coherence. We show that SnB naturally extends to downstream zero-shot tasks such as interleaved co-generation, image editing, and style coupling/decoupling. Our results demonstrate that bottom-up generation provides a practical framework that complements existing top-down multimodal approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/AhmadArrabi/SnB

AI.tldr: 提出自底向上的多模态生成框架Split and Bridge (SnB)，在采样阶段耦合预训练单模态扩散模型：先共享扩散轨迹直至分裂点，再经桥接模块分支为模态特定轨迹，实现无需联合训练的即插即用多模态生成。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数多模态方法采用自顶向下范式，通过从零开始的联合训练学习共享潜变量，限制了可扩展性；且难以复用强大的预训练单模态模型。
AI.method: SnB不学习统一潜空间，而是沿共享扩散轨迹采样至"分裂点"后，由桥接模块引导各模态分支到各自的模态特定轨迹，从而在采样时耦合多个预训练单模态扩散模型，实现免联合训练的即插即用复用。
AI.result: 在PolyMNIST、CelebAMask-HQ等标准基准及PIE-Bench++、ROCO等更复杂设置上，SnB在样本质量与模态一致性之间取得良好平衡；并可自然扩展到交错协同生成、图像编辑、风格耦合/解耦等零样本下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 自底向上生成提供了与现有自顶向下多模态方法互补的实用框架，兼具可扩展性与灵活适配性。

title: RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出RefineSplat，在"先分割后重建"（Segment-then-Splat）范式上闭环引入重建引导的跟踪反馈与视角感知语言嵌入，实现统一的开开放词汇3D分割与检索；并发布Blender-OVS合成基准，在静态/动态场景中提升渲染视角分割与物体级Chamfer距离。
AI.motivation: 主流"先重建后分割"（splat-then-segment）流程存在视角不一致、物体边界模糊、物体级对应弱的问题，尤其在复杂静态与动态场景中，导致开放词汇3D分割与检索不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 沿用物体中心范式：先在2D跟踪物体，再为每个物体用专属3D高斯集合重建，保持显式物体-高斯对应；2) 重建引导反馈机制：用渲染掩码与多视图一致性反向修正不可靠的视频跟踪掩码，闭环2D跟踪与3D重建；3) 视角感知嵌入分配：每个物体维护多个按视角聚类的语言嵌入，而非单一嵌入；4) 构建Blender-OVS合成基准，含静态与动态序列及精确物体网格与点云。
AI.result: 在静态与动态基准上，渲染视角分割性能提升、物体级Chamfer距离降低，同时场景重建质量保持有竞争力；Blender-OVS可支持对提取几何的直接评估。
AI.conclusion: 以物体为中心并闭环2D跟踪与3D重建，辅以多视角嵌入，可有效缓解开放词汇3D场景理解中的跟踪噪声与视角依赖语义问题；合成基准为几何级评测提供可控手段。

title: DAPointRWKV: Domain Adaptive Vision RWKV for Point Cloud Completion
comment: This paper has been accepted by 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia
summary: Domain adaptive point cloud completion (DA PCC) aims to bridge the geometric discrepancy between labeled source domains and unlabeled target domains for accurate 3D shape completion. Existing methods based on CNNs, Transformers, and Mamba-like sequence models still face challenges from limited receptive fields, high computational complexity, insufficient geometric bias, and serialization sensitivity. Recently, Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) provides a linear-complexity alternative for long-range sequence modeling. However, adapting RWKV to DA PCC remains challenging due to the lack of explicit geometric priors, the mismatch between recurrent modeling and coarse-to-fine generation, and unstable target-domain adaptation. To address these challenges, we propose DAPointRWKV, a novel RWKV-based framework for DA PCC. DAPointRWKV consists of three components: Geometry-Aware RWKV (GA-RWKV) Backbone, RWKV-Oriented Progressive Decoder (RWKV-PD), and Dual Structural Regularization (DSR). Specifically, GA-RWKV introduces geometry-aware recurrent representation learning, RWKV-PD bridges RWKV token representations with coarse-to-fine reconstruction through local token-guided refinement, and DSR stabilizes target-domain transfer through visible-structure anchoring and complete-shape hypothesis stabilization. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that DAPointRWKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出基于RWKV的域自适应点云补全框架DAPointRWKV，含几何感知GA-RWKV主干、渐进解码器RWKV-PD与双结构正则DSR，在合成与真实基准上优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有CNN/Transformer/Mamba类方法存在感受野受限、计算复杂度高、几何先验不足、序列化敏感等问题；RWKV虽具线性复杂度长程建模能力，但直接用于DA PCC面临三项困难：缺乏显式几何先验、循环建模与由粗到细生成不匹配、目标域自适应不稳定。
AI.method: 三模块框架：(1) GA-RWKV主干，引入几何感知的循环表征学习，弥补显式几何先验缺失；(2) RWKV-PD渐进解码器，通过局部token引导的细化，将RWKV token表征与由粗到细重建衔接；(3) DSR双结构正则，借助可见结构锚定与完整形状假设稳定化，提升目标域迁移稳定性。
AI.result: 在合成与真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，DAPointRWKV在域自适应点云补全任务上持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将线性复杂度的RWKV适配于点云补全的跨域场景是可行的，关键在于几何先验注入、解码器与循环表征的耦合以及目标域迁移的双重结构正则约束。

title: PoseBench: Probing Pose Awareness in Visual Foundation Models
summary: Pose awareness characterizes the extent to which a learned feature space aligns with the underlying object-pose manifold, such that observations with similar poses exhibit greater feature similarity than those with increasingly different poses. While such structure is desirable for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks, visual foundation models pre-trained on individual 2D images typically lack explicit 3D or pose supervision. This raises a fundamental question: Do 2D visual foundation models exhibit pose awareness after large-scale pretraining? To answer this question, we introduce PoseBench, a systematic benchmark to probe pose awareness in pretrained visual features. Our evaluation follows a progressive design: held-out rendered views probe intrinsic pose-aware structure under controlled conditions, while real-image queries evaluate how robustly this structure remains accessible under real-world variations. We further introduce pose-graph-based refinement as a complementary probe of compatibility between feature neighborhoods and the underlying pose manifold. Across 31 publicly available checkpoints from 10 pretraining families, PoseBench reveals that pose awareness is an implicit but non-uniform property of 2D visual foundation models, and consistent gains from pose-graph refinement suggest that feature spaces retain structure compatible with the underlying pose manifold. PoseBench therefore provides a systematic basis for understanding and selecting pretrained features for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出PoseBench基准，系统探测2D视觉基础模型特征空间是否隐式具备姿态感知（pose awareness）结构，发现该性质隐式存在但并不均匀，且特征空间与姿态流形保持较好兼容性。
AI.motivation: 姿态敏感的3D视觉任务希望特征空间与物体姿态流形对齐（姿态相近则特征相似），但主流视觉基础模型仅在单张2D图像上预训练、缺乏显式3D或姿态监督，因此需要回答：大规模预训练后的2D视觉基础模型是否具备姿态感知能力。
AI.method: 构建PoseBench基准，采用渐进式评测设计：用留出的渲染视图在受控条件下探测内在姿态感知结构，再用真实图像查询评估该结构在真实变化下的可访问鲁棒性；并引入基于姿态图的精化（pose-graph-based refinement）作为补充探针，检验特征邻域与底层姿态流形的一致性。实验覆盖10个预训练家族、31个公开检查点。
AI.result: PoseBench显示姿态感知是2D视觉基础模型的一种隐式但非均匀属性；姿态图精化带来一致增益，表明特征空间保留了与底层姿态流形兼容的结构。
AI.conclusion: PoseBench为理解预训练特征的姿态感知性质、并为姿态敏感3D视觉任务筛选预训练特征提供了系统化依据。

title: AI-Driven Repair of Missing Automotive Components
summary: Due to supply constraints, replacing damaged automotive components can be expensive and time-consuming, while replacing the entire component can be wasteful when much of it remains usable. This paper presents a pipeline to investigate whether missing geometry can be reconstructed as a repair patch using paired observations of the intact models and synthetically damaged components. Noise-free color, depth, and silhouette images were produced using the camera viewpoints. Depth differences were then used to identify the potential missing regions, while multi-view voxel reconstruction was used to estimate the missing portion. A pretrained DINOv2 model was also added to validate missing candidates and determine whether pretrained visual features could improve reconstruction. We tested the pipeline on 20 automotive CAD models, each with a synthetically removed portion. Each model was tested under four different conditions using two reconstruction methods for a total of 160 trials. The predictions were compared with the missing geometry of the unchanged ground-truth using predefined thresholds of the voxel intersection-over-union over 0.85 and the absolute relative volume error less than 15%. Of the 160 experimental trials, 109 of them satisfied both thresholds. Geometry-only reconstruction passed 16 of 20 components with eight views but only 10 of 20 with four adjacent views. Further analysis showed that 24 out of the 37 failed reconstructions could be categorized as unsuccessful because extra material was incorrectly added to areas that should have been empty. The implementation of DINOv2 into the pipeline did not improve the overall reconstruction accuracy and made prediction generation slower. For 13 verified tests, printing only the repaired sections instead of the entire parts reduced filament use by 93.08% and printing time by 89.39% based on the median results.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一套基于多视角彩色、深度与轮廓图像的流程，用配对的无损/合成损伤模型重建缺失几何作为修复补片，在20个汽车CAD模型、160次试验中109次同时满足IoU>0.85与相对体积误差<15%的阈值；DINOv2未提升精度且拖慢速度。
AI.motivation: 汽车零部件损坏后整件更换成本高、耗时长，且当大部分结构仍可用时整件替换造成浪费；因此需要判断能否仅重建缺失部分作为修复补片（repair patch），实现局部修复而非整体更换。
AI.method: 构建配对观测数据（完整模型与合成去除局部后的损伤件），由设定相机视角生成无噪声的彩色、深度和轮廓图像；用深度差识别潜在缺失区域，用多视角体素重建估计缺失部分；并引入预训练DINOv2验证缺失候选、考察预训练视觉特征能否改善重建。在20个汽车CAD模型上，每件合成去除一部分，按四种条件×两种重建方法共160次试验，以体素IoU>0.85和绝对相对体积误差<15%为阈值评估，并与未改动真值的缺失几何比较。
AI.result: 160次试验中109次同时满足两项阈值。仅几何重建在八视角下20个部件通过16个，四相邻视角下仅通过10个。37次失败中24次归因于在应为空白的区域错误添加了多余材料。DINOv2的引入未提升整体重建精度，且使预测生成更慢。在13组验证试验中，仅打印修复部分相比打印整件，按中位数计耗材减少93.08%、打印时间缩短89.39%。
AI.conclusion: 多视角几何体素重建可作为缺失几何修复补片的可行方案，其精度对视角数量与覆盖度敏感；预训练视觉特征（DINOv2）对精度无明显增益且增加计算开销。局部修复打印在材料与时间上收益显著，但需重点抑制假阳性填充（多余材料外溢）以提升成功率。

title: STAIRS: Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling for Unrolled MRI Reconstruction
summary: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) forms images from incomplete Fourier measurements, shifting acquisition burden to computational reconstruction. Deep unrolled networks interleave learned regularization and data consistency, yet typically estimate the full unmeasured spectrum at every cascade. We propose STAIRS (Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling), which projects intermediate reconstructions onto nested Fourier supports that expand to the full spectrum and conditions each update on its support transition. Conditional increments of a regularized log-determinant score of training covariance define a normalized spectral coordinate, accounting for dependencies between newly and previously admitted frequencies. Dyadic targets allocate larger coordinate increments to earlier cascades and are mapped to fixed supports before training, enabling coarse-to-fine reconstruction with unchanged sampling masks and data consistency. On fastMRI and Stanford2D, STAIRS improves matched Transformer (HUMUSNet) and convolutional (NAFNet) backbones in single- and multi-coil reconstruction, including radiologist-annotated pathology regions. It also outperforms predictor-based progression with lower parameter overhead and inference latency. Stage-wise analysis shows repeated error correction by projection and lower intermediate reconstruction errors than the backbones alone throughout support expansion. Ablations favor dyadic allocation over uniform expansion for square and line-band supports and over manual front-loading for square windows. Support projection alone improves reconstruction, and transition conditioning strengthens the gain. Cross-dataset evaluation shows improvements for both backbones in both directions. Support allocation thus complements regularizer design in unrolled MRI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出STAIRS，将展开式MRI重建的中间结果投影到由小到大的嵌套傅里叶支撑上，实现粗到细的渐进重建。
AI.motivation: 现有深度展开网络在每个级联都直接估计完整未采样频谱，未利用频谱探索的由粗到细结构，计算负担大且缺乏对频率渐进引入的显式调度。
AI.method: 用训练协方差的对数行列式得分（log-determinant score）的增量定义归一化频谱坐标，考虑新旧频率间依赖；采用二进（dyadic）目标分配，使早期级联获得更大坐标增量，并映射为训练前固定的支撑；每步更新以其支撑转移为条件，采样掩码与数据一致性保持不变。
AI.result: 在fastMRI与Stanford2D上，单/多线圈重建均提升HUMUSNet（Transformer）与NAFNet（卷积）骨干，包括放射科标注的病理区域；优于基于预测器的渐进策略，参数开销与推理延迟更低；逐阶段分析显示投影带来重复误差校正，中间重建误差持续低于骨干本身；消融表明二进分配优于均匀扩展与手工前置加载，支撑投影本身即有效，转移条件化进一步增强增益；跨数据集双向评估均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 支撑调度与正则化器设计互补，是展开式MRI重建中一个独立且有效的改进维度。

title: Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) perform strongly in face recognition (FR), yet their fixed-depth inference limits deployment in resource-constrained settings. We propose SD-ViT, a training framework that gives a usable exit at every block depth by making every depth produce discriminative embeddings, for budget-selected fixed-depth exits. Standard ViTs supervise intermediate layers only through backpropagation, so their intermediate representations are not directly optimized to form usable identity embeddings. SD-ViT adds a stochastic auxiliary signal: at each iteration a randomly selected intermediate block is passed through the same embedding head as the final layer and trained with a weighted margin-penalty softmax loss. The objective is thus stochastically sampled deep supervision through a shared classifier. Because both loss terms share that head and classifier, intermediate tokens are trained to map into the same embedding space as final-layer tokens. This matters for FR, where matching is by similarity: a probe processed at an early exit can be compared directly against full-depth gallery embeddings, with no gallery recomputation or adaptation layers. On established benchmarks, SD-ViT stays within 0.4 IJB-C points of the same backbone trained conventionally at full depth, while its early-exit probes recover over 96% of their own full-depth performance at 50% of the computational cost without modifying the reference gallery. A single verification threshold calibrated at full depth remains usable from quarter depth onward.

AI.tldr: 提出SD-ViT训练框架，使ViT在人脸识别中每个block深度都能输出可用的人脸嵌入，支持按预算选择的固定深度提前退出。
AI.motivation: ViT在人脸识别上表现优异，但固定深度推理限制了其在资源受限场景的部署。标准ViT仅通过反向传播监督中间层，中间表示未被直接优化为可用的人脸身份嵌入，导致提前退出难以直接与全深度gallery匹配。
AI.method: 在每个训练迭代中随机选取一个中间block，使其通过共享的embedding head与分类器，并与最后一层同样采用加权margin-penalty softmax损失进行监督，形成"通过共享分类器随机采样的深度监督"。由于损失项共享head与分类器，中间token被训练映射到与最终层相同的嵌入空间。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，SD-ViT全深度性能与常规训练的同一骨干相差不超过0.4个IJB-C点；提前退出探针在50%计算成本下恢复自身全深度性能的96%以上，且无需修改参考gallery；全深度校准的单一验证阈值从四分之一深度起即可使用。
AI.conclusion: SD-ViT通过共享分类器的随机深度监督，使ViT各深度嵌入处于统一空间，实现无需gallery重算或适配层的预算化提前退出，兼顾精度与效率。

title: SceneShifter: Training-free Multi-Scene Temporal Control for Audio-driven Human Animation
summary: Although audio-driven human animation has achieved impressive realism, it still lacks effective Multi-Scene Temporal Control: orchestrating background transitions at precise timestamps while preserving a coherent foreground subject. We show that this challenge stems from the diffusion transformer's self-attention mechanism, and addressing it requires two capabilities: (1) Semantic-Aware Temporal Decoupling, which isolates background attention across scenes while retaining cross-scene foreground attention for subject consistency; and (2) Foreground Motion Localization, which accurately tracks the foreground subject across latent frames, especially under large motion. To address these challenges, we introduce SceneShifter, a training-free framework for precise multi-scene control in audio-driven human animation. SceneShifter guides spatio-temporal self-attention by suppressing cross-scene attention among background tokens while preserving cross-scene attention among foreground tokens. To support this guidance under large motion, SceneShifter extracts dynamic foreground masks from the self-attention layers and heads that best capture subject trajectories. We further introduce SceneShifterBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate scene-timing accuracy, foreground preservation, and visual quality under large motion, multiple subjects. Experiments show that SceneShifter achieves frame-level scene timing, strong subject preservation, and high visual quality, outperforming existing baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/JamesLong199/SceneShifter.

AI.tldr: SceneShifter：一种免训练框架，通过引导扩散 Transformer 的自注意力实现音频驱动人体动画中的精确多场景时序控制（背景按时间戳切换且前景主体保持一致）。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动人体动画虽已高度逼真，但缺乏有效的多场景时序控制能力：难以在精确时间戳切换背景同时保持前景主体连贯。作者指出该问题源于扩散 Transformer 的自注意力机制，并需具备两项能力：语义感知的时序解耦（隔离跨场景背景注意力、保留跨场景前景注意力）与前景运动定位（在大幅运动下准确跟踪潜在帧中的前景主体）。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架 SceneShifter，通过抑制背景 token 的跨场景注意力、保留前景 token 的跨场景注意力来引导时空自注意力；并从最能捕捉主体轨迹的自注意力层与注意力头中提取动态前景掩码，以支撑大幅运动下的引导。同时构建 SceneShifterBench 基准，评测场景时序精度、前景保持与大幅运动/多主体下的视觉质量。
AI.result: 实验表明 SceneShifter 实现帧级场景时序控制、强主体保持与高视觉质量，优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过对自注意力的语义感知时序解耦与基于注意力衍生的动态前景掩码定位，可在无需训练的条件下实现精确多场景控制；SceneShifterBench 为该任务提供了系统评测协议。

title: A four-view smartphone video dataset of a robot-held flexible strip, with camera poses and a 3D LaGSplat baseline
comment: 2 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Dataset and checkpoints: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23601189. Training code: https://github.com/LouenPottier/lagsplat-mpov. Interactive demo: https://louenpottier.github.io/xrdays.html
summary: This note describes a multi-view video dataset of a deformable object driven by a measured input, with the measured pose of every camera, and a first 3D result obtained on it with LaGSplat. LaGSplat learns from video a low-dimensional latent state that is both the generalized coordinate of a learned dissipative Lagrangian and the conditioning variable of a Gaussian Splatting decoder; fitting the decoder in 3D calls for synchronized multi-view footage, which the original paper only had from synthetic renderings. Here a robot arm moves a flexible strip by oscillating along a one-dimensional path, and four iPhones, three fixed and one handheld, film it for ten minutes. The videos are synchronized, the cameras are posed from the scene, and the position of the gripper is given per frame as the input of the system. LaGSplat fitted on this data with the gripper acceleration as a forcing term renders held-out views at 26 to 33 dB PSNR and runs as a real-time interactive demo in a web browser. Dataset, checkpoints and training code are public.

AI.tldr: 论文发布一个由实测输入驱动的可变形物体多视角视频数据集（4台iPhone、含相机实测位姿与逐帧夹爪位置），并用LaGSplat在其上取得首个3D结果，留出视角PSNR为26–33 dB，且可实现在浏览器实时交互演示。
AI.motivation: LaGSplat需同步多视角真实视频来在3D中拟合高斯泼溅解码器，而原论文仅有合成渲染数据，缺乏带实测驱动输入与相机位姿的真实多视角数据。
AI.method: 搭建由机械臂沿一维轨迹往复驱动柔性条带的采集场景；3台固定加1台手持iPhone拍摄约10分钟同步视频；从场景中恢复相机位姿，逐帧记录夹爪位置作为系统输入；以夹爪加速度作为外力项训练LaGSplat，其隐状态同时充当耗散拉格朗日广义坐标与高斯泼溅解码器的条件变量。
AI.result: 在该数据上拟合的LaGSplat在留出视角上达到26–33 dB PSNR，并能在网页浏览器中以实时交互演示形式运行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了带实测输入与相机位姿的真实多视角可变形物体数据集及首个3D重建结果，弥补LaGSplat仅依赖合成数据的不足；数据集、检查点与训练代码均已公开。

title: HippoMamba: A Mamba-augmented network for hippocampal segmentation and serial volumetry in Alzheimers disease
summary: Hippocampal atrophy is among the earliest structural markers of Alzheimer's disease, and reliable hippocampal segmentation across serial MRI visits is a prerequisite for measuring it. We present HippoMamba, a network that combines a 3D convolutional encoder and decoder with a Mamba selective state space block at the bottleneck, designed to process one or more MRI visits of a subject. On the Medical Segmentation Decathlon hippocampus dataset (260 subjects, five-fold cross-validation), HippoMamba obtained a mean Dice similarity coefficient of 0.8861 $\pm$ 0.0094, the highest among six convolutional and transformer-based methods trained with the same folds and patch size, and its per-subject Dice was significantly higher than that of each method (Holm-corrected Wilcoxon tests, $p \leq 0.013$). Its mean 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (1.45 mm) and average surface distance (0.44 mm) were the lowest of the compared methods, although they did not differ significantly from those of Attention U-Net, and the Hausdorff distance did not differ significantly from that of SegResNet. Without retraining, the five-fold ensemble was applied to 600 T1-weighted sessions from 150 participants of the OASIS-3 cohort. In sessions meeting a registration quality criterion, predicted hippocampal volumes ranked consistently with FreeSurfer volumes (Pearson r = 0.778, 95% CI 0.699 to 0.838; ICC(3,1) = 0.772) but were systematically smaller by about 27%. In a pre-specified analysis of participants followed for at least two years, annualised volume change derived from per-visit segmentation was moderately correlated with that of FreeSurfer (r = 0.503, 95% CI 0.319 to 0.659), with a larger mean rate. These results support the use of HippoMamba for hippocampal segmentation and for ranking hippocampal volume within a cohort, with absolute volumes and rates of change interpreted relative to the reference method.

AI.tldr: HippoMamba将3D卷积编解码器与瓶颈处的Mamba选择性状态空间模块结合，用于多访次MRI海马分割；在MSD海马数据集上Dice达0.8861±0.0094，优于六种对比方法，在OASIS-3上与FreeSurfer体积排序一致但系统性偏小约27%。
AI.motivation: 海马萎缩是阿尔茨海默病最早的结构标志之一，而跨序列MRI访次的可靠海马分割是测量萎缩的前提，因此需要兼顾精度与多访次一致性的分割方法。
AI.method: 提出HippoMamba：3D卷积编码器-解码器，瓶颈处引入Mamba选择性状态空间块，可处理同一受试者的一个或多个MRI访次。在MSD海马数据集（260例，五折交叉验证）上与六种卷积及Transformer方法在相同折与patch尺寸下比较；并将五折集成模型不经重训练直接用于OASIS-3队列150名参与者的600个T1加权访次。
AI.result: MSD上平均Dice 0.8861±0.0094，为六方法中最高，逐受试者Dice显著高于各方法（Holm校正Wilcoxon，p≤0.013）；95%HD为1.45 mm、ASD为0.44 mm，均为最低，但与Attention U-Net无显著差异，HD与SegResNet亦无显著差异。OASIS-3中满足配准质量标准的访次里，预测海马体积与FreeSurfer体积排序一致（r=0.778，95% CI 0.699–0.838；ICC(3,1)=0.772），但系统性偏小约27%；随访≥2年者的年化体积变化与FreeSurfer中度相关（r=0.503，95% CI 0.319–0.659），平均变化率更大。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将HippoMamba用于海马分割及队列内海马体积排序；其绝对体积与变化率需相对参考方法解读。

title: FG-DSA: Frequency-Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction
summary: Dense prediction and generative modeling in resource-constrained scenarios remain challenging, as repeated downsampling substantially reduces spatial detail and degrades boundaries. Although recent attention mechanisms have alleviated the problem of semantic ambiguity, they often fail to preserve high-frequency features or do so at the expense of a very high computational cost. In this paper, we propose the Frequency Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction (FG-DSA), a novel framework for efficient dense visual understanding and generation. FG-DSA employs a 2D FFT high-pass filtering module to explicitly inject frequency domain priors into the spatial attention mechanism, allowing lightweight networks to recover sharp boundary transitions with linear complexity. A range of experiments show that FG-DSA is effective at recovering fine object boundaries and leads to a consistent performance gain in the task of semantic segmentation. Importantly, we show that FGA-DSA can be used as a module in diffusion-based generative U-Nets, leading to a significant improvement in the detail of the generated images with very little additional parameter and Floating Point Operation (FLOP) cost.

AI.tldr: 提出频率引导的深度可分离注意力框架FG-DSA：用2D FFT高通滤波显式注入频域先验到空间注意力中，以线性复杂度恢复细节边界，兼顾分割与扩散生成。
AI.motivation: 资源受限场景下的密集预测与生成建模受反复下采样影响，空间细节与边界显著退化；现有注意力机制虽缓解语义歧义，但难以保留高频特征，或需付出极高计算代价。
AI.method: FG-DSA框架：引入2D FFT高通滤波模块提取高频信息，将频域先验显式注入空间注意力，并结合深度可分离卷积实现轻量化注意力，计算复杂度为线性；该模块可嵌入分割网络及扩散生成U-Net中。
AI.result: 语义分割任务上取得一致的性能提升，能有效恢复精细物体边界；作为模块嵌入扩散U-Net后，生成图像细节显著改善，而额外参数量与FLOPs开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 频域先验与深度可分离注意力的结合是低成本保留高频细节的有效途径，具备在密集预测与生成任务间通用的模块化价值。

title: Scaling Optimization-Oriented Hypernetworks for Implicit Neural Representations
summary: We present a hypernetwork that generates the parameters of an implicit neural representation (INR) for a given signal in a single forward pass, without test-time optimization. Existing hypernetworks for this problem either ignore the chain-rule structure of the test-time optimization that produces an INR or, when they preserve it, instantiate the structure with MLPs whose parameter count grows quartically in target-network width. Our central contribution is to show that this parameter-count cost is structural to the MLP instantiation, not to the optimization-oriented principle of preserving chain-rule structure, and to resolve it by replacing the MLP body with attention. The resulting hypernetwork combines three design choices: an output-neuron-centric tokenization that aligns the token axis with each layer's output-neuron axis; an information-flow consistency rule that fixes the role of every cross-attention module from the representation its output should occupy; and a token-space iterative rollout that realizes the five quantities one optimization step on the target INR computes as five cross-attention modules with parameter count independent of target-network width. Across five 2D and 3D INR generation benchmarks, our method outperforms the state-of-the-art single-pass and optimization-oriented baselines; scales to target-network widths at which the MLP-based optimization-oriented paradigm exhausts GPU memory; and produces the highest result on NeRF generation without ground-truth INR weights supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出以注意力替代MLP体的超网络，单次前向生成INR参数，参数量与目标网络宽度无关。
AI.motivation: 现有面向INR的超网络要么忽视测试时优化所依赖的链式法则结构，要么在保留该结构时用MLP实现，导致参数量随目标网络宽度呈四次方增长。
AI.method: 论证该参数代价源于MLP实例化而非保留链式法则的原则本身；用注意力替换MLP体，并采用三项设计：以输出神经元为中心的分词、固定各交叉注意力模块角色的信息流一致性规则、以及在token空间中迭代展开，将一次优化步的五个量实现为五个交叉注意力模块。
AI.result: 在五个2D/3D INR生成基准上优于单次前向与优化导向的SOTA基线；可扩展至MLP范式耗尽GPU显存的目标网络宽度；在无真值INR权重监督的NeRF生成中取得最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 参数量四次方增长是MLP实例化的结构性缺陷，注意力化实例化可在保持链式法则结构的同时消除该代价，并带来精度与可扩展性优势。

title: GMD-Mamba: Lightweight 3D Medical Image Segmentation Using a Grouped Multi-Directional Mamba
comment: It is a four pages paper with 2 figures and submitted to ISBI2027
summary: Mamba has the capability to capture global context in linear time for 3D medical image segmentation. However, existing methods employ Mamba with full-width directional scans at every resolution, keeping the model large (64-138M parameters and high FLOPs). We propose Grouped Multi-Directional (GMD) Mamba, a lightweight network based on the GMD scan that divides input channels $C$ into groups $G$ and flattens each group in different directions in one pass. This gives multi-directional context at $O(C^2/G)$ instead of $O(K \cdot C^2)$, where $K$ is the number of scan directions. Additionally, we employ Mamba only at the deepest encoder stages, resulting in 19.2M parameters. On BraTS2023, it achieves the best average Dice of 92.0% and the lowest HD95 of 2.7 at $\sim$1/7 the parameters of SegMamba-V2. For model validation, we also ran experiments on the MSD Spleen dataset, achieving competitive performance. The implementation details and code are publicly available at https://github.com/2802990u/GMD-Mamba.

AI.tldr: 提出分组多方向（GMD）Mamba，将通道分组并各向不同方向展平，实现 O(C²/G) 的多方向上下文建模，仅在编码器最深阶段使用Mamba，模型仅19.2M参数。
AI.motivation: 现有3D医学图像分割方法在每个分辨率都使用全宽多方向Mamba扫描，导致模型参数多（64–138M）且FLOPs高，亟需轻量化。
AI.method: GMD扫描：将输入C个通道分为G组，每组沿不同方向展平，一次扫描即获得多方向上下文，复杂度由O(K·C²)降为O(C²/G)；并将Mamba仅部署于编码器最深阶段。
AI.result: 模型仅19.2M参数；在BraTS2023上平均Dice达92.0%、HD95最低为2.7，参数量约为SegMamba-V2的1/7；在MSD Spleen数据集上取得有竞争力表现。
AI.conclusion: GMD扫描以分组方式高效获得多方向上下文，配合深层稀疏部署可显著降低参数量与计算量，同时保持或提升分割精度，代码已开源。

title: CompositionEvidence: Controlling Geometric Evidence for Cinematic Composition Reasoning with Frozen Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at the 33rd International Conference on MultiMedia Modeling (MMM 2027)
summary: Cinematic composition questions depend on in-frame geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) use inconsistently. External perception tools can expose this geometry, but naive prompt injection can overwrite useful visual predictions. On ShotBench composition, pre-question geometry reduces Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 49.5% to 46.3%; corrupted measurements lower it to 33.6%. CompositionEvidence derives nine reproducible features from frozen detection, depth, and line experts and supplies their shared 24-dimensional representation through two interfaces. A training-free channel appends gated neutral evidence after the question, reaching 56.2% (+6.7, exact McNemar p=0.0018) and 48.4% under corrupted evidence. A minimal-training channel maps the same representation to four soft tokens with a 7.37M-parameter projector while leaving the VLM frozen; it reaches 61.0% (+11.5). Across nine VLMs, including five commercial models queried through official provider APIs, zero-shot accuracy ranges from 43.8% to 63.0%, and the text channel changes it by +6.7 to -6.9 points; the highest baseline is among the regressions. The effect of explicit geometry depends on measurement reliability and on how the receiving model integrates it.

AI.tldr: 提出CompositionEvidence：用冻结的检测/深度/线检测专家提取9个可复现几何特征并编码为24维共享表示，经"免训练文本通道"(门控中性证据后置)与"最小训练软token通道"(7.37M投影器)两种接口注入VLM；在ShotBench构图任务上将Qwen2.5-VL-7B从49.5%提升至56.2%/61.0%，并揭示显式几何的增益取决于测量可靠性与模型整合方式。
AI.motivation: 电影构图问题依赖帧内几何关系，而VLM对该几何信息的利用不稳定；外部感知工具虽可显式提供几何，但朴素提示注入会覆盖模型原本有效的视觉预测（如从49.5%降至46.3%，证据被污染时更降至33.6%），因此需要一种不破坏原有视觉能力、且对噪声鲁棒的几何证据注入机制。
AI.method: 1) 基于冻结的检测、深度、线段三类专家提取9个可复现构图特征，并构造统一的24维共享表示；2) 通道A（免训练）：在问题之后追加带门控的中性证据文本，避免覆盖原视觉预测；3) 通道B（最小训练）：用7.37M参数投影器将同一表示映射为4个软token，VLM主干保持冻结；4) 在ShotBench及九个VLM（含五个经官方API访问的商业模型）上评估，并进行McNemar显著性检验与噪声鲁棒性分析。
AI.result: ShotBench上，免训练通道达56.2%（+6.7，精确McNemar p=0.0018），证据污染下仍达48.4%；最小训练通道达61.0%（+11.5）。九个VLM零样本准确率区间为43.8%–63.0%，文本通道带来+6.7至−6.9点的变化，且基线最高的模型出现在性能退化组中。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何证据的效用并非普遍正向，而取决于两点：测量可靠性（证据质量与污染程度）与接收模型对证据的整合方式（接口设计与模型自身能力）。提示注入式证据可能损害强基线模型，需按模型特性选择注入通道。

title: VLM as an Editing Pilot: VLM-Steered Velocity Control for Flow-Based Image Editing
summary: Text-guided image editing requires realizing the requested semantic change while preserving content unrelated to the instruction. FlowEdit provides an efficient inversion-free solution, but its source-anchored coupling can become overly restrictive, causing zero-edit, where the output remains close to the source and the requested change fails to emerge. We find that source coupling directly governs the preservation--editing trade-off, while a fixed coupling schedule cannot adapt to timestep-specific editing needs. Motivated by this observation, we propose V2C-Edit, a training-free VLM-steered velocity control framework. V2C-Edit constructs complementary coupling-controlled velocities and dynamically selects among them using Instruction-Level Similarity (ILS), which evaluates whether the predicted transformation follows the editing instruction. Adaptive spatial masking further preserves regions unrelated to the edit. Experiments on MagicBrush and PIE-Bench with FLUX and Stable Diffusion 3 show that V2C-Edit consistently improves instruction alignment over FlowEdit while maintaining competitive structural preservation, and that ILS better reflects editing effectiveness than target-caption CLIP similarity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kuanshen77/V2C-Edit.

AI.tldr: V2C-Edit是一种免训练、由VLM引导的速度控制框架，通过构建互补的耦合控制速度并用指令级相似度动态选择，缓解FlowEdit的零编辑问题，改善指令对齐。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像编辑需在实现语义修改的同时保留无关内容。FlowEdit虽高效免反演，但其源锚定耦合过于严格，易产生"零编辑"（输出过于接近源图、修改未发生）。作者发现源耦合直接决定"保留—编辑"权衡，而固定耦合调度无法适应不同时间步的编辑需求。
AI.method: 提出免训练的VLM引导速度控制框架V2C-Edit：构建多种互补的耦合控制速度，并基于指令级相似度（ILS）动态选择，ILS用于评判预测变换是否遵循编辑指令；同时引入自适应空间掩码以保留与编辑无关的区域。
AI.result: 在MagicBrush和PIE-Bench上，基于FLUX与Stable Diffusion 3的实验表明：V2C-Edit相较FlowEdit持续提升指令对齐，并保持有竞争力的结构保留；ILS比目标描述CLIP相似度更能反映编辑有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以VLM评判的指令级相似度动态调控源耦合强度，可有效解决零编辑问题并自适应不同时间步的编辑需求；ILS是更可靠的编辑评估指标。

title: VAComp: View-Aware Full Projector Compensation
summary: Full projector compensation adjusts a projector's input image to compensate for both geometric and photometric distortions introduced by the projection surface. Existing methods generally treat the viewing condition as a static camera viewpoint. When applied to a moving viewer, existing methods face two key challenges: (1) view-dependent methods require model retraining or recalibration to compensate for novel viewpoints; and (2) NeRF/GS-based view-agnostic methods use structure from motion (SfM) to calibrate the projector-camera systems (ProCams) with an unknown global scale, while view-aware tracking requires calibrating a camera oriented opposite to the projector, which introduces an additional calibration challenge. To address these challenges, we introduce VAComp, the first view-aware framework for full projector compensation for a moving viewer in a naked-eye setting. Using a projector, VAComp enables the viewer to perceive a virtual object that visually replaces the real object or to observe view-consistent modifications of the real object's appearance and material properties. To resolve the SfM scale ambiguity, we use metric calibration as a reference to recover the global scale; to calibrate the oppositely facing camera, we use two checkerboards, one facing the RGB camera and the other facing the depth camera. To balance compensation quality and runtime efficiency, we develop two non-iterative hybrid methods, VAComp-SD and VAComp-SI. Both combine 2D Gaussian-based view-conditioned geometric correction with learned photometric compensation, predicting each compensation image through a single forward pass without per-frame iterative optimization. Real-world experiments show that both methods achieve competitive compensation quality, with VAComp-SD enabling real-time updates and VAComp-SI operating at interactive rates. Project page: https://realkaizhou.github.io/VAComp/.

AI.tldr: VAComp 是首个面向移动观察者的视角感知全投影仪补偿框架，通过度量标定消除 SfM 尺度歧义、双棋盘标定反向相机，并提�� VAComp-SD/SI 两种非迭代混合方法，实现实时/交互级补偿。
AI.motivation: 现有全投影仪补偿方法将观察条件视为静态相机视角。面向移动观察者时面临两大挑战：(1) 视角相关方法需对新视角重新训练或重标定；(2) NeRF/GS 等视角无关方法依赖 SfM 标定 ProCams，存在未知全局尺度；而视角感知跟踪需标定与投影仪朝向相反的相机，带来额外标定难题。
AI.method: 提出 VAComp 框架：以度量标定作为参考恢复全局尺度以解决 SfM 尺度歧义；使用两块棋盘格（分别面向 RGB 相机与深度相机）标定朝向相反的相机。提出两种非迭代混合方法 VAComp-SD 与 VAComp-SI，将基于 2D 高斯的视角条件几何校正与学习式光度补偿结合，单次前向传播预测补偿图像，无需逐帧迭代优化。
AI.result: 真实场景实验表明两种方法均取得有竞争力的补偿质量；VAComp-SD 支持实时更新，VAComp-SI 达到交互级帧率。系统可用于裸眼场景下使观察者感知虚拟物体替换真实物体，或观察视角一致的材质与外观修改。
AI.conclusion: VAComp 将全投影仪补偿从静态视角推广至移动观察者，通过尺度恢复与反向相机标定解决标定瓶颈，并以非迭代混合设计兼顾补偿质量与运行效率，为裸眼增强现实显示提供了可行方案。

title: Adapting Frozen Promptable Segmenters to User-Defined Taxonomies via Few-Shot Proposal Learning
summary: Promptable segmenters of the SAM family turn a click or a phrase into an instance mask, so the costly part of a label is now its class. However, each annotation project draws its own class boundary, often through objects these models already know: people from cars, sedans from trucks, one sedan model from another. A generic model's boundary is fixed by its training vocabulary. We present SNAP, an annotation pipeline that learns the project's boundary from the labels the annotator draws anyway. On one frozen SAM2.1 pass per image, we fit a per-project head, SnapHead, that classifies every proposal and refits in seconds after each labeled image. Where SAM 3 is available, the same labels decide class by class whether to keep its boundary or ours. Given the true masks of eight look-alike cell lines, SAM 3 assigns classes at Cohen's kappa = 0.038 and SnapHead at 0.754 (60 labeled images), and when only the class names change, SAM 3 falls to chance and SnapHead's score is unchanged. End to end, with 20 labeled images, SNAP beats a SAM 3 oracle tuned on the evaluation labels on five microscopy projects (0.484 against 0.441 F1), and run unchanged on five held-out datasets, it beats SAM 3 as shipped on four. Our results suggest that frozen foundation features already encode the class boundaries a generic vocabulary misses, and that a project's own labels are enough to read them out.

AI.tldr: 提出 SNAP 标注流水线：在冻结的 SAM2.1 特征上训练轻量项目级分类头 SnapHead，从标注者本就绘制的标签中学习项目专属类别边界，避免依赖通用模型固定的语义词表。
AI.motivation: SAM 系列可提示分割器把点击或短语转成实例掩码，标注的昂贵部分已从"分割"转移到"类别"。但每个标注项目的类别边界是自定义的（人/车、轿车/卡车、不同轿车型号），且往往借助模型已知物体来界定；通用模型的边界由训练词表固定，无法适配项目语义。因此需要让边界从项目自身标签中学得。
AI.method: 1）每张图像仅做一次冻结的 SAM2.1 前向，得到候选掩码提案；2）在提案特征上拟合项目级分类头 SnapHead，对每个提案分类，且每标注一张图像后可在数秒内重拟合；3）当可用 SAM 3 时，利用同一批标签逐类决定是保留 SAM 3 的边界还是采用 SnapHead 的边界。
AI.result: 在八种形态相似的细胞系真值掩码上：SAM 3 分类 Cohen's kappa = 0.038，SnapHead = 0.754（60 张标注图像）；仅改变类别名称时 SAM 3 降至随机水平，而 SnapHead 分数不变。端到端 20 张标注图像下，SNAP 在五个显微项目上以 0.484 F1 超过在评测标签上调优的 SAM 3 oracle（0.441 F1）；原样迁移至五个留出数据集，在其中四个上优于官方 SAM 3。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明冻结的基础模型特征本身已编码了通用语义词表所缺失的类别边界，项目自身的少量标签足以将其读出；类别语义可解耦于名称，从而支持低成本、项目自适应的标注。

title: EarthJev: Efficient Visual Evidence Acquisition and Decision for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires locating fine-grained evidence in large scenes under limited visual input budgets. Active observation addresses this challenge through selective exploration, but repeated generative judgments can make region search costly. Its decisions also concern distinct prediction targets: spatial pointer validity, evidence presence, and reasoning correctness. We propose EarthJev, a framework that separates region scoring from answer generation and uses target-specific decision signals while keeping the answering model frozen. A spatial pointer verifier uses visual and geometric cues to guide exploration or bypass search. An evidence-aware decision mechanism scores compact candidate views in batches using a lightweight head on frozen representations, without generating textual region judgments. Format-specific confidence calibration then guides selection between candidate answers generated from memory and overview presentations of the acquired evidence. Across five benchmarks, EarthJev achieves a mean accuracy of 53.06% with Qwen3.5-9B, outperforming ZoomSearch with the same answering model by 2.33 to 14.73 percentage points per benchmark while reducing mean latency from 11.30 - 1.67 seconds per question. With four additional frozen answering models, model-specific fitting of the decision modules and calibration mappings yields mean accuracy gains of 3.41 - 6.53 percentage points over the corresponding single-pass baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Da1daidaidai/EarthJev

AI.tldr: 提出EarthJev框架，将区域打分与答案生成解耦，在冻结回答模型下实现UHR遥感VQA的高效主动观察。
AI.motivation: 超高分辨率遥感VQA需在有限视觉输入预算下定位细粒度证据；主动观察虽可行，但重复生成式判断使区域搜索代价高昂，且其决策涉及空间指针有效性、证据存在性与推理正确性等不同目标，需分别处理。
AI.method: 三点设计：(1) 空间指针验证器利用视觉与几何线索决定探索或跳过搜索；(2) 证据感知决策机制用冻结表示上的轻量头批量打分紧凑候选视图，避免生成文本式区域判断；(3) 格式特定置信度校准，用于在基于记忆与基于概览呈现的证据所生成的候选答案间做选择；回答模型全程冻结。
AI.result: 五个基准上，Qwen3.5-9B平均准确率53.06%，较同回答模型的ZoomSearch在各基准提升2.33–14.73个百分点，平均延迟由11.30秒降至1.67秒；另在四个冻结回答模型上，模块与校准映射的模型特定拟合带来3.41–6.53个百分点平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 将区域评分从答案生成中分离、并采用目标特定决策信号，可在不微调回答模型的前提下兼顾UHR遥感VQA的精度与效率，且思路可迁移到多种回答模型。

title: MATA: Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. Joint first authors with equal contributions. Code - https://github.com/prakashchhipa/MATA-Motion-aligned-Temporal-Adapter
summary: Few-shot fine-grained video action recognition requires recognizing novel action classes from only a few labeled examples. The difficulty is that visually similar actions often share actors, scenes, poses, and objects, differing only in the order, timing, and short duration of motion changes. We study this problem under three practical constraints: few tunable parameters, low compute cost, and use of the video modality alone. We propose Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter (MATA), a parameter-efficient adapter on top of a frozen CLIP backbone. MATA specializes CLIP features along the temporal dimension using two components: temporal phase alignment through learnable temporal positional embeddings, and a local motion transition operator through depth-wise convolution. With only ~3.6M tunable parameters, MATA achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple fine-grained benchmarks while remaining robust to both visual corruptions and temporal disruptions induced by frame dropping. Code is available at https://github.com/prakashchhipa/MATA-Motion-aligned-Temporal-Adapter

AI.tldr: 提出MATA（Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter），在冻结CLIP主干上以约3.6M可调参数实现少样本细粒度视频动作识别，通过时间相位对齐与局部运动转移算子专门化时序特征，在多基准上达SOTA并具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 少样本细粒度视频动作识别中，视觉相似的动作常共享人物、场景、姿态与物体，仅在运动变化的顺序、时序与短持续时间上存在差异，因此需要模型聚焦细微的时序运动线索；同时需满足三个实际约束：可调参数少、计算成本低、仅使用视频模态。
AI.method: 在冻结的CLIP主干之上构建参数高效适配器。MATA沿时间维度专门化CLIP特征，包含两个组件：(1) 通过可学习时间位置嵌入实现时间相位对齐；(2) 通过深度可分离卷积构建局部运动转移算子。
AI.result: 仅约3.6M可调参数，在多个细粒度基准上取得SOTA性能，并对视觉损坏与帧丢弃引起的时间扰动保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 以极低参数与计算开销、单模态视频输入，即可有效挖掘细粒度时序运动差异，验证了冻结CLIP加轻量时序适配器范式的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Optimized Car Damage Detection Using CNN and Object Detection Model
summary: Car damage detection systems play a vital role in scenarios, like the insurance claims process, accident reporting systems, or a documented write-up of the various damages a vehicle in a car garage exhibits upon entry and exit. This paper presents a two-fold model architecture encompassing a convolutional neural network used to classify the collected input samples as clear or damaged, thereby filtering out the undamaged images, before the input is passed on to the object detection layer for further localization and classification of defects into Scratch, Dent, Glass Shatter, and Smash. A deviation from the focus of related work, this paper poses the use of unified models while applying transfer learning techniques to augment performance that caters to multiple use cases. The design of this model has been made to optimize performance by incorporating the two models to streamline the processing of input samples. The model boasts significant performance with accuracies of 98% for the CNN layer and 0.5 mAP for the object detection layer. However, the metric for the object detection layer seems to understate its performance due to reasons discussed within the paper.

AI.tldr: 提出两级串联的汽车损伤检测架构：先用CNN将输入图像二分类为"完好/受损"以过滤无损图像，再交由目标检测层定位并识别划痕、凹陷、玻璃碎裂、撞毁四类缺陷；采用迁移学习与统一模型以适配多场景，CNN准确率98%，检测层mAP为0.5。
AI.motivation: 汽车损伤检测在保险理赔、事故上报、车辆进出场登记等场景至关重要。既有工作多聚焦单一任务，本文希望用统一模型配合迁移学习覆盖多种用例，并通过两级结构简化输入处理、提升整体效率。
AI.method: 两阶段模型架构：第一阶段为CNN分类器，将采集样本判定为clear或damaged，滤除无损图像；第二阶段为object detection层，对通过筛选的图像进行缺陷定位与分类（Scratch、Dent、Glass Shatter、Smash）。全程采用迁移学习增强性能，并以统一模型设计适配多场景用例。
AI.result: CNN分类层准确率达98%；目标检测层mAP为0.5，作者指出该指标因文中讨论的原因而低估了检测层的实际性能。
AI.conclusion: 两级串联架构可通过前置过滤降低检测层负担、提升处理效率，统一模型加迁移学习在小样本、多场景条件下具备可行性；检测层评估指标存在偏差，需结合具体原因进一步解读，未来应改进评价方式。

title: Clinically Informed Colour Encoding Improves the Localisation and Stability of Explanations in Deep Learning ECG Models: External Validation in a UK Biobank Epilepsy Cohort
summary: Objective: It is not known whether the input representation governs the quality of explanations of deep learning models for electrocardiogram analysis. Risk of dangerous ventricular repolarisation is judged from the QT-interval and the shape of the T-wave, features that are hard to assess visually and harder still to verify in a model's reasoning. We evaluate a pseudo-colour encoding filling the area beneath the QT interval, its colour sequence designed from clinical electrophysiology knowledge and mapped to a validated risk prediction model, the QT-nomogram. Methods: Two identically configured residual networks were trained on single-heartbeat images from a clinical trial, differing only in whether pseudo-colour encoding was applied, so that any difference is attributable to the chromatic channel alone. To externally validate the effect, both models were applied without fine-tuning or threshold tuning to a previously unseen epilepsy cohort from the UK-Biobank at two visits, and eight explanation methods compared on faithfulness, localisation and stability. Results: The pseudo-colour model achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.903 and 0.914 at the first and follow-up visits, against 0.719 and 0.720 for the monochrome model, recovering three to five times as many at-risk heartbeats at comparable specificity. Pseudo-colour encoding improved explanation localisation and stability for almost every method, and the improvement reproduced across both visits. Conclusion: The input representation is a controllable and previously overlooked determinant of both predictive performance and explanation quality. Significance: Treating interpretability as a representation-design problem offers a route towards explanations clinicians can check against known electrophysiology.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明输入表征（伪彩色编码）是深度学习心电图模型预测性能与解释质量的共同决定因素。
AI.motivation: 在深度心电图分析中，尚不清楚输入表征是否影响模型解释的质量。QT间期与T波形态的复极风险难以视觉评估，更难在模型推理中验证，因此需要使解释可与已知电生理知识对照。
AI.method: 构建填充QT间期下方区域的伪彩色编码，其颜色序列依据临床电生理知识设计并映射到已验证的QT-nomogram风险模型；训练两个配置完全相同的残差网络，唯一差异为是否施加伪彩色编码；在UK-Biobank未见过癫痫队列的两个访视上无微调、无阈值调整地外部验证，并用八种解释方法比较忠实性、定位性与稳定性。
AI.result: 伪彩色模型在首次与随访访视的ROC-AUC分别为0.903与0.914，单色模型为0.719与0.720；在相当特异度下检出三至五倍的高危心搏；伪彩色编码在几乎所有解释方法上改善了定位性与稳定性，且该改进在两个访视中均可复现。
AI.conclusion: 输入表征是被以往忽视、但可主动控制且同时影响预测性能与解释质量的因素；将可解释性视为表征设计问题，可为临床医生提供可对照已知电生理学进行核验的解释路径。

title: Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning for Handwritten Letter Recognition: A Controlled Study on EMNIST Letters
summary:
Handwritten character recognition systems can achieve high accuracy while retaining concentrated errors among visually similar classes. Motivated by residual letter confusions in earlier geometry-based recognition work, we investigate whether these errors can be addressed through the training objective. We introduce Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning (CAML), which constructs a sparse weighted confusion graph from a discovery partition held out from pilot training and applies pair-specific cosine-separation constraints during final training. CAML adds no classifier, routing rule, or inference-time parameters.
  We evaluate CAML on EMNIST Letters against a strictly matched cross-entropy CNN baseline, using the same architecture, final training data, deterministic augmentation, optimizer, and checkpoint selection. Eight confusion pairs are targeted: I/L, G/Q, U/V, R/V, D/O, C/E, I/J, and H/N. On the official clean test set, accuracy changes from 95.6346% to 95.6731%, and macro-F1 from 0.956326 to 0.956724. Mean accuracy across ten predefined corrupted conditions increases from approximately 95.3812% to 95.4303%; symmetric errors within targeted pairs decrease from 614 to 605 (1.47%).
  The global differences are small and not statistically reliable. CAML fixes 124 baseline errors but introduces 116 new errors on clean data (exact McNemar p=0.6515), and no corruption-specific difference remains significant after Holm correction. Thus, CAML does not establish global superiority, but shows that a leakage-controlled, pair-specific margin objective can alter targeted error structure with limited overall benefit for an already strong classifier.

AI.tldr: 提出混淆自适应间隔学习（CAML），用留出分区构建稀疏加权混淆图并在训练中施加类别对特定的余弦分离约束；在EMNIST Letters上与严格匹配的交叉熵CNN基线相比，整体精度提升微小且不显著，但目标混淆对的对称错误数略有下降。
AI.motivation: 手写字符识别系统对视觉相似类别存在集中且残留的混淆错误（源于早期基于几何的识别工作），作者希望探究能否通过训练目标本身（而非新增分类器或后处理规则）来针对性地缓解这些成对的视觉相似混淆。
AI.method: CAML：先从试点训练中留出一个发现分区（discovery partition）以保证无泄漏地识别混淆对，据此构建稀疏加权混淆图，再在最终训练阶段对特定类别对施加成对余弦分离约束。方法不引入额外分类器、路由规则或推理期参数。实验在EMNIST Letters上进行，与严格匹配的交叉熵CNN基线对比（相同架构、最终训练数据、确定性增强、优化器与检查点选择），针对I/L、G/Q、U/V、R/V、D/O、C/E、I/J、H/N共8个混淆对，并评估10种预定义损坏条件。
AI.result: 干净官方测试集精度由95.6346%→95.6731%，macro-F1由0.956326→0.956724；10种损坏条件下平均精度约95.3812%→95.4303%；目标对内的对称错误由614降至605（1.47%）。但全局差异很小且不具统计可靠性：干净数据上CAML修正124个基线错误而引入116个新错误（精确McNemar p=0.6515），经Holm校正后无损坏条件差异显著。
AI.conclusion: CAML未能确立全局优越性，但表明在无泄漏控制的条件下，成对特定的间隔目标可以改变目标错误结构，而对本已很强的分类器整体收益有限。

title: WordEval: Evaluating Word-Native Operation Fidelity in Document Editing
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). Project page with code and data at https://aka.ms/word-eval
summary: Microsoft Word is a central environment for office automation, and the faithful execution of its editing operations is an important capability for document agents. Unlike plain-text editing, editing in Word modifies a structured object model, where the requested effect is realized in object properties. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate office workflows or desktop automation, treating word-processor documents as one task domain among many and verifying outcomes with keyword matching, per-task property checks, or screenshot comparison. We introduce WordEval, an operation-fidelity benchmark that instead centers evaluation on Word editing operations, testing whether each requested edit is realized as intended changes to Word objects and properties. It contains 642 cases across 15 Word feature areas, ranging from text and lists to charts, shape geometry, and SmartArt. 546 atomic cases cover 231 commands, 96 compositional cases combine multiple edits in a single document, and a Word-native oracle checks task-specific object properties and preservation conditions. Cases are constructed from editing-unit specifications, yielding controlled input documents, reference documents, and aligned oracle checks. Each compositional case is linked to corresponding atomic cases, supporting fine-grained diagnosis of editing failures. We evaluate eight agent systems and find that many struggle on the Atomic track, with performance varying across feature areas. Moreover, every system scores lower on Compositional than on Atomic, with gaps that vary substantially by system. Exact atomic-intent links and recorded failure diagnoses provide complementary views of this variation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WordEval，一个面向 Word 编辑操作保真度的基准，包含 642 个案例（原子/组合两类），用 Word 原生 oracle 校验对象属性是否按要求变更，并据此评估了 8 个智能体系统。
AI.motivation: 现有办公类基准把 Word 文档当作众多任务域之一，侧重工作流或桌面自动化，并用关键词匹配、逐任务属性检查或截图对比来验证结果，无法判断"请求的编辑是否真正落实为 Word 结构化对象模型的属性变更"。
AI.method: 构建 WordEval：以编辑操作本身为评估中心，覆盖 15 个 Word 功能领域、642 个案例；其中 546 个原子案例覆盖 231 条命令，96 个组合案例在同一文档中叠加多次编辑；由"编辑单元规格"生成受控输入文档、参考文档与对齐的 oracle 检查，oracle 为 Word 原生，校验任务特定对象属性及保持性条件；组合案例与对应原子案例显式关联以支持细粒度诊断。
AI.result: 评估 8 个智能体系统：多个系统在原子轨道上表现不佳，且各功能领域间差异明显；所有系统在组合轨道上的得分均低于原子轨道，且系统间差距幅度差异很大；原子意图链接与记录的失败诊断提供了互补视角。
AI.conclusion: 现有文档智能体在 Word 对象级编辑上仍存在显著能力缺口，尤其在多操作组合场景下；将评估锚定到操作—对象属性层面并结合原子/组合关联结构，可提供更可靠且可诊断的评测信号。

title: ESTRA: Enabling Extreme Attention Sparsity for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but attention over long spatiotemporal sequences makes inference computationally expensive. Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only a subset of query-key interactions exactly, and recent training-free methods further approximate the remaining interactions. These methods, however, degrade quickly at high sparsity, which limits the achievable speedup. We present ESTRA (Extreme Sparsity Through Refined Attention), a training-free acceleration method that preserves generation quality even at extreme sparsity. ESTRA concentrates exact attention computation on a small set of important key-value tokens and approximates the remaining contributions with cluster representatives. To identify these tokens efficiently, it groups similar queries and uses their representatives to score individual keys. A variance-based correction further refines the attention weights of the cluster representatives, improving the accuracy of the approximation. Experiments on Wan2.1-14B and HunyuanVideo-13B show that ESTRA establishes a new quality-efficiency frontier for training-free sparse attention, achieving $3.26\times$ and $4.71\times$ end-to-end speedups at 5% attention density while surpassing Sol-Attn and SVG-EAR in fidelity to dense generation and on most VBench dimensions. Even at 1% density, ESTRA remains more faithful to dense generation than Sol-Attn at 12.5%, while reaching up to $5.39\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: ESTRA：一种无需训练的极端稀疏注意力加速方法，通过聚类代表与方差修正保持视频扩散Transformer在5%乃至1%注意力密度下的生成质量，实现3.26×–5.39×端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer在长时空序列上的注意力计算导致推理代价高昂；现有稀疏注意力及无训练近似方法在高稀疏度下质量迅速退化，限制了可获得的加速比。作者希望在高稀疏条件下仍保持生成保真度。
AI.method: ESTRA将精确注意力计算集中在少量重要key-value token上，其余贡献用簇代表近似；为高效识别重要token，先对相似query聚类，用簇代表对单个key打分；并引入基于方差的修正项细化簇代表的注意力权重以提升近似精度。方法完全无需训练。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-14B与HunyuanVideo-13B上，5%注意力密度下实现3.26×和4.71×端到端加速，且在保真度与多数VBench维度上超过Sol-Attn与SVG-EAR；1%密度下仍在保真度上优于12.5%密度的Sol-Attn，加速最高达5.39×。
AI.conclusion: ESTRA在无需训练的前提下建立了稀疏注意力的新质量-效率前沿，证明通过聚类打分与方差修正可在极端稀疏下维持视频生成质量，显著优于现有无训练稀疏注意力方法。

title: Frequency-Structure Complementary Modeling for Hyperspectral Image Fusion
summary: Existing methods mainly rely on convolutional aggregation or attention-based spatial-spectral interaction. However, conventional feature-domain attention does not explicitly characterize variation patterns along spatial-token and learned latent-channel coordinates, while spatially shared local operators lack the flexibility to adapt neighborhood aggregation to heterogeneous structures. To address these limitations, we propose a Frequency-Structure Complementary Modeling Network (FSCM-Net), which couples frequency-aware dependency learning with structure-adaptive local refinement. Specifically, a Spatial-Spectral Frequency Calibration Attention (SSFCA) module constructs spatial-token affinities from Fourier-interacted query-key representations and builds latent-channel affinities after input-conditioned frequency filtering along learned channel coordinates. The latent-channel response is then calibrated by a learned shared gain and combined with the spatial-token response. Complementarily, a Structure-Coherent Dynamic Feature Fusion (SC-DFF) module combines regularized structure-tensor cues from MSI features with context-modulated HSI detail representations to generate channel- and position-dependent aggregation kernels. This design makes local HSI refinement responsive to smooth regions, edges, and textures while maintaining spectral fidelity. The two modules are progressively integrated within a multiscale encoder-decoder to coordinate representation-level interaction and structure-adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on two simulated benchmarks and one real remote-sensing dataset demonstrate favorable performance against representative fusion methods in spatial detail reconstruction and spectral preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出频率-结构互补建模网络FSCM-Net，将频率感知依赖学习与结构自适应局部精炼耦合，用于高光谱与多光谱图像融合。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖卷积聚合或注意力空间-光谱交互，但常规特征域注意力未显式刻画沿空间token坐标与学习到的潜通道坐标的变化模式，空间共享的局部算子也缺乏对异质结构自适应调整邻域聚合的灵活性。
AI.method: 1) 空间-光谱频率校准注意力（SSFCA）：由傅里叶交互的query-key表示构造空间token亲和度，并在学习到的通道坐标上经输入条件化频率滤波后构建潜通道亲和度，潜通道响应经学习共享增益校准后与空间token响应融合；2) 结构一致动态特征融合（SC-DFF）：融合MSI特征的正则化结构张量线索与上下文调制的高光谱细节表示，生成通道与位置相关的聚合核；3) 两模块在多层编码-解码器中渐进集成。
AI.result: 在两个模拟基准与一个真实遥感数据集上，相较代表性融合方法在空间细节重建与光谱保真方面取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 频率感知的全局依赖建模与结构自适应的局部精炼具有互补性，结合多尺度编解码框架可有效兼顾空间细节恢复与光谱保真。

title: PhysDNet: Physics-Driven Gradient Amplification for Real-Time Image Dehazing
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Code, deployment scripts and pre-trained checkpoints: https://github.com/Heatdh/PhysDnet
summary: Modern dehazing networks are often computationally expensive and overfit to synthetic haze, limiting real-time deployment. This underscores an urgent demand for efficient, high-fidelity restoration methods that can operate on resource-constrained edge devices in practical, dynamic environments. We introduce PhysDNet, a lightweight multimodal architecture that fuses NIR imagery with sparse LiDAR depth and is trained with a physics-constrained dual-head objective. Differentiating through a fixed Koschmieder inversion induces density-adaptive gradient amplification, acting as an implicit resource allocation mechanism that concentrates learning on heavily degraded regions without increasing inference cost. PhysDNet delivers superior restoration with minimal capacity and enhanced training efficiency, facilitating real-time deployment on edge devices without increasing inference overhead. On the Seeing Through Fog benchmark, PhysDNet outperforms competitors by 1.67 dB at 5.2 times lower compute while recovering 54.9% of fog-induced detection loss. Ablations and cross-domain evaluations show that physics-guided training improves generalization, including under non-homogeneous haze that violates the Koschmieder assumption. PhysDNet further demonstrates compatibility with fixed-function NPUs, running at 29/45/99 FPS at <4 W across L/M/S variants. Code, deployment scripts and pre-trained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Heatdh/PhysDnet.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量多模态去雾网络PhysDNet，融合NIR与稀疏LiDAR深度，并用物理约束双头目标训练，在Seeing Through Fog基准上以5.2倍更低算力获得1.67 dB增益，可实时部署于边缘设备。
AI.motivation: 现有去雾网络计算开销大且易过拟合合成雾，难以在资源受限边缘设备上实时部署，亟需高效高保真、适应动态真实环境的复原方法。
AI.method: 轻量多模态架构，融合近红外图像与稀疏LiDAR深度；采用物理约束的双头训练目标，通过对固定Koschmieder逆变换求导，产生密度自适应梯度放大，作为隐式资源分配机制，将学习集中于重度退化区域，且不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在Seeing Through Fog基准上以5.2倍更低计算量领先1.67 dB，并恢复54.9%的雾致检测损失；消融与跨域实验显示物理引导训练提升泛化性（包括违反Koschmieder假设的非均匀雾）；兼容固定功能NPU，L/M/S变体在<4 W下分别达29/45/99 FPS。
AI.conclusion: PhysDNet以极小容量实现优越复原效果与更高训练效率，支持边缘实时部署；物理引导训练可改善泛化性，并为硬件部署提供实用方案（代码与权重开源）。

title: Uncertainty, Not Concealment: A Mechanistic Reappraisal of Sycophancy in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Med-Reasoner Workshop
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) in medical retrieval-augmented generation must be able to say when a retrieved report contradicts the X-ray, so understanding whether they can detect such conflicts is important for safe deployment. The sycophancy mask hypothesis holds that these models internally detect conflicts but refuse to report them, concealing a detected contradiction. We introduce a three-part diagnostic that separates concealment from uncertainty: representation probing, activation steering, and two-way forced choice.
