Across four instruction-tuned VLMs on chest X-rays, we confirm behavioral suppression of contradiction and find that a linear probe separates matched from mismatched inputs, beyond what a simple CLIP model achieves. Steering the learned conflict direction never elicits contradiction, and forcing a binary choice does not recover one; instead, cross-modal attention to the image drops on mismatched pairs. We conclude that these models fail to contradict because the mismatch registers as hedged, gated uncertainty rather than concealed knowledge, calling for re-grounding and uncertainty surfacing. Code is available at https://github.com/mohamed-eldagla/Uncertainty-Not-Concealment/.

AI.tldr: 论文检验"谄媚式掩盖假说"是否成立：医疗VLM内部是否已检测到检索报告与X光片的冲突却拒不报告。通过表征探针、激活引导与二选一强制选择三项诊断，发现冲突以"被门控的模糊不确定性"形式登记，而非被掩盖的知识。
AI.motivation: 医疗检索增强生成中的VLM需在检索报告与影像矛盾时明确指认冲突，这是安全部署的前提。若模型内部已检测到冲突却选择不报告（谄媚式掩盖），则只需改变输出策略即可修复；若模型实际只是"不确定"，则需从接地与不确定性表达层面重新设计。因此区分"掩盖"与"不确定"对干预方向至关重要。
AI.method: 构建三部分诊断框架：（1）表征探针，用线性探针区分匹配/不匹配输入，并与CLIP基线比较；（2）激活引导，沿学到的"冲突方向"干预激活，检验能否诱发出矛盾判断；（3）二选一强制选择，消除回避选项以测试行为层面的恢复能力。实验覆盖四个指令微调的VLM与胸部X光数据，并辅以跨模态注意力分析。
AI.result: 确认存在行为层面的矛盾抑制；线性探针可区分匹配与不匹配输入，且优于简单CLIP模型。但沿冲突方向引导激活从不引发矛盾表述，强制二选一也无法恢复；不匹配样本上，模型对图像的跨模态注意力反而下降。
AI.conclusion: "谄媚式掩盖假说"不成立：模型并非内部知晓冲突而隐瞒，而是将不匹配登记为被门控、带模糊措辞的不确定性。因此改进方向不是输出策略纠偏，而是重新接地（re-grounding）与不确定性显式化（uncertainty surfacing）。

title: Domain Generalization for Style-Debiased Object Detection via Label-Consistent Training across Multiple Styles
summary: Domain generalization (DG) for object detection aims to improve model performance on unseen target domains. Existing detectors, however, suffer substantial degradation on visually distinct unseen domains, as models confined to limited training styles tend to overfit superficial statistical cues rather than object-level semantics. Motivated by human perception, which attends primarily to semantically relevant features while ignoring irrelevant style cues, we propose Origin-Anchored Multi-Style Consistency (OAMSC), a source-only framework that couples multi-style data synthesis with cross-style consistency learning to suppress style-sensitive shortcut learning. For data preparation, we leverage off-the-shelf diffusion models to expand the source datasets into 20 distinct styles, with all generated images manually verified to ensure that object instances and annotations remain consistent across style variants. During training, we impose Origin-anchored consistency constraints at scene and object levels to reinforce the learning of domain-stable features while suppressing the influence of style-sensitive cues. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on multiple challenging DG benchmarks demonstrate the consistent effectiveness and strong generalization performance of OAMSC across diverse domain shifts. Notably, our approach applies to both one-stage and two-stage detectors, while its data-centric design is complementary in principle to other DG methods. The training code and two style-transfer datasets constructed for the experiments, comprising approximately 180K images in total, are publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用源域的OAMSC框架，通过扩散模型多风格合成与原点锚定的跨风格一致性约束抑制风格捷径，提升目标检测域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有目标检测器在视觉差异大的未见域上性能显著下降，因模型局限于有限训练风格、易过拟合表层统计线索（风格）而非目标级语义。受人类感知只关注语义相关特征、忽略无关风格线索的启发，作者希望抑制风格敏感的捷径学习。
AI.method: 1) 数据端：用现成扩散模型将源数据集扩展为20种风格，生成图像人工校验以保证目标实例与标注在各风格变体间保持一致；2) 训练端：在场景级与目标级施加“原点锚定”的一致性约束（以原始风格为锚，跨风格输出对齐），强化域稳定特征、抑制风格敏感线索。属仅源域（source-only）框架。
AI.result: 在多个具有挑战性的DG基准上，大量实验与消融验证了OAMSC在不同域偏移下的一致有效性与较强泛化性能；方法适用于一阶段与两阶段检测器；其以数据为中心的设计在原理上与其他DG方法互补。公开训练代码及两个风格迁移数据集（合计约180K图像）。
AI.conclusion: 多风格合成加原点锚定的跨风格一致性学习是抑制风格捷径、提升检测器域泛化的有效且兼容性强的方案。

title: JoVox: Joint Hierarchical Flow Matching for Lightweight Voxel Generation
summary: Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. Current generators are either high-fidelity but computationally heavy, or lightweight but of lower fidelity. Hierarchical methods keep the lightweight nature of voxels. However, their coarse levels, which decide where all finer cells can appear, are generated with the least information about the shape and are never revisited, so they are often plausible but wrong. Our key insight is to let finer cells take part in deciding coarse cells. To this end, we propose JoVox, a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of the voxel hierarchy, instead of a separate distribution for each level, so that coarse cells can be predicted with finer cells already generated nearby. Within this framework, we further introduce a two-level prediction, which outputs the cells two levels finer at once instead of one level finer, halving the number of levels that the network processes and yielding voxels of higher fidelity. We also introduce an unmasking strategy that revisits early decisions once finer cells are generated and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models. Our framework outperforms the baselines on both unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. Compared with the current state-of-the-art TRELLIS.2, we achieve 8x higher training throughput, 1/15 of the FLOPs in a forward pass, train on 4 vs. 32 GPUs, and obtain higher quality with an 11% lower Chamfer distance.

AI.tldr: 提出 JoVox：基于离散流匹配的体素层次联合生成框架，让细层单元参与粗层决策，实现轻量且高保真的体素生成。
AI.motivation: 高保真体素生成与轻量化难以兼得：高保真模型算力开销大，轻量模型保真度低。层次化方法虽保持轻量，但粗层在信息最少时生成且从不被修正，常出现"看似合理却错误"的粗结构。
AI.method: 核心思路是让细层单元参与粗层单元的判定。提出 JoVox：离散流匹配框架，学习体素层次所有层级的联合分布而非逐层独立分布，使粗层单元可在邻近细层单元已生成的条件下预测；引入两级预测（two-level prediction），一次输出细两级的单元，将网络处理的层数减半；并提出 unmasking 策略，在细层生成后回溯早期决策，纠正掩码扩散模型中的不一致性。
AI.result: 在无条件与图像条件体素生成上均优于基线。相较当前最优 TRELLIS.2：训练吞吐提升 8 倍，前向 FLOPs 仅为 1/15，训练使用 4 块 GPU（对比 32 块），质量更高，Chamfer 距离降低 11%。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合建模体素层次分布并允许细层信息回溯修正粗层，JoVox 在显著降低计算成本的同时提升了生成保真度，证明"细层参与粗层决策"是兼顾轻量与高保真的有效途径。

title: Physically Guided TeX Generation for Low-Light Visual Tasks
summary: Low-light conditions reduce visible contrast and obscure details, while infrared images lack color and texture, motivating the fusion of infrared and visible information for visual tasks. Existing fusion methods primarily optimize image appearance or task-specific features without explicitly disentangling the coupled factors underlying thermal observations, limiting their physical interpretation under thermal degeneracy. Hyperspectral thermal measurements enable physical decomposition, but they require specialized imaging hardware, while pixel-level physical annotations for supervision or evaluation incur additional costs. We propose TeX-Gen, a physically guided framework for TeX generation from paired visible and infrared images in low-light visual tasks. TeX Generation constructs complementary multi-view features and employs independent branch-specific gates to route cues into the Temperature, Emissivity, and Texture maps. TeXMetric integrates radiometric reconstruction, channel structure, and material consistency to assess the generated maps without requiring pixel-level physical labels. TeX Tune improves performance through task-guided adjustments, jointly optimizing the adjustment modules and task network while keeping the generator frozen. Experiments show that TeX-Gen achieves competitive task performance in low-light environments on the FLIR, LLVIP, M3FD, and MSRS datasets. Experiments on HADAR also examine the association between TeXMetric scores and downstream detection performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Te X-Gen框架，从低光场景的可见光-红外图像对中物理引导地生成温度(T)、发射率(E)与纹理(X)三张解耦图，并配套无需像素级物理标注的TeXMetric评价指标与TeX Tune任务调优策略。
AI.motivation: 低光下可见光图像对比度低、细节丢失，红外图像缺乏颜色与纹理，故需红外-可见光融合。现有融合方法多只优化图像外观或任务特征，未显式解耦热观测背后的耦合物理因素，在"热退化"条件下物理可解释性不足。高光谱热测量虽可物理分解，但需专用硬件，且像素级物理标注用于监督或评价成本高昂。
AI.method: TeX Generation：构建互补多视图特征，用独立的分支专属门控将线索分别路由至温度、发射率、纹理三个图分支。TeXMetric：融合辐射重建、通道结构与材质一致性三项准则，无需像素级物理标签即可评价生成图。TeX Tune：冻结生成器，联合优化调整模块与任务网络，实现任务引导的性能提升。
AI.result: 在FLIR、LLVIP、M3FD、MSRS数据集上，TeX-Gen在低光环境下取得有竞争力的任务性能；在HADAR数据集上进一步考察了TeXMetric得分与下游检测性能之间的关联性。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理引导的T/E/X解耦生成、无标注物理评价指标与任务端调优，可在不依赖专用高光谱硬件与像素级物理标注的前提下提升低光视觉任务的性能与物理可解释性。

title: SHIN: Scalable Hierarchy for INcremental 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 8 pages of main text (13 pages including references and supplementary material), 7 figures
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis, but deployment budgets vary across devices and network conditions. Most compact methods target one operating point, so another budget requires a separate representation. SHIN is a scalable 3DGS hierarchy with a reusable Base and additive enhancement layers, so each higher-quality operating point extends rather than replaces the decoded representation. Constructing this hierarchy requires deciding which Gaussians each stage adds and how much spherical-harmonic (SH) appearance each retains, because these choices remain fixed in later prefixes. SHIN derives one shared Gaussian order from multi-scale position-scale sensitivity and divides each stage budget between adding Gaussians and retaining SH bands using calibrated gradient-based scores per byte. Lightweight opacity updates adjust compositing while transmitted geometry and SH coefficients remain unchanged. Across three benchmarks, SHIN progressively improves one cumulative representation and achieves the best PSNR-size efficiency in every overlapping comparison with the multi-rate and progressive baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SHIN，一种可扩展的3DGS层级表示，由一个可复用的Base与若干可加性增强层构成，通过共享高斯排序与按字节校准的梯度评分在层间分配高斯与SH带宽，实现单一累积表示覆盖多个率点，并在三个基准上取得最优PSNR-size效率。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽能高质量实时新视角合成，但不同设备与网络条件的部署预算各异；现有紧凑方法多只针对单一工作点，更换预算即需另一套独立表示，缺乏可复用的多率可扩展性。
AI.method: 构建Base+可加性增强层的层级结构，使高质量工作点在解码表示上做扩展而非替换；由多尺度位置-尺度敏感性导出统一的全局高斯顺序，保证前缀一致性；每层预算在高斯增量与SH频带保留之间，依据按字节校准的梯度评分分配；辅以轻量不透明度更新调整合成，传输的几何与SH系数保持不变。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，SHIN可渐进式改进同一份累积表示；在与多率及渐进式基线的所有重叠比较中，均取得最优的PSNR-size效率。
AI.conclusion: 将可扩展性设计为“前缀可扩展”的单一累积表示，并以字节归一化的敏感性评分统一分配几何与外观预算，是兼顾多预算部署与率-失真效率的有效途径。

title: Latent-WAM++: Shaping World and Action Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: We introduce Latent-WAM++, a representation-centered World Action Model (WAM) for end-to-end autonomous driving. Existing WAMs are primarily trained to predict future states or final actions, leaving the intermediate world and action representations that connect prediction to planning only indirectly constrained. Latent-WAM++ matches the supervision of each representation to its role in planning. World Representation Construction combines scene-ego future prediction, SIGReg-based distribution stabilization, and frozen geometric priors to learn a temporally predictive, non-degenerate, and geometry-aware world representation without an EMA target encoder. Trajectory MeanFlow Planner directly predicts multimodal trajectory proposals while being optimized with an Improved MeanFlow velocity-space objective, enabling one-step sampling. Visual-Action Representation Alignment further aligns the resulting pre-output action features with a stop-gradient target derived from current visual semantics. Latent-WAM++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM v2 and under zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM, reaching 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 47.0 average RC and 30.1 average HD-Score on HUGSIM. Training the planner end to end costs 190 GPU-hours for Latent-WAM++ versus 1,600 for Latent-WAM, a reduction of 88.1%.

AI.tldr: 提出以表征为中心的世界动作模型 Latent-WAM++，按各表征在规划中的角色匹配监督信号，在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 90.1 EPDMS，零样本 HUGSIM 上平均 RC 47.0、HD-Score 30.1，端到端训练仅需 190 GPU 小时（较 Latent-WAM 降低 88.1%）。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）主要监督未来状态或最终动作预测，连接预测与规划之间的中间世界表征与动作表征仅受间接约束，缺乏与规划目标对齐的显式监督。此外，采样效率与训练成本仍是瓶颈。
AI.method: 三项设计：(1) 世界表征构建（WRC）：结合场景-自车未来预测、SIGReg 分布稳定化与冻结几何先验，学习时间可预测、非退化、几何感知的世界表征，无需 EMA 目标编码器；(2) 轨迹 MeanFlow 规划器：直接预测多模态轨迹提案，采用改进的 MeanFlow 速度空间目标优化，支持一步采样；(3) 视觉-动作表征对齐（VARA）：将输出前的动作特征与来自当前视觉语义的 stop-gradient 目标对齐。
AI.result: NAVSIM v2 上 EPDMS 达 90.1，取得 SOTA；HUGSIM 零样本评估平均 RC 47.0、平均 HD-Score 30.1；规划器端到端训练 190 GPU 小时，对比 Latent-WAM 的 1,600 GPU 小时，降低 88.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将各中间表征的监督信号与其在规划中的功能角色显式匹配，可同时提升闭环驾驶性能、零样本泛化能力与训练效率，验证了表征中心式 WAM 设计的有效性。

title: The RenAIssance: Caption-Guided Diffusion Models for Historical-Art Visual Media
comment: Accepted at ACMMM26 RichMediaGAI. This work is co-funded by the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under MSCA with grant agreement No 101081674
summary: Generative AI can expand cultural collections into prompt-responsive visual media, but historical artworks rarely provide the paired descriptions needed to adapt modern image generators. We present The RenAIssance, a scalable pipeline that turns a collection of historical European artworks into a reusable text-to-image media resource. The pipeline generates scene-level captions with BLIP and uses the resulting approximately 15,000 image--text pairs from DEArt to train a compact LoRA adapter for Stable Diffusion v1.5. The adapter shifts generated images toward the historical-art distribution while retaining the base model's ability to render novel concepts. On historical and contemporary prompts of different lengths, it improves FID to the DEArt reference distribution in every setting with only a modest decrease in CLIP text--image similarity. Qualitative results show that the same adapter can render both period-appropriate subjects and contemporary concepts in a coherent historical visual language. By decoupling a reusable style representation from the base generator, the approach offers a practical building block for controllable historical-art media creation, interactive authoring, and rich-media experiences.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 The RenAIssance 流水线，用 BLIP 为 DEArt 历史欧洲艺术藏品生成场景级描述，构建约 1.5 万图文对，并训练轻量 LoRA 适配器微调 Stable Diffusion v1.5，实现可复用的历史艺术风格文生图生成。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 可将文化藏品扩展为可提示响应的视觉媒体，但历史艺术品通常缺乏配对描述文本，难以直接适配现代图像生成器，导致文化遗产资源难以被生成模型有效利用。
AI.method: 构建可扩展流水线：用 BLIP 为 DEArt 藏品自动生成场景级 caption，得到约 15,000 条图文对；在此基础上训练紧凑的 LoRA 适配器，微调 Stable Diffusion v1.5；将可复用的风格表示与基础生成器解耦。
AI.result: 在不同长度、历史与当代提示下，生成图像到 DEArt 参考分布的 FID 在所有设置中均改善，同时 CLIP 图文相似度仅有小幅下降；定性结果显示同一适配器既能生成符合时代的主体，也能以连贯的历史视觉语言呈现当代概念。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦可复用风格表示与基础生成器，该方法为可控历史艺术媒体创作、交互式创作流程及富媒体体验提供了实用的构建模块。

title: Beyond Row Alignment: Virtual-Camera-Aware Online Stereo Rectification
summary: Stereo matchers estimate depth by comparing the left and right images from a stereo camera pair, but they assume that the two cameras are accurately calibrated and rectified. In real deployments, small physical shifts after calibration, caused by camera motion, mechanical drift, vibration, or installation changes, can break this assumption and degrade depth estimation. Online stereo rectification is therefore needed to correct the image pair during operation and recover a stereo geometry where standard stereo matching can work reliably. Recent online rectification methods mainly optimize row alignment, making the left and right views of the same scene point fall on the same image row. We show that this target, while necessary, is insufficient for deployable stereo depth estimation. A rectifier may make a small set of matched points look well row-aligned, but still distort the full images in ways that hurt stereo matching: useful image regions may be cut off, large blank areas may appear, objects may be stretched or squeezed, or image scale may change unevenly across the view. We propose VirtualRect, an online stereo rectification method designed for reliable real-world deployment. Rather than treating rectification as simply making the left and right image rows line up, this method estimates a rectified virtual stereo camera and combines image-wide supervision of image warp behavior. This makes the rectified images and the camera parameters come from the same geometry, so the images used for matching and the model used for depth computation remain consistent. Experiments on multiple datasets show that, compared with the prior state-of-the-art online rectifier, VirtualRect reduces vertical flow error by 17% on Carla-Flowguided and 7% on Semi-Truck Highway, and lowers depth MAE by 30-41% on Carla-Flowguided across three downstream stereo matchers.

AI.tldr: 提出 VirtualRect：一种面向真实部署的在线立体校正方法，通过估计“虚拟校正立体相机”并对整幅图像畸变行为施加监督，使校正图像与相机参数来自同一几何，从而在行对齐之外保证图像质量与深度可靠性。
AI.motivation: 标准立体匹配假设左右相机已精确标定与极线校正，但实际部署中相机运动、机械漂移、振动或安装变更会引起标定后的微小物理位移，破坏该假设并降低深度估计精度，因此需要在线立体校正。现有在线校正方法主要优化行对齐（同一场景点在左右图中处于同一行），但作者指出这一目标虽必要却不充分：校正器可能让少量匹配点看似行对齐，却以裁切有效区域、出现大片空白、物体拉伸/压缩、尺度不均等方式扭曲整幅图像，损害立体匹配。
AI.method: VirtualRect 不把校正仅视为左右图像行对齐，而是估计一个经过校正的虚拟立体相机，并联合对整幅图像的 warp 行为进行监督（image-wide supervision of image warp behavior）。这使校正后的图像与相机参数源自同一几何，保证用于匹配的图像与用于深度计算的模型保持一致。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，相较此前最优的在线校正器：Carla-Flowguided 上垂直光流误差降低 17%，Semi-Truck Highway 上降低 7%；在 Carla-Flowguided 上，三种下游立体匹配器的深度 MAE 降低 30–41%。
AI.conclusion: 仅优化行对齐不足以支撑可部署的立体深度估计；以虚拟立体相机估计结合整幅图像 warp 监督的 VirtualRect，能在图像与参数几何一致的前提下显著改善行对齐质量与下游深度精度，更适合真实场景在线校正。

title: Locating and Repairing Domain Shift in VLM Trajectory Planning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). 30 pages, 7 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/ZhihongCui/MoLaRx
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted as end-to-end driving planners, yet they suffer from cross-city domain shift. Existing methods treat this shift as a single quantity addressed by uniform alignment or single-site editing. We challenge this view on two counts: (i) domain shift in VLM trajectory planners is inherently structured across modality and layer, and (ii) a locate-then-repair recipe matched to this structure outperforms every uniform-objective baseline. We analyse domain shift via activation patching and uncover two regularities. (F1) Modality axis. Image and text tokens exhibit distinct shift patterns in each VLM. (F2) Layer axis. The layer-wise shift partition is architecture-dependent and dataset-stable. These findings recast domain shift as a two-dimensional tensor indexed by modality (image vs. text tokens) and layer, motivating a simple principle: locate where shift occurs, and repair only there. We instantiate this principle in MoLaRx (Modality-Layer Repair), a locate-then-repair framework. The Causal Importance Score (CIS) estimates the domain shift as a modality-layer tensor and partitions the layers into functional zones. CIS-Guided Selective Repair (CISR) then applies a matched operator (Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) / low-rank adaptation (LoRA) / freezing) to repair each zone, with the composition adapting automatically to each architecture. We evaluate MoLaRx on three architecturally distinct VLMs (LFM2-VL-1.6B, Qwen2-VL-2B, and PaliGemma2-3B) across two cross-city benchmarks (nuScenes and Argoverse 2). MoLaRx attains the lowest cross-city trajectory-error gap among adaptation methods in all six main-table settings, while using 50-60% fewer trainable parameters and 8.4-10.9 ms lower inference latency. In contrast, uniform MMD-only adaptation collapses in all six settings, highlighting the importance of structure-guided repair.

AI.tldr: 该论文将VLM驾驶规划器的跨城市域偏移刻画为由"模态×层"构成的二维张量，提出先定位、再修复的MoLaRx框架，在3个VLM、2个跨城市基准的6个主表中均取得最低轨迹误差差距，且可训练参数减少50-60%、推理延迟降低8.4-10.9 ms。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将跨城市域偏移视为单一整体，采用统一对齐或单点编辑来处理。作者提出两点反驳：(i) VLM轨迹规划器中的域偏移在模态与层两个维度上是结构化的；(ii) 与这种结构匹配的"定位—修复"策略优于所有均匀目标基线。因此需要验证并利用这种结构。
AI.method: 通过激活修补（activation patching）分析域偏移，发现两条规律：F1模态轴——图像token与文本token在各VLM中呈现不同的偏移模式；F2层轴——逐层偏移划分依赖于架构且在数据集上稳定。据此将域偏移建模为模态（图像/文本）×层的二维张量，提出MoLaRx框架：Causal Importance Score（CIS）估计模态-层偏移张量并将层划分为功能区域；CIS-Guided Selective Repair（CISR）为每个区域匹配相应算子（MMD、LoRA或冻结），组合方式随架构自动适配。
AI.result: 在三个架构不同的VLM（LFM2-VL-1.6B、Qwen2-VL-2B、PaliGemma2-3B）与两个跨城市基准（nuScenes、Argoverse 2）上进行评测。MoLaRx在全部六个主表设置中取得所有适应方法里最低的跨城市轨迹误差差距，同时可训练参数少50-60%、推理延迟低8.4-10.9 ms。相反，仅使用统一MMD的适应方法在六个设置中全部失效。
AI.conclusion: 跨城市域偏移应被视为模态与层二维结构化的偏移，而非单一标量；结构引导的"定位—修复"修复显著优于均匀目标对齐，且更参数高效、更低延迟，说明偏移结构定位是VLM驾驶规划器跨域适应的关键。

title: Quadratic Bezier Splatting with Structural Initialization for Efficient Painting Rendering
summary: Stroke-based rendering is often optimized as a pixel-level reconstruction task. This over-reliance on global error reduction not only degrades strokes into fragmented curves due to a lack of structured planning, but also allows locally defective primitives to be concealed by overlapping layers. To address these issues, we introduce a model-guided framework for stroke-audited rendering. Our framework uses Quadratic Bezier Splatting to analytically model continuous curved strokes with efficient differentiable alpha compositing. Built on this renderer, a feedforward multi-scale stroke decoder provides a structural initialization with learned stroke-scale allocation, while test-time stroke optimization supplies the reconstruction capacity needed for high-fidelity refinement. We further propose a single-stroke audit mechanism that explicitly evaluates local stroke quality, preventing defective primitives from surviving optimization through layer-wise compensation. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves coherent layouts, improves PSNR by up to 5.46 dB, yields a 16% more compact representation, and accelerates combined renderer forward and backward computation by a factor of 220.3.

AI.tldr: 提出模型引导的笔画审计渲染框架：用二次贝塞尔泼溅（Quadratic Bezier Splatting）对连续曲线笔画做解析建模并支持可微alpha合成，结合前馈多尺度笔画解码器提供结构化初始化与测试时笔画优化，并引入单笔画审计机制剔除局部缺陷图元，实现更连贯布局、PSNR最高提升5.46 dB、表示紧凑度提升16%、渲染前后向计算加速220.3倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于笔画的渲染被当作像素级重建任务优化，过度依赖全局误差下降：一方面缺乏结构化规划导致笔画退化为碎片化曲线，另一方面局部缺陷图元会被重叠图层掩盖而存活。
AI.method: 1) Quadratic Bezier Splatting 解析建模连续曲线笔画，配高效可微alpha合成；2) 前馈多尺度笔画解码器给出带学习式笔画尺度分配的结构化初始化；3) 测试时笔画优化保证高保真细化能力；4) 单笔画审计机制显式评估局部笔画质量，阻止缺陷图元通过逐层补偿残留。
AI.result: 相比现有方法获得更连贯的布局，PSNR最高提升5.46 dB，表示紧凑度提升16%，渲染器前向+后向计算加速220.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 将笔画渲染从纯像素误差优化转向“结构化初始化+测试时优化+局部笔画审计”的模型引导范式，可同时改善布局连贯性、重建质量、表示效率与计算效率。

title: Nanopath: Fast, Fair, Open Experimentation for Pathology Foundation Models
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. NeurIPS 2026 workshop: AI at Scale for Clinical Impact: Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
summary: We introduce nanopath, an open-source framework and benchmark for rapidly training and evaluating small-scale pathology foundation models. Using a single H100 GPU, a typical nanopath model trains in a little over an hour on up to one million TCGA pathology tile presentations and evaluates within 25 minutes on a broad suite of tile-level and slide-level tasks. Nanopath enables rapid exploration of research ideas at small scale, so promising training recipes can subsequently be tested with more data and compute. To enable fair comparisons between ideas, we constrain submissions to fixed data and compute budgets while keeping the downstream evaluation protocol fixed. Anyone may clone the codebase, automatically download the data, reproduce or modify existing models, and submit a run to Labless, our public experiment ledger where researchers and AI agents can search through prior attempts. Since its public release in June 2026, nanopath has received 1,269 experiments from 20 contributors. Here, we detail its design and assess how well its rapid evaluation tracks standardized THUNDER, HEST, and PathoBench (CPTAC) benchmarks across six nanopath and 14 reference foundation models. Nanopath's fast evaluation suite strongly tracked these standardized benchmarks, and a few 22M parameter nanopath models even outperformed giant 1.1B parameter models on a subset of downstream tasks. We subsequently discuss how we have since optimized nanopath's evaluation suite to be an even more faithful, quick proxy for external benchmarking. Nanopath provides an accessible testbed for students, researchers, and AI agents to explore pathology foundation modeling through fair, transparent, and directly comparable experiments.

AI.tldr: 作者提出开源框架与基准 nanopath，用于在单张 H100 上约 1 小时训练、25 分钟评测小规模病理基础模型，并以固定数据/算力预算与固定评测协议保证公平比较；其快速评测套件与 THUNDER、HEST、PathoBench (CPTAC) 高度一致，部分 22M 参数模型在部分任务上超过 1.1B 参数模型。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型研究受限于大规模数据与算力，单个想法验证成本高，且不同实验间数据、算力与评测协议不一致，难以公平比较；同时学生、研究者与 AI agent 缺乏可及的低门槛实验平台。因此需要一个可快速迭代、成本可控且评测标准统一的测试床，使有前景的训练方案可以在小规模筛出后再放大验证。
AI.method: 构建开源框架与基准 nanopath：单张 H100 GPU 上于最多一百万张 TCGA 病理切块（tile）上训练，典型模型训练约一小时余；提交约束在固定的数据与算力预算内，下游评测协议固定不变；代码库可克隆、数据可自动下载、模型可复现或修改，并可将运行结果提交至公开实验账本 Labless 供检索历史尝试。以六个 nanopath 模型与 14 个参考基础模型为对象，检验其快速评测与标准化 THUNDER、HEST、PathoBench (CPTAC) 基准的一致性，并据此迭代优化评测套件。
AI.result: 自 2026 年 6 月公开发布以来，nanopath 收到来自 20 位贡献者的 1,269 次实验。快速评测套件与三个标准化基准的排序高度吻合；若干 22M 参数的小模型在部分下游任务上优于 1.1B 参数的大模型。作者随后据此进一步优化评测套件，使其成为更忠实的快速外部基准代理。
AI.conclusion: nanopath 提供了一个低成本、可复现、公平透明的病理基础模型实验测试床，其小规模快速评测能有效预测标准化基准表现，适合作为放大实验前的筛选工具，并为学生、研究者与 AI agent 提供可直接比较的研究入口。

title: PLS-GS: Probabilistic Lidar Scaffolds for Compact, Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Main paper and supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/k-harikumar/PLS-GS
summary: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is typically optimized from images only, many robotics and mapping applications provide both camera and high-definition LiDAR data, combining rich visual appearance with accurate geometric structure. We introduce PLS-GS, a probabilistic LiDAR scaffold for Gaussian Splatting that exploits this complementary sensing setting to construct a compact 3DGS representation aligned to the measured surface. PLS-GS fits a Hierarchical Gaussian Mixture Model jointly over position and color, yielding a continuous and adaptive scaffold that eliminates the need for discrete scene partitioning such as voxel grids or octrees. The fitted mixture then guides the renderable 3DGS Gaussians: each rendering Gaussian is associated with a GMM component and constrained in the local surface frame induced by that component's covariance. A Mahalanobis support loss bounds the deviation of the rendering Gaussians from the corresponding LiDAR-derived surface. Across five large outdoor scenes, PLS-GS places primitives markedly closer to the LiDAR measurements than both image- and LiDAR-initialized baselines, while employing substantially fewer primitives, yielding a considerably more compact model and faster rendering. At matched capacity, PLS-GS places primitives closer to the LiDAR measurements, with comparable rendering quality. Code is available at https://github.com/k-harikumar/PLS-GS.

AI.tldr: 提出 PLS-GS，用概率 LiDAR 脚手架（联合拟合位置与颜色的层次高斯混合模型）引导 3DGS 优化，构建紧致且贴合 LiDAR 表面的表示。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 通常仅从图像优化，而机器人与建图场景常同时提供相机与高精度 LiDAR 数据；现有方法未充分利用这一互补传感信息来约束几何结构。
AI.method: 对位置与颜色联合拟合层次高斯混合模型（GMM），得到连续自适应脚手架，无需体素网格或八叉树等离散划分；每个渲染高斯关联一个 GMM 分量，并约束在该分量协方差诱导的局部表面坐标系中；引入马氏距离支撑损失，限制渲染高斯相对 LiDAR 表面的偏差。
AI.result: 在五个大型室外场景上，相比图像初始化与 LiDAR 初始化基线，基元显著更贴近 LiDAR 测量，同时使用远少的基元，模型更紧致、渲染更快；在等容量条件下，基元更贴近 LiDAR 测量且渲染质量相当。
AI.conclusion: 利用 LiDAR 几何先验构建概率脚手架可有效提升 3DGS 的几何对齐度与紧致性，在保持渲染质量的同时显著减少基元数量并加速渲染。

title: Remembering to Reason: Structured Memory for Scene and Workflow Understanding in Robot-Assisted Surgery
summary: Surgical video understanding is an important foundation for intelligent assistance in robot-assisted surgery. Similar surgical views can reflect different actions or procedural stages. Interpreting these views requires access to earlier observations, yet frame-centric prompting leaves this history unavailable. We introduce MemSurg, a framework that remembers surgical observations before reasoning over them. Its structured memory graph stores timestamped entity categories, locations, motion cues, and interaction summaries. Chronological links preserve recent context, while entity-associated links connect recurring observations across the procedure. Task-adaptive retrieval then supplies evidence-grounded prompts for scene and workflow reasoning, supporting both frozen inference and memory-conditioned supervised fine-tuning. Evaluation on robot-assisted prostatectomy and two complementary surgical benchmarks shows a 10.43-percentage-point gain over SurgRAW with GPT-4o. Memory conditioning adds 6.52 points under matched Qwen3-VL-8B fine-tuning, and an inference-time plug-in adds 7.04 points to EndoChat. These results support structured memory as a reusable source of procedural evidence for surgical video understanding. Our code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemSurg框架，在推理前先记住手术观测：以结构化记忆图存储带时间戳的实体类别、位置、运动线索与交互摘要，并用时间链与实体关联链组织，配合任务自适应检索为场景与流程推理提供有据可依的提示，支持冻结推理与记忆条件监督微调。
AI.motivation: 机器人辅助手术的智能辅助依赖手术视频理解，但相似的手术视野可能对应不同动作或手术阶段，判断需回溯更早的观测；而以单帧为中心的提示方式使这些历史信息不可用。
AI.method: 构建结构化记忆图：存储带时间戳的实体类别、位置、运动线索和交互摘要；时间链保留近期上下文，实体关联链连接术中重复出现的观测；任务自适应检索生成证据支撑的提示，用于场景与流程推理，同时支持冻结推理与记忆条件的有监督微调。
AI.result: 在机器人辅助前列腺切除术及两个互补手术基准上，较SurgRAW配合GPT-4o提升10.43个百分点；在Qwen3-VL-8B同等微调条件下，记忆条件带来6.52个点提升；推理期即插即用模块为EndoChat带来7.04个点提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明结构化记忆可作为手术视频理解中可复用的流程证据来源；代码将公开。

title: ARMOR: Adaptive Curriculum Meta-Learning for Noise-Robust RAG Reasoning
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in mitigating hallucinations by incorporating external knowledge. However, the retrieval process inevitably introduces noise, posing significant challenges to RAG robustness. Fundamentally, noise robustness is a composite competency encompassing noise identification, retrieval filtering, and robust reasoning. Unfortunately, existing methods often fail to capture this holistic nature, typically restricted to single-dimensional enhancements or hampered by noise-induced optimization interference. To address these limitations, we decompose RAG robustness into three sub-tasks: knowledge boundary perception, retrieval verification, and robust reasoning. Accordingly, we propose ARMOR, an Adaptive Curriculum Meta-Learning for Noise Robust RAG Reasoning. Inspired by the teaching process, ARMOR introduces an adaptive task scheduler as a teacher to curate training plans according to the absolute learning progress of RAG generators (Student). Distinct from GRPO, ARMOR utilizes inter-group advantage estimation during learning to effectively mitigate mode collapse caused by limited output spaces. Experiments on three complex reasoning datasets (2WikiMultiHopQA, MusiQue, and HotPotQA) indicate that ARMOR achieves synergistic improvements in retrieval noise robustness, significantly outperforming baselines in output quality.

AI.tldr: 提出ARMOR，自适应课程元学习框架，将RAG鲁棒性分解为知识边界感知、检索验证与鲁棒推理三个子任务，借助自适应任务调度器按生成器的绝对学习进度安排训练，并用组间优势估计缓解模式坍塌，在三个多跳推理数据集上显著提升噪声鲁棒性与输出质量。
AI.motivation: RAG虽能缓解幻觉，但检索不可避免地引入噪声。噪声鲁棒性本质上是涵盖噪声识别、检索过滤与鲁棒推理的复合能力，而现有方法多局限于单维度增强，或受噪声引起的优化干扰所限，缺乏对这种整体性的把握。
AI.method: 将RAG鲁棒性分解为知识边界感知、检索验证、鲁棒推理三个子任务；提出ARMOR（自适应课程元学习）。采用教师—学生范式：自适应任务调度器充当教师，依据RAG生成器（学生）的绝对学习进度策划训练计划；与GRPO不同，学习过程中采用组间优势估计以缓解输出空间受限导致的模式坍塌。
AI.result: 在2WikiMultiHopQA、MusiQue、HotPotQA三个复杂推理数据集上，ARMOR在检索噪声鲁棒性上实现协同提升，输出质量显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 将RAG噪声鲁棒性视为复合能力并以课程化元学习统一优化是有效路径；自适应任务调度与组间优势估计能协同提升多子任务表现，为噪声鲁棒RAG推理提供了可行范式。

title: Optimizing Multi-Tier Intermediation in Programmatic Advertising: A DAG-Based Mechanism for Supply Path Optimization
summary: Digital programmatic advertising operates through complex, multi-hop supply chains. The opacity of these intermediary networks leads to significant efficiency losses, often referred to as the ``ad-tech tax.'' While current industry practices utilize heuristic Supply Path Optimization (SPO) to trim inefficient routes, they fail to optimize the equilibrium of the entire network. This paper extends previous work on Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) intermediation models by applying them to traceable programmatic supply chains mapped via the OpenRTB SupplyChain object. We introduce multi-attribute utility functions and Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) to account for substitutable routing (OR nodes) and percentage-based fee structures. Furthermore, we outline a computational methodology and experimental framework using public \texttt{schain} and \texttt{sellers.json} data to benchmark optimal Nash social welfare against current uncoordinated market outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该文将DAG中介模型扩展到基于OpenRTB SupplyChain对象的可溯源程序化广告供应链，引入多属性效用函数与MILP以刻画可替代路由（OR节点）和按比例费率，并提出利用schain与sellers.json公开数据的计算与实验框架，以最优Nash社会福利为基准评估当前无协调市场结果。
AI.motivation: 程序化广告的多跳中间链不透明，造成"ad-tech tax"式效率损失；现有启发式Supply Path Optimization只能裁剪低效路径，无法实现全网均衡优化。
AI.method: 扩展有向无环图（DAG）中介模型，映射至OpenRTB SupplyChain可溯源供应链；构建多属性效用函数；采用混合整数线性规划（MILP）处理OR节点（可替代路由）与百分比费率结构；给出计算方法与基于schain、sellers.json数据的实验框架。
AI.result: 摘要中未给出实证结果；研究设计为将最优Nash社会福利与当前未协调市场结果进行基准对比。
AI.conclusion: 启发式SPO不足以优化网络均衡，需以形式化的DAG-MILP框架刻画含可替代路径与比例费用的供应链，并以最优Nash社会福利衡量并改进市场化配置效率。

title: Weight-Space Programming of Policies and Their Verification via Model Checking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can write the weights of small neural networks directly, without gradient descent. This weight-space programming creates policies for sequential decision-making from a task description alone, but nothing guarantees that a written policy behaves as intended. We combine weight-space programming with probabilistic model checking. Given an environment modeled as a Markov decision process and a requirement in probabilistic computation tree logic (PCTL), an LLM writes all weights of a policy network, optionally repairs them on a dataset of optimal actions, and receives model-checking feedback until the requirement holds or a round limit is reached. The model checker Storm computes, rather than estimates from simulations, the probability that the policy satisfies the requirement, so every returned policy is verified. With two LLMs on three environments, the created policy of each of the 18 runs attains the optimal probability, before any dataset or model-checking feedback. Four of six policies programmed for two transporter jobs also complete three jobs with probability 1, so they generalize to a task that the LLM never saw. The pipeline also programs a policy that satisfies a complex safety requirement expressed with the PCTL until operator in all six runs. In one of them, dataset repair raised the accuracy to 98.4\% but broke the requirement, and one round of model-checking feedback restored it.

AI.tldr: 将权重空间编程与概率模型检验结合：LLM直接写出策略网络权重，由Storm对PCTL要求做精确验证并反馈修复，返回的策略均为已验证。
AI.motivation: LLM可直接生成小型神经网络权重，仅凭任务描述即可构造序贯决策策略，但无法保证所写策略行为符合意图；需要形式化验证来把关。
AI.method: 环境建模为MDP，要求用PCTL表达；LLM写出策略网络全部权重，可选地在最优动作数据集上修复，并接收模型检验反馈迭代，直至满足要求或达到轮数上限；由模型检验器Storm精确计算（而非仿真估计）策略满足要求的概率。
AI.result: 两种LLM、三个环境共18次运行，在未使用数据集或模型检验反馈前即达到最优概率；六个为两个搬运任务的策略中四个能以概率1完成三个任务（对未见任务的泛化）；六次运行全部为含until算子的复杂安全要求编程出满足的策略；其中一次数据集修复将准确率升至98.4%却破坏要求，一轮模型检验反馈即恢复。
AI.conclusion: 权重空间编程与概率模型检验可互补：前者提供免梯度下降的策略合成，后者提供精确保证与可用的修复信号，使生成的策略可验证并具备一定泛化能力。

title: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Project page and code: https://github.com/TokenRhythm/InfraRSI
summary: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift. We present InfraRSI, the agentic harness that turns open-ended human commands into verified training optimizations via a five-stage workflow: init locks editable scope and a fixed task contract over workload, loss, and timing invariants to prevent reward hacking, doctor profiles baseline phases and calibrates cluster noise, run co-optimizes launch knobs and code patches before re-verifying top candidates against the baseline and logging findings to a cross-hardware experience bank, and report and apply audit source paths, track failed-trial costs, and commit promoted changes. Rather than stepping greedily from a single incumbent, InfraRSI initializes from diverse experience-seeded configurations and fits global execution-time and censored peak-memory models across all trials, including OOMs. Using these models, it prices per-setting memory costs, revises miscalibrated LLM priors from live runs, and pairs memory-hungry optimizations with memory savers and verified code patches. Across four single- and multi-node dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM workloads, InfraRSI achieves a speedup of up to $2.75\times$ and lifts mean Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) from $17.4\%$ to $30.0\%$, outperforming existing tuners and coding agents while transferring experience across GPUs. As it improves training infrastructure efficiency, InfraRSI forms a two-level Recursive Self-Improvement loop---revising priors online within runs and distilling experience across clusters---to push foundation model scaling.

AI.tldr: InfraRSI 是一个代理式自动化框架，将开放式人类指令转化为经验证的分布式LLM训练优化，实现两级递归自我改进循环。
AI.motivation: 传统RSI只能加速孤立的算法与内核合成，而分布式LLM训练依赖紧密耦合的启动配置、算子内核与通信调度，单点改动常触发OOM、编译器冲突、测量抖动或静默数值漂移，现有调优器与编码代理难以应对。
AI.method: 提出五阶段工作流：init锁定可编辑范围与固定任务契约（工作负载、损失、计时不变量，防奖励黑客）；doctor剖析基线阶段并校准集群噪声；run在重新验证前联合优化启动旋钮与代码补丁；report/apply审计来源、追踪失败成本并提交变更。核心是从多样化经验种子配置初始化，对全部试验（含OOM）拟合全局执行时间与删失峰值内存模型，据此定价各配置内存代价、用实时运行修正LLM先验错误，并将高内存优化与省内存手段及验证补丁配对。
AI.result: 在四个单/多节点稠密及MoE LLM工作负载上，最高提速2.75倍，平均MFU从17.4%提升至30.0%，超越现有调优器和编码代理，并能跨GPU迁移经验。
AI.conclusion: InfraRSI形成两级RSI闭环——运行内在线修正先验、跨集群蒸馏经验——提升训练基础设施效率，助力基础模型规模化。

title: An Interpretable Fuzzy Tree for Turbofan Remaining Useful Life with an Auditable Per-Component Diagnostic Layer
summary: Data-driven remaining useful life (RUL) estimators for turbofan engines are accurate but opaque, and their internal features typically encode remaining life rather than any specific component's state. This paper presents an interpretable genetic fuzzy tree that predicts RUL from cruise-condition sensor means on N-CMAPSS while exposing a per-component diagnostic layer inspectable rule by rule. The tree follows the engine hierarchy: sensors to component health, then to bounded component damage, spool damage, and RUL, so each level answers a different maintenance question. Training is staged so the prognostic objective cannot reshape the diagnostic layers: health leaves are fitted to physical targets and frozen, a deterministic fuzzy damage map with fleet-referenced thresholds is imposed on each component, and only the aggregation is optimized for RUL. It consumes 13 cruise-mean scalars per cycle rather than a trajectory, which removes any sequence model. On the native split it reaches 8.44 cycles RMSE on the multi-fault subset and 11.51 across all modes with 333 free parameters, 411 total rules, 32 to 12,000 times fewer than compiled baselines. An exhaustive sensor search bounds which components are diagnosable under the tested cruise-mean design, and the rule base is structured to admit formal verification, which this study does not discharge.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可解释遗传模糊树，在N-CMAPSS上从巡航均值传感器预测涡扇发动机RUL，并公开可按规则检查的部件级诊断层。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动RUL估计器精度高但不透明，其内部特征通常编码剩余寿命而非具体部件状态，难以支撑逐部件的维护决策。
AI.method: 按发动机层级构建树：传感器→部件健康→有界部件损伤→转子损伤→RUL；分阶段训练使诊断层不被预测目标重塑（健康叶节点拟合物理目标后冻结，部件上施加带机队参考阈值的确定性模糊损伤映射，仅聚合层针对RUL优化）；每循环输入13个巡航均值标量而非轨迹，去除序列模型；并做穷举式传感器搜索界定可诊断部件。
AI.result: 原生划分下多故障子集RMSE为8.44循环，全模式11.51循环；333个自由参数、411条规则，比编译式基线少32至12000倍；给出巡航均值设计下哪些部件可诊断的边界。
AI.conclusion: 以极小参数量实现兼顾精度与逐部件可解释性的RUL估计，规则库结构可支持形式化验证，但本文未执行该验证。

title: LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting
summary: Frontline sales staff spend much of their day re-coordinating quotes after customers change quantities, ask for discounts or new payment terms, or costs move. We present LoMASA (Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant), a training-free multi-agent system that runs entirely on one desktop computer. A 35B mixture-of-experts model (System-1) makes each decision in a single forward pass and reads its confidence from the probabilities of the answer options. A 27B dense model (System-2) writes customer replies and escalation briefs and is consulted when System-1 is unsure. Code computes every price, margin and option, and hard pricing rules cannot be overridden. On a test split of 500 simulated episodes with 1512 decisions built from public supply-chain data, the salesperson has to decide only 19.5% of decisions: 38.0% are settled automatically, with a median latency of 2.67 seconds, and 42.5% are escalated to a manager by the hard rules. On the automatically settled decisions LoMASA is as accurate as a rule baseline (0.894 vs.\ 0.894) and makes fewer commitments whose margin later falls below the floor (2.61% vs 4.53%); the price is additional escalations to the manager. Option probabilities are well calibrated without any training, unlike confidence stated in words by the same model. We also report where the design does not help: the 27B model rarely changes a decision.

AI.tldr: LoMASA 是一个完全运行于单台桌面电脑上的免训练多智能体销售辅助系统：35B MoE 模型（System-1）单次前向决策并从选项概率读取置信度，27B 稠密模型（System-2）负责撰写客户回复与升级简报，所有价格/毛利/选项由代码计算且硬性定价规则不可覆盖。
AI.motivation: 一线销售每天需反复重新协调报价：客户改数量、要求折扣或新付款条件、成本变动都会触发重算。作者希望在不训练模型的前提下，用本地可部署的系统分担这部分重复决策，同时保证定价与毛利的可控性与合规性。
AI.method: 系统由三层构成：(1) System-1 为 35B 混合专家模型，单次前向输出决策，并以答案选项概率作为置信度；(2) System-2 为 27B 稠密模型，负责生成客户回复与升级简报，仅在 System-1 不确定时被调用；(3) 代码层负责全部价格、毛利与选项计算，硬性定价规则具有最高优先级。评估使用基于公开供应链数据构建的 500 个模拟 episode、共 1512 个决策的测试集。
AI.result: 销售员仅需处理 19.5% 的决策；38.0% 自动解决（中位延迟 2.67 秒），42.5% 由硬规则升级给经理。自动解决部分，LoMASA 与规则基线准确率持平（0.894 vs. 0.894），但事后毛利跌破下限的承诺更少（2.61% vs. 4.53%），代价是更多向经理的升级。选项概率在无训练情况下校准良好，而同一模型以文字表述的置信度则不然。
AI.conclusion: 免训练、单机本地化的多智能体设计在报价重协调场景中可显著减轻人工负担，并以代码化硬规则保障毛利底线；校准良好的选项概率是可靠的路由信号。局限同样明确：27B 模型极少改变决策，System-2 的增益有限，且准确率提升以更多经理升级为代价。

title: When Self-Consistency Hurts: The Hidden Cost of Majority Voting in Small Language Models
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted by the 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)
summary: We study prompted chain-of-thought (CoT) with self-consistency (SC), i.e. sampling N traces and plurality-voting, on small language models, a regime where per-query compute budgets are tight yet SC is commonly applied with a fixed sample budget inherited from large-model practice, regardless of instance difficulty. Across two model families (Qwen-2.5-0.5B, Gemma-3-1B) at FP16 and MLX-Q4 (4-bit quantisation in Apple's MLX framework), on GSM8K and MATH-500, we run 8 per-task and 4 task-pooled experiments at n=200-400 with 1,000x paired-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs). Our first result is an upper bound: an oracle gate deciding per prompt whether to invoke SC reaches 109-174% of always-SC's accuracy at 23-30% of its compute in all 12/12 cases, so at N=5 always-SC is dominated everywhere on our grid. That margin is exactly the rate at which SC flips correct greedy answers to wrong, here 3-10.5% of prompts, which on Qwen-Q4 x MATH-500 exceeds the wrong-to-right rate and leaves always-SC 3 pt worse than always-greedy. Our second result is a deployable approximation: a gate over greedy-pass signals skips 45-99% of SC calls, with bootstrap CI half-widths under 5 pt, removing 36-79% of always-SC compute. Accuracy retention at those operating points has point estimates of 98.1-98.8%, which we report as point estimates because their CIs are wide (lower bounds 76-86%) over an SC accuracy of only 15-36%. The evidence covers N=5 on two <=1B families and two math benchmarks, which is the scope we claim. Code is available at https://github.com/heywanrong/SiftSC.

AI.tldr: 在小模型上，固定样本预算的自一致性（SC）常被主导；本文给出oracle门控的上界（23-30%算力达109-174%精度）与一个基于greedy-pass信号的可部署门控，跳过45-99%的SC调用并节省36-79%算力。
AI.motivation: 小模型上每查询算力预算紧张，但SC仍沿用大模型固定的采样预算，不随实例难度自适应。作者欲量化固定N的always-SC是否被更聪明的按需调用策略支配，并给出可落地的近似方案。
AI.method: 在Qwen-2.5-0.5B与Gemma-3-1B（FP16与MLX-Q4）上，于GSM8K、MATH-500开展8个单任务与4个任务池化实验（n=200-400），采用1000次配对bootstrap置信区间。先构造oracle门控（按提示决定是否调用SC）给出性能上界，再提出基于greedy-pass信号的门控作为可部署近似；N=5。
AI.result: oracle门控在12/12情形下以23-30%算力达到always-SC精度的109-174%；优势来自SC将正确答案翻错的比例（3-10.5%提示），在Qwen-Q4×MATH-500上该翻转率超过错误转正确率，使always-SC反而比always-greedy低3个点。可部署门控跳过45-99%的SC调用，移除36-79%算力，CI半宽<5pt；精度保留点估计98.1-98.8%（CI下界76-86%，基线SC精度仅15-36%）。
AI.conclusion: 固定预算的always-SC在≤1B模型、N=5、两数学基准范围内被按需门控普遍支配；基于greedy-pass的门控可显著省算力且点估计上保留精度，但其置信区间较宽，结论限于所声明范围。

title: GARP: Real-Time Generative Agents on Local Hardware in a Game Engine
summary: Generative agents are game characters whose plans, conversations, and memories are written on the fly by a large language model (LLM). The original Generative Agents demonstration used cloud inference in a custom simulation. We present GARP, a platform for real-time generative agents inside Godot, and describe the Character Behavior System used in GARP 2. The complete loop runs on local hardware using a 3B-parameter open-weight model and no cloud service. Alongside the original planning, memory, and reflection, GARP gives each agent an emotion system driven by LLM appraisal, four graded personality axes drawn from the Big Five that set simulation parameters as well as prompt text, six needs whose urgency grows over time, and pairwise relationships updated after every conversation. The system narrows 50+ candidate actions to typically 3-8, constrains model responses with JSON schemas, and surfaces important memories in decision prompts. A layered optimization strategy (an adjustable game clock, decisions taken ahead of need, multi-tier caching, prompt compression, and fully asynchronous execution) keeps the game responsive while the model thinks. In a nine-scenario evaluation, 25 of 27 runs passed log-based checks. Both failures occurred in the birthday party scenario, where one guest omitted the event from their daily plan.

AI.tldr: GARP 是一个在 Godot 引擎内实时运行生成式智能体的本地化平台，使用 3B 开源模型完成推理并无需云服务，通过情感、人格、需求与关系系统及多层优化策略实现流畅交互。
AI.motivation: 原始生成式智能体演示依赖云端推理与定制模拟环境，缺乏可落地的实时游戏平台，且本地小模型运行面临延迟与响应性问题。
AI.method: 提出 GARP 平台及 Character Behavior System：在原有规划、记忆、反思基础上增加 LLM 评估驱动的情感系统、基于大五人格的四维分级人格轴（影响模拟参数与提示词）、随时间增强紧迫度的六种需求、每次对话后更新的成对关系；将 50+ 候选动作缩减至 3–8 个、用 JSON schema 约束输出、在决策提示中突出重要记忆；采用可调游戏时钟、提前决策、多级缓存、提示压缩与全异步执行的分层优化。
AI.result: 在九场景评估中，27 次运行有 25 次通过日志检查；两次失败均出现在生日派对场景，原因是某位客人未将该事件纳入日常计划。
AI.conclusion: 本地 3B 模型可在 Godot 中支撑实时生成式智能体，系统具备较高可靠性；事件纳入计划仍是智能体规划环节的主要薄弱点。

title: RetinaGuard: Risk-Controlled Agentic Triage for Multi-Disease Retinal Screening
summary: Retinal screening programmes need to know which automated decisions can be accepted without review. This paper presents RetinaGuard, an agentic triage framework in which quality, diagnostic, uncertainty, verification and explanation agents gather evidence for each fundus photograph, a learned failure predictor estimates the probability that the decision is unsafe, auxiliary tools are invoked only when their expected value of information exceeds their cost, and the acceptance threshold is certified by conformal risk control. On the RFMiD test split, RetinaGuard was compared with confidence and calibrated-uncertainty referral at matched referral budgets and equal certified safety, using two RETFound primary models of different strength. With the weaker model (macro-AUROC 0.896), verifier disagreement added significant information, RetinaGuard captured 119 of 280 unsafe decisions at a 20% budget against 88 for lowest-confidence referral, and at a nominal 5% unsafe level it accepted 37.0% of cases against 10.3%. With the stronger model (0.925) the verifier added nothing beyond uncertainty and the advantage shrank to a few percentage points. In both settings its coverage at the nominal 5% level stayed near 37.7%, gating cut computation by about 30%, and a quality agent reduced unsafe acceptances under most image corruptions. The benefit of agentic evidence gathering thus depends on how much the primary model's own uncertainty already reveals about its errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RetinaGuard，一个由质量、诊断、不确定性、验证与解释五类智能体组成、以学习型失败预测器评估"决策是否不安全"、按信息价值触发辅助工具、并用共形风险控制认证接受阈值的智能体式分诊框架；在 RFMiD 上，其相对置信度/校准不确定性转诊的收益取决于主模型自身不确定性对错误的揭示程度。
AI.motivation: 视网膜筛查流程需要明确哪些自动化决策可在不人工复核的情况下被接受；现有基于置信度或校准不确定性的转诊策略只能利用单一信号，且阈值缺乏严格的风险保证。
AI.method: 多智能体证据采集（质量、诊断、不确定性、验证、解释智能体对每张眼底图收集证据）+ 学习型失败预测器估计"决策不安全"概率 + 辅助工具仅在期望信息价值超过其成本时调用 + 共形风险控制认证接受阈值；在 RFMiD 测试集上与最低置信度转诊、校准不确定性转诊在相同转诊预算与相同认证安全水平下比较，使用强弱两档 RETFound 主模型（macro-AUROC 0.896 / 0.925）。
AI.result: 弱模型下，验证器分歧提供显著增量信息：20% 预算下捕获 280 例不安全决策中的 119 例（最低置信度转诊为 88 例）；名义 5% 不安全水平下接受率 37.0% vs 10.3%。强模型下验证器在不确定性之外无增益，优势缩小至几个百分点。两种设置下 5% 水平覆盖率均约 37.7%，门控使计算量减少约 30%，质量智能体在多数图像损坏情形下降低不安全接受数。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式证据采集的收益并非普遍成立，而取决于主模型自身不确定性已能揭示多少错误：当不确定性已较充分时，额外验证工具的边际价值有限。

title: MMGraph-Agent: Agentic Multimodal RAG via Cache-Inspired Multimodal Knowledge HyperGraphs
summary: Driven by increasingly complex real-world applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has evolved from textual pipelines to multimodal settings, comprising two complementary dimensions: knowledge organization and retrieval enhancement. However, existing methods still face challenges of high construction cost, context window limitations, and the lack of unified training across offline and online knowledge sources. To address these challenges, we propose MMGraph-Agent, a unified multimodal RAG framework based on cache-inspired multimodal knowledge hypergraphs. MMGraph-Agent enables extremely lightweight hypergraph construction with zero API cost and dynamic memory-based retrieval that alleviates long-context issues. Experiments across offline, online, and joint retrieval settings demonstrate consistent improvements in performance, efficiency, and architectural unification. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/MMGraph-Agent.

AI.tldr: 提出基于缓存启发式多模态知识超图的统一多模态RAG框架MMGraph-Agent，实现零API成本超图构建与动态记忆检索，统一离线与在线知识源。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在三大痛点：高构建成本、上下文窗口限制、离线与在线知识源缺乏统一训练。
AI.method: 以缓存启发的多模态知识超图组织知识，实现极轻量的超图构建（零API调用成本），并采用动态记忆式检索缓解长上下文问题，统一离线与在线检索。
AI.result: 在离线、在线及联合检索设置下均取得性能、效率与架构统一性上的一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: MMGraph-Agent为多模态RAG提供低成本、可扩展的统一解决方案，代码与数据已开源。

title: An LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Modal Chatbot for Tomato Disease Consultant
comment: 14th International Conference on Multidisciplinary Research (ICMR 2026), ISBN: 978-974-474-120-2, Thaksin University Publisher, pp. 37-50, 2026 (Published)
summary: This paper introduces a chatbot developed to assist in diagnosing common diseases in tomato plants through natural language interaction. Users can describe symptoms in text. Then, the chatbot responds with the most likely disease, and basic treatment suggestions and related image-based reasoning. The system leverages pre-trained Mistral and Llama 3.2 large language models. The system is also built using LangChain and Streamlit to provide a lightweight and offline-friendly interface. This work targets to support tomato growers a fast and accessible tomato plant health guidance when the technical expertise is not available nearby, especially in the remote areas. The experimental results are promising and encourage further improvement of the chatbot for future real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个基于自然语言交互的番茄常见病害诊断聊天机器人，利用预训练的Mistral与Llama 3.2大语言模型，结合LangChain与Streamlit构建轻量、可离线运行的界面，面向缺乏技术支持的偏远地区种植者提供快速可及的植株健康指导。
AI.motivation: 番茄种植者，尤其在技术专家难以就近获取的偏远地区，缺乏快速、易得的病害诊断与防治指导渠道，现有方案对用户的技术门槛与网络条件要求较高。
AI.method: 用户以文本描述症状；系统基于预训练的Mistral与Llama 3.2大语言模型进行推理，输出最可能的病害、基础防治建议及相关图像推理；工程上采用LangChain编排流程、Streamlit构建轻量且支持离线的交互界面。
AI.result: 实验结果具有良好前景，验证了该聊天机器人在番茄病害诊断场景中的可行性，并为进一步改进与真实场景部署提供了依据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明基于开源大语言模型的轻量聊天机器人可作为番茄种植者便捷的诊断辅助工具，具备面向真实部署的改进空间。

title: Agentic discrete-event simulation for manufacturing system design: an open 3D simulator, a benchmark and an industrial case
comment: 55 pages, 15 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Manufacturing Systems (special issue AI for Manufacturing). Software: https://github.com/simulean/SimuLean (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23565564)
summary: The design of manufacturing systems relies on discrete-event simulation (DES) models that experts still build in tool-specific interfaces. AI agents can now write simulation code, but every model they write from scratch is new, unverified software. We present SimuLean, an open-source 3D DES simulator on the Unity engine designed to be programmed by AI agents: its modelling semantics are verified once, in the platform, and the agent builds and studies one model through domain-level commands, in the 3D scene or headless; physically simulated durations are calibrated for fast headless studies. We evaluated it on 18 manufacturing modelling tasks, from single machines to published production lines. A frontier agent built valid models in 93 of 108 attempts (86%), in about two minutes each; on the benchmark's interface version, two frontier agents built 105 of 108 models through domain commands alone, so that each comes with a record of how it was built. Every residual failure was silent - a model that builds and runs but answers wrongly - and only comparison with reference models revealed them all. In an industrial case, one agent working alone rebuilt, verified and studied a robotised welding workshop from a published study, in SimuLean and in SimPy. Comparing them with the published, expert-built model exposed an error in it; against the corrected model, the agent-built models agree within 1%. One agent can already build complete, realistic and traceable models for the design of manufacturing systems; independent reference models are what make them trustworthy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SimuLean——一个基于 Unity 的、面向 AI 智能体编程的开源 3D 离散事件仿真（DES）平台，其建模语义在平台层面一次性验证，智能体通过领域级命令构建模型；在 18 个制造建模任务上验证成功率达 86%，但残余失败均为"静默错误"，需借助独立参考模型才能全部发现。
AI.motivation: 传统 DES 模型依赖专家在特定工具界面中手工搭建，而 AI 智能体若从零生成仿真代码，每个模型都是一份未经校验的新软件，具有极高的不可信风险。作者希望把"建模语义验证"从每个模型转移到平台层，使智能体只负责通过领域命令构建与研究生模型，从而兼顾自动化效率与模型可信度。
AI.method: 构建开源 3D DES 仿真器 SimuLean，基于 Unity 引擎，支持在 3D 场景或无头（headless）模式下通过领域级命令编程；平台内一次性验证建模语义；对物理仿真时长进行校准，以支持快速的无头研究。评估使用 18 个制造建模任务（从单机到已发表的产线），由前沿智能体自动建模；并以工业案例（机器人焊接车间）让单一智能体在 SimuLean 与 SimPy 中各重建一个模型，并与已发表专家模型及修正后模型对比。
AI.result: 前沿智能体在 108 次尝试中成功构建 93 个有效模型（86%），平均耗时约 2 分钟；在基准的界面版本上，两个前沿智能体仅通过领域命令构建了 108 个模型中的 105 个，因而每个模型都自带构建过程记录。所有残余失败均为静默错误——模型能构建、能运行，但结果错误，只有与参考模型对比才能全部暴露。工业案例中，智能体独立重建、验证并研究了该焊接车间；与发表模型对比时，反而暴露出原专家模型中的一处错误；与修正后模型相比，智能体所建模型结果误差在 1% 以内。
AI.conclusion: 单一 AI 智能体已能构建完整、真实且可追溯的制造系统设计模型，但模型的可信度依赖独立参考模型进行交叉校验——独立参考模型是使智能体建模结果可被信任的关键。

title: Receiver-Resolution APS-PDP Maps for Wireless Channels: Benchmarking and Coarse-to-Fine Modeling
summary: Angle Power Spectrum (APS) and Power Delay Profile (PDP) are receiver-facing spectra that govern beam selection and wideband equalization. Most ray-tracing benchmarks provide supervision as variable-size multipath component lists. This format does not match practical receivers, whose angular and delay resolutions are limited by array aperture and system bandwidth. As a result, learning targets are ambiguous and evaluations can change with reconstruction conventions. We introduce UrbanADPSMap, a benchmark that converts ray-traced supervision into fixed-grid APS and PDP targets by explicitly modeling bandwidth-limited and aperture-limited response kernels. By fixing the receiver-domain kernels, discretization, and validity mask, UrbanADPSMap removes reconstruction-induced target ambiguity and stabilizes downstream evaluation across methods. Built on this benchmark, we propose SpecFlowAR, a coarse-to-fine generator based on multi-scale autoregressive flow matching. The model first captures coarse dispersion structure and then refines beam-relevant peaks and low-power tails. The number of function evaluations controls the sampling budget, enabling latency and quality to be adjusted for dense spectrum queries. Experiments on the test set show that SpecFlowAR reduces BPL@5 to 2.03 dB under a unified NFE=80 budget, while improving beam utility and reducing errors of 3GPP dispersion statistics.

AI.tldr: 提出 UrbanADPSMap 基准，将射线追踪结果转换为固定网格的角度功率谱（APS）和功率延迟谱（PDP）目标；并基于此提出多尺度自回归流匹配生成模型 SpecFlowAR，实现由粗到细的频谱预测。
AI.motivation: 现有射线追踪基准以可变长度的多径分量列表形式提供监督，与受阵列孔径和系统带宽限制的实际接收机不匹配，导致学习目标存在歧义，评估结果随重建约定变化而不稳定。
AI.method: 构建 UrbanADPSMap：显式建模带宽受限与孔径受限的响应核，固定接收机域核、离散化方式与有效性掩码，将射线追踪监督转为固定网格 APS/PDP 目标。在其上提出 SpecFlowAR：基于多尺度自回归流匹配的由粗到细生成器，先捕捉粗粒度弥散结构，再细化波束相关峰值与低功率尾部；函数评估次数（NFE）控制采样预算以权衡时延与质量。
AI.result: 在统一 NFE=80 预算下，测试集上 BPL@5 降至 2.03 dB，同时提升波束效用并降低 3GPP 弥散统计量误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过固定接收机域核与离散化，UrbanADPSMap 消除了重建导致的目标歧义并稳定跨方法评估；SpecFlowAR 在该基准上以可控采样预算取得更优的频谱预测精度与下游指标。

title: Separation of Skilling Context for Standard Operating Procedure-based Agents
summary: Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are kept concise for human readability, so LLM agents that generate executable skills from them lack the tacit knowledge and implementation details needed for automation. Human intervention fills these gaps, but must be repeated as SOPs evolve---a problem we call \textit{SOP-skill drift}. We propose managing SOPs and Contextual Knowledge (CK) separately, together with a \textit{contract-aware} evaluation that distinguishes genuine violations from CK-resolved differences. On eight Indeed-derived workflows (single LLM), it raises the functional-equivalence rate from 12\% to 58\%. Under three SOP-revision perturbations, previously extracted CK already covers 79.5\% of newly introduced automation gaps.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将SOP与上下文知识（CK）分离管理，并设计契约感知评估以区分真实违规与CK消解差异，缓解"SOP-技能漂移"问题。
AI.motivation: SOP为人类可读而保持简洁，导致LLM agent从中生成的可执行技能缺乏隐性知识与实现细节；人工补齐这些缺口，但SOP演进后需重复干预，形成SOP-skill drift问题。
AI.method: 将SOP与Contextual Knowledge（CK）分开管理，并提出contract-aware评估方法，用于区分真正的规范违规与由CK消解造成的差异；在八个源自Indeed的工作流上以单LLM进行验证，并施加三种SOP修订扰动。
AI.result: 功能等价率从12%提升至58%；在三种SOP修订扰动下，已提取的CK已覆盖新引入自动化缺口的79.5%。
AI.conclusion: SOP与CK分离管理配合契约感知评估可显著提升技能生成的功能等价性，且已提取的CK对SOP变更具有较好的复用与覆盖能力，可减少重复人工干预。

title: Multimodal Models Can See, But Can They Think? A Study of Turkish Visual Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models have had massive leaps in recent years. Yet, when tested on high-level cognitive tasks like pattern completion, abstract logic, and relational reasoning, they still fall short. This limitation stems from the models' lack of ability to find out underlying rules and maintain constant intermediate steps, rather than merely deciding on the correct option. To research these shortcomings, this study analyzes visual reasoning performance throughout a multilingual evaluation framework encompassing the BİLSEM, MM-IQ, Visual Puzzles, and PuzzleVQA datasets. We evaluate various data mixing strategies and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) methods. We observed that a correct answer does not always mean the reasoning chain is valid. Because of this, we adopt an LLM-as-a-Judge approach to assess the quality of reasoning beyond final answer accuracy. Our experimental results reveal that baseline models often exhibit more stable reasoning compared to fine-tuned counterparts. Most importantly, we observe that SFT can lead to model collapse, manifesting as infinite text loops or empty outputs. The study concludes that current VLMs still struggle with abstract visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文在多语言视觉推理基准（BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles、PuzzleVQA）上系统评测视觉语言模型的高阶抽象推理能力，发现正确答案不等于有效推理链，SFT 反而可能引发模型崩溃。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在模式补全、抽象逻辑与关系推理等高阶认知任务上表现不足，其瓶颈在于模型难以提取潜在规则并保持稳定的中间推理步骤，而非仅仅选对选项。作者希望系统刻画这一缺陷。
AI.method: 构建覆盖 BİLSEM、MM-IQ、Visual Puzzles 与 PuzzleVQA 的多语言评测框架；比较多种数据混合策略与监督微调（SFT）方法；除最终答案准确率外，引入 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估推理链质量。
AI.result: 基线模型的推理往往比微调后模型更稳定；正确答案并不总对应有效推理链；SFT 可能导致模型崩溃，表现为无限文本循环或空输出。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在抽象视觉推理上仍存在明显短板，且简单 SFT 未必带来推理能力提升，甚至可能损害生成稳定性；评测应超越答案准确率、关注推理过程质量。

title: ATHENA: Hypergraph-Based Learning for Toddler Autism Classification from Eye-Tracking
summary: In this work we proposed a architecture designed for the classification of ASD in toddlers using eye-tracking data, addressing the critical need for early and precise detection. The proposed model incorporates FMMix, a feature-level augmentation technique that bolsters the model's learning capacity, and in this work we proposed the ATHENA, which captures intricate feature relationships via an adaptive hypergraph framework. Evaluated on two datasets dataset of gaze coordinates-the model achieves state-of-the-art performance, with AUC scores of 99.80% and 99.86%, respectively. It also exhibits high accuracy of 98.45% and 98.56%, sensitivity 98.01% and 98.10%, and specificity 98.74% and 99.02%, respectively. Demonstrating its superior ability to identify subtle gaze patterns associated with ASD, these results significantly surpass existing methods, highlighting the model's potential for clinical ASD screening. Future efforts will focus on validation across broader populations and integration with multi-modal data to further refine diagnostic accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出面向幼儿ASD分类的眼动数据架构，结合特征级增强FMMix与自适应超图框架ATHENA，在两个凝视坐标数据集上取得AUC 99.80%/99.86%、准确率98.45%/98.56%的SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: ASD的早期精准检测存在迫切临床需求，而眼动数据中与ASD相关的凝视模式较为细微，需要更强的关系建模与数据增强能力来提升识别效果。
AI.method: 构建面向幼儿ASD分类的深度架构：引入FMMix进行特征级数据增强以提升模型学习能力；提出ATHENA，通过自适应超图（hypergraph）框架捕捉复杂的高阶特征关系。
AI.result: 在两个凝视坐标数据集上：AUC分别为99.80%与99.86%，准确率98.45%与98.56%，敏感度98.01%与98.10%，特异度98.74%与99.02%，均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该模型能有效识别与ASD相关的细微凝视模式，具备临床ASD筛查潜力；后续将开展更广泛人群验证并融合多模态数据以进一步提升诊断精度。

title: No Second Run: Does RSI Stop at Frontier Pre-training?
summary: Pre-training is where every foundation model begins; bringing recursive self-improvement (RSI) there would let AI improve the process that creates AI. Yet public RSI work has so far targeted only post-training, which starts from an existing base model, runs trials costing GPU-hours, and returns verifiable scores. Pre-training breaks all three conditions at orders-of-magnitude higher cost: a run consumes hundreds of thousands of GPU-hours over months and cannot be repeated; its objective, post-training headroom, cannot be read off any single score; and what must improve is not a model but the whole production system, from data pipelines and training infrastructure to the teams that run them. To our knowledge, we are the first to apply RSI to an entire frontier pre-training run from scratch and to report it in detail. RSI does not stop at frontier pre-training, but it changes form: since no end-to-end loop can close over a single unrepeatable run, we decompose it into smaller loops that can, each repairing a step the full run breaks. The result is 801-30B-A3B-Base, a 30B-A3B MoE trained from scratch on 11.8T tokens in three months by a newly formed team. We release it as a base model; the lightweight SFT reported here (6B tokens, no RL) only probes post-training headroom. As a base model, 801-30B-A3B outperforms Qwen3-30B-A3B and Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B, trailing only the larger Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and keeps this position under identical SFT; with lightweight SFT alone, it achieves the highest average on four agentic benchmarks against fully post-trained models, including Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Since post-training RSI presupposes a strong base model, bringing RSI into pre-training acts on the foundation every later stage builds on. We open-source 801-30B-A3B-Base and the lightweight SFT data at https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/801-30B .

AI.tldr: 该文首次将递归自我改进（RSI）应用于从零开始的完整前沿预训练过程，通过将不可闭合的单次大循环分解为多个可闭合的小循环，构建出801-30B-A3B-Base（30B-A3B MoE，11.8T tokens，三个月），其基座性能超越同规模Qwen3-30B-A3B与Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B，并开源模型与轻量SFT数据。
AI.motivation: 既有公开的RSI工作仅针对后训练：从已有基座出发、以GPU小时级试验反复试错、并获得可验证分数。而预训练在三方面根本不同——成本高出数量级（数十万GPU小时、耗时数月、不可重复）、优化目标（后训练提升空间）无法由单一分数读出、需要改进的是包含数据管线、训练基础设施与团队在内的整个生产系统。由于后训练RSI本身就依赖强基座模型，将RSI引入预训练可作用于所有后续阶段所依赖的基础。
AI.method: 提出RSI在预训练中的"形态转换"：由于端到端闭环无法跨越一次不可重复的运行闭合，将其分解为多个能独立闭合的小循环，每个小循环修复完整运行中某一无法反复验证的环节（数据管线、训练基础设施、团队流程等）。以一个新建团队从零训练30B-A3B MoE模型，消耗11.8T tokens、历时三个月；随后仅用6B tokens、无RL的轻量SFT探测后训练提升空间。
AI.result: 801-30B-A3B-Base作为基座模型优于Qwen3-30B-A3B与Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B，仅落后于规模更大的Qwen3.5-35B-A3B；在相同SFT协议下位次保持不变；仅用轻量SFT时，在四个智能体基准上的平均分超过完成完整后训练的模型（含Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）。
AI.conclusion: RSI可延伸至前沿预训练但需改变实现形态，即以可闭合的子循环替代不可复现的端到端大循环；该范式在新建团队与有限算力条件下产出具备强基座竞争力的模型，说明作用于预训练基础的RSI对后续所有阶段具有放大效应。模型与轻量SFT数据已开源。

title: PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 46 pages. Code: https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom
summary: Reinforcement-learning-trained agents for retrieval-augmented generation retrieve content (passages, knowledge-graph fragments, or hyperedges) and supervise training with outcome rewards on the final answer. Across these paradigms the reasoning route through retrieved content never leaves the language model's hidden state, conflating declarative knowledge with the procedural knowledge that recurs across queries of the same logical type; content-only methods consequently plateau as reasoning depth grows. We introduce PatternBloom, an agentic RAG framework that shifts the unit of retrieval from content (what to read) to logic (how to reason). A first RL stage scores the agent's constructed evidence graph by a frozen oracle's information gain through the Information-Density Reward (IDR), a size-normalized mutual-information surrogate. High-reward trajectories are distilled into a Graph Pattern Memory (GPM) of type-abstracted reasoning skeletons, and a second RL stage uses the Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) to couple policy to memory, turning procedural reasoning into a learnable, externalized structural prior. A 7B PatternBloom outperforms $27$ baselines by $+15.0$ Avg-OOD EM, with the gain compounding with reasoning depth precisely because procedural knowledge, once distilled, is reused rather than re-derived at every query. We release our code at https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom.

AI.tldr: PatternBloom将RAG的检索单元从"内容"转向"逻辑"：用信息密度奖励(IDR)训练第一阶段强化学习筛选高信息增益证据图，蒸馏出图模式记忆(GPM)，再以模式增强奖励(PAR)进行第二阶段RL使策略与记忆耦合；7B模型在OOD上平均EM超越27个基线15.0，且增益随推理深度递增。
AI.motivation: 现有RL训练RAG智能体（检索段落、知识图谱片段或超边）仅以最终答案的结果奖励监督，推理路径始终局限于语言模型隐状态中，将声明性知识与跨同类逻辑查询可复用的程序性知识混为一谈，导致纯内容方法随推理深度增加而性能停滞。
AI.method: 提出PatternBloom智能体式RAG框架。第一阶段RL：由冻结oracle的信息增益对智能体构建的证据图打分，采用尺寸归一化的互信息代理指标——信息密度奖励(IDR)；将高奖励轨迹蒸馏为类型抽象的推理骨架，构成图模式记忆(GPM)。第二阶段RL：使用模式增强奖励(PAR)将策略与记忆耦合，把程序性推理外化为可学习的结构先验。
AI.result: 7B规模的PatternBloom在OOD平均EM上超过27个基线15.0个百分点，且增益随推理深度增加而复合增长，原因是蒸馏后的程序性知识被复用而非每次查询重新推导。
AI.conclusion: 将检索单元由内容转向逻辑、并把可复用推理模式作为外部化结构先验，是突破RAG智能体深度推理瓶颈的有效途径；代码已开源。

title: Decentralised Drone Swarm Formation under Silent Failures with ACO Pheromone Claims and PSO Tuning
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 22 tables. Code, browser demo and raw results are included as ancillary files
summary: We study decentralised drone formation, without a central planner, under the conditions that make it hard: nobody knows how many drones are alive, failures are silent, radio is short-ranged and lossy, and actuation is noisy. In our controller, ant colony optimisation (ACO) allocates drones to picture positions through claims that behave as reinforced, evaporating pheromone and are gossiped between neighbours, so evaporation doubles as failure detection. A particle swarm optimisation (PSO) law flies the drones, a noise-buffered Voronoi filter keeps them apart, and PSO also tunes the controller offline. We prove that claims of destroyed drones vanish within bounded time, that conflicts between drones that exchange tables are resolved consistently, that survivors cover the picture to within a factor of two, and that drones cannot collide while their safety cells are feasible. On held-out seeds and with two tuned configurations, the controller formed the picture in 95-99% of runs in the hardest regime, restored it after a silent loss of half the swarm in 96-100% of runs at normal difficulty, transferred unchanged to eight unseen shapes and to 300 drones, and overlapped in 5 of 21,088 runs. A CBBA-style baseline that shares the evaporating claims but uses argmax without swaps was at least as reliable as ours once tuned with the same budget, and repaired faster, whereas ours generalised better to unseen shapes. The benefit thus comes from the pheromone dynamics and from tuning, not from ACO's stochastic construction or PSO's social terms. A centralised oracle is faster.

AI.tldr: 提出无中心规划者的去中心化无人机编队控制器：ACO式"信息素声明"分配+PSO飞行律+噪声缓冲Voronoi避碰，在通信短距丢包、静默故障、执行噪声条件下实现95–99%成形率，并给出有界时间收敛与两倍覆盖保证。
AI.motivation: 在"难条件"下研究去中心化编队：无人知晓存活数量、故障静默、无线短距且丢包、执行有噪声，且不允许中心规划者。这类条件下传统集中式分配与显式故障检测不可行，需要一种把分配、故障检测与避碰统一内嵌于局部交互的机制。
AI.method: 控制器由三部分组成：(1) ACO式分配——无人机通过"声明(claim)"竞争图形位置，声明表现为强化且随时间挥发的信息素，并在邻居间 gossip 传播，挥发本身兼作故障检测；(2) PSO 飞行律驱动机体，并以噪声缓冲的 Voronoi 过滤保证间隔；(3) PSO 亦用于离线参数整定。理论部分证明：被毁无人机的声明在有界时间内消失；交换表的无人机间冲突一致消解；幸存者对图形覆盖误差不超过 2 倍；安全单元可行时不会碰撞。实验在留出随机种子与两套调参配置下评测，并做消融（去掉 ACO 随机构造与 PSO 社会项）与 CBBA 式基线（共享挥发声明但用 argmax 无交换）对比。
AI.result: 最难场景下 95–99% 运行成功成形；常规难度下静默损失半数集群后 96–100% 运行恢复；零改动迁移到 8 个未见形状与 300 机规模；21,088 次运行中仅 5 次重叠。CBBA 式基线在同预算调参后可靠性不低于本文方法且修复更快，但本文方法对未见形状泛化更好。收尾出现 5 次重叠，说明理论无碰撞保证在有限缓冲/离散步长下有前提；集中式 oracle 更快。
AI.conclusion: 性能来源被归因于"信息素动力学（强化-挥发-gossip）"与"参数整定"，而非 ACO 的随机构造或 PSO 的社会项；挥发式声明是兼作故障检测的关键抽象。方法在鲁棒性、可扩展性与形状迁移上表现良好，但相较同预算调参的 CBBA 式基线无可靠性优势，且速度不及集中式 oracle。

title: BunshinRL: Splitting Live Agent Workspaces for Memory-Efficient Agentic RL
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) rollouts interleave model reasoning with tool calls in persistent workspaces. Scaling these rollouts incurs substantial memory costs for concurrent environments, while slow tool calls delay entire rollout batches. We present BunshinRL, an agentic RL rollout system that exploits shared environment state and recurring tool calls through three techniques: memory sharing across environments, tool-prefix caching, and speculative tool execution. These techniques build on BunshinFork, a novel live whole-workspace forking mechanism for containers. BunshinFork reconstructs process trees, shares memory copy-on-write, and preserves file, communication, and GUI state, enabling cached-state reuse and rollback after incorrect speculation. We implement BunshinRL and BunshinFork through Linux kernel module and CRIU modifications. BunshinRL reduces peak memory by up to 43%, total memory consumption by up to 51%, and end-to-end rollout latency by 23%.

AI.tldr: BunshinRL是一个面向智能体强化学习rollout的系统，基于容器全工作区实时fork机制BunshinFork，通过环境间内存共享、工具前缀缓存和投机式工具执行三种技术，降低内存开销与延迟。
AI.motivation: 智能体RL rollout在持久工作区中交替进行模型推理与工具调用。扩展这类rollout时，并发环境带来巨大内存开销，而缓慢的工具调用又会拖慢整批rollout，现有系统缺乏对共享环境状态与重复工具调用的有效利用。
AI.method: 提出BunshinRL rollout系统及BunshinFork机制。BunshinFork通过重建进程树、写时复制共享内存、保留文件/通信/GUI状态，实现容器级全工作区实时fork，从而支持缓存状态复用与错误投机后的回滚。在此之上实现三项技术：跨环境内存共享、工具前缀缓存、投机式工具执行。系统通过Linux内核模块与CRIU改造实现。
AI.result: 峰值内存最多降低43%，总内存消耗最多降低51%，端到端rollout延迟降低23%。
AI.conclusion: 利用共享环境状态与重复工具调用的系统级优化，可有效缓解智能体RL rollout的扩展性瓶颈，容器级实时fork是支撑这些优化的关键基础机制。

title: DiSARM: Diverse and Surprising Association Rule Mining with Large Language Models
summary: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) aims to discover informative patterns in large datasets. For transactional data, Association Rule Mining (ARM) is an established approach that facilitates EDA by efficiently generating candidate patterns. Beyond efficient mining, identifying informative rules has also been extensively studied through both objective and subjective interestingness measures. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for assessing subjective interestingness using world knowledge. Nevertheless, relying solely on LLMs raises concerns about scalability and statistical reliability. Building on prior ARM research, we propose a hybrid framework, DiSARM, that leverages the world knowledge of LLMs to assess the subjective interestingness of rules, while maintaining statistical reliability and promoting diversity among the selected rules. Across three transactional datasets, experiments demonstrate that DiSARM effectively combines statistical reliability with surprise and diversity, offering a promising approach to ADE from transactional data.

AI.tldr: DiSARM：结合大语言模型世界观知识与关联规则挖掘的混合框架，用于评估交易数据中规则的主观趣味性，兼顾统计可靠性与多样性。
AI.motivation: 关联规则挖掘（ARM）已能高效生成候选模式，规则趣味性也已有客观与主观度量研究；LLM 的世界知识为评估主观趣味性（惊讶度）提供了新机会，但仅依赖 LLM 存在可扩展性与统计可靠性方面的隐忧。
AI.method: 提出混合框架 DiSARM，沿用既有 ARM 研究基础，利用 LLM 的世界知识评估规则的主观趣味性（surprise），同时保持统计可靠性并促进所选规则之间的多样性。
AI.result: 在三个交易数据集上的实验表明，DiSARM 能有效将统计可靠性与惊讶度、多样性结合起来。
AI.conclusion: DiSARM 为从交易数据开展探索性数据分析（EDA）提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: Conformal Fair Decoding for Large Language Model Recommenders
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate personalized recommendations without task-specific training, but changing a protected attribute while holding interaction history fixed can alter the semantic content of recommended items. We study fairness control when model weights and full-vocabulary logits are unavailable. We propose Fair- Rec, an item-level decoding framework that uses an offline-calibrated semantic-disparity threshold and controls candidate selection as recommendation lists are generated. A hard variant filters candidates against the threshold; a soft variant trades off candidate likelihood and disparity while adapting a penalty using observed violations. Under an explicit uniform enforceability assumption, we establish a pathwise O(1/T) upper bound on the excess empirical violation rate of the soft decoder. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and Amazon Movies & TV using Qwen3-8B and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct show that the soft variant lowers measured counterfactual disparity relative to zero- =shot recommendation, UP5, and FACTER, while retaining competitive HR@10 and NDCG@10.

AI.tldr: 提出Fair-Rec：在无法获取模型权重与全词表logits的黑箱条件下，用离线校准的语义差异阈值对LLM推荐进行条目级解码控制，实现反事实公平，且不牺牲推荐精度。
AI.motivation: LLM可零样本生成个性化推荐，但在固定交互历史下改变受保护属性会改变推荐条目的语义内容，产生反事实不公平；而实际部署中往往无法访问模型权重和全词表logits，现有方法难以适用。
AI.method: 提出条目级解码框架Fair-Rec，采用离线校准的语义差异阈值，在推荐列表生成过程中控制候选选择。硬变体按阈值过滤候选；软变体在候选似然与语义差异间做权衡，并依据观测到的违规自适应调整惩罚项。在显式均匀可执行性假设下，给出软解码器经验违规率超额部分的pathwise O(1/T)上界。
AI.result: 在MovieLens-1M与Amazon Movies & TV上，使用Qwen3-8B与Llama3.1-8B-Instruct实验表明：软变体相比零样本推荐、UP5和FACTER降低了实测反事实差异，同时保持有竞争力的HR@10与NDCG@10。
AI.conclusion: Fair-Rec证明可在黑箱、仅需解码接口的约束下实现有效的推荐公平控制，软解码器兼具理论收敛保证与实证效果，为LLM推荐的公平后处理提供了可行方案。

title: Adversarial Evaluation of Large Language Models for Patient-Friendly Radiology Report Summarization
comment: This work has been submitted to Radiology: Artificial Intelligence for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary:
Purpose: To develop and validate a scalable adversarial evaluation framework for assessing the robustness of large language models (LLMs) that generate patient-friendly summaries of radiology reports.
  Methods: We introduced a clinically grounded adversarial framework that uses controlled term substitutions and impression removals across intensity levels. Using a radiologist-validated adversarial dictionary, we generated adversarial variants of CT and MRI reports. Six LLMs summarized original and adversarial impressions using 2 prompt styles, yielding 18,000 evaluation pairs. Robustness was evaluated with an automated LLM-as-a-judge framework scoring factual faithfulness, sensitivity to adversarial edits, certainty fidelity, and hallucination rate. Failure mode analysis quantified vulnerabilities in incorporating clinical modifiers. Agreement with two radiologists was assessed on 105 cases.
  Results: GPT-5-mini achieved the highest factual faithfulness and certainty fidelity under both adversarial edits. Under term substitution, hallucinations occurred in 28.1-30.1% of GPT-5-mini summaries, compared with 35.3-36.4% for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and 41.4-41.9% for MedGemma. Impression-removal edits were handled more robustly than term substitutions. Even for the highest-scoring summarizer, substitutions of anatomical terms were not reflected in 23.7% of summaries, diagnostic certainty in 22.3%, and descriptor terms (e.g., "substantial") in 21.2%. Judge-radiologist agreement (macro-F1: 0.55-0.56) was comparable to inter-radiologist agreement (0.53).
  Conclusions: Adversarial evaluation exposes clinically meaningful failure modes, including missed anatomical modifiers, altered diagnostic certainty, and omitted severity descriptors.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个临床相关的对抗性评测框架，通过受控术语替换与"印象"内容删除来检验LLM生成放射报告患者友好摘要的稳健性，发现即使最佳模型（GPT-5-mini）仍存在显著的临床相关失败模式。
AI.motivation: LLM被用于生成放射报告的患者友好摘要，但其面对临床关键修饰语扰动（解剖术语、诊断确定性、严重程度描述词）时的稳健性缺乏系统性、可扩展的评估手段。
AI.method: 提出临床落地的对抗框架：基于放射科医师验证的对抗词典，对CT与MRI报告的"印象"部分进行多强度层级的受控术语替换与印象删除；6个LLM×2种提示风格×原始/对抗版本共生成18,000对评测样本；采用LLM-as-a-judge自动评分事实忠实性、对抗编辑敏感性、确定性保真度与幻觉率，并进行失败模式分析与双放射科医师一致性校验（105例）。
AI.result: GPT-5-mini在两类对抗编辑下事实忠实性与确定性保真度最高；术语替换下其幻觉率为28.1–30.1%，Claude Sonnet 4.5为35.3–36.4%，MedGemma为41.4–41.9%。印象删除类编辑的稳健性优于术语替换。即便最优模型，仍有23.7%摘要遗漏解剖术语替换、22.3%遗漏诊断确定性、21.2%遗漏描述词（如"substantial"）。评判者与放射科医师一致性（macro-F1 0.55–0.56）与放射科医师间一致性（0.53）相当。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性评测可揭示具有临床意义的失败模式，包括漏失解剖修饰语、改变诊断确定性及省略严重程度描述词；该框架可作为LLM放射报告摘要稳健性的可扩展评测工具。

title: What Is the Value of AI-Involved Art? Evidence From a Juried In-Person Exhibition
summary: What is the value of AI-involved art, and to whom does it belong? We begin to answer these questions using data from an in-person, juried AI art exhibition. Our study involved artists, lawyers, and computer scientists (N=209) as either creators or evaluators of AI-involved artworks. We found that nearly half of evaluators reported willingness to buy an artwork, with pricing correlating with perceived artistic value---creativity and visual appeal---as well as the effort necessary to create it. In contrast, three-quarters of creators reported willingness to sell at prices correlating only with effort rather than artistic value. Both groups viewed prompting users and AI developers as deserving rewards and rights, leaving training data artists behind. Disciplinary training shaped these views: participants with legal training favored distributed reward models. These findings have implications for future research on human-AI creative collaboration and policy debates regarding AI-involved works.

AI.tldr: 基于一项线下评审制AI艺术展的实证研究（N=209，含创作者与评估者），考察AI参与艺术品的价值来源与归属：评估者购买意愿与"艺术价值（创造力、视觉吸引力）+创作投入"相关，创作者出售意愿仅与投入相关；双方都认为提示词用户与AI开发者应获回报与权利，却忽视训练数据艺术家；法学训练者更倾向分布式回报模型。
AI.motivation: AI参与艺术品的价值如何界定、权利应归属何人尚缺乏实证依据，本文试图用真实展览场景的数据回答这一价值与归属问题。
AI.method: 采用线下、评审制（juried）AI艺术展作为研究场景，招募艺术家、律师与计算机科学家（N=209），分别作为作品的创作者或评估者参与；收集其购买/出售意愿与定价、对作品艺术价值（创造力、视觉吸引力）与创作投入的感知，以及对各类主体（提示词用户、AI开发者、训练数据艺术家）应得回报与权利的看法，并比较不同学科训练背景的差异。
AI.result: 近半数评估者表示愿意购买，其定价与感知艺术价值（创造力、视觉吸引力）及创作所需投入相关；四分之三的创作者表示愿意出售，但其价格仅与投入相关而与艺术价值无关。两类群体均认为提示词用户与AI开发者应获回报与权利，而将训练数据艺术家排除在外。学科训练影响判断：具法律训练背景者更支持分布式回报模型。
AI.conclusion: AI参与艺术品的估值存在"供需不对称"：买方按艺术价值+投入定价，卖方仅按投入定价；权利归属认知则系统性忽视训练数据贡献者。研究为人机创意协作的后续研究与AI生成作品的政策讨论提供了实证依据。

title: META-IR: Meta-Introspective Reasoning for Adaptive Safety Alignment in LLM
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Multimedia & Expo (ICME 2026), Bangkok, Thailand. Source code: https://github.com/Miraj-Rahman-AI/Meta-IR. Supplementary material is included in the ancillary files
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks and harmful-content prompts, particularly under adversarial distribution shifts where static alignment pipelines fail to generalize. Although introspective methods such as STAIR strengthen refusal consistency, they depend on fixed self-evaluation policies that cannot rapidly adapt to evolving manipulation strategies. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces META-IR, a meta-introspective reasoning framework that enhances safety alignment through meta-learning-driven adaptation. It employs a dual-loop architecture: an inner introspective loop that performs structured risk analysis, self-assessment, and reflective correction via SI-MCTS, and an outer meta-learning loop that optimizes the introspection policy across diverse jailbreak task families to enable rapid generalization to unseen attacks. A dynamic jailbreak simulation module further exposes the model to progressively harder adversarial prompts, enabling continual self-improvement without human supervision. Experiments across multiple models (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2-7B-Instruct) and a broad suite of safety, helpfulness, generalization, and introspection metrics demonstrate that META-IR substantially improves adaptation speed, robustness, and reasoning stability compared with all baseline models. These results establish META-IR as an effective pathway toward building LLMs capable of sustained, adaptive safety alignment under dynamic and evolving threat environments.

AI.tldr: 提出META-IR元内省推理框架，用双层元学习架构提升LLM对越狱攻击的适应性与安全对齐鲁棒性。
