AI.motivation: LLM在对抗性分布偏移下仍易受越狱与有害内容提示攻击，静态对齐流程难以泛化；STAIR等内省方法依赖固定的自评估策略，无法快速适应不断演化的操纵手段。
AI.method: 双层架构：内层内省循环通过SI-MCTS进行结构化风险分析、自我评估与反思纠正；外层元学习循环在多样化的越狱任务族上优化内省策略，以实现对未见攻击的快速泛化；并引入动态越狱模拟模块，逐步施加更难对抗提示，实现无人工监督的持续自我改进。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与Qwen-2-7B-Instruct上，基于安全、有用性、泛化与内省等多类指标，META-IR相较所有基线显著提升适应速度、鲁棒性与推理稳定性。
AI.conclusion: META-IR为在动态演化威胁环境下构建具备持续、自适应安全对齐能力的LLM提供了有效路径。

title: LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving
summary: LoRA offers a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy, supporting multi-user workloads via customized adapters on a shared backbone. However, serving concurrent requests with different adapters introduces substantial computation and memory-management overhead. We ask the research question: Do all requests need their adapters throughout the whole generation process? Our motivational study reveals that employing LoRA adapters at every decoding step is unnecessary, releasing them early has limited impact on accuracy while substantially accelerating generation. Although skipping adapters early offers theoretical workload reduction, translating these computational savings into concrete throughput gains requires tailored GPU kernels. We present LoRazor, a multi-LoRA serving framework that combines early adapter release with active-row aware GPU kernels. LoRazor determines when to permanently release a request's adapter and continue decoding with the backbone alone. By dynamically resizing LoRA kernel launches as adapters are released, LoRazor trims idle GPU blocks. Across two backbones and four tasks, LoRazor achieves up to 3.02x request throughput and 2.53x output-token throughput over vLLM multi-LoRA, with a mean relative task-accuracy decrease of 2.89%.

AI.tldr: 提出LoRazor多LoRA服务框架，通过在生成过程中"提前释放适配器"并配合活跃行感知GPU内核，显著提升并发生成吞吐。
AI.motivation: 多用户并发服务中，不同LoRA适配器在共享主干上带来显著的计算与显存管理开销；作者质疑"整个生成过程是否都需要适配器"，动机研究显示早期释放适配器对精度影响有限但能大幅加速生成，然而将理论省下的计算转化为实际吞吐收益需要定制GPU内核。
AI.method: LoRazor判定何时永久释放某请求的适配器、之后仅用主干继续解码；并设计活跃行感知（active-row aware）的GPU内核，随着适配器释放动态调整LoRA内核启动规模，裁剪空闲GPU block。
AI.result: 在两个主干模型、四项任务上，相比vLLM multi-LoRA实现最高3.02倍请求吞吐、2.53倍输出token吞吐，任务精度平均相对下降2.89%。
AI.conclusion: 生成过程无需全程使用LoRA适配器，早期释放配合内核级优化可将计算节省转化为显著服务吞吐提升，且精度损失可控。

title: ScreenProof: Where Is This Screen Wrong? Finding UI Faults Without a Reference
summary: A phone screen can be wrong in ways that need no reference: a label that runs off the screen, letters that touch, a line that breaks one character before its end, one button with sharp corners among round ones. We ask whether a model can box every such fault on a screenshot, given no target design and no reference image. Such a critic could serve as a cheap first pass over generated pages before a designer reviews them, but only if it stays silent on clean pages. ScreenProof poses this target-free critique over three families of faults: general faults, local style faults (one element breaks the style its page sets) and text layout faults (letter spacing, line height, line breaks). A data engine makes each fault in page code and records the changed element's box, and hard negatives change every sibling alike. No frontier judge is reliable: frontier models flag 18-62% of clean real screenshots and 18-82% of clean generated pages, find 47-72% of text layout faults, and rarely find a foreign icon (5-19%). Our small critic ProofJudge (Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA), trained on code-made pages with one to four faults each and keeping a finding only when it is confident, reaches F1 0.48, the highest of all judges (Gemini 4 Argon 0.37; open models at most 0.15; 0.46 even without the confidence cut), and is the only fault-finding judge within 15% false alarms on clean pages (2% real, 9% generated), the property such a first pass needs, at about a hundredth of Argon's cost. It finds the most general faults (59%) but fewer local style faults than Argon (25% against 41%) and fewer text layout faults than the API judges (43%; Gemini 4 Argon 47%). Against a named brand the task is harder still: models know a design language about as well as its public documentation states it.

AI.tldr: 提出无需参考设计的界面截图缺陷检测基准ScreenProof及小模型批评器ProofJudge，在保持低误报的同时取得最高F1。
AI.motivation: 手机截图的许多缺陷（标签溢出、字符粘连、断行差一字符、圆角按钮中混入直角按钮）无需目标设计稿即可判定。此类"无参考批评器"可作为设计评审前的廉价初筛，但前提是对干净页面保持沉默（低误报）。现有前沿模型判官不可靠。
AI.method: 构建ScreenProof基准，覆盖三类缺陷：通用缺陷、局部风格缺陷（单个元素违背页面自身风格）、文本排版缺陷（字距、行高、断行）。通过数据引擎在页面代码中注入缺陷并记录被改动元素的边界框；并构造"硬负样本"——整组同级元素同步改变以消除可辨识信号。训练小模型ProofJudge（Qwen3.5-9B + LoRA），在每页含1–4个缺陷的代码生成页上训练，并仅在置信时保留检出结果（置信度截断）。
AI.result: 前沿判官均不可靠：在干净真实截图与生成页上误报率分别达18–62%与18–82%，文本排版缺陷召回仅47–72%，外域图标仅5–19%。ProofJudge达到F1 0.48（Gemini 4 Argon 0.37，开源模型≤0.15；去掉置信截断仍有0.46），是唯一在干净页面上误报率低于15%的缺陷判官（真实页2%，生成页9%），成本约为Argon的1/100。其通用缺陷召回最高（59%），但局部风格缺陷（25% vs 41%）与文本排版缺陷（43% vs 47%）弱于Argon/API判官。
AI.conclusion: 无参考截图批评可行，且小模型配合置信度截断即可满足初筛所需的低误报特性；但在面向特定品牌时任务更难，模型对设计语言的掌握程度仅相当于其公开文档所述水平。

title: Approximate Recall, Approximate Forecasts: Recall as a Diagnostic for LLM Forecasting Errors
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures (including appendix). Accepted as a Spotlight at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit approximate recall: they retain coarse associations about past events while losing fidelity on specific details. Past research on LLMs has quantified different models' forecasting ability in real-world events using prediction markets, but has not studied how losing said fidelity impacts their forecasting abilities. For example: while an LLM correctly recalls that the answer to: ''Did Anna Sawai win the Best Drama Actress in the 76th Emmy Awards?'' is ''Yes,'' it incorrectly states the event date as September 22 rather than September 15. In this paper, we introduce a novel metric called the Recall Fidelity Score to study how imprecision in internalized knowledge propagates to forecasting capability on future events. On resolved historical markets, we find that higher local recall fidelity around semantically similar past events predicts lower forecasting error on resolved markets, and the same signal predicts smaller distance from open markets prices.

AI.tldr: 提出"回忆保真度分数"(Recall Fidelity Score)，量化LLM内部知识中细节的不精确性如何传播并影响其对未来事件的预测能力。
AI.motivation: LLM具有"近似回忆"特性：保留对往事的粗略联想，却在具体细节上失真。已有研究用预测市场衡量LLM的预测能力，但尚未探究细节失真的程度如何影响预测表现，本文填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出新指标 Recall Fidelity Score，用于度量语义相似历史事件周边局部回忆的保真度；在已结算的历史预测市场数据上，检验该局部保真度与预测误差、以及与开放市场价格偏离度的关系。
AI.result: 在已结算历史市场上，语义相似以往事件周围更高的局部回忆保真度可预测更低的预测误差；同一信号也预测其预测值与开放市场价格之间更小的距离。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部知识细节的保真度可外溢为预测能力的可靠预测因子，Recall Fidelity Score可作为评估与诊断LLM预测表现的有效信号。

title: ProofDiff: Auditable Argument-Level Comparison of AI-Generated Mathematical Proofs
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. An earlier version of this work was accepted by the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding. Code and artifacts are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23930759
summary:
Mathematical understanding depends on the route from hypotheses to conclusion: how the parts of a proof function and which dependencies carry the argument forward. This structure can persist when wording or notation changes, while a small alteration to a hypothesis or inference can produce a different argument beneath similar prose. Formal verification can establish that a rewrite proves the same theorem, but not whether it follows the same mathematical route. Comparing informal proofs, especially those produced or revised by generative models, therefore requires reconstructing which claims, dependencies, and reasoning steps are preserved, reorganized, or replaced.
  We present ProofDiff, a system for comparing informal mathematical documents. It is designed to support human review, not to certify mathematical correctness. Given two documents, ProofDiff independently constructs a source-grounded argument map for each and proposes correspondences between the resulting maps. Each map captures the document's claims and reasoning steps and records the typed relations that connect them. An integrated human-review layer allows reviewers to revise the maps and correspondences while preserving an auditable history. Comparing the two argument maps provides a basis for inspecting whether the documents follow the same mathematical route and where their claims or dependencies differ. We demonstrate ProofDiff on four illustrative pairs of AI-generated proofs, ranging from a detailed proof and its concise revision to proofs using different mathematical strategies.

AI.tldr: ProofDiff 通过为两份非形式数学文档分别构建"论证地图"并对其做对应匹配，支持人工审查两份证明是否沿同一数学路线、哪些主张与依赖被保留或替换。
AI.motivation: 数学理解依赖从假设到结论的论证路线：证明各部分如何发挥作用、哪些依赖推动论证。该结构可在措辞或记号变化时保持，而假设或推理的微小改动会在相似表述下产生不同论证。形式化验证只能确认改写后证明同一定理，无法判断是否沿同一数学路线；比较（尤其是生成模型产出或修改的）非形式证明因此需要重建主张、依赖与推理步骤的保留/重组/替换情况。
AI.method: 提出 ProofDiff 系统：对给定两份文档，各自独立构建基于原文的论证地图（argument map），捕获文档的主张与推理步骤，并记录连接它们的类型化关系（typed relations）；随后在两张地图间提出对应关系（correspondences）。系统内置人工审查层，允许审查者修改地图与对应关系并保留可审计的历史记录。系统定位为辅助人工审查，而非认证数学正确性。
AI.result: 在两份论证地图之间进行比较，可为检查两文档是否遵循同一数学路线、以及其主张或依赖在何处不同提供依据。作者在四组示例性 AI 生成证明对上演示了 ProofDiff，涵盖从详细证明到其精简修订版、以及采用不同数学策略的证明等情形。
AI.conclusion: ProofDiff 提供了面向非形式数学文档的结构化比较与可审计的人工审查流程，能够揭示表面相似文本下的论证路线差异，适用于评估生成模型产出或修订的证明。

title: TimeHF 2.0: Multimodal, Multivariate, and Multi-Region Collaborative Forecasting for Large-Scale Retail Supply Chains
summary: Large-scale retail supply chains need sales forecasts for specified products, future dates or planning windows, and regions under the conditions available at the forecast origin. Regional sparsity, changing environments, volatile sales, and unfamiliar business situations make these dimensions difficult to model together. We introduce TimeHF 2.0, a multimodal, multivariate, and multi-region collaborative forecasting framework that makes flexibly expressed business knowledge usable in numerical prediction. A coverage-aware directed encoder integrates regional sales and applicable covariates. A semantic alignment module transfers language-model hidden representations of natural-language plans and domain experience into target-specific forecasting context. Learning against sales observations connects these meanings to numerical evidence, allowing business users to supply experience, future plans, and changing circumstances without defining a new numerical feature for each description. Text-conditioned future queries and shared/routed experts adapt prediction to the supplied context. An ordered-distribution head allocates fine resolution to routine fluctuations and coarse resolution to extreme sales movements, while daily/window learning connects forecasts to cumulative planning quantities. Online parallel forecasting at JD yields relative accuracy improvements of 18.25% and 17.94% for national daily and planning-window sales, and 19.44% and 18.99% for DC daily and planning-window sales, over the original production deep learning baseline. Component comparisons, loss-design results, and product-type analyses examine the roles of regional information, covariates, business knowledge, context-dependent processing, and robust planning-oriented learning.

AI.tldr: 提出TimeHF 2.0多模态、多变量、多区域协同预测框架，将自然语言形式的业务知识注入数值销量预测，并在京东线上取得显著相对精度提升。
AI.motivation: 大规模零售供应链需按商品、未来日期/计划窗口和区域进行销量预测，但区域稀疏性、环境变化、销量波动及陌生业务情境使多维度联合建模困难；同时业务人员的经验、未来计划等知识难以转化为数值特征。
AI.method: (1) 覆盖感知的有向编码器融合区域销量与适用协变量；(2) 语义对齐模块将语言模型对自然语言计划与领域经验的隐表示迁移为目标特定的预测上下文，并以销量观测为监督把语义与数值证据连接；(3) 文本条件化的未来查询与共享/路由专家实现上下文自适应预测；(4) 有序分布输出头对常规波动分配细粒度、对极端波动分配粗粒度分辨率；(5) 日/窗口联合学习将预测与累计计划量关联。
AI.result: 京东线上并行预测中，全国日销量与计划窗口销量相对原始生产深度学习基线分别提升18.25%和17.94%，DC日销量与计划窗口销量分别提升19.44%和18.99%；并通过组件对比、损失设计与品类分析验证了区域信息、协变量、业务知识、上下文相关处理及鲁棒规划导向学习的作用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明自然语言业务知识可在无需逐条构造数值特征的情况下有效用于数值预测，多区域协同、语义-数值对齐与规划导向的分布学习共同支撑大规模供应链预测的精度提升。

title: But It Was True When I Checked: Compiling SHOP-Style Method Preconditions into Partially-Ordered HTN Planning
summary: Method preconditions specify when a method may be applied in hierarchical task network (HTN) planning, but their meaning differs under two established semantics. The SHOP planners, like the classical HTN formalism of Erol, Hendler and Nau, require the precondition to hold immediately before the method's first action. HDDL, the input language of the International Planning Competition's HTN track, instead introduces an auxiliary action to check it; under partial order, unrelated actions may invalidate the precondition before the method starts. HDDL's designers adopted this weaker semantics because the first-action reading could not easily be compiled. Subsequent work has repeatedly identified its compilation under partial order as an open question, with existing transformations limited to total order. We give a compilation of the first-action semantics into standard partially ordered HTN planning without method preconditions using only two additional facts, thereby resolving a longstanding question in the HTN planning community.

AI.tldr: 该文研究HTN规划中方法前置条件在两种语义下的差异，并给出将"首个动作"语义（first-action semantics）在偏序下编译为标准偏序HTN规划的方法，仅需两个额外事实，从而解决了长期悬而未决的编译问题。
AI.motivation: SHOP与Erol-Hendler-Nau传统HTN形式化要求方法前置条件在方法第一个动作之前立即成立；而HDDL（IPC HTN赛道输入语言）通过引入辅助动作检查前置条件，在偏序下无关动作可能使前置条件在方法开始前失效，语义更弱。HDDL设计者采用弱语义是因为首动作语义难以编译；后续工作多次将其在偏序下的编译列为开放问题，现有转换仅限全序。
AI.method: 提出一种将首动作语义编译为不含方法前置条件的标准偏序HTN规划的转换，仅引入两个额外事实即可实现，突破了以往仅适用于全序的局限。
AI.result: 给出了偏序下首动作语义的完整编译方案，用两个额外事实即可表达首动作前置条件的约束。
AI.conclusion: 该编译解决了HTN规划社区长期存在的一个开放问题，弥合了HDDL弱语义与传统强语义之间的差距，使首动作语义可在标准偏序HTN规划器中直接表达。

title: Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases
comment: 28 pages; 5 figures and 1 table in the main text; 5 Extended Data figures, 5 Extended Data tables; Supplementary Information with 2 figures and 15 tables
summary: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练混合量子-经典框架KQE-2，实现可复现的全转录组单细胞聚类；无纠缠量子编码足以界定单量子比特特征方差，精度、可扩展性与跨随机种子稳定性均优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞聚类流程丢弃大部分基因，且不同随机种子下聚类结果不一致，导致稀有类型标记与药物靶点识别不稳定。作者希望在不训练模型的前提下，利用全部转录组信息获得可复现的聚类结果。
AI.method: KQE-2将细胞映射为无纠缠（乘积态）量子态，使特征可在经典硬件上精确计算，并可在量子处理器上直接校验；理论上证明去除纠缠是局部界定单量子比特特征方差的充要条件。方法为免训练（training-free）的量子-经典混合流程。
AI.result: 与重训练scVI相比（后者使14%细胞发生迁移并改变稀有类型标记与药物靶点），KQE-2多次运行生物学结论完全一致；仅量子编码即将发育皮层准确率从0.61提升至0.79；单服务器可扩展至1140万细胞核；在10个完整图谱中的8个上优于对比方法（另2个处于最优方法的运行波动范围内），即使在标准下游聚类设置下也在6个图谱上领先。
AI.conclusion: 无需纠缠的量子编码即可在全转录组尺度上提供高精度、可扩展且运行间一致的聚类，提示“无纠缠”是其理论保证与实用稳定性的共同来源。

title: A Bifurcation-Theoretic Framework for the Controllability of Emergent Intelligent Systems
summary: Real-world intelligent systems must reconcile two demands: the adaptability conferred by emergence and the steerability required for accountable deployment. We show that these demands are governed by two distinct bifurcations on the same object and that, consequently, increased capability does not imply increased controllability. Emergence is a bifurcation of the capability variable $S$, with criterion $Γ:=\mathcal F'(0)>1$ equivalent to the existence of a unique positive stable fixed point of a self-consistency equation, following solely from the concavity of $\mathcal F$. Controllability is a bifurcation of the permission variable $c$, whose dynamics include an erosion term and exhibit a saddle-node fold with hysteresis as the gate criterion $ρ^\ast$ crosses unity. Three quantitative results follow: the critical exponent distinguishes families rather than classifying the transition; the gating-cost bound $K(M)\propto\log(1+M)$ grows with scope, not capability; and the fold threshold is $γ_c\approx4μκ$. Calibrated in both directions, the criteria reproduce the two-dimensional Ising transition, admit two true-feedback order parameters, and reject nine candidate quantities, supporting the conclusion that the order parameter is geometric rather than capability-related. Since permission cannot be endogenized and no deployed system has been measured to satisfy $Γ>1$ and $ρ^\ast>1$ simultaneously, increased capability does not imply controllability.

AI.tldr: 论文指出"能力涌现"与"可控性"是同一对象上的两个不同分岔，因而能力提升并不蕴含可控性提升。
AI.motivation: 现实智能系统既要涌现带来的适应性，又要可问责部署所需的可操控性。作者要澄清这两项要求之间是否存在必然联系，尤其反驳"能力越强越可控"的默认假设。
AI.method: 将涌现刻画为能力变量 S 的分岔，判据 Γ:=F'(0)>1，等价于自洽方程存在唯一正稳定不动点，且仅依赖 F 的凹性；将可控性刻画为许可变量 c 的分岔，其动力学含侵蚀项，并在门控判据 ρ* 越过 1 时出现鞍结折返与迟滞。方法上做双向校准：复现二维 Ising 相变、给出两个真正的反馈序参量、并排除九个候选量。
AI.result: 得到三项定量结论：临界指数用于区分族而非对转变分类；门控代价界 K(M)∝log(1+M) 随作用范围而非能力增长；折返阈值 γ_c≈4μκ。
AI.conclusion: 序参量是几何性的而非能力相关的；许可无法内生化，且尚无已部署系统在实测中同时满足 Γ>1 与 ρ*>1，故能力增强不蕴含可控性。

title: State Media at Retrieval Time: A Large-Scale Audit of Russian State-Aligned Sources in AI Chatbot Responses
summary: The Pravda Network is a Russian state-aligned media aggregator, with over 110 websites and more than 15 million articles published since 2023. Given its prolific and repetitive output, emerging scholarship argues that the Pravda Network was built to influence AI systems. We conduct a large-scale audit of leading AI chatbots to understand: (1) the retrieval rates of Pravda Network articles, (2) the conditions of retrieval, and (3) whether chatbot responses affirm or caveat this content. We build a 10,000 prompt corpus from sampled Pravda Network headlines varied along two dimensions (headline rewording and user skepticism) and query 11 AI chatbots via the web interface (n=104,997 completed responses). Overall, we find susceptibility to Pravda Network retrieval to be infrequent---appearing in 7.3% of responses---and highly platform dependent---with three chatbots responsible for 94% of retrievals (You.com, Claude, and Copilot). Among the frontier models, Claude is an outlier: ChatGPT, Gemini, and Meta AI retrieved no Pravda Network articles, likely indicative of a domain-level filtering policy. All 11 chatbots, however, retrieved other Russian state-aligned media to some degree (median=13.56% of responses). When Pravda Network articles are surfaced, caveat rates vary widely by platform (from 5.3% to 76.2%), with You.com providing the fewest caveats. We also identify the tactic of headline washing: where 9.92% of sampled Pravda Network headlines attribute their reporting to other, often more credible, media outlets, while the articles themselves are republished from Russian state-aligned media. We discuss headline washing's potential to launder state media as independent reporting. With this audit, we provide a systematic analysis of AI chatbots' susceptibility to Russia's latest attempt to manipulate the information environment.

AI.tldr: 该论文对11款主流AI聊天机器人进行大规模审计，量化其对"真理网络"（Pravda Network）文章的检索率、触发条件及回应中的警示（caveat）情况。
AI.motivation: Pravda Network自2023年以来发布超1500万篇文章，学界怀疑其目的之一是影响AI系统。作者希望系统评估AI聊天机器人是否会被该网络内容"污染"，填补对此类AI信息操纵的系统性审计空白。
AI.method: 从Pravda Network抽样标题构建1万条提示语料，沿"标题改写"与"用户怀疑度"两维度变化；通过网页界面查询11款AI聊天机器人，获得104,997条完整回应；分析检索率、平台差异及caveat率，并识别"标题洗白"（headline washing）手法。
AI.result: Pravda Network文章检索率低（7.3%），且高度依赖平台：You.com、Claude、Copilot三款贡献94%的检索量；Claude是前沿模型中的异常值，ChatGPT、Gemini、Meta AI零检索，可能因域名级过滤。但所有11款机器人都检索到其他俄官方对齐媒体（中位13.56%）。caveat率平台间差异大（5.3%–76.2%），You.com最少。另有9.92%的Pravda标题将报道归因于其他更可信媒体，实为转载俄官方媒体内容。
AI.conclusion: AI聊天机器人对Pravda Network的易感性总体较低但平台分化显著，域名过滤可能是有效防线；"标题洗白"具有将官方媒体洗白为独立报道的潜在风险，需持续监测平台检索与caveat行为。

title: CASCoDe: A Closed-Loop Agentic Framework for Analog Sizing and Layout Co-Design
summary: Expert analog layouts differ from auto-generated ones in density and regularity, not only in legality: experts make a succession of discrete, hierarchical physical decisions and revisit each after extracted electrical results, while most existing automated flows act on a physical search space fixed before the controller runs. We present CASCoDe, a closed-loop LLM agent framework for analog netlist-to-layout design that formalizes those expert decisions as a hierarchical discrete action space-sizing selection, structural floorplan, local layout refinement, routing-attempt selection-on which the agent runs feedback-driven tree search from a circuit netlist to a verified GDS. The agent authors the circuit-specific floorplans and scripts, and an execution layer of interface adaptations over adapted tools make every action land at physical implementation and be judged by DRC, LVS, and extracted-RC simulation. On 20 SKY130 amplifiers spanning single-, two-, and three-stage topologies, CASCoDe is the only flow that delivers a DRC- and LVS-clean routed layout when meeting design specifications for every circuit. It reduces area by 59-85% (mean 71%) against a conventional P&R flow on identical PCells, raises mean device density from 0.39 to 0.74 against APPlace, MAGICAL, ALIGN and ICPI. A layout that beats every baseline in area and legality appears after 11 minutes of agent time on average, and ablations show that the structured action space and the feedback-guided tree search each reduce area and search cost.

AI.tldr: CASCoDe：面向模拟网表到版图设计的闭环LLM智能体框架，将专家版图决策形式化为分层离散动作空间（尺寸选择、结构化布局、局部版图优化、布线尝试选择），并通过反馈驱动的树搜索从电路网表生成经DRC/LVS/RC提取仿真验证的GDS。
AI.motivation: 专家版图与自动生成版图的差异不仅在合法性，还在于密度与规整性：专家做一系列分层离散的物理决策，并在提取电学结果后反复回溯修正；而现有自动流程在控制器运行前就固定了物理搜索空间，无法闭环调整。因此需要一个能像专家一样"决策—评估—修正"的闭环框架。
AI.method: CASCoDe将专家决策形式化为四级分层离散动作空间：尺寸选择、结构化布局规划（floorplan）、局部版图精化、布线尝试选择；智能体在动作空间上执行反馈驱动的树搜索。智能体自行编写电路专用floorplan与脚本，执行层通过接口适配封装工具，使每个动作落到实际物理实现，并由DRC、LVS与提取RC仿真进行评判。实验在20个SKY130放大器（单级/两级/三级拓扑）上评估，并与传统P&R流程及APPlace、MAGICAL、ALIGN、ICPI对比，另做消融实验。
AI.result: CASCoDe是唯一在全部20个电路上均满足设计指标且输出DRC/LVS干净的已布线版图的流程。相比相同PCell下的传统P&R流程，面积减少59–85%（均值71%）；相比APPlace、MAGICAL、ALIGN、ICPI，平均器件密度由0.39提升至0.74。平均11分钟智能体时间即可得到在面积与合法性上超越所有基线的版图。消融表明结构化动作空间与反馈引导树搜索各自都能降低面积与搜索开销。
AI.conclusion: 将模拟版图设计映射为分层离散决策并以LLM智能体进行闭环反馈树搜索，可同时显著改善密度、规整性与合法性，且计算开销可控，明显优于固定搜索空间的传统自动化流程。

title: Self-Indexing Latent Memories for Access-Aware Continual Instruction Tuning of LLMs
summary: Continual instruction tuning often preserves old skills with task-private modules. Inference still requires selecting the right module from the prompt alone. We introduce Task-Isolated Latent Adapter Continual Training (TILA-CT), a replay-free method that makes each task module self-indexing. Each task receives a latent memory and adapter bank in a frozen LLM. During adaptation, the memory gathers causal-prefix information and injects task-conditioned context. For access, its persistent state provides the routing prototype used by a shared prompt-only router. On the 8-task CT-Pipeline stream, TILA-CT achieves 65.19 acquisition and 63.98 final macro score, with 1.38 points of average forgetting. A middle-reversed order gives 65.38 acquisition and 64.17 final macro score. Across 6 backbones, final scores remain within 1.5 points of acquisition. Ablations support memory-derived routing keys and causal gathering. Final macro routing accuracy is 93.9\%, and oracle routing recovers 1.21 final macro points. These results separate preserved task computation from learned access to it.

AI.tldr: 提出无回放的TILA-CT方法，使每个任务模块"自索引"：冻结LLM中为每个任务配置潜在记忆与适配器库，记忆的状态本身充当路由原型，由共享的仅提示路由器完成模块选择。在CT-Pipeline流上最终宏分63.98、平均遗忘仅1.38，路由准确率93.9%。
AI.motivation: 持续指令微调通常用任务私有模块保留旧技能，但推理时仍需仅凭提示选择正确模块，任务访问（路由）与任务计算被混为一谈，成为部署瓶颈。
AI.method: TILA-CT（Task-Isolated Latent Adapter Continual Training）：在冻结LLM中为每个任务配置潜在记忆与适配器库；适配阶段记忆汇聚因果前缀信息并注入任务条件上下文；推理时记忆的持久状态直接作为路由原型，供共享的仅提示路由器使用；全程无回放。
AI.result: 8任务CT-Pipeline流上：获取阶段宏分65.19、最终65.98→63.98（原文63.98），平均遗忘1.38；中段逆序设置下获取65.38、最终64.17。6个骨干网络最终分与获取分差距均在1.5分内。消融验证了记忆派生路由键与因果汇聚的必要性；最终宏路由准确率93.9%，oracle路由仅额外恢复1.21分。
AI.conclusion: 将"任务计算保留"与"任务访问学习"解耦：记忆状态既是适配上下文又是路由键，可在无回放下实现低遗忘与高路由精度；oracle差距很小说明访问机制已接近上限，主要瓶颈回到计算保真度本身。

title: Multi-GPU MoE Inference with Adaptive Expert Offloading
summary: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference is constrained by GPU memory. This constraint is mitigated by expert offloading, which stores part of the model's weight in host memory and executes on demand. Though MoE architecture has computation sparsity, more GPUs are needed for serving increasingly larger frontier models. However, existing expert offloading systems overlook this need and fail to scale performance with additional GPUs. We present AdaOffload, a general and efficient multi-GPU hybrid expert execution framework that effectively handles heterogeneous hardware and workloads. We co-design GPU-CPU parallelism and GPU-CPU co-execution for decode and prefill with online workload observation that adapts to different hardware, workload, and batch size heterogeneity. We evaluated AdaOffload on five different platforms with varying GPU capability (L4, Pro6000, B200), number of GPUs, CPU capability, and NUMA topology on three different frontier open-weight models (284B to 753B). AdaOffload achieves $1.9\times$ to $15.5\times$ throughput speedups across different models over state-of-the-art systems.

AI.tldr: AdaOffload：面向多GPU混合专家（MoE）推理的通用高效专家卸载框架，通过GPU-CPU并行与协同执行的设计，实现随GPU数量扩展的性能。
AI.motivation: MoE推理受限于GPU显存，专家卸载可缓解该约束，但现有卸载系统忽视了随模型规模增长而增加GPU的需求，无法随GPU数量扩展性能；同时缺乏对异构硬件与异构负载（decode/prefill、batch size）的适配。
AI.method: 提出AdaOffload多GPU混合专家执行框架：将GPU-CPU并行与GPU-CPU协同执行统一设计，分别针对decode与prefill阶段；引入在线负载观测机制，动态适应不同硬件、负载与batch size的异构性。
AI.result: 在5种平台（GPU型号L4、Pro6000、B200，不同GPU数量、CPU能力与NUMA拓扑）与3个前沿开源权重模型（284B~753B）上评测，相比SOTA系统取得1.9×至15.5×的吞吐加速。
AI.conclusion: AdaOffload证明了面向多GPU的协同设计与在线负载观测能有效突破专家卸载系统的可扩展性瓶颈，在异构硬件与大模型场景下显著提升吞吐。

title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PISA（提示自适应、成本感知的单模型路由器）及其集成扩展 PISA-E，通过软聚类隶属度与模型专属预测器估计各模型能力，并据此在显式成本—质量偏好下联合选择集成组成与规模；在四个路由基准的 ID/OOD 设定下取得最优或更优的成本—性能折中。
AI.motivation: Web 服务中的 LLM 需在异构请求间平衡响应质量与推理成本。传统路由器每个提示只选一个模型，固定集成又无法针对单个请求自适应调整组成与成本，因此缺乏能在单请求粒度上兼顾质量与开销的机制。
AI.method: PISA 将软聚类隶属度与模型专属预测器结合，估计各模型对给定提示的能力；PISA-E 在此基础上引入可处理的集成成功替代指标与高效候选筛选，在推理时可调的成本—质量偏好下联合选择集成的组成与基数，无需针对集成进行专门训练。
AI.result: 在四个基准的 ID 与 OOD 设置下，PISA 在被评估的单模型路由器中取得最高的宏平均成本—性能超体积；PISA-E 在优先质量时宏平均任务性能最高，ID/OOD 分别领先最强对手 2.09 与 2.87 个百分点；在选定低成本工作点，仍优于最强集成对手，同时推理成本分别降低约 36% 与 25%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，提示自适应的能力估计对单模型路由与选择性集成均有效，可在推理时按需调节质量—成本权衡。

title: MambaLoc: Lightweight Indoor Localization Using Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation
summary: Accurate indoor localization on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging due to the tension between modeling fidelity and computational efficiency. Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) enables low-cost deployment using existing Wi-Fi infrastructure but is heavily distorted by multipath propagation. Transformer-based solutions mitigate these effects but their quadratic complexity limits real-time edge deployment. Ultra-Wideband (UWB) provides geometrically precise ranging yet requires dedicated infrastructure. We present MambaLoc, a cross-modal distillation framework that improves the accuracy-efficiency balance in CSI-based localization. MambaLoc uses a linear-time Selective State Space Model (Mamba) as a lightweight CSI student, guided during training by a UWB-Transformer teacher. A Feature Alignment Module bridges the representational gap between heterogeneous RF modalities, allowing the CSI model to inherit UWB-derived geometric structure without UWB hardware at inference. A probabilistic Gaussian Mixture regression head models multi-modal spatial ambiguity from multipath effects, avoiding the physically implausible averaging of deterministic regression. Evaluations on a real-world dataset show MambaLoc achieves a median localization error of 0.230 m, reducing error by 22.2% over a standalone Mamba baseline, while requiring 65.1% fewer FLOPs and 58% lower inference latency than Transformer-based approaches.

AI.tldr: MambaLoc：以 UWB-Transformer 为教师、Mamba 为 CSI 学生的跨模态蒸馏定位框架，在推理阶段无需 UWB 硬件即可达到 0.230 m 中位误差，FLOPs 与延迟显著低于 Transformer 方案。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上室内定位面临建模精度与计算效率的矛盾：Wi-Fi CSI 成本低但受多径严重畸变，Transformer 效果好却因二次复杂度难以实时部署；UWB 几何精度高但需专用基础设施。
AI.method: 采用跨模态知识蒸馏：线性复杂度的 Mamba（选择性状态空间模型）作为轻量 CSI 学生网络，训练时由 UWB-Transformer 教师引导；设计特征对齐模块弥合异构 RF 模态间的表征鸿沟，使 CSI 模型继承 UWB 的几何结构；并以概率式高斯混合回归头建模多径导致的多峰空间模糊，替代确定性回归的平均化。
AI.result: 真实数据集上中位定位误差 0.230 m，较独立 Mamba 基线降低 22.2%；相比 Transformer 方法减少 65.1% FLOPs、降低 58% 推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态蒸馏配合线性时间序列建模与概率回归头，可在无 UWB 硬件的推理条件下兼顾 CSI 定位的精度与边缘端效率，为资源受限设备的实时室内定位提供可行路径。

title: IdealCache: Rethinking Cache Scheduling in Diffusion Transformers via Ideal Trajectories
comment: accepted 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Feature caching accelerates Diffusion Transformers by reusing intermediate computations across denoising timesteps, yet existing methods share a fundamental blind spot: they treat the standard reference denoising trajectory as the optimisation target, approximating its per-step states and thus inheriting its output as an implicit quality ceiling. We argue that this target is arbitrary -- what truly matters is the ideal result, not the intermediate path taken to reach it. We propose IdealCache, a training-free framework that abandons step-wise imitation of the reference trajectory. Instead, it anchors caching on a per-input ensemble of ideal trajectories constructed from candidate target results, aggregates their geometry into a single graph, and discovers optimal non-uniform schedules via a constrained shortest path on this graph. By decoupling from the reference process, IdealCache breaks the performance bottleneck of trajectory-approximation; our schedules can attain near-lossless fidelity in generation and even surpass on task-specific metrics (e.g., maintaining higher semantic consistency in image editing). Without retraining, IdealCache achieves 6.35x speedup on Qwen-Image, 5.84x on Qwen-Image-Edit, and 4.32x on HunyuanVideo, with competitive or superior quality across tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IdealCache，摒弃对标准参考去噪轨迹的逐步模仿，改为基于由候选目标结果构建的"理想轨迹集成"进行特征缓存，并通过约束最短路径发现最优非均匀调度。训练-free 下在 Qwen-Image、Qwen-Image-Edit、HunyuanVideo 上分别实现 6.35x、5.84x、4.32x 加速且质量近乎无损甚至部分指标更优。
AI.motivation: 现有特征缓存加速 Diffusion Transformer 的方法存在共同盲点：将标准参考去噪轨迹视为优化目标，逼近其逐步状态，从而把该轨迹的输出当作隐式质量上限。作者认为该目标是任意的——真正重要的是理想结果本身，而非到达它的中间路径。
AI.method: 训练-free 框架：放弃对参考轨迹的逐步模仿；对每个输入，用候选目标结果构造一组"理想轨迹"集成；将其几何结构聚合为单一图；在该图上通过约束最短路径求解最优非均匀缓存调度。
AI.result: 通过与参考过程解耦，突破轨迹近似带来的性能瓶颈，调度可实现生成近乎无损保真，甚至在任务特定指标上超越（如图像编辑中保持更高语义一致性）。无需重训练即达 6.35x（Qwen-Image）、5.84x（Qwen-Image-Edit）、4.32x（HunyuanVideo）加速，跨任务质量相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 将缓存优化的锚点从"参考轨迹"转向"理想结果"，是打破现有特征缓存质量天花板的有效思路；IdealCache 以无需训练的方式在多种生成与编辑模型上同时取得显著加速与高质量。

title: TripleGrader: A Web-Based Platform Supporting Collaborative Triple Annotation with Quality Grading and Inter-Rater Agreement Assessment
summary: Knowledge graphs need validated relational triples, and gold benchmarks of such triples are often built by several annotators. Most text annotation platforms focus on span tagging and compute agreement on categorical labels. They are not designed for ordinal quality grading of triples that have already been extracted. We present TripleGrader, an open-source web platform for grading subject-predicate-object triples on a 0 to 10 ordinal scale. In TripleGrader, each triple is scored independently, and peer scores stay hidden until the grader has rated it. Graders then discuss entries in threaded comments and propose revisions, which the session owner approves and publishes as new versions. For agreement, the platform computes quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa for two raters and a quadratic-weighted Fleiss-type kappa for three or more. Graded sessions and the final benchmark are exported in common formats. We evaluated the platform in three ways. We ran 72 automated tests, including 18 workflow scenarios through the REST API. We also injected 10 error types to check whether prescribed corrections could be applied while preserving unaffected triples. On two small corpora with existing gold benchmarks, we then used the platform to curate the triples extracted by four large language models into each benchmark. Only 10% to 32% of the candidate triples could be kept unchanged, and 53% to 71% needed corrections, partly to match the benchmarks' naming conventions. Per model, 11 to 29 missing triples had to be added. On these corpora, the extracted triples therefore needed substantial human review. The source code is available at https://github.com/razz0n/triple-grader-tool.

AI.tldr: TripleGrader 是一个开源 Web 平台，用于对已抽取的主-谓-宾三元组按 0–10 序数尺度独立评分，支持隐藏同伴分数、线程讨论与修订发布、二次加权 Cohen's κ 与 Fleiss 型 κ 一致性计算及多格式导出。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱依赖经校验的关系三元组，其金标准基准常由多名标注者构建；但现有文本标注平台主要面向 span 标注与类别标签的一致性计算，缺乏针对已抽取三元组的序数质量分级设计。
AI.method: 平台对每条三元组独立打分，同伴分数在评分完成前隐藏；评分者在树状评论中讨论并提修订，由会话负责人批准发布为新版本；一致性用二次加权 Cohen's κ（两评分者）与二次加权 Fleiss 型 κ（≥3 评分者）；评估包含 72 项自动化测试（含 18 个 REST API 工作流场景）、10 类错误注入检验局部修正能力，并在两个已有金标准的小型语料上，用平台对四个大语言模型抽取的三元组进行人工整编。
AI.result: 自动化测试与错误注入均验证了工作流与修正能力可保持未受影响三元组不变；在两个语料上，仅 10%–32% 的候选三元组可原样保留，53%–71% 需修正（部分为匹配基准命名规范），每个模型还须补充 11–29 条缺失三元组。
AI.conclusion: 现有 LLM 抽取的三元组需大量人工审核；TripleGrader 提供了面向序数质量分级与多评分者一致性的可复用开源工具，代码已公开。

title: SLA-Aware Task Offloading in the IoT Edge-Cloud Continuum: Class-Weighted Deep Reinforcement Learning Against an Exact Optimum
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to decide where Internet of Things (IoT) tasks with different latency limits run in the edge-cloud continuum, yet some methods give every missed task the same penalty and few compare their agents with an optimal policy. This benchmark study builds four offloading systems small enough to solve exactly by dynamic programming and measures reward and learner against the optimum. A bonus for a met limit makes each miss cost its penalty plus the bonus, which shifts the class weights of published per-class rewards. A class-blind penalty stays 65% to 118% above the optimal cost even with a perfect learner, while a corrected per-class penalty comes within 0.13% of the optimum. With a per-class reward, tuned proximal policy optimization (PPO) agents come within 9% to 11% of the optimum in the smallest system, and the corrected one beats a tuned reservation rule in 9 of 10 seeds. In larger systems the agents stay 41% to 76% above the optimum, and a tuned rule beats their mean. Training ten times longer does not close this gap, and a PPO-Lagrangian agent with reachable targets does no better than the per-class reward.

AI.tldr: 本文构建四个可精确求解的小规模IoT卸载系统，以动态规划最优策略为基准，比较奖励设计与RL学习器表现，发现类别盲惩罚即使学习完美也高出最优65%–118%，而修正的按类别惩罚可逼近最优0.13%以内。
AI.motivation: 现有深度强化学习IoT任务卸载研究常对每个超时任务施加相同惩罚，且少有工作将智能体与最优策略对比，导致奖励设计与学习器能力无法解耦评估，缺乏可靠的性能上界参照。
AI.method: 建立四个规模足够小、可用动态规划精确求解的卸载系统作为基准；分别度量奖励函数（reward）与学习器（learner）相对最优解的差距；分析"命中奖励"如何改变按类别奖励的类别权重，并对比类别盲惩罚与修正的按类别惩罚；在按类别奖励下训练调优的PPO智能体，与调优的预留规则（reservation rule）及PPO-Lagrangian（可达目标）比较，并测试延长十倍训练的效果。
AI.result: 类别盲惩罚即使配完美学习器仍高出最优成本65%–118%；修正的按类别惩罚距最优仅0.13%。按类别奖励下，调优PPO在最小系统中距最优9%–11%，修正版在10个随机种子中9个优于调优预留规则；较大系统中智能体高出最优41%–76%，调优规则优于其均值；训练延长十倍无法弥合差距，可达目标的PPO-Lagrangian不优于按类别奖励。
AI.conclusion: 奖励函数设计是性能瓶颈的首要来源，修正的按类别奖励可接近最优；但即使奖励设计正确，PPO在大系统中仍与最优存在显著差距，且增加训练量或采用拉格朗日约束方法均无效，说明需要更强的策略学习方法或混合规则方法。

title: Towards Identity-Preserving LLM Agents under Model Transition
summary: When an LLM agent's backend model is upgraded or replaced, operators typically reload the same persona, memory, and rules onto the new model and assume the agent will behave as before. We show this assumption requires empirical validation-and that whether identity is preserved depends on the specific model pairing. Across 5,760 compliance-testing runs in 12 regulated domains with three open-weight models, we find that some transitions produce significant behavioral drift while others do not, even when the agent's external state remains identical. Crucially, this drift is invisible to verbal verification: every model claims full policy compliance, yet actual decisions under pressure differ across models. The same external state can reorder which model is most compliant-a large positive effect on one substrate, negligible on the other two. Practitioners should treat model transitions as behavioral changes requiring action-level empirical testing, not as transparent infrastructure operations.

AI.tldr: 当LLM agent更换后端模型时，即使重载相同的人格、记忆与规则，智能体的行为也不必然保持不变：身份是否保留取决于具体的模型配对，且这种漂移无法通过语言层面的自我报告检测。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍假设：升级或替换agent后端模型时，只需把同一套人格、记忆和规则重新载入新模型，智能体行为即如前。作者要检验该假设是否成立，并指出其潜在风险——模型切换被当作透明的基础设施操作处理。
AI.method: 在12个受监管领域、3个开源权重模型上开展5,760次合规性测试运行，保持智能体外部状态（人格、记忆、规则）完全一致，仅改变后端模型配对，比较压力情境下的实际决策行为；同时对比模型的语言层面合规声明。
AI.result: 部分模型切换产生显著行为漂移，另一些则不产生，差异由模型配对决定；该漂移在语言验证中不可见——所有模型均声称完全遵守政策，但压力下的实际决策各异。同一外部状态可改变"最具合规性模型"的排序：在某一底座上呈大幅正向效应，在另两个底座上可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 模型切换应被视为需要行动层面实证测试的行为变更，而非透明的基础设施操作；实践者不能依赖模型的自我合规声明来判断身份/行为的保持。

title: Inference for Reasoning Models: Practical Lessons from Evaluation and Serving
comment: 217 pages. Book, first edition, version 1.0 (August 2026). Published on Zenodo
summary:
Running a language model involves more than its trained weights. The same model can receive very different benchmark scores, produce different answers, or cost more to serve depending on how it is evaluated and run. In one experiment in this book, changing only the maximum response length moved accuracy on a math benchmark from 0.08% to 93.18%.
  This book explains how inference settings shape the results we report and the systems we deploy. We begin with evaluation, including generation limits, answer extraction, scoring methods, and quantization. We then examine why outputs can change across batches, attention backends, and caching, even when sampling is disabled. The next chapters cover serving performance, including batching, memory capacity, latency, throughput, and cost. We also study structured outputs, tool calls, reasoning budgets, and long-context tasks, showing what these controls and benchmarks do and do not establish.
  The book concludes with practical guidance for recording inference runs, checking evaluations, estimating capacity, and comparing systems fairly. Written for researchers and engineers working with language models, it aims to make inference results easier to understand, reproduce, and trust.

AI.tldr: 本文是一本书（序言/摘要）的主题概述，主张语言模型的运行结果高度依赖推理设置，系统梳理评估、输出一致性、服务性能、可控输出与长上下文等维度，并给出可复现、可比较的实践指南。
AI.motivation: 同一模型在不同评测与运行方式下会出现基准分数差异、答案不一致、服务成本变化等显著波动（如仅改最大响应长度即使数学基准准确率从0.08%跃升至93.18%），因此需要系统解释推理设置如何塑造所报告的结果与所部署的系统。
AI.method: 以书稿综述形式分层展开：先讨论评估环节（生成长度限制、答案抽取、评分方法、量化），再分析即使关闭采样时批次、注意力后端与缓存导致的输出漂移，继而讨论服务性能（批处理、显存容量、延迟、吞吐、成本），最后考察结构化输出、工具调用、推理预算与长上下文任务能/不能证明什么。
AI.result: 揭示推理配置是影响基准分数、答案一致性与服务成本的关键变量；量化、答案抽取规则、内核与缓存策略、批处理等均会系统性改变可测结果，使跨系统与跨实验比较存在可比性风险。
AI.conclusion: 面向研究人员与工程师，提供记录推理运行、核查评估、估算容量与公平比较系统的实践建议，目标是使推理结果更易理解、可复现且可信。

title: The Lagrangian Brain: A Constraint Mechanics of Mind and Machine
summary: A brain is in one state at a time, yet most of what decides its next state is absent from it: the patterns its world never produces, the statistics of a lifetime, a goal that lies ahead. In mechanics a wire acts on a bead only through a force that appears when the bead presses on it, and Lagrange computed such forces with one multiplier for each constraint. We propose that a brain follows the same mechanics. Everything a circuit knows, is told or wants is a constraint on its single state and acts through its own multiplier, which accumulates the violation and pushes the state back. Neurons and synapses carry the multipliers, each with its own time constant: inhibitory interneurons carry what never happens, adaptation the cost of staying in one state, synapses the statistics of experience, and feedback to apical dendrites the future. From this hypothesis follow Dale's law, the reciprocal wiring and balance of excitation and inhibition, the paradoxical responses of cortex and the frequencies of brain rhythms. Belief becomes the time one trajectory spends in each state, learning becomes sleep proposing laws and waking refuting the false ones, and planning becomes a wave from the goal meeting a wave from the present. Connectionism and symbolism are the limits of frozen and of instantaneous multipliers, and between them the time a circuit runs becomes the depth of its computation. A machine built on these principles, trained without gradients on 1000 solved puzzles, solves all 422,786 Sudoku-Extreme test puzzles with one trajectory each. It rediscovers the rules of Sudoku by sleeping and waking, plans shortest paths in mazes of 64 times the training area, and tracks permutations exactly on strings 25 times longer than in training, where Transformers fail. A mind, on this view, is life that learns its own constraints.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"大脑遵循拉格朗日力学"的假说：一切电路所知、被告知或所求皆是对其单一状态的约束，各由自己的乘子（乘子累积违背量并推回状态）起作用；由此导出戴尔定律、E/I平衡、皮层反常反应与脑节律，并构建无梯度、基于轨迹的机器在Sudoku-Extreme、迷宫与长串置换任务上大幅超越Transformer。
AI.motivation: 大脑每次只处于一个状态，但决定其下一状态的大部分信息并不在状态之中：世界从不产生的模式、一生的统计量、前方的目标。需要一种统一机制解释"当下状态如何被缺席之物所约束"。作者从力学类比出发：力学中导线只通过在珠子压迫时出现的力作用于珠子，拉格朗日用一个约束对应一个乘子来计算该力。
AI.method: 提出"约束—乘子"假说：神经元与突触承载乘子，各有自己的时间常数——抑制性中间神经元承载"从不发生之事"，适应承载停留在单一状态的成本，突触承载经验的统计，对顶树突的反馈承载未来。以该原理构建机器，用无梯度方式在1000个已解谜题上训练，以单条轨迹求解。
AI.result: 理论上导出戴尔定律、交互布线与兴奋—抑制平衡、皮层反常反应及脑节律频率；给出信念（轨迹在各状态驻留时间）、学习（睡眠提出规律、清醒反驳伪规律）、规划（目标波与当下波相遇）的重解释；指出联结主义与符号主义分别是冻结乘子与瞬时乘子的极限，其间"运行时间即计算深度"。实验中：1000题训练后以单轨迹解出全部422,786道Sudoku-Extreme测试题；靠"睡—醒"重新发现数独规则；在面积为训练64倍的迷宫中规划最短路径；在长度为训练25倍的字符串上精确追踪置换，而Transformer在此失败。
AI.conclusion: 心智可视为"学习自身约束的生命"；约束乘子框架统一了神经生理规律、学习、规划与推理，并在组合外推任务上展现出远超Transformer的泛化能力。

title: Reconstructing hourly traffic on every street of a capital from a sparse counting network: a graph neural network applied to Paris
summary: Micro-scale air quality models require hourly traffic data on every road segment, whereas permanent counters cover only a small part of the network. A graph neural network (GNN) was developed to reconstruct hourly traffic flows on the 32,163 road segments of Paris intra-muros from the 1,573 segments equipped with a counter (4.9%). The model adapts the Graph Neural Network for Urban Interpolation (GNNUI) to a real, sparse counting network. Flows are decoded on the edges of the junction graph (one edge per segment, both directions summed), a traffic climatology serves as an offset in a zero-inflated negative-binomial likelihood, and training proceeds by masking counters. Eight-fold spatial cross-validation, with counters sharing a published series merged before splitting, distinguishes interpolation at a withheld counter in an instrumented district (R${}^2$ = 0.89, error of a quarter of the mean flow) from extrapolation to a district without counters (R${}^2$ = 0.74, a third of the mean flow). These scores hold on main axes where counters are located, while relative errors are about 50% on the few counted local streets. Ablations show that the climatology offset tends to help extrapolation. Road attributes, time cycles and the live state of the counting network matter most, while weather inputs have no significant effect. The masking rate is the only inherited hyperparameter with a clear effect. When evaluated on January--August 2026 (outside the training period), the frozen model stayed around the error band of previous years.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建图神经网络模型（GNNUI），利用巴黎市内4.9%路段的计数器数据重建全部32,163个路段的小时交通流量，空间交叉验证内插R²=0.89、外推R²=0.74，并给出消融与跨年验证结果。
AI.motivation: 微观空气质量模型需要每个路段的小时交通流量，但永久计数器仅覆盖路网的极小部分（巴黎为4.9%），存在严重的空间稀疏性，需要方法在真实稀疏计数网络上重建全网流量。
AI.method: 将GNNUI（图神经网络城市内插模型）适配到真实稀疏计数网络：在路口图的边上解码流量（每边对应一个路段，双向求和）；以交通气候学值作为零膨胀负二项似然的offset；训练时采用掩蔽计数器策略；采用八折空间交叉验证，并在划分前合并共享同一已发布序列的计数器。
AI.result: 仪器化城区的留出计数器内插R²=0.89（误差约为平均流量的1/4）；无计数器城区的外推R²=0.74（误差约1/3平均流量）；在主要轴线上表现稳定，少数被计数的局部街道相对误差约50%。消融显示气候学offset有助于外推；道路属性、时间周期与计数网络实时状态影响最大，天气输入不显著；掩蔽率是唯一有明确影响的继承超参数。在2026年1–8月（训练期外）评估，冻结模型的误差仍处于往年误差带内。
AI.conclusion: 基于GNN的边级解码配合气候学offset与掩蔽训练，可在稀疏计数的真实路网上实现高精度的小时交通流内插，并在无计数区域保持可用的外推能力；模型对跨时段具有时间稳健性，天气输入可省略，计数网络实时状态是重要输入。

title: REDiff-AD: No Training and No Target Masks for Industrial Anomaly Image Generation via Diversity-Driven In-Context MMDiT
summary: Industrial anomaly detection is challenged by the scarcity and diversity of real defects, leaving insufficient anomalous data to effectively train downstream models. Existing anomaly generation methods often require product-specific fine-tuning, target mask annotation, or costly procedures to achieve realistic and diverse defects. We propose REDiff-AD, a framework that requires neither model training nor target masks and introduces Rectified Flow MMDiT into industrial anomaly generation for efficient sampling with fewer generation steps. Given a normal product image and a single masked reference anomaly, REDiff-AD employs in-context learning to transfer the defect appearance from the reference into the normal image. Internal attention signals generated during this process are further reused to localize the synthesized anomaly, while edge and color cues refine the localization into pixel-level pseudo-masks. Two lightweight modules further improve generation quality: adaptive reference conditioning enhances defect fidelity, while diversity guidance promotes varied defect patterns without additional training. Experiments demonstrate that REDiff-AD can well address the tradeoff between realism and diversity for anomaly pattern generation and achieve competitive downstream anomaly classification, detection, and localization performance. These results show that REDiff-AD is a simple, efficient, and effective solution for large-scale anomaly data augmentation and pixel-level data construction. Github code: https://github.com/efdefe4-droid/REDiff-AD

AI.tldr: REDiff-AD 提出一种免训练、免目标掩码的工业异常生成框架，借助 Rectified Flow MMDiT 与上下文学习将参考异常外观迁移到正常图像，并复用内部注意力实现像素级伪掩码定位，兼顾真实性与多样性。
AI.motivation: 工业缺陷数据稀缺且形态多样，现有异常生成方法通常需要针对具体产品微调、标注目标掩码或依赖昂贵流程，难以获得真实且多样的缺陷样本，从而制约下游检测模型的训练。
AI.method: 将 Rectified Flow MMDiT 引入工业异常生成以实现少步高效采样；以一张正常产品图像和单个带掩码的参考异常为输入，通过 in-context learning 迁移缺陷外观；复用生成过程中的内部注意力信号进行异常定位，并结合边缘与颜色线索细化为像素级伪掩码；另设两个轻量模块——自适应参考条件增强缺陷保真度，多样性引导在不额外训练的情况下产生多样化缺陷模式。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能较好平衡异常模式生成的真实性与多样性，并在下游异常分类、检测与定位任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: REDiff-AD 是一种简单、高效、有效的方案，可支持大规模异常数据增强与像素级数据构建。

title: Interactive Person Retrieval with On-the-Fly Visual Feedback
summary: Traditional text-based person retrieval (TPR) assumes that a witness provides a complete description at once, whereas interactive person retrieval (Inter-PR) refines a partial description through question-answer exchanges. In this setting, the questioner inspects retrieved candidates to decide what evidence to request next, while the answerer sees only the witness-side memory and cannot report candidate-specific visual differences. Existing methods mainly learn offline question orderings, leaving this visual-feedback loop underexplored. To address this limitation, we introduce visual-feedback interactive person retrieval (VFI-PR), a new interactive retrieval paradigm in which retrieved candidates produce visual feedback that becomes evidence for subsequent questioning and re-ranking. To support training and evaluation in this setting, we construct VFI-PEDES, a dataset and evaluation protocol for visual-feedback interaction, and propose VFI-ReID, a framework that learns to use visual feedback during interactive person retrieval. Through the Dynamic Accumulated-evidence Retriever (DAR) and retrieval-aware question optimization, VFI-ReID adapts retrieval and question generation to evolving evidence states, turning visual feedback into complementary evidence for subsequent retrieval. Experiments show that VFI-ReID consistently improves retrieval across VFI-PR interaction stages, demonstrating the utility of visual feedback for interactive person retrieval and outperforming existing Inter-PR baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉反馈交互式行人检索（VFI-PR）新范式，构建VFI-PEDES数据集与评测协议，并提出VFI-ReID框架，利用检索候选产生的视觉反馈作为后续提问与重排序的证据。
AI.motivation: 传统文本行人检索假设一次给出完整描述，交互式行人检索（Inter-PR）通过问答逐步细化，但问题者看候选、回答者仅有目击记忆，无法报告候选相关的视觉差异；现有方法主要学习离线问题顺序，视觉反馈回路未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出VFI-PR交互范式，使检索候选产生视觉反馈并进入后续提问与重排序；据此构建VFI-PEDES数据集与评测协议；提出VFI-ReID框架，含动态累积证据检索器（DAR）与检索感知的问题优化，使检索与提问生成随证据状态演化自适应。
AI.result: 实验表明VFI-ReID在VFI-PR各交互阶段均一致提升检索性能，验证视觉反馈对交互式行人检索的有效性，并优于现有Inter-PR基线。
AI.conclusion: 视觉反馈可作为互补证据用于交互式行人检索，VFI-PR范式与VFI-ReID框架有效拓展了Inter-PR的研究空间。

title: Beyond Bit Matching: Orthogonal Watermarks for Collusion-Resistant Image Fingerprinting
summary: Image fingerprinting assigns each distributed copy a user-specific watermark for source tracing. Averaging collusion is a central threat: several recipients can average their differently marked copies to suppress each individual mark. Discrete bit-string watermarks are especially vulnerable because averaging drives bit evidence toward ambiguous decisions. We introduce \textbf{VectorMark}, which maps user keys to near-orthogonal high-dimensional unit vectors and identifies colluders by cosine similarity to the extracted watermark direction. Under ideal averaging of $K$ vector keys, the normalized average preserves a cosine signal of order $1/\sqrt{K}$ for each colluder, while unrelated keys remain concentrated near zero. The spherical geometry of random directions gives a shifted-Beta null distribution for cosine similarities, enabling analytic per-key false-positive-rate control after validation on unwatermarked images. VectorMark uses a neural watermark encoder and centered extractor trained with JND masking and a progressive curriculum for photometric, geometric, and collusion robustness. Experiments on MS-COCO, OpenImages, and AI-generated images show that VectorMark maintains robust watermark attribution under photometric and geometric distortions, and achieves the best strict all-colluder detection among evaluated methods, while preserving high visual quality. Our code is publicly available: https://github.com/nurlanov-zh/VectorMark

AI.tldr: VectorMark 将用户密钥映射为近正交高维单位向量，以余弦相似度进行共谋者溯源，并借助随机方向的球面几何给出移位Beta零分布实现解析式逐密钥假阳性率控制，配合神经水印编解码器与渐进课程训练获得对光度、几何及平均共谋攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 图像指纹需为每份分发副本嵌入用户特定水印以溯源。平均共谋是核心威胁：多个接收者平均各自副本可抑制个体标记。离散比特串水印尤易受害，因为平均会把比特证据推向模糊判决。作者希望从根本上规避比特判决的脆弱性。
AI.method: 1) 密钥映射：将用户密钥映射为近正交的高维单位向量，以向量指纹替代比特串。2) 检测准则：以提取水印方向与各密钥的余弦相似度识别共谋者。3) 理论分析：理想K方平均下，归一化平均对每个共谋者保留量级为1/√K的余弦信号，无关密钥集中在零附近；随机方向球面几何导致余弦相似度服从移位Beta零分布，从而在无水印图像上验证后实现解析的逐密钥FPR控制。4) 网络设计：神经水印编码器+中心化提取器，采用JND掩蔽与渐进课程训练，覆盖光度、几何与共谋鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在MS-COCO、OpenImages及AI生成图像上，VectorMark在光度与几何失真下保持稳健的水印归属；在严格的全共谋者检测指标上优于所评估的方法，同时保持高视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 以近正交向量密钥替代离散比特水印，可将平均共谋从"证据抹平"问题转化为"方向保持"问题，并结合球面几何的解析零分布实现可控误报的共谋溯源；代码已公开。

title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
comment: 39 pages, 10 figures. This technical report will be updated periodically
summary: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出生成式世界模型的严格定义（维护持久、历史条件化的环境表征并响应动作/干预更新），据此构建五维智能导向框架，并发布开源基础设施WorldFoundry，用于视频、3D/4D、具身动作与交互式世界系统的可复现推理与评测。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成模型日益模糊"合成观测"与"模拟环境"的界限，但视觉逼真度本身并不等于成功的世界建模：令人信服的输出可能缺乏持久状态、物理动力学或对交互的因果一致响应。领域亟需从感知合成转向可度量的世界智能，并以可复现的方式比较异构系统中的持久化、可控动力学。
AI.method: 1) 将生成式世界模型形式化为预测性动力系统：维护持久、历史条件化的环境表征，依据动作/干预更新表征，生成反映观测与反事实干预结果的时间一致轨迹；2) 由该定义推导智能导向框架，涵盖感知接地、持久状态建模、可控变换、动力学感知预测与闭环交互五个方面；3) 构建开源基础设施WorldFoundry，统一模型与基准发现、运行时与资产生成准备、执行编排、产物管理与交互可视化；4) 通过模态专用适配器保留原生输入、执行语义、输出表示与评测协议；5) 以显式清单、持久化产物契约与证据感知评分卡，将"执行就绪性"与"评测性主张"分离，使每项主张可追溯至支撑产物。
AI.result: WorldFoundry目录收录270个模型条目、74个基准与62个注册指标条目，并就绪性与执行证据分别记录；平台支持对异构系统间持久、可控动力学的可复现比较，且所有评测主张均可溯源至对应产物证据。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭视觉逼真度不足以判定世界建模成功；以持久状态、动作响应性与时间因果一致性为核心的定义与框架，配合分离就绪性与证据的可复现基础设施，可将领域从感知合成推进至可度量的世界智能。

title: InfCoiL: Coordinated Planner-Controller Learning for Closed-Loop Physics-Based Human-Object Interaction
summary: Text- and goal-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) provides an intuitive interface for specifying high-level intents in physics-based character animation. Mapping such intents to physically plausible, contact-rich behaviors naturally calls for a generative planner and a physics-based controller, yet existing planner-controller systems either execute plans open-loop or close the loop while keeping the planner fixed, so execution feedback never reshapes what is planned. We present InfCoiL, a closed-loop framework for physics-based HOI from coordinated planner-controller learning. InfCoiL couples a morphology-aware flow-matching planner with a unified multi-morphology controller through a shared morphology interface in an autoregressive plan-and-execute loop, and alternately fine-tunes both components with reinforcement learning from the same physical rollouts. To optimize the flow-matching planner online, we introduce Semantic Flow Policy Optimization (SFPO), which stochasticizes selected denoising transitions with channel-wise semantic covariance over heterogeneous HOI features and assigns group-relative, sequence-level rewards from complete closed-loop executions. On held-out OMOMO sequences, InfCoiL outperforms open-loop hierarchical baselines in goal-reaching task success and physical tracking accuracy. Project page: https://infcoil.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出InfCoiL闭环框架，通过规划器-控制器协同学习实现文本/目标条件下的物理可信人-物交互（HOI），并用SFPO实现流匹配规划器的在线强化学习优化。
AI.motivation: 现有规划器-控制器系统要么开环执行规划，要么闭环但保持规划器固定，导致执行反馈无法反过来修正规划内容；而文本/目标意图到物理可信、接触丰富的行为本身需要生成式规划器与物理控制器的紧耦合。
AI.method: 1）形态感知的流匹配规划器与统一多形态控制器，通过共享形态接口耦合；2）自回归"规划—执行"闭环循环；3）用同一批物理rollout对两个组件交替进行强化学习微调；4）提出语义流策略优化（SFPO）：对选定的去噪转移注入随机性，在异构HOI特征上采用通道级语义协方差，并以完整闭环执行的序列级、组相对奖励进行优化。
AI.result: 在OMOMO留出序列上，InfCoiL在目标达成任务成功率与物理跟踪精度上均优于开环分层基线。
AI.conclusion: 闭环、协同演化的规划-控制学习能有效利用执行反馈重塑规划，提升物理化HOI的可行性与跟踪精度；SFPO为扩散/流匹配规划器提供了可行的在线RL优化途径。

title: Correctness Metric Matters: NWD-Based Calibration Loss for Tiny Person Detection in UAV Infrared Imagery
summary: Detection calibration aligns predicted confidence with empirical correctness. Existing calibration losses inherit their correctness definition from box regression, specifically IoU against a hard threshold. We show that this target is geometrically ill-posed for tiny objects in UAV infrared imagery, where persons occupy less than 0.1\% of the image. The same pixel error is penalized more heavily as the target shrinks, so binary prediction calibration (BPC) actively suppresses confidences that should be high. On HIT-UAV, BPC with an IoU target degrades image-level localization-aware ECE (LaECE) from 0.0689 to 0.0761, 0.0649 to 0.0733, and 0.0653 to 0.0682 across Low, Mid, and High signal-to-clutter ratio (SCR) groups. We replace the IoU target with a continuous, scale-invariant normalized Wasserstein distance (NWD). The NWD target reduces LaECE\(_{\mathrm{NWD}}\) relative to BPC+IoU on all three groups (\(p<10^{-7}\)) with mAP neutral (0.9356 vs.\ 0.9347), and an independent center-offset anchor confirms that the gain is a genuine geometric correction. The improvement holds across a broad plateau of calibration weights. The NWD formulation requires no inference-time mapping layer. If a validation-fitted isotonic map is applied on top of it, calibration is lowered further, and the two corrections act on different components of the same error. The metric-level remedy has a measurable boundary. Target-background thermal pairing in the training distribution and detection-level aggregation under per-image detection-count heterogeneity lie outside it. Both are quantified independently of the NWD target.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出在无人机红外小目标检测中，以IoU硬阈值为正确性定义的二值预测校准（BPC）存在几何病态性，提出用尺度不变的归一化Wasserstein距离（NWD）替代IoU目标，在HIT-UAV上显著降低LaECE而mAP保持中性，且与等渗回归校准互补。
AI.motivation: 现有校准损失沿用回归中的IoU硬阈值来定义"预测是否正确"，但这种定义对占图像面积不足0.1%的无人机红外小目标几何上病态：相同像素误差在目标缩小后被更严重惩罚，导致BPC反而压制了本应较高的置信度，损害校准质量。
AI.method: 将BPC中的IoU目标替换为连续、尺度不变的归一化Wasserstein距离（NWD）作为正确性度量，并引入图像级定位感知ECE（LaECE_NWD）评估校准；在HIT-UAV数据集上按低/中/高信杂比（SCR）分组对比BPC+IoU与NWD目标，辅以独立的中心偏移锚点实验验证几何校正归因，并考察校准权重平台期与验证集拟合等渗映射的叠加效果。
AI.result: BPC+IoU使LaECE由0.0689升至0.0761、0.0649升至0.0733、0.0653升至0.0682（低/中/高SCR）；NWD目标在三组上均降低LaECE_NWD（p<10^-7），mAP中性（0.9356 vs 0.9347）；增益在较宽校准权重区间内保持稳定；NWD无需推理时映射层，叠加等渗映射可进一步降低校准误差，二者作用于同一误差的不同分量。
AI.conclusion: 指标层面的修正存在可测量边界：训练分布中的目标-背景热配对、以及逐图检测数异质下的检测级聚合，均超出NWD目标的作用范围，且这两点被独立量化。NWD目标是一种无推理开销、可与其他校准手段互补的几何修正方案。

title: LocateAnyMesh: Grounding 3D Mesh Queries in 2D Images with Vision-Language Models
summary: Textured 3D meshes specify object geometry and appearance, making them a natural query for finding a particular asset in an image. We introduce LocateAnyMesh, a vision-language model that uses the mesh itself as part of its prompt. A frozen 3D encoder maps colored surface points to a compact token sequence, which a learned connector places alongside image and instruction tokens. We evaluate two grounding models with PPAT mesh tokens: LAM-Select selects image-region proposals, while LAM-Direct predicts coordinates directly. Neither requires rendered query views or view-template matching. New objects require a single encoder pass and no object-specific fine-tuning. LAM-Select improves localization on the reported real-image suites and the official BOP YCB-V evaluation. Secondary experiments compare mesh encoders, and a LAM-Direct study isolates surface color. A single-seed LAM-Select continuation supplies pointing and mesh-only description evidence without replacing the reported localization model. The results support mesh tokens as a query representation, with remaining limitations in presence decisions, identity binding, proposal coverage, and descriptive fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出LocateAnyMesh，一种以纹理3D网格本身作为提示一部分的视觉-语言模型：冻结3D编码器将带色表面点映射为紧凑token序列，经连接器与图像、指令token拼接，实现无需渲染查询视图或视图模板匹配的网格引导图像定位。
AI.motivation: 纹理3D网格同时包含几何与外观信息，是图像中查找特定资产的天然查询；但现有方法通常需要渲染查询视图或进行视图-模板匹配，且新对象往往需要针对性的微调，成本高、泛化差。
AI.method: 以网格作为提示的一部分：冻结的3D编码器把彩色表面点编码为紧凑token序列，可学习连接器将PPAT网格token与图像token、指令token并列输入。评估两种定位模型：LAM-Select在图像候选区域提议上做选择，LAM-Direct直接回归坐标。新增对象仅需一次编码器前向，无需对象特定微调、渲染视图或模板匹配。辅以网格编码器对比实验及隔离表面颜色作用的LAM-Direct研究。
AI.result: LAM-Select在所报告的真实图像数据集及官方BOP YCB-V评测上提升定位性能；单种子LAM-Select延续实验提供指向与纯网格描述的证据（作为补充，不替代主定位模型）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将网格token作为查询表示的可行性；仍存在局限：存在性判定、身份绑定、提议覆盖度以及描述保真度。

title: NightSteps: A Night-Time Dataset and Benchmark for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction
summary: Autonomous vehicles use pedestrian crossing intention prediction (PCIP) to participate safely in traffic. Existing models are largely trained under favourable daytime conditions with sufficient daylight. Little is known about the robustness of these models under night-time and low-light conditions, due to the lack of datasets containing night-time footage. This paper investigates how a dataset, named NightSteps, can be constructed and evaluated as a baseline benchmark. The dataset is based on nighttime dashcam footage collected from six different cities around the world, capturing a wide variety of road conditions. The dataset consists of dashcam-recorded point-of-view footage, raw data of pedestrians' locations with corresponding 'track ids' and ground-truth labels containing accurate information about pedestrian crossing behaviour, resulting in a diverse dataset. Gemini, ChatGPT, and human assessment are used to demonstrate the usability of the dataset by predicting crossings in clips from the dataset and comparing the results with the initial ground-truth labels. These results show that human input achieves an accuracy of 88.17% and an F1-score of 80.21%. Predictions from Gemini and ChatGPT perform lower, with accuracies of 60% and 79.13% respectively, and F1-scores of 42.50% and 63.64%. The evaluation demonstrates that the NightSteps dataset can be used for future model evaluation to test the performance of PCIP, with the aim of improving road safety at night.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并评估了夜间行人过街意图预测基准数据集 NightSteps，用于检验现有 PCIP 模型在夜间/低光条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有行人过街意图预测（PCIP）模型多在白天光照充足条件下训练，缺乏夜间视频数据，导致其在夜间/低光条件下的鲁棒性未知；本文动机是填补夜间数据缺失这一空白。
AI.method: 采集全球六座城市的夜间行车记录仪（dashcam）第一视角视频，覆盖多样化道路条件；数据包含带 track id 的行人位置原始数据及行人过街行为的精确真值标签；并使用 Gemini、ChatGPT 与人工评估在片段上预测过街行为，与初始真值标签比对，以验证数据集可用性。
AI.result: 人工评估准确率 88.17%、F1 80.21%；Gemini 准确率 60%、F1 42.50%；ChatGPT 准确率 79.13%、F1 63.64%，二者均低于人工。
AI.conclusion: NightSteps 可作为基线基准，用于未来 PCIP 模型在夜间条件下的性能评估，以提升夜间道路安全。

title: Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression for Extreme Image Compression
summary: In the extreme-low bitrate range below $0.01$ bpp, image compression becomes a constrained generation problem: the reconstruction depends on inferring plausible missing details while staying close to the input image. Autoregressive token models provide an efficient coarse-to-fine prior for this setting, but the transmitted early-scale tokens often leave object identity and texture underdetermined, which can lead to source-inconsistent reconstructions. We introduce Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression (SAVAR), a generative codec built on Visual Autoregressive (VAR) modeling. SAVAR transmits early-scale tokens and a compact caption. The tokens provide image-specific layout information, while the caption supplies global semantics. SAVAR reconstructs a partial VQ-VAE latent from the retained scales, maps it to the start-of-sequence initialization, and uses the same latent to condition the caption embedding before adaptive layer normalization, separating two roles that are typically driven by a shared condition in VAR-style generation. On the Kodak and CLIC2020 datasets in the extreme-low range, SAVAR reduces perceptual distortion relative to matched ARPC retained-scale operating points, lowering LPIPS by about $8$--$9\%$ and DISTS by up to $22\%$ at a lower bpp. It reconstructs a $512 \times 512$ image in about $218$ ms on one NVIDIA L20X GPU, retaining fast autoregressive decoding in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: SAVAR 在超低码率（<0.01 bpp）下结合早期尺度 VAR token 与紧凑文本描述，分离“布局”与“语义”两类条件，以降低感知失真并保持快速解码。
AI.motivation: 超低码率图像压缩本质是受限生成问题：需推断合理缺失细节又保持与源图一致。自回归 token 模型提供由粗到细先验，但传输的早期尺度 token 往往无法确定物体身份与纹理，导致重建偏离源图。
AI.method: 提出 Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression（SAVAR），基于 VAR 的生成式编解码器：传输早期尺度 token 与紧凑 caption；token 提供图像特定布局，caption 提供全局语义。由保留尺度重建部分 VQ-VAE latent，映射为序列起始（start-of-sequence）初始化，并用同一 latent 在自适应层归一化前对 caption 嵌入进行条件化，从而分离 VAR 中通常由共享条件承担的两类角色。
AI.result: 在 Kodak 与 CLIC2020 超低码率区间，相较匹配的 ARPC 保留尺度工作点，在更低 bpp 下 LPIPS 降低约 8–9%，DISTS 最多降低 22%；在单块 NVIDIA L20X GPU 上重建 512×512 图像约 218 ms，保持快速自回归解码。
AI.conclusion: 以源图锚定的部分 latent 同时作为初始化与语义条件，可有效缓解超低码率下身份/纹理不确定性问题，在提升感知保真度的同时维持高效解码。

title: From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Training vision-language-action (VLA) models to follow gameplay instructions across diverse games is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. We introduce a framework that automatically generates game environments and expert demonstrations. An LLM-powered agent uses game-building tools to construct executable environments and tasks targeting specified skills. Programmatic experts then use privileged simulator state to generate aligned instructions, rendered observations, and keyboard and mouse actions. We train our game policy, Script2Play, by post-training a 4B vision-language model with behavior cloning on 150.3 hours of synthetic Minecraft and Roblox gameplay, without human gameplay demonstrations or reinforcement learning. Evaluation on multiple public game benchmarks demonstrates that Script2Play follows gameplay instructions effectively and generalizes across game engines, highlighting the effectiveness of targeted synthetic supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出自动生成游戏环境与专家演示的框架，用LLM智能体构建可执行环境与任务，程序化专家基于特权状态生成对齐数据，训练出4B游戏策略Script2Play，仅靠合成数据实现跨游戏引擎的指令跟随。
AI.motivation: 训练VLA模型在多样化游戏中遵循玩法指令，受限于收集人类演示的高昂成本。
AI.method: LLM驱动的智能体利用游戏建造工具，针对指定技能自动构建可执行环境与任务；程序化专家利用仿真器特权状态生成对齐的语言指令、渲染观测及键鼠动作；随后对4B视觉-语言模型做行为克隆后训练。
AI.result: 在150.3小时合成Minecraft与Roblox玩法数据上训练，无人类演示、无强化学习；在多个公开游戏基准上有效遵循指令，并跨游戏引擎泛化。
AI.conclusion: 针对性的合成监督可替代昂贵的人工演示，是训练通用游戏VLA策略的有效途径。

title: CrossLiDAR: Controllable Multi-Sensor LiDAR Sequence Generation
summary: High-fidelity LiDAR simulation remains a bottleneck for scalable development and validation of autonomous systems. Existing generators can synthesize realistic scans, but they are typically constrained to a single sensor configuration, offer limited control over structure and geometry, and drift in long-horizon 4D generation. We present CrossLiDAR, a unified transformer-based framework capable of generating controllable and spatio-temporally consistent multi-sensor LiDAR sequences. Our approach leverages a rectified flow objective with a Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) backbone, within a compact latent space of range images. To support multiple LiDAR sensors, an Inter-sensor Module enables interaction across sensors, while a ControlNet-style branch provides structural conditioning (e.g., BEV priors or 3D bounding boxes). For modeling the temporal consistency, CrossLiDAR generates short $N$-frame sequences and extends them autoregressively to improve long-horizon coherence. Our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 29.56\% in JSD and 15.36\% in MMD evaluated on nuScenes and the Waymo Dataset. CrossLiDAR bridges the gap to modern autonomous-driving simulation by enabling calibration-consistent multi-sensor LiDAR rollouts over long horizons for controllable, scenario-based testing.

AI.tldr: CrossLiDAR：基于MM-DiT与rectified flow的统一多传感器LiDAR序列生成框架，支持结构条件控制与长时程时空一致生成。
AI.motivation: 高保真LiDAR仿真对自动驾驶系统的规模化开发与验证至关重要，但现有生成器受限于单一传感器配置、对结构与几何控制能力有限，且长时程4D生成存在漂移问题。
AI.method: 采用紧凑的range image潜空间；以Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT)为骨干结合rectified flow目标；引入Inter-sensor Module实现多传感器交互，ControlNet式分支提供结构条件（如BEV先验或3D框）；先生成短N帧序列，再自回归扩展以提升长时程一致性。
AI.result: 在nuScenes与Waymo数据集上显著优于SOTA基线，JSD平均提升29.56%，MMD平均提升15.36%。
AI.conclusion: CrossLiDAR实现了标定一致的多传感器LiDAR长时程rollout，支持可控的基于场景测试，弥合了与现代自动驾驶仿真需求之间的差距。

title: Query-Only Prompt-Agnostic Attacks on Visual In-Context Learning
summary: Visual In-Context Learning (VICL) enables promptable segmentation by conditioning RGB predictions on visual demonstrations, making it attractive for auto-labeling, but its robustness under query-only access and unknown deployment prompts remains underexplored. We study query-only, prompt-agnostic targeted attacks where the attacker observes only returned RGB outputs, without access to model internals or deployment prompts. Treating prompt-conditioned RGB rendering as a distinct attack surface, we introduce two appearance-space attacks: Color Hijack (CH) drives foreground colors toward the background to suppress visibility, while Task Hijack (TH) collapses instance-distinguishing colors toward a shared color assignment. To transfer across unseen prompts, we propose a Self-Prompt Surrogate (SPS) constructed from the clean query and its output. In a paired, matched-budget SegGPT comparison, SPS outperforms the Random-Prompt Surrogate (RPS), reducing CH instance foreground retention from 0.918 to 0.155 and TH palette-aware tolerance distance from 0.345 to 0.225. Across four VICL models on COCO and HierText, CH suppresses foregrounds across semantic-, instance-, and text-style outputs, while TH collapses instance colors under held-out deployment prompts. After palette-based decoding, TH also reduces the decoded instance count and mask retention while increasing instance merges. Finally, at 30% corruption, CH-corrupted annotations from a publicly accessible VICL-based auto-labeling pipeline reduce downstream YOLO-seg mAP50 from 0.761 to 0.281.

AI.tldr: 本文研究查询-only、提示无关的定向攻击，提出两种外观空间攻击（Color Hijack、Task Hijack）及自提示代理（SPS），在多个VICL模型上有效抑制前景并破坏实例色彩区分。
AI.motivation: VICL可通过视觉示例实现提示式分割、适合自动标注，但其在"仅查询访问"和"未知部署提示"下的鲁棒性研究不足；作者将提示条件化的RGB渲染视为独立攻击面。
AI.method: 攻击者仅观察返回的RGB输出，不可见模型内部与部署提示。提出CH（把前景颜色驱向背景以抑制可见性）与TH（将区分实例的颜色坍缩为共享色彩分配）；为跨未见提示迁移，用干净查询及其输出构建SPS代理模型。在SegGPT上与随机提示代理RPS进行配对等预算对比。
AI.result: SPS优于RPS：CH实例前景保留率由0.918降至0.155，TH调色板感知容差距离由0.345降至0.225。在COCO与HierText上四个VICL模型中，CH抑制语义/实例/文本风格输出前景，TH在留出部署提示下坍缩实例颜色；调色板解码后TH降低解码实例数与掩码保留率并增加实例合并。30%污染下，CH使公开VICL自动标注管线的下游YOLO-seg mAP50从0.761降至0.281。
AI.conclusion: 提示条件化RGB渲染是VICL的显著攻击面，仅查询访问的提示无关攻击可跨提示迁移并实质破坏下游自动标注性能，凸显VICL应用需加强此类鲁棒性防护。

title: MySign: A High-Fidelity Motion-Capture Dataset for 3D Sign Generation in Bahasa Isyarat Malaysia
summary: Progress in 3D sign generation is constrained by the scarcity of high-fidelity 3D sign language datasets, a limitation that is particularly severe for under-resourced languages. We introduce MySign, the first motion-capture dataset for isolated signs in Bahasa Isyarat Malaysia (BIM). Its 5,000 samples cover 1,000 lexical items (glosses) and were produced by five Deaf native signers. Prior datasets that rely on SMPL-X parameters regressed from video provide pseudo-labels, which are often affected by depth ambiguity, inaccurate finger poses, and temporal jitter. MySign instead provides ground-truth SMPL-X sequences retargeted from recordings made with a motion-capture setup tailored for sign language; these sequences offer higher-fidelity motion, particularly in fine-grained hand and finger articulation. A controlled comparison on the same glosses and signers indicates that training on these sequences improves generation over training on such pseudo-labels. We establish MySign as a challenging benchmark for gloss-conditioned 3D sign generation: state-of-the-art models produce visually plausible outputs but fall short of the ground truth, most notably in fine-grained articulation, revealing persistent gaps in modeling articulated sign motion. In contrast, recognition baselines consistently achieve high lexical accuracy, indicating that the dataset reliably supports supervised learning. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mysigner/MySign

AI.tldr: MySign 是首个马来手语（BIM）孤立词动作捕捉数据集，含 5,000 条样本、1,000 个义项、5 位聋人母语者，提供重定向得到的真值 SMPL-X 序列，并作为义项条件 3D 手语生成的挑战性基准。
AI.motivation: 3D 手语生成受限于高保真 3D 手语数据稀缺，低资源语言尤为严重；已有数据集的 SMPL-X 参数多由视频回归获得，属伪标签，存在深度歧义、手指姿态不准与时间抖动问题。
AI.method: 构建面向手语的动捕采集方案，由 5 位聋人母语者完成 1,000 个义项共 5,000 条孤立词录制，重定向生成真值 SMPL-X 序列；在同一义项与同一签名者条件下，与基于伪标签训练做受控对比；并以义项条件 3D 生成与手语识别两类基线进行评估。
AI.result: 在相同义项与签名者条件下，使用真值序列训练较伪标签训练显著提升生成质量；当前最优生成模型输出视觉上合理，但在细粒度手指关节运动上与真值差距明显；识别基线则稳定取得高词汇准确率。
AI.conclusion: MySign 填补了 BIM 动捕数据空白，验证了真值动捕数据相对视频伪标签的优势，并揭示关节化手语运动建模仍是开放难点，可作为该任务的基准数据集。

title: MoT3DVG: A Benchmark for Outdoor 3D Visual Grounding with Motion-Aware Descriptions and Temporal Cues
summary: 3D visual grounding (3DVG) localizes language-referred objects in 3D scenes, with broad applicability in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, existing 3DVG research focuses on static indoor objects, limiting its use in dynamic outdoor autonomous driving. Motion descriptions, which capture the temporal dynamics of moving objects, offer a promising way to address this challenge. We therefore introduce MoT3DVG, a large-scale dataset for dynamic-aware outdoor 3DVG with temporally evolving motion descriptions. It contains 850 scenarios with 31,128 frames from nuScenes dataset, and provides 144,568 language prompts with motion-aware descriptions for dynamic objects across time. We further propose DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG. In addition to the standard modality-specific encoders, DynaVG introduces a Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding (SLIDE) module before the language-point cloud alignment. SLIDE models both local motion cues and global temporal context via short-term window encoding and long-term window shifting. Extensive experiments demonstrate its state-of-the-art performance on MoT3DVG, validating the effectiveness of motion-aware encoding. Our work reveals open challenges and promising directions for future research in outdoor 3DVG.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向户外动态场景的3D视觉定位数据集MoT3DVG（基于nuScenes，850个场景、31,128帧、144,568条运动感知语言提示），并提出DynaVG框架，通过Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding（SLIDE）模块建模局部运动线索与全局时序上下文，在MoT3DVG上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉定位（3DVG）研究集中于静态室内目标，难以适用于动态户外自动驾驶场景；运动描述能够刻画移动目标的时间动态性，为解决该问题提供了途径，但缺乏相应数据集与方法。
AI.method: 构建MoT3DVG数据集，提供随时间演化的运动描述；提出DynaVG框架，在标准模态特定编码器之外，于语言-点云对齐之前引入SLIDE模块，通过短时窗口编码建模局部运动线索，并通过长时窗口平移捕获全局时序上下文。
AI.result: 在MoT3DVG上的大量实验表明DynaVG达到最先进性能，验证了运动感知编码的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 工作揭示了户外3DVG的开放挑战，并为未来研究指出了有前景的方向。

title: TIRAD: Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent anomaly detection studies have shown that residual features, which model the discrepancy between normal and abnormal patterns, provide strong generalization to anomalies unseen during training. However, existing residual-based approaches mainly rely on visual discrepancies derived from image representations, while semantic discrepancies that can be explicitly expressed through language remain largely underexplored. To address this problem, we propose TIRAD, Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection, a multimodal residual learning framework that defines the discrepancy between textual representations of normal and abnormal states as a Text Residual Feature and uses it to guide the Image Residual Feature. Specifically, a Text Fusion Module converts patch-level text residuals into a gate that modulates the image residual of each patch. The gate retains the visual discrepancies that the text residual identifies as defect-related and attenuates the others, leading to more discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments on industrial benchmarks and industrial-to-medical transfer demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing image-centric residual learning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 TIRAD 多模态残差学习框架，将"文本残差特征"（正常与异常状态文本表示之差）用于引导图像残差特征，实现通用异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有基于残差特征的异常检测方法主要依赖图像表示得到的视觉差异，而可通过语言显式表达的语义差异尚未被充分挖掘，导致异常表征判别性不足。
AI.method: 定义文本残差特征（正常与异常文本表示之差），并通过 Text Fusion Module 将 patch 级文本残差转换为门控信号，对每个 patch 的图像残差进行调制：保留与缺陷相关的视觉差异、抑制无关差异。
AI.result: 在工业基准数据集以及工业到医学的跨域迁移实验中，性能优于现有以图像为中心的残差学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 引入文本语义残差引导图像残差，可生成更具判别性的异常表示，为通用异常检测提供有效的多模态残差学习范式。

title: 3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have demonstrated strong generalization under large-scale pre-training, yet they struggle in long-tail scenarios such as low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation. We observe relational attention structure collapse, manifested as the failure of cross-view correspondences, as a primary cause of these limitations. While adaptation offers a practical way to bridge this gap, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches mainly perform channel-wise feature adjustment and lack mechanisms to explicitly adapt relational structures, leaving correspondence failures unresolved. In this work, we formulate adaptation of 3D reconstruction models as a problem of correspondence recovery under domain shift and propose 3R-Adapter, a PEFT paradigm for long-tail 3D reconstruction scenarios. Our method consists of three components: Deformable Retrieval for task-adaptive relation candidate retrieval, Relational Rewiring for reconstructing cross-view relational structures, and Consistency Refinement for injecting the rewired relations into stable predictions. Extensive experiments on low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves robustness over existing PEFT methods while maintaining efficient lightweight adaptation. Our code is released at https://github.com/PKU-OV3-LAB/3R-Adapter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出3R-Adapter，将前馈3D重建模型的适配问题重新表述为域偏移下的对应关系恢复问题，通过可变形检索、关系重连与一致性精炼三个模块显式重建跨视角关系结构，在低光照重建、人物-场景联合重建与测试时适配等长尾场景中显著优于现有PEFT方法。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型在大规模预训练下泛化性强，但在低光照重建、人物-场景联合重建、测试时适配等长尾场景中表现不佳。作者观察到其主因是"关系注意力结构崩塌"，即跨视角对应关系失效。现有参数高效微调（PEFT）方法主要做通道级特征调整，缺乏显式适配关系结构的机制，因而无法解决对应失效问题。
AI.method: 将3D重建模型的适配建模为域偏移下的对应恢复问题，提出PEFT范式3R-Adapter，包含三个组件：(1) Deformable Retrieval，进行任务自适应的关系候选检索；(2) Relational Rewiring，重建跨视角关系结构；(3) Consistency Refinement，将重连后的关系注入稳定预测中。
AI.result: 在低光照重建、人物-场景联合重建与测试时适配三类任务上的大量实验表明，该方法在保持高效轻量适配的同时，鲁棒性显著优于现有PEFT方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 显式恢复跨视角关系结构是提升前馈3D重建模型长尾鲁棒性的关键，3R-Adapter以轻量PEFT形式实现了有效的关系级适配。

title: End-to-End Joint Training of Super-Resolution and Compression Artifact Removal for Industrial Machine Vision
