To address this limitation, we propose Multi-STG, a unified framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-derived semantic priors with graph-based spatiotemporal learning. Multi-STG introduces an LLM-empowered semantic enhancement module that transforms comprehensive context descriptions such as weather, POIs, and holidays into high-level semantic embeddings, effectively providing a knowledge-driven complement to data scarcity. Furthermore, we design a multimodal attentional fusion mechanism to dynamically weigh heterogeneous inputs and a semantic-enhanced prediction head with gated residual calibration to robustly adjust forecasts based on semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-city private car datasets demonstrate that Multi-STG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MAE by 11.82\% on average relative to the strongest baseline across three cities, while maintaining stable performance under sparse and non-stationary conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出Multi-STG框架，将LLM生成的语义先验与图时空学习融合，用于恶劣天气下的城市交通流预测，在多城市真实数据集上平均降低MAE 11.82%。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气等罕见气象事件下的交通流预测存在数据稀疏与复杂非线性偏移问题；现有数据驱动模型将环境上下文仅作为浅层数值特征，无法刻画"为何、如何"影响不同功能区出行行为的语义推理过程。
AI.method: 统一框架Multi-STG：1) LLM赋能的语义增强模块，将天气、POI、节假日等上下文描述转写为高层语义嵌入，作为知识驱动的数据稀缺补充；2) 多模态注意力融合机制，动态加权异构输入；3) 语义增强预测头，结合门控残差校准，依据语义引导稳健调整预测。
AI.result: 在多城市真实私家车数据集上优于SOTA基线，三个城市平均MAE相对最强基线降低11.82%，并在稀疏、非平稳条件下保持稳定性能。
AI.conclusion: 引入LLM语义先验可有效弥补恶劣天气场景下的数据稀缺，语义-时空联合建模是提升异常条件下交通预测鲁棒性的有效途径。

title: Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories
summary: Large language models and the multi-agent systems built around them could accelerate materials discovery by connecting scientific knowledge with experimental decisions. Existing benchmarks establish capabilities in domain knowledge, multimodal interpretation and scientific tool use. As language models increasingly support materials research workflows, their ability to distinguish closely related material states and reason accurately with quantitative evidence remains insufficiently evaluated. These abilities are essential for comparing material responses, assessing mechanisms and maintaining reliable judgements as experimental evidence accumulates. We introduce MatScope to evaluate three connected capabilities. M1 tests unaided, condition-specific reasoning through 200 tasks spanning ten research functions, using aluminium and high-entropy alloys as representative material systems. M2 tests agent-assisted transfer of related knowledge to unresolved materials questions. MatEvoBench-20 tests initial forecasts across scientific dependency chains and revisions of still-hidden responses as observations accumulate. Across eleven model deployments, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, given-input calculations and many physical explanations are handled well. Fine-grained response estimates, comparisons between similar states and quantitatively supported choices remain substantially weaker. Related literature improves selected estimates, while condition and baseline mismatches limit transfer. Progressive observations calibrate some downstream responses and destabilize earlier accurate predictions. MatScope establishes measurable targets for developing reliable scientific reasoning in future self-evolving materials laboratories and materials-aware world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MatScope 基准，用于评估语言模型及多智能体系统在材料科学中对相近材料状态的区分、定量证据推理及随证据累积修正判断的能力，涵盖 M1、M2 与 MatEvoBench-20 三项关联任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基准已覆盖领域知识、多模态解读与科学工具使用，但模型区分密切相关材料状态、以定量证据准确推理的能力评估不足；而这些能力对比较材料响应、判定机制及维持可靠判断至关重要。
AI.method: MatScope 设计三项任务：M1 用 200 个任务、覆盖十类研究功能、以铝合金与高熵合金为代表体系，测试无辅助的条件特定推理；M2 测试智能体辅助下将相关知识迁移至未解决的材料问题；MatEvoBench-20 测试沿科学依赖链的初始预测，以及随观测累积对仍隐藏响应的修正。共评估十一个模型部署。
AI.result: 给定输入的计算与多数物理解释表现良好；但细粒度响应估计、相似状态比较与有定量支撑的选择明显较弱。相关文献可改善部分估计，但条件与基线不匹配限制迁移；渐进观测能校准部分下游响应，却会破坏早先准确的预测。
AI.conclusion: MatScope 为未来自演化材料实验室与材料感知世界模型中的可靠科学推理设定了可测量的发展目标。

title: ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents
summary: On-policy self-distillation lets a language agent act as its own Teacher by conditioning on privileged context such as skills written from its own trajectories. Its guidance, however, is weighted by how much this context shifts token likelihoods rather than by whether it improves behavior, so errors in self-written skills return through later updates. We propose environment-calibrated on-policy self-distillation, which uses environmental outcomes to decide how much to trust the Teacher's current guidance and which self-written skills to reinforce. Command-level advantages, estimated by comparing commands executed at similar observations, scale each Teacher preference and reward reflections and skills whose induced preferences favor higher-advantage commands. Without skills at inference, 3B and 7B agents reach 90.5% and 93.3% macro success on seen ALFWorld tasks and 75.5% and 80.5% success on WebShop. On unseen ALFWorld tasks, they outperform GRPO under the same protocol by 11.0 and 7.6 percentage points, respectively. In an ablation study, supervising only executable commands rather than the Actor's full response raises 3B WebShop success from 52.3% to 75.0%.

AI.tldr: 提出环境校准的在线自蒸馏（EC-OPSD），用环境结果（命令级优势）来衡量教师引导的可信度并筛选需要强化的自写技能，使3B/7B智能体在ALFWorld和WebShop上显著优于GRPO。
AI.motivation: 在线自蒸馏中，智能体以特权上下文（如自写技能）充当教师，但引导信号仅按该上下文对token似然的改变程度加权，而非按是否真正改善行为加权，导致自写技能中的错误会通过后续更新被传播放大。
AI.method: 以环境结果为校准信号：在相似观测下比较所执行命令来估计命令级优势，用该优势对每个教师偏好进行缩放；并对那些诱导出的偏好倾向于更高优势命令的反思与技能给予奖励（加权强化），仅监督可执行命令而非Actor的完整回复。
AI.result: 推理时不使用技能，3B与7B在已见ALFWorld任务上宏平均成功率为90.5%/93.3%，WebShop为75.5%/80.5%；在未见ALFWorld任务上于相同协议下分别比GRPO高11.0与7.6个百分点。消融显示仅监督可执行命令可将3B的WebShop成功率从52.3%提升至75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 用环境结果校准自蒸馏的教师引导权重和技能强化方向，能有效抑制自写技能错误回流，提升分布内与分布外泛化能力，且命令级监督是关键设计。

title: Joi-Bench-Task: Benchmarking Task Coordination in Full-duplex Voice Agents through Interactive Simulation
summary: Full-duplex voice agents enable natural, hands-free interaction, allowing users to refine requests, redirect ongoing work, and seek clarification while the agent is speaking. However, existing voice-agent benchmarks insufficiently isolate coordination between task execution and conversation. We introduce a benchmark that assesses this coordination by examining whether agents track what is being executed, what has been completed, what has been communicated, and what remains to be reported as the conversation evolves. We propose an interactive user simulator that introduces configurable interventions at designated timing in tool execution and spoken result delivery, supporting controllable and reproducible evaluation conditions. We evaluate five leading commercial voice agents along three dimensions: execution responsiveness, coordination under request changes, and coordination under interruptions. Agent evaluations reveal persistent coordination failures. Under request changes, the highest result completion rate is only 55%, indicating difficulty for current voice agents adapting to new requests while preserving earlier obligations. After user interruption, four of the five agents exhibit average information omission rates of at least 23%. These findings highlight task coordination as a central challenge for current voice agents in complex, evolving conversations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个评估全双工语音智能体"任务执行与对话协调"能力的基准，并配套可配置干预的交互式用户模拟器；评测五种主流商业语音智能体，发现其在请求变更与打断场景下存在持续性的协调失败。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音智能体支持用户在智能体说话时细化请求、改变方向或寻求澄清，但现有语音智能体基准未能充分隔离"任务执行"与"对话"之间的协调能力，缺乏对"正在执行什么、已完成什么、已传达什么、尚待汇报什么"的跟踪评估。
AI.method: 构建一个基准，通过在对话演进过程中检验智能体对执行状态与信息传达状态的跟踪来评估协调能力；提出交互式用户模拟器，可在工具执行的指定时点与语音结果播报的指定时点引入可配置干预，从而支持可控、可复现的评测条件；沿三个维度评测五种领先商业语音智能体：执行响应性、请求变更下的协调、打断下的协调。
AI.result: 智能体评测显示持续存在的协调失败：在请求变更条件下，最高结果完成率仅55%，表明当前语音智能体难以在保留既有义务的同时适应新请求；在用户打断后，五种智能体中有四种平均信息遗漏率至少为23%。
AI.conclusion: 任务协调是当前语音智能体在复杂、动态演进对话中的核心挑战；该基准与模拟器为可控、可复现地诊断此类失败提供了评测手段。

title: From Fluent Text to Ontology-Compatible Definitions: A Quality-Control Agentic Workflow
summary: Biomedical ontologies are structured knowledge systems that must evolve continuously to represent newly emerging knowledge, but their manual maintenance remains time-consuming and laborintensive. Textual definitions are especially costly because they must be readable to humans and compatible with controlled entities, relations, and logical constraints. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising way to assist ontology engineering tasks, including definition generation. However, textual plausibility does not guarantee knowledge-system compatibility. A generated definition may be fluent and close to a reference definition, yet still fail to ground its implied entities or violate ontology-level constraints. Directly inserting such definitions into ontology libraries may therefore introduce entity-level hallucinations and logical inconsistencies. To address this problem, we propose two structured-knowledge incompatibility metrics, Entity Error Rate (EER) and Logical Inconsistency Rate (LIR), to quantify entity grounding and logical consistency for LLM-generated ontology definitions. We further develop an agentic quality-control (QC) workflow that treats definition generation as an iterative process rather than a direct decoding step: it generates definitions, extracts axioms, checks entity existence and logical consistency, and uses the resulting diagnostics to drive repair loops. Comprehensive experiments on Disease Ontology, Uberon Ontology, and Uberon-ConstraintStress demonstrate that EER and LIR complement conventional reference-based metrics by evaluating whether generated content can be grounded and checked inside the target ontology. The workflow effectively decreases EER while maintaining strong conventional text-generation performance. LIR further exposes sparse ontology-level logical failures that are invisible to text similarity metrics, although their repair remains limited.

AI.tldr: 该文提出实体错误率(EER)与逻辑不一致率(LIR)两个结构化知识不兼容性指标，并构建智能体式质检(QC)工作流迭代生成与修复本体定义。
AI.motivation: 生物医学本体需持续演化，但人工维护定义成本高；LLM生成定义虽文本流畅，却可能出现实体接地幻觉与逻辑约束冲突，文本合理性不等同于知识系统兼容性，直接写入本体库风险大。
AI.method: 提出EER（实体接地）与LIR（逻辑一致性）两项指标；设计智能体质检工作流，将定义生成视为迭代过程：生成定义→抽取公理→检查实体存在性与逻辑一致性→依据诊断信息驱动修复循环。在Disease Ontology、Uberon及Uberon-ConstraintStress上评测。
AI.result: EER与LIR可补充传统基于参考文本的指标，衡量生成内容能否在目标本体中接地与校验；工作流降低EER并保持较强常规文本生成表现；LIR揭示文本相似度无法察觉的本体级逻辑失效，但其修复效果仍有限。
AI.conclusion: 文本相似度不足以评估LLM生成本体定义的质量，需引入结构化兼容性指标与迭代质检机制；实体接地问题可有效改善，逻辑不一致的自动修复仍是待解难题。

title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery
summary: We propose SciMARS, a framework for recursive task-local adaptation of multi-agent harnesses in closed-loop scientific discovery. Multi-agent systems coordinate analysis, experimental design, and verification as scientific evidence evolves. However, two problems limit their effectiveness: (i) without shared memory, agents lose observations and repeat work; (ii) fixed role procedures, handoffs, and memory policies perpetuate mistakes despite retained evidence. We address these problems with a shared evidence graph and separate component editors. SciMARS adapts roles and coordination; SciMARS + Memory adds a third editor for how agents record, retrieve, and receive evidence. Candidate probes guide composition and selection of the next harness. We evaluate scientific discovery through experimental-data replay and a digital twin. SciMARS + Memory resolves 12/18 GPT-6-Astra and 2/18 GLM-5.3 attempts on Autonomous Science Bench, compared with 8/18 and 1/18 for the base multi-agent team. On ScienceAgentBench and AppWorld, it solves 14/38 and 11/20 tasks, compared with 11/38 and 5/20 for the base team. These results support combining shared memory with harness adaptation across scientific and interactive tasks.

AI.tldr: SciMARS 提出闭环科学发现中多智能体框架的递归式任务局部自适应方法，结合共享证据图与分离的组件编辑器，并给出实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体科学发现系统存在两个问题：(i) 缺乏共享记忆导致智能体丢失观测、重复劳动；(ii) 固定的角色流程、交接与记忆策略会在已有证据的情况下延续错误。
AI.method: 以共享证据图（shared evidence graph）与彼此分离的组件编辑器为核心：SciMARS 自适应调整角色与协作方式，SciMARS + Memory 额外增加第三个编辑器，专门处理智能体如何记录、检索与接收证据；并通过候选探针（candidate probes）指导下一版 harness 的组装与选择。评估采用实验数据回放与数字孪生。
AI.result: 在 Autonomous Science Bench 上，SciMARS + Memory 于 GPT-6-Astra 解决 12/18、GLM-5.3 解决 2/18，基线多智能体团队分别为 8/18 与 1/18；在 ScienceAgentBench 与 AppWorld 上分别解决 14/38 与 11/20，基线为 11/38 与 5/20。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将共享记忆与 harness 自适应相结合，可同时提升科学发现类与交互类任务的完成表现。

title: Detecting Shadow AI: Unsanctioned LLM Agents on Enterprise Endpoints: A Taxonomy, an Open Detector and a Controlled Evaluation
comment: 55 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Code, catalog and evaluation bench: https://github.com/jeremy1392/IntuneAgentDetector
summary: Shadow IT, the use of technology that the IT organisation has not approved, is a long-standing governance problem. We argue that autonomous AI agents can make it grow much faster: agents make building tools nearly free, act with their user's privileges, and leave behind scripts, automations and MCP servers that are themselves unsanctioned. A simple compounding model shows that, under its assumptions, shadow IT grows exponentially once agentic artifacts reproduce faster than the organisation retires them; retiring them starts with detecting them. We then ask whether unsanctioned agents can be detected on Windows endpoints. We propose a taxonomy of nine classes of agents and six layers of endpoint footprint, and argue that rules based only on the structure of processes and connections cannot separate an agent from its behavioural twin, the same program talking to a non-AI service. We present Agent Detector, an open-source Windows detector that anchors behaviour to the identity of the remote service and correlates it with configuration, installation and execution history, using a catalog of 39 tools and 184 LLM endpoint entries; it informs users through a notice they must acknowledge instead of blocking. On a controlled bench of 12 synthetic agents, 3 AI components and 9 benign workloads, repeated 5 times on one workstation, two behavioural rules flagged every behavioural twin, while Agent Detector flagged none and detected every agent in the majority of runs. Its limits are temporal: a connection to a provider behind a shared content-delivery network is attributable only while the DNS cache holds the provider's name, one to five minutes, and an intermittent agent was seen by about one scan in three. A scan costs about 154 ms. The bench is too small to rank detectors; it maps what each kind of evidence can see: unsanctioned agents can be partly detected, and not by behaviour alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自主AI智能体会加速影子IT扩散，并论证仅靠进程/连接结构规则无法区分AI智能体与其"行为孪生"，进而提出基于远端服务身份锚定的Windows端检测器Agent Detector。
AI.motivation: 影子IT长期是治理难题，而自主AI智能体使工具构建近乎零成本、以用户权限运行、并留下脚本/自动化/MCP服务器等未授权产物，可能显著加速其增长；而治理退休这些产物的前提是先能检测到它们。
AI.method: 建立简单复合增长模型刻画影子IT的指数增长机制；提出9类智能体分类学与6层端点足迹框架；论证仅凭进程与连接结构的规则无法区分智能体与非AI服务的"行为孪生"；实现开源Windows检测器Agent Detector，将行为锚定到远端服务身份，并与配置、安装、执行历史关联，使用39个工具与184条LLM端点条目的目录，以必须确认的提示而非阻断方式通知用户；在12个合成智能体、3个AI组件与9个良性负载的受控测试台上重复5次评估，并与两条行为规则对比。
AI.result: 两条纯行为规则标记了全部行为孪生（误报），而Agent Detector未标记任何孪生，并在大多数运行中检出所有智能体；局限性为时间相关：经共享CDN访问的提供商连接仅在DNS缓存保留期（1–5分钟）内可归因，间歇性智能体约每3次扫描仅被看到1次；单次扫描约154 ms。
AI.conclusion: 测试台规模不足以对检测器进行排序，但能刻画各类证据的可观测边界：未授权智能体只能被部分检测，且不能仅靠行为检测。

title: AMSchem: Automated Schematic Visualization of AMS Circuits via Verifiable Agentic Generation
summary: For decades, the netlist-to-schematic gap has remained a persistent challenge in design automation, especially for analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits. Netlists encode connectivity, not visual presentation, making their manual conversion into readable schematics time-consuming and dependent on expert conventions. The same gap leaves LLM-based design tools without structured visual feedback, forcing them to iterate on circuits they cannot see. We present AMSchem, a training-free, verifier-guided agentic framework that automatically generates human-readable schematics from AMS netlists. AMSchem separates circuit-aware visual planning (DrawingIntent) from executable schematic geometry (SchematicIR), and applies localized visual feedback with bounded, revalidated repair patches. Deterministic validators enforce device preservation, pin-net consistency, and geometric correctness throughout. For evaluation, we construct AMSchem-Bench comprising 64 circuits of 12 types. On the 40-circuit schematic subset, AMSchem with gpt-5.5 achieves 85.0\% validity (vs. 32.5\% direct generation). When integrated as a visual feedback module in LLM-based analog design, AMSchem resolves all 13 previously failed cases from AnalogCoder benchmark across five models, substantially improving the success rate. Our dataset and benchmark are available at https://www.amschem.com/benchmark

AI.tldr: AMSchem：免训练、验证器引导的智能体框架，将 AMS 网表自动转为可读原理图，达到 85.0% 有效率并可作为 LLM 设计工具的视觉反馈模块。
AI.motivation: 网表只编码连接关系而非视觉呈现，人工转原理图耗时且依赖专家惯例；同时 LLM 设计工具缺乏结构化视觉反馈，只能"盲"迭代电路。
AI.method: 将电路感知的视觉规划（DrawingIntent）与可执行原理图几何（SchematicIR）解耦；采用局部化视觉反馈与有界、可重验证的修复补丁；以确定性验证器全程约束器件保持、引脚-网络一致性及几何正确性；框架免训练。
AI.result: 构建 AMSchem-Bench（64 个电路、12 类）；40 电路原理图子集上，AMSchem+gpt-5.5 有效率达 85.0%（直接生成为 32.5%）；作为视觉反馈模块接入 LLM 模拟设计后，在五个模型上解决了 AnalogCoder 基准中全部 13 个失败案例，显著提升成功率。
AI.conclusion: 分层抽象+确定性验证+局部修复的策略有效弥合网表-原理图鸿沟，并可作为通用视觉反馈组件增强 LLM 模拟电路设计闭环。

title: Med-DualLoRA: Local Adaptation of Foundation Models for 3D Cardiac MRI
summary: Foundation models (FMs) show great promise for robust downstream performance across medical imaging tasks and modalities, including cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), following task-specific adaptation. However, adaptation using single-site data may lead to suboptimal performance and increased model bias, while centralized fine-tuning on clinical data is often infeasible due to privacy constraints. Federated fine-tuning offers a privacy-preserving alternative; yet conventional approaches struggle under heterogeneous, non-IID multi-center data and incur substantial communication overhead when adapting large models. In this work, we study federated FM fine-tuning for 3D CMR disease detection and propose Med-DualLoRA, a client-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) federated framework that disentangles globally shared and local low-rank adaptations (LoRA) through additive decomposition. Global and local LoRA modules are trained locally, but only the global component is shared and aggregated across sites, keeping local adapters private. This design improves personalization while significantly reducing communication cost, and experiments show that adapting only two transformer blocks preserves performance while further improving efficiency. We evaluate our method on a multi-center state-of-the-art cine 3D CMR FM fine-tuned for disease detection using ACDC and combined M\&Ms datasets, treating each vendor as a federated client. Med-DualLoRA achieves statistically significant improved performance (balanced accuracy 0.768, specificity 0.612) compared to other federated PEFT baselines, while maintaining communication efficiency. Our approach provides a scalable solution for local federated adaptation of medical FMs under realistic clinical constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出 Med-DualLoRA：将 LoRA 加性分解为全局共享与本地私有两部分，仅聚合全局分量的客户端感知联邦 PEFT 框架，用于 3D CMR 疾病检测。
AI.motivation: 心脏磁共振基础模型需任务适配，但单中心数据适配易致性能次优与模型偏置；集中式微调受隐私限制不可行。常规联邦微调在异构 non-IID 多中心数据下表现不佳，且大模型适配通信开销大。
AI.method: 基于加性分解的联邦参数高效微调：全局与本地 LoRA 模块均在本地训练，仅全局分量在站点间共享与聚合，本地适配器保持私有；实验表明仅适配两个 transformer 块即可保持性能并进一步提升效率。在 ACDC 与 M&Ms 组合数据上，以厂商为联邦客户端，将 cine 3D CMR 基础模型微调用于疾病检测。
AI.result: 相比其他联邦 PEFT 基线取得统计显著更优性能（平衡准确率 0.768，特异度 0.612），同时保持通信效率。
AI.conclusion: Med-DualLoRA 在真实临床约束下为医学基础模型的本地化联邦适配提供了可扩展方案。

title: MaxIM: Maximally Informative Incremental Summarization via Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: AI systems must often maintain bounded memory of unbounded interaction histories. However, optimizing the memory representation, and its updates, for downstream task utility is difficult for standard reinforcement learning (RL) due to severe credit assignment bottlenecks induced by sparse, delayed rewards. We introduce MaxIM (Maximally Informative Incremental Memory), a framework that formulates incremental summarization as a capacity-constrained, information-theoretic reward-shaping problem. Grounded in value suboptimality bounds, we show that bounding sequential information loss motivates maximizing the predictive log-likelihood of future, task-relevant targets, a variational lower bound on predictive sufficiency. We introduce a recursive consistency condition to ensure summaries are grounded by maximizing mutual information (MI) with the observed history. We mitigate credit assignment issues with a parameterized asymmetric critic that computes step-wise variational MI bounds for dense reward shaping. Empirical evaluation on long-horizon scientific reading and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks shows that MaxIM outperforms RL, supervised fine-tuning, and prompt-focused baselines on factual grounding, comprehensive autorater metrics, and downstream task utility across strict token budgets and extended horizons, without the need for expensive human preference labels.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MaxIM（Maximally Informative Incremental Memory）框架，将增量摘要（有界记忆更新）建模为容量约束下的信息论奖励塑形问题，用于在无界交互历史中学习对下游任务最有用的有界记忆表示。
AI.motivation: AI 系统需要在无界交互历史中维护有界记忆，但标准强化学习因稀疏、延迟奖励带来严重信用分配瓶颈，难以直接优化记忆表示及其更新以服务下游任务效用。同时依赖昂贵的人类偏好标注也不理想。
AI.method: 基于价值次优性界，证明约束序列信息损失可转化为最大化未来任务相关目标的预测对数似然（预测充分性的变分下界）；引入递归一致性条件，通过最大化摘要与观测历史的互信息保证摘要"有据可依"；并用参数化非对称评论家计算逐步变分互信息下界，构造稠密奖励以缓解信用分配问题。
AI.result: 在长程科学阅读与多轮对话基准上，于严格 token 预算与更长时序条件下，MaxIM 在事实依据性、综合自动评分指标和下游任务效用上均优于 RL、监督微调及面向提示的基线方法，且无需昂贵的人类偏好标签。
AI.conclusion: 将增量记忆摘要表述为信息论奖励塑形问题，可在不依赖偏好标注的情况下有效优化有界记忆对下游任务的效用，并缓解稀疏奖励下的信用分配瓶颈。

title: Interpretability Is Not Model-Specific
summary: Interpretability tools are usually built for one model at a time: a refusal direction, a truthfulness probe, or a steering vector is found with labeled data inside the model it explains. We ask whether such tools can be carried to other models through a map between residual streams fit only on unlabeled prompts. We transfer a refusal direction, tested causally by addition and ablation, and two read-out tools, a correctness direction and a sentiment probe, across 110 pairs of models from five families and 1B to 72B parameters and between base and instruction-tuned models, with controls for specificity and five seeds. How much transfers depends on what the map was fit on. A map fit on ordinary questions recovers 54\% of the target's own refusal steering and 16\% to 77\% of its correctness gain; adding unlabeled prompts from the region where the tool operates raises these to 102\% and 88\% to 98\%, while control directions recover at most 1\%. We prove that a linear map behaves this way whenever two models correspond linearly on the data it covers, and a label-free coverage score derived from this result tracks recovery across more than 16,000 runs and explains earlier reports that maps between models fail across domains. Carried read-out tools outperform anything the target's unlabeled representations yield. Interpretability results, once found, can be reused across models at the cost of a few unlabeled prompts.

AI.tldr: 通过仅在无标注提示上拟合的残差流映射，可将拒答方向、正确性方向与情感探针跨模型迁移；映射所覆盖的数据区域决定迁移效果，并可用无标签覆盖率分数预测。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性工具（拒答方向、真实性探针、引导向量）通常针对单一模型、依赖该模型内部标注数据构建，无法直接复用。作者希望检验这些工具能否借助仅用无标注提示拟合的模型间残差流映射迁移到其他模型。
AI.method: 在五个模型家族、1B–72B 参数、共110对模型（含基座与指令微调之间）上迁移一个拒答方向（以加性与消融方式做因果检验）及两个读出工具（正确性方向、情感探针），并设置特异性对照与五个随机种子；比较不同拟合数据（普通问题 vs. 工具作用区域的提示）对迁移效果的影响，并从理论上证明线性映射在数据线性对应时的行为，据此提出无标签覆盖率分数。
AI.result: 在普通问题上拟合的映射可恢复目标模型自身拒答引导效果的54%、正确性增益的16%–77%；加入工具作用区域的无标注提示后提升至102%和88%–98%，而对照方向最多仅恢复1%。理论证明线性映射在此情形下必然呈现该行为，覆盖率分数在逾16000次运行中与恢复率吻合，并解释了此前"跨域映射失败"的报告；迁移后的读出工具优于目标模型无标注表示所得结果。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性结果一旦获得，只需少量无标注提示即可跨模型复用；迁移成败由映射覆盖的数据区域决定，并可由无标签覆盖率分数预先评估。

title: CHORD: Multi-resolution Compression for Multimodal Time Series
summary: Wearables, mobile devices, and IoT platforms generate multimodal time-series data continuously and at scale, making efficient storage and transfer a primary concern. The same recordings are reused after collection by many downstream models, often at different temporal resolutions, so a compressed representation should be small, useful across resolutions, and produced at a bit rate known in advance. Prior work meets parts of this: symbolic and error-bounded compressors reconstruct accurately but fix resolution at compression time, learned codecs target one signal domain, and discrete tokenizers reconstruct without accounting for rate. We introduce CHORD, a coarse-to-fine compressor for heterogeneous multimodal time series. A residual cascade orders each payload from broad to fine temporal scales and synthesizes corrections through learned shapelet-inspired atoms. A shared pathway supplies a reusable synthesis basis across modalities, while private pathways retain capacity for sensor-specific morphology. Finite scalar quantization fixes the bit width of every modality and scale, so payload size is known before encoding, and scale dropout trains each coarse-to-fine prefix to be a valid reconstruction operating point. Across seven wearable-sensing and forecasting benchmarks, CHORD stays within 0.62 points of uncompressed classification accuracy on average at the 8x target, the smallest gap of any compressed method, with all resolutions decoded from one payload.

AI.tldr: CHORD：面向异构多模态时间序列的由粗到细压缩器，通过残差级联+shapelet原子合成+有限标量量化+尺度dropout，实现多分辨率复用、码率已知的紧凑表示，在7个基准上8x压缩下分类精度与未压缩仅差0.62点。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴/移动/IoT平台持续产生大规模多模态时序数据，存储与传输成本高；同一记录被多下游模型在不同时间分辨率上复用，理想压缩表示需同时满足三条件：体积小、跨分辨率可用、码率可预先确定。现有方法各有缺陷：符号化与误差有界压缩虽重建精确但分辨率在压缩时被固定；学习式编解码器仅针对单一信号域；离散tokenizer重建时未考虑码率控制。
AI.method: 1) 残差级联（residual cascade）：将每个数据载荷按时间尺度由粗到细排序；2) 学习式类shapelet原子（shapelet-inspired atoms）合成各级修正项；3) 共享通路提供跨模态可复用的合成基，私有通路保留传感器特有形态的表达容量；4) 有限标量量化（finite scalar quantization）固定每个模态、每个尺度比特宽度，使载荷大小在编码前已知；5) 尺度dropout训练使每个由粗到细前缀都成为有效重建工作点。
AI.result: 在7个可穿戴感知与预测基准上，8x目标压缩率下CHORD平均分类精度与未压缩相比差距仅0.62个百分点，为所有压缩方法中最小；且所有分辨率均可由单一载荷解码。
AI.conclusion: CHORD以由粗到细的残差级联与固定比特量化，兼顾紧凑性、跨分辨率复用性和码率可控性，验证了"一次压缩、多分辨率下游使用"的可行范式。

title: ACROSSVAM3.0: Resource-Bounded 4D Scene Construction and Adaptive Surface Association
summary: Combining video generation, dynamic reconstruction and monocular SLAM requires consistent coordinates, explicit handling of missing outputs and predictable memory use. We present AcrossVAM3.0, an offline system that converts text, images or monocular RGB video into a versioned point representation. Frozen components run sequentially on one GPU; map corrections update cameras, points and trajectories together. The coordination layer adds no neural parameters. Three fresh input-mode runs completed with a maximum sampled task-process-tree GPU footprint of 17.14 GB. In a frozen 16-scene video suite, every scene yielded a 4D reconstruction and 15 yielded a non-empty SLAM map. Strict cross-window matching reduced local surface error but lost long-range track coverage on TAP-Vid-DAVIS. We therefore developed multi-hypothesis adaptive surface chaining (MHAC), which retains several candidate matches and an explicit missing state. After selection on disjoint development data, MHAC improved Average Jaccard over a position-only baseline by 0.1394 on a frozen ten-video holdout (95% bootstrap interval [0.1074,0.1689]). Across 265 RoboTAP videos, the mean paired gain was 0.0610 ([0.0510,0.0715]), with 215 wins, one tie and 49 losses. These results support resource-bounded scene construction and an external tracking gain under the tested protocol. They do not establish metric scale, semantic identity or high-fidelity novel-view rendering.

AI.tldr: AcrossVAM3.0 是一个无神经网络参数的协调层离线系统，将文本/图像/单目 RGB 视频统一转换为可版本化的点表示，并支持相机、点与轨迹的同步修正。
AI.motivation: 整合视频生成、动态重建与单目 SLAM 需要一致的坐标系、对缺失输出的显式处理以及可预测的内存占用；严格跨窗口匹配虽降低局部表面误差，却损失长程轨迹覆盖。
AI.method: 冻结组件在单张 GPU 上顺序执行，协调层不含神经参数，地图修正统一更新相机、点和轨迹；提出多假设自适应表面链接（MHAC），保留多个候选匹配并引入显式缺失状态，并在独立开发集上完成选择。
AI.result: 三种输入模式各一次新运行，任务进程树采样 GPU 峰值显存 17.14 GB；冻结的 16 场景视频套件全部产出 4D 重建，15 个产出非空 SLAM 地图。MHAC 在冻结的 10 视频留出集上较仅位置基线提升 Average Jaccard 0.1394（95% bootstrap 区间 [0.1074, 0.1689]）；在 265 个 RoboTAP 视频上平均配对增益 0.0610（[0.0510, 0.0715]），215 胜、1 平、49 负。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持资源受限的场景构建及所测协议下的外部跟踪增益，但未证明度量尺度、语义身份与高保真新视角渲染能力。

title: COMPASS: Composable Policy-Amortized Structured Search for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
summary: Large language models offer a promising technique for translating natural-language optimization problems into solver code, but their reliability remains constrained by the quality of template retrieval. While recent structured methods improve over flat prompting through hierarchical taxonomy search, their traversal rules remain fixed or LLM-driven at inference time, leaving retrieval unable to improve from past successes and failures. This motivates treating template retrieval as a policy that can be learned from modeling experience, rather than as a static inference-time rule. We propose COMPASS, a policy-amortized framework for retrieving optimization templates in LLM-based solver modeling, which represents the template library as a directed acyclic graph and formulates retrieval as a sequential decision process over template nodes. A deep Q-network learns a reusable traversal policy from template-level judgments and execution feedback, reducing reliance on fixed heuristic traversal through feedback-driven graph navigation. To support extensible retrieval, COMPASS embeds problem descriptions and template nodes in a shared semantic space, allowing newly inserted templates to be scored from their text descriptions without redefining the action space. Experiments across multiple LLM backbones and optimization-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that COMPASS consistently improves over heuristic structured retrieval, with the largest gains on complex and mixed-category problems.

AI.tldr: COMPASS将优化建模中的模板检索建模为DAG上的序贯决策问题，用深度Q网络从历史建模经验中学习可复用的遍历策略，提升LLM生成求解器代码的可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM将自然语言优化问题翻译为求解器代码时，可靠性受限于模板检索质量。现有结构化方法（如层级分类体系搜索）虽优于扁平提示，但遍历规则在推理时固定或由LLM驱动，无法从既往成功与失败中学习改进。因此需要把模板检索视为可从建模经验中学习的策略，而非静态推理规则。
AI.method: 提出COMPASS策略摊销框架：将模板库表示为有向无环图（DAG），把检索形式化为模板节点上的序贯决策过程；采用深度Q网络（DQN），基于模板级判定与执行反馈学习可复用的遍历策略，以反馈驱动的图导航替代固定启发式遍历；同时在共享语义空间中对问题描述与模板节点进行嵌入，使新插入模板可直接由其文本描述打分，无需重定义动作空间，从而支持可扩展检索。
AI.result: 在多个LLM主干与优化建模基准上的实验表明，COMPASS相对启发式结构化检索取得一致性提升，且在复杂问题与混合类别问题上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 将模板检索从静态推理规则转变为可学习策略是可行且有效的；DAG形式化结合DQN策略摊销，配合语义嵌入支持的可扩展检索，能够持续改善LLM驱动的优化求解器建模，尤其适用于复杂和跨类别场景。

title: Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood
summary: Code localizers are usually trained to predict the files a reference patch edits, but the code a fixer needs to read is not the same as the code it changes. We propose Fixer-Guided Localization (FGL): the localizer proposes several localizations, a frozen fixer scores each by how likely it makes a verified patch, and the localizer is trained on these scores with weighted supervised fine-tuning, without running tests and without reinforcement learning. We build the full pipeline on Gemma 4 E4B for the Kaggle Gemma-4 Developer Agent competition, from 1,629 test-verified Kimi K3 trajectories. The FGL target helps the fixer find the bug as often as the teacher's localization while using 27.5% less code. On the development set, one EM round moves the agent in the expected direction compared with a matched control: more tasks reach a patch (53 vs. 46), fewer tasks get stuck reading files that do not exist (43 vs. 54), and more tasks are solved (8 vs. 6). Training also changes how the agent works: trained agents explore about three times more than the base model and write far fewer wrong patches, and the single agent solves up to 11 of 78 tasks, against 8 for the base model. An analysis of 13 evaluation runs identifies what limits a 4B agent under an 8-minute budget (time, repetition loops and edit quality) and gives practical lessons for training small coding agents. All data, code and adapters are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fixer-Guided Localization (FGL)：用冻结的修复器为定位候选打分，并以加权监督微调训练定位器；在 Gemma 4 E4B 上构建完整智能体流水线，验证集上解出任务数由 6 提升至 8，单智能体最高解出 11/78（基线 8）。
AI.motivation: 代码定位器通常被训练去预测参考补丁所修改的文件，但修复器实际需要阅读的代码与它需要修改的代码并不一致，存在目标错配。
AI.method: FGL 流程：定位器提出多个定位结果，由冻结修复器按"能否促成一个已验证补丁"的可能性打分，定位器用这些分数做加权监督微调；不运行测试、不使用强化学习。基于 Kimi K3 的 1,629 条测试验证轨迹，在 Gemma 4 E4B 上搭建完整流水线；开发集采用一轮 EM 与匹配对照组对比，并分析 13 次评测运行。
AI.result: FGL 目标使修复器发现缺陷的频率与教师定位相当，但少用 27.5% 的代码。开发集上相对匹配对照：达成补丁的任务 53 vs 46，卡在读取不存在文件的任务 43 vs 54，解出任务 8 vs 6。训练后智能体探索量约为基线的 3 倍、错误补丁显著减少，单智能体最高解出 11/78（基线 8）。
AI.conclusion: 以修复器反馈替代测试与强化学习来训练定位器是可行且高效的；4B 智能体在 8 分钟预算下的瓶颈为时间、重复循环与编辑质量，论文据此给出训练小型编码智能体的实践建议，并公开数据、代码与适配器。

title: CRAFT-AI: Capability and Requirement Alignment for Flexible Manufacturing through Agentic AI
comment: Preprint intended for submission to the 37th European Safety and Reliability Conference (ESREL 2027)
summary: One of the fundamental needs for reaching resilient production infrastructure is flexible manufacturing, which requires translating changing production requirements into implementable system configurations. This paper introduces \textbf{CRAFT-AI}, an agentic AI approach combining natural language (NL) requirement interpretation, Asset Administration Shell (AAS)-based capability descriptions, and reusable engineering knowledge from existing manufacturing configurations. A tool-using AI agent matches requirements with available capabilities and reference implementations to generate manufacturing scenes and corresponding AAS instances. The approach is demonstrated using a Factory I/O prototype with twelve reference scenes and five illustrative manufacturing tasks of varying complexity, providing an initial feasibility assessment of the proposed AAS-enabled, system-level generative engineering approach. For the four valid user task descriptions, proper requirements, correct references to the relevant engineering knowledge, correct components and lastly a valid Factory I/O scene are generated. For the task with missing engineering knowledge and a wrong sensor selection, the user is informed about which requirements of the scene generation lack domain knowledge and also which sensor is not compatible with the selected raw material by the user with link to the related documentation. After fixing the task description, the correct scene is seamlessly generated. \textbf{CRAFT-AI} highlights the importance of safeguards for risk perception and communication in foundation model-driven solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CRAFT-AI，一种融合自然语言需求理解、基于AAS的能力描述与可复用工程知识的智能体方法，可通过工具调用式AI智能体匹配需求与能力/参考实现，自动生成制造场景及对应AAS实例。
AI.motivation: 实现韧性生产基础设施需要柔性制造，而柔性制造要求将不断变化的生产需求转化为可实施的系统配置。现有工程流程缺乏从自然语言需求到可执行系统配置的自动化衔接。
AI.method: CRAFT-AI由三部分构成：自然语言需求解析、基于Asset Administration Shell（AAS）的能力描述，以及来自既有制造配置的可复用工程知识。工具调用式AI智能体据此将需求与可用能力及参考实现进行匹配，生成制造场景和相应AAS实例。基于Factory I/O原型，使用12个参考场景和5个复杂度不同的示例制造任务进行验证。
AI.result: 在4个有效的用户任务描述上，系统均生成正确需求、对相关工程知识的正确引用、正确组件及有效的Factory I/O场景。对于缺少工程知识且传感器选择错误的任务，系统能告知用户哪些场景生成需求缺乏领域知识，并指出所选原料不兼容的传感器及相关文档链接；修正任务描述后可无缝生成正确场景。
AI.conclusion: 该研究初步验证了AAS赋能的系统级生成式工程方法的可行性，并强调基础模型驱动方案中风险感知与沟通的安全保障机制的重要性。

title: AuDiR: Diagnosing Audio Reasoning with Rule and Percept Interventions
summary: Answer accuracy alone does not distinguish failures in acoustic perception, rule knowledge, and rule application. AuDiR (Audio Diagnostic Reasoning) examines these distinctions through controlled input interventions. Each item contains an audio clip, a multiple-choice question, a task-general rule, and a textual description of the acoustic observations needed to answer. Three conditions progressively supply the rule and observations; a fourth removes the audio while retaining the question and rule. The first correct diagnostic condition assigns an operational response label, without identifying a unique internal cause. The current benchmark contains 201 items in 18 families drawn from 9 sources, with answer references documented separately from percept extraction. In a preliminary evaluation of Gemini-3.8-flash, accuracy is 29.3% without supplied information, 31.3% with the rule, and 98.5% with the observations also supplied. No-audio accuracy is 23.9%, with a confidence interval containing the 25.0% chance rate. A family-level knowledge probe associates incomplete rule recall with larger gains from rule provision. These results show the benefit of supplying acoustic observations as text, while incomplete validation, possible recognition shortcuts, and non-monotonic responses limit stronger failure-attribution claims.

AI.tldr: AuDiR通过受控输入干预分离声学感知、规则知识与规则应用三类失败；初步结果显示提供文本化声学观测使准确率从29.3%升至98.5%。
AI.motivation: 单一答案正确率无法区分声学感知失败、规则知识缺失与规则应用错误，因此需要可控的输入干预来对失败类型进行功能性定位。
AI.method: 构建AuDiR基准：每题含音频、多选题、任务通用规则、以及回答所需的声学观测文本描述。设置三种渐进条件（依次提供规则、观测）与第四种条件（去除音频、保留题目与规则）；以首个通过的诊断条件赋予操作性响应标签，而非归因唯一内部原因。数据为201题、18个族、9个来源，答案参考与感知抽取文档分离；另设族级知识探测。
AI.result: Gemini-3.8-flash初步评测：无提示29.3%，提供规则31.3%，再提供观测98.5%；无音频条件23.9%，置信区间覆盖25.0%随机水平。族级知识探测显示规则回忆不完整与规则提供带来更大增益相关。
AI.conclusion: 文本化声学观测的供给带来显著收益；但验证不充分、可能的识别捷径及非单调响应限制了更强的失败归因结论，AuDiR目前定位为诊断性探针而非因果判定工具。

title: AutoBuddy: Evaluating Proactive, Always-On Agents on Task Discovery and Execution in a Simulated Workplace
summary: As LLM agents become more autonomous, they are increasingly expected to run as always-on assistants on a user's behalf, identifying work to be done and completing it without being asked. Yet existing benchmarks usually give the agent its task, whereas in knowledge work the requests sit in the user's workspace and the agent must first recognise which obligations exist. We study proactive task discovery and execution, in which an agent must infer a user's pending tasks from their workspace and complete them in the systems where the work lives. This setting poses two challenges. For the agent, the tasks are buried in a large volume of mail, chat, documents and records. For evaluation, a benchmark needs a simulated organisation whose people, events and documents are mutually consistent, so that tasks arise realistically and their correct outcomes are known. We introduce AutoBuddy-Bench, a simulator that addresses these challenges. It models an organisation's employees, projects, business systems and event history as a temporal graph, renders it into realistic workspace artefacts, derives ground-truth tasks from the events that create obligations, and computes each task's outcome from the world state; execution is judged by the agent's changes to the workspace. To evaluate current LLMs, we build AutoBuddy, a reference agent with interchangeable backbone LLMs: it identifies tasks from the workspace, grounding each in its source records, and executes each in a separate session with write access. Varying only the backbone, we find a systematic shift in where tasks are lost: weaker models fail mainly at discovery, intermediate models identify tasks but often stop short of carrying them out, and the strongest models fail mainly during execution, most often on business-system operations. Discovery precision is only weakly related to execution quality, suggesting the two are distinct capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoBuddy-Bench 模拟器与参考智能体 AutoBuddy，研究"主动任务发现与执行"：从用户工作区推断待办任务并在业务系统中完成，执行结果依据工作区变更判定。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常直接给出任务，而真实知识工作中请求散落在用户工作区（邮件、聊天、文档、记录）里，智能体须先自行识别有哪些义务存在；同时评估此类能力需要人员、事件、文档相互一致的组织仿真环境与已知正确答案。
AI.method: 构建 AutoBuddy-Bench：以时序图建模组织员工、项目、业务系统与事件历史，渲染为真实工作区产物，从产生义务的事件推导真值任务，并由世界状态计算任务结果，以智能体对工作区的改动评判执行。另构建参考智能体 AutoBuddy，可从工作区发现任务、将任务溯源到源记录，并在具写权限的独立会话中执行；实验中仅替换骨干 LLM。
AI.result: 仅更换骨干模型即观察到任务丢失位置的系统性迁移：弱模型主要失败于任务发现；中等模型能识别任务但常止步于执行之前；最强模型主要失败于执行阶段，且多集中在业务系统操作。发现精度与执行质量仅弱相关。
AI.conclusion: 任务发现与任务执行是两种可区分的能力，需分别评估与优化；一致性组织仿真加工作区状态判分是评测主动式智能体的可行范式。

title: Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks
comment: 20th CIRP Conference on Intelligent Computation in Manufacturing Engineering
summary: The push towards circularity and Re-X principles presents a challenge to SMEs, particularly due to increasing product complexity that impedes the adoption of disassembly automation. This paper introduces and compares two frameworks for extracting disassembly instructions from unstructured information sources, such as disassembly manuals. Our goal is to transform natural language text into a structured, curated and machine-readable format. We implemented and tested a rule-based Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework against a generative AI framework leveraging LLMs. The performance of both approaches was compared using real-world disassembly manuals. This work provides the necessary data foundation for developing and automating future disassembly processes.

AI.tldr: 该文面向中小企业推进循环经济与Re-X的拆解自动化瓶颈，提出并比较两种从拆解手册等非结构化文本中抽取拆解指令的框架：基于规则的自然语言处理（NLP）方法与基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式AI方法，目标是将自然语言文本转化为结构化、经人工校核、机器可读的格式，并用真实拆解手册进行性能对比。
AI.motivation: 产品复杂度上升阻碍拆解自动化的采用，中小企业尤受制约；拆解自动化需要结构化数据基础，而拆解信息多以非结构化自然语言文本（如拆解手册）存在，缺乏可直接利用的机器可读指令。
AI.method: 提出并实现两种拆解指令抽取框架：一是基于规则（rule-based）的NLP框架，二是利用LLM的生成式AI框架；在真实拆解手册数据上对两者进行实现、测试与性能对比评估。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标；报告了对两种方法在真实拆解手册上的性能比较结果（规则式NLP与LLM生成式方法的对照评估）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为未来拆解流程的开发与自动化提供了必要的数据基础，并揭示了规则式与生成式两类文本抽取路径在拆解知识结构化中的适用性与差异。

title: Unified Framework with Convex-Concave Decomposition and Sparse Topological Learning for Skeleton-Based Clinical Assessment
summary: Skeleton-based rehabilitation assessment faces fundamental limitations of fixed topologies which cannot model compensatory patterns, uniform joint treatments overlook clinically important deviations, and lack of geometric understand- ing. We propose Concave-Convex Decomposition Sparse Topological Graph Convolutional Network (CC2-STG), a multi-stream model that combines geo- metric decomposition, sparse feature learning, and adaptive topology. Our framework decomposes joint relationships into complementary convex-concave distance functions to model both local and global movement characteristics, with sparse regularization with proximal optimization selecting clinically relevant geo- metric features, while multi-scale topological analysis captures non-anatomical joint dependencies in pathological movements. Experiments on the KiMoRe and UIPRMD datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art performance on clinical pathological movement assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出CC²-STG多流模型，将几何凸凹分解、稀疏特征学习与自适应拓扑结合，用于骨架康复评估并取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架康复评估受限于固定拓扑无法建模代偿模式、统一处理关节忽视临床重要偏差、缺乏几何理解。
AI.method: 将关节关系分解为互补的凸-凹距离函数以刻画局部与全局运动特征；采用带近端优化的稀疏正则化筛选临床相关几何特征；多尺度拓扑分析捕捉病理性运动中的非解剖关节依赖；整体为多流架构。
AI.result: 在KiMoRe与UIPRMD数据集上验证有效性，在临床病理性运动评估上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 凸凹分解、稀疏几何特征学习与自适应多尺度拓扑的结合能有效提升骨架康复评估性能。

title: RoadState: A Domain-Prior-Enhanced Vision-Language System for Industrial-Grade Lane-Level Map Updating
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Accepted to AAAI-IAAI 2027, poster presentation
summary: Lane-level map updating requires temporally consistent, physically valid, and auditable road-scene semantics despite occlusions, ambiguous lane markings, temporary obstacles, and viewpoint changes. We present RoadState, a production-deployed vision-language system that transforms sequential road-scene observations into structured lane-level semantics for Baidu Maps' map-updating pipeline. Its core model, RoadState-VLM, formulates road-scene understanding as autoregressive state estimation, predicting the current structured road state from the previous observation and symbolic state together with the current observation. We introduce Geometric Chain-of-Thought (Geo-CoT), which uses a directed acyclic graph of semantic dependencies as a domain prior to improve semantic consistency and reasoning fidelity across interdependent road-state dimensions. Extensive experiments on a real-world dataset show that RoadState-VLM achieves 94.33% mean accuracy across six road-state dimensions, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned VLM baseline. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary effectiveness of Geo-CoT and temporal transition context. A cascaded routing pipeline directs routine cases to lightweight models while reserving complex cases for RoadState-VLM. Since its deployment in March 2025, RoadState has supported lane-level map updating across more than 360 cities and reduced overall production costs by 30%. Together with human-in-the-loop auditing, the system maintains robust performance under stress-test conditions. These results demonstrate how domain-prior-enhanced reasoning, structured state interfaces, selective routing, and human quality control can bridge the gap between VLM-based road-scene understanding and large-scale lane-level map updating.

AI.tldr: RoadState：生产级视觉语言系统，将序列道路观测转为结构化车道级语义，RoadState-VLM以自回归状态估计建模并引入几何思维链（Geo-CoT），六维度平均准确率94.33%，已落地360+城市、降本30%。
AI.motivation: 车道级地图更新需在遮挡、标线歧义、临时障碍与视角变化下保持时序一致、物理有效且可审计的道路语义，现有VLM方法难以满足规模化生产要求。
AI.method: RoadState-VLM将道路场景理解建模为自回归状态估计：以先前观测与符号状态、当前观测为输入预测当前结构化道路状态；提出Geo-CoT，以语义依赖有向无环图作为领域先验提升跨维度语义一致性与推理保真度；并在系统层采用级联路由管线，常规案例交轻量模型、复杂案例交RoadState-VLM，配合人在回路审计。
AI.result: 真实数据集上六类道路状态维度平均准确率94.33%，优于最强微调VLM基线；消融显示Geo-CoT与时序转换上下文互补有效；2025年3月部署以来支持360余城市车道级更新，整体生产成本下降30%，压力测试下性能稳健。
AI.conclusion: 领域先验增强推理、结构化状态接口、选择性路由与人工质控相结合，可弥合VLM道路场景理解与大规模车道级地图更新之间的差距。

title: Tiny Evidence Region Localization with Selective Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Multimodal large language models have made progress in general visual tasks. However, limitations remain in fine-grained visual tasks requiring evidence from minute image regions. Existing methods primarily train models using evidence-related regions while overlooking the influence of extensive background regions, resulting in a limited ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. We propose selective positive-negative on-policy self-distillation (SPN-OPSD), which considers both evidence and background regions. Supervision from both views improves the model's ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. Furthermore, selective token-level distillation provides more informative supervision, improving the model's ability to attend to evidence regions in Fine-Grained Visual Tasks. On Qwen3.5-2B, SPN-OPSD improves accuracy on V* Bench, ZoomBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite from 76.44%, 45.92%, and 57.43% to 84.82%, 54.56%, and 59.56%, respectively. Similar gains are also observed on Qwen3.5-0.8B.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性正负在线策略自蒸馏（SPN-OPSD），同时利用证据区域与背景区域监督，提升多模态大模型在细粒度视觉任务中的抗干扰能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在需要微小图像区域证据的细粒度视觉任务中存在不足；现有训练方法仅使用证据相关区域，忽视大量背景区域的影响，导致模型抵抗无关区域干扰的能力有限。
AI.method: SPN-OPSD 同时考虑证据区域与背景区域，通过正、负两种视角的监督增强抗干扰能力；并采用选择性的 token 级蒸馏，提供更具信息量的监督信号，提升模型对证据区域的关注能力。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-2B 上，V* Bench、ZoomBench、MME-RealWorld-Lite 准确率分别由 76.44%、45.92%、57.43% 提升至 84.82%、54.56%、59.56%；Qwen3.5-0.8B 上亦观察到类似增益。
AI.conclusion: 联合证据与背景区域的正负监督，配合 token 级选择性蒸馏，可有效提升多模态大模型在细粒度视觉任务中的抗干扰性与证据关注能力。

title: Not All Layers Are Equal in Image-to-Video Transfer
summary:
Parameter-efficient image-to-video transfer adapts frozen image foundation models to video via lightweight trainable adapters. Existing methods insert the same adapter at every transformer layer, implicitly assuming all layers require equal temporal modeling. A layer-wise sensitivity analysis across four video-native model families and two pretraining paradigms reveals that this assumption is wrong: temporal sensitivity increases with depth, and the pretraining paradigm determines its growth profile. Vision-only models exhibit a gradual rise, while vision-language models show early suppression followed by late recovery.
  This finding motivates STRAP, a training-free adapter placement rule that derives a spatial-to-temporal transition boundary from a paradigm-matched video model. Spatial adapters are assigned before this boundary and temporal adapters after it, without modifying the adapter architecture itself. On four fine-grained action recognition benchmarks, STRAP improves accuracy by up to 11.8% over uniform placement, reduces trainable parameters by 29 to 48%, and lowers inference time by up to 10%. On standard benchmarks, it matches accuracy with fewer parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/th-nesh/STRAP.

AI.tldr: STRAP：依据层间时间敏感性随深度递增的规律，从范式匹配的视频模型导出"空间→时间"适配器切换边界，实现免训练的逐层差异化适配器放置。
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效图像到视频迁移方法在每一层插入相同适配器，隐含假设各层所需时间建模强度相同；作者通过跨四类视频原生模型家族与两种预训练范式的层级敏感性分析，证明该假设不成立。
AI.method: 先做层间敏感性分析，发现时间敏感度随深度上升，且增长曲线由预训练范式决定（纯视觉模型渐进上升，视觉-语言模型先抑制后回升）；据此设计免训练放置规则STRAP：由范式匹配的视频模型推导空间到时间的转换边界，边界前放置空间适配器、边界后放置时间适配器，不改变适配器结构本身。
AI.result: 在四个细粒度动作识别基准上，相较均匀放置最高提升11.8%准确率，可训练参数减少29%–48%，推理时间最多降低10%；在标准基准上以更少参数达到同等准确率。
AI.conclusion: 适配器放置位置本身即是被忽视的关键设计维度；利用预训练范式决定的时间敏感性深度分布进行异质放置，可在不增加参数的前提下同时提升精度与效率。

title: Graphene: A Lightweight Transformer with Ising Mean-Field Refinement for Image Super-Resolution
summary: This paper proposes Graphene, a lightweight image super-resolution architecture with two complementary feature refinement mechanisms: Ising-model-inspired local feature refinement using an Ising Refinement Block (IRB) and stage-history-based feature refinement using a History Attention (HistAttn) module. The IRB reuses attention output features and pre-softmax attention logits to construct signed pairwise token couplings within each local window, applies unrolled mean-field updates, and refines features through a gated residual correction. These signed couplings allow alignment and opposition between latent spins to modulate local feature refinement. HistAttn attends over the current stage output and earlier representations at the same token position and adaptively blends the current stage output with a history-weighted feature aggregate without adding spatial pairwise attention. On Urban100 at $\times4$, Graphene and Graphene-light improve over IET and IET-light by 0.24 dB and 0.38 dB, respectively, with 34.3%/13.7% fewer parameters, 44.8%/44.4% fewer FLOPs, 78.4%/71.5% lower latency, and 76.0%/85.5% lower peak memory. Real-world SR comparisons further show that Graphene recovers fine details and preserves textures across diverse degradations. Code and reference checkpoints are available at https://github.com/skethz/Graphene

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级图像超分架构 Graphene，结合 Ising 模型启发的局部特征精炼（IRB）与基于阶段历史的特征精炼（HistAttn），在 Urban100 ×4 上以更低参数量、FLOPs、延迟和显存超越 IET。
AI.motivation: 现有轻量超分网络在局部特征建模与跨阶段特征聚合上效率不足，需在保持性能的同时显著降低计算与内存开销。
AI.method: 两种互补机制：1）Ising Refinement Block（IRB）复用注意力输出特征与 softmax 前注意力 logits，在局部窗口内构建带符号的成对 token 耦合，执行展开的平均场更新，并通过门控残差校正精炼特征；带符号耦合使潜在自旋间的对齐与对立调制局部特征。2）History Attention（HistAttn）在同一 token 位置上对当前阶段输出与早期表示做注意力聚合，自适应地将当前输出与历史加权特征融合，且不引入空间成对注意力。
AI.result: Urban100 ×4 上，Graphene 与 Graphene-light 分别较 IET 与 IET-light 提升 0.24 dB 和 0.38 dB，参数量减少 34.3%/13.7%，FLOPs 减少 44.8%/44.4%，延迟降低 78.4%/71.5%，峰值显存降低 76.0%/85.5%。真实场景 SR 对比显示其在多种退化下能恢复细节并保持纹理。
AI.conclusion: Graphene 以物理启发的局部精炼与高效历史注意力实现了高性价比的轻量超分，在精度与效率上同时优于 IET 系列，并具备良好的真实场景泛化能力。

title: NanoNet: Ultra-Lightweight Network for MRI Brain Tumor Classification toward Edge AI
summary: Automated brain tumor classification from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can support accessible medical image analysis, but conventional deep learning models often exceed the resource budgets of highly constrained edge-AI platforms. We present NanoNet, an ultra-lightweight convolutional neural network designed for resourceconstrained MRI classification and motivated by future edge-AI applications. Inspired by MobileNetV2, NanoNet substantially reduces network depth, channel capacity, expansion ratios, and final feature dimensionality, resulting in only five inverted residual blocks and 8,132 parameters. We further investigate dependency-aware structured pruning, knowledge distillation, and INT8 quantization-aware training for additional compression. Experiments on the BRISC 2025 benchmark show that NanoNet achieves 92.80% accuracy and 92.97% macro F1 with 8,132 parameters and 10.498 MFLOPs. Across three compression seeds, it exceeds the mean accuracy of 70%-pruned MobileNetV2 by 5.20 percentage points while using 60.2% fewer parameters and 9.8% less computation. Converted INT8 NanoNet achieves 89.70% accuracy and 90.22% macro F1 across three QAT seeds. Earlier TensorFlow Lite measurements indicate 27.7 KB of baseline model storage, motivating future edge-AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出超轻量CNN「NanoNet」用于MRI脑肿瘤分类，仅5个倒残差块、8132参数，在BRISC 2025上达92.80%准确率/92.97% macro F1，并探索剪枝、蒸馏与INT8量化进一步压缩。
AI.motivation: 自动化MRI脑肿瘤分类有助于可普及的医学影像分析，但常规深度学习模型常超出受限边缘AI平台的资源预算，需面向未来边缘部署的极轻量方案。
AI.method: 受MobileNetV2启发构建NanoNet：大幅削减网络深度、通道容量、扩展比与末端特征维度，仅保留5个倒残差块、8132参数；并研究依赖感知结构化剪枝、知识蒸馏与INT8量化感知训练（QAT）以进一步压缩。
AI.result: BRISC 2025基准上，NanoNet达92.80%准确率、92.97% macro F1，8132参数、10.498 MFLOPs；三种子下相较70%剪枝的MobileNetV2均值准确率高5.20个百分点，参数少60.2%、计算少9.8%；INT8版本三种QAT种子下为89.70%准确率、90.22% macro F1；早期TFLite测量基线模型存储27.7 KB。
AI.conclusion: NanoNet在极低参数与计算预算下仍具竞争力，优于更重的剪枝MobileNetV2，且INT8量化保持较好精度，为未来边缘AI部署提供可行基础；部署测量仍属初步，需后续验证。

title: Sensitivity-Gated Accumulator Caching for On-Device Learning of Low-Bit Hand Networks
summary: Small hand-tracking networks are deployed as 4- and 8-bit codes, and they should keep adapting to a user's camera after deployment, on the device and within roughly the memory of the model itself. Quantization-aware training cannot do this cheaply, because it keeps a 32-bit master copy of every weight together with its optimizer state, about 96 bits per weight. Training the codes directly with stochastic rounding needs no copy but injects rounding noise at every step, and the methods that remove this noise keep a residual buffer for every weight. We introduce sensitivity-gated accumulator caching (SGAC), which keeps residual state for only a small and changing set of weight groups. A set-associative cache of 8-bit accumulators collects the sub-step updates of the groups with the largest Fisher-weighted squared code step and writes them into the codes as whole steps; an evicted line is flushed by stochastic rounding, and a group without a line does not move until it is admitted. We prove that the write-back is unbiased and show, under a local quadratic model, that rounding a sub-step update costs loss of the same order as the update's own gain, so that rounding pays only where the expected gradient is large relative to the curvature. On a 383k-parameter hand-keypoint network, SGAC trains with 8.1 bits of state per weight. Scored on the 4/8-bit network that the device runs after adaptation, it has the highest mean accuracy of nine deployed low-bit networks on two simulated cameras. On twelve ImageNet-C corruptions it has the highest average of corrupted and clean accuracy of seven deployed methods, ahead of the PEQA-style, ECO-style and direct low-bit baselines with confidence intervals that exclude zero, and it matches an 8-bit accumulator kept for every weight with 56% of that state.

AI.tldr: SGAC提出一种灵敏度门控累加器缓存方法，用仅8.1比特/权重的状态实现在设备上对量化网络进行低比特持续自适应训练，在低比特部署网络精度上优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 小型手部跟踪网络以4/8比特部署后，仍需在设备端、以接近模型自身内存的预算持续适配用户相机。量化感知训练需保留32位主副本及优化器状态（约96比特/权重），过于昂贵；而直接用随机舍入训练代码虽无需副本，却在每步注入舍入噪声；去除该噪声的方法又需为每个权重维护残差缓冲，内存开销大。
AI.method: 提出灵敏度门控累加器缓存（SGAC）：仅为少量且动态变化的权重组保留残差状态。采用组相联缓存的8位累加器，收集Fisher加权平方代码步最大组的子步更新，并作为整步写入代码；被驱逐的行通过随机舍入刷新，未被分配的组在获准前不更新。论文证明写回无偏，并在局部二次模型下说明：对子步更新进行舍入的损失与更新本身的增益同阶，因此只有期望梯度相对曲率较大时舍入才划算。
AI.result: 在383k参数的手部关键点网络上，SGAC以每权重8.1比特状态进行训练。在两个模拟相机上，于设备运行经适配后的4/8比特网络，其平均精度在九个部署的低比特网络中最高；在十二种ImageNet-C损坏上，其损坏与干净精度平均在七种部署方法中最高，优于PEQA式、ECO式和直接低比特基线，置信区间排除零；并以56%的状态匹配每权重8位累加器的效果。
AI.conclusion: SGAC证明：通过在少量高灵敏度权重组上选择性保留残差状态，可在极低内存预算下实现无偏、有效的低比特网络设备端持续自适应，兼顾精度与内存效率。

title: Auto-GlaKG: Automated Biomarker Reasoning for Explainable Glaucoma Detection
summary: Interpretable glaucoma detection requires a transparent connection between fundus images, clinically meaningful biomarkers, and diagnostic predictions. Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning provides this structure, but performance measured using annotated biomarkers does not establish performance when only images are available. We present Auto-GlaKG, an automated framework that combines image-based biomarker prediction with fixed clinical-prior rules. A ResNet50 network predicts the cup-to-disc ratio (CDR) and six morphological signs using biomarker supervision, and a KG reasoner aggregates their signed rule contributions into a glaucoma score. On 689 fundus images evaluated using stratified, group-aware five-fold cross-validation, Auto-GlaKG achieves a pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.951 (95\% confidence interval: 0.931--0.969), with sensitivity of 0.970 and specificity of 0.779. The matched image classifier also achieves an AUC of 0.951, while the rule stage adds 0.2~ms per image. Replacing predicted CDR with its annotation increases fold-mean AUC from 0.953 to 0.995. The framework provides an explicit rule-level account of image-based predictions and identifies CDR estimation as a priority for validation using independently measured biomarkers.

AI.tldr: Auto-GlaKG框架将ResNet50生物标志物预测与固定临床先验规则的知识图谱推理结合，实现可解释的青光眼检测，在689张眼底图像上获得AUC 0.951。
AI.motivation: 可解释的青光眼检测需要在眼底图像、临床有意义生物标志物与诊断预测之间建立透明联系。知识图谱推理可提供该结构，但使用标注生物标志物测得的性能无法代表仅有图像时的实际性能。
AI.method: Auto-GlaKG：ResNet50在生物标志物监督下预测杯盘比（CDR）及六项形态学征象；随后KG推理器将各带符号的规则贡献聚合为青光眼评分。采用分层、分组感知的五折交叉验证在689张眼底图像上评估。
AI.result: 汇总AUC为0.951（95%CI：0.931–0.969），敏感度0.970，特异度0.779；匹配的图像分类器AUC同为0.951，规则阶段每张图像仅增加约0.2 ms。以标注CDR替代预测CDR后，折均值AUC由0.953提升至0.995。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为基于图像的预测提供显式的规则级解释，并指出CDR估计是需用独立测量的生物标志物进行验证的优先方向。

title: SAFE-Hair: Scalp-Anchored Fields for Exportable Single-View Hair Reconstruction
summary: Single-view 3D hair reconstruction has progressed rapidly, but many methods optimize for visual plausibility rather than producing strand assets that can be directly used in grooming, editing, or simulation pipelines. We propose SAFE-Hair, a framework that reconstructs explicit strand grooms from a single portrait by decoding hair from persistent follicles in a canonical scalp-UV domain. Given a fitted template head, SAFE-Hair projects self-supervised image features onto the scalp, uses a conditional Rectified Flow model to generate latent scalp fields, and decodes occupancy, segment directions, length allocation, and total length at a fixed set of scalp follicles. This representation enforces scalp-rooted strand identities by construction and enables direct export with follicle IDs and guide-family metadata. We further introduce attachment, collision, and bending priors to improve geometric validity without per-subject test-time optimization. To evaluate both reconstruction fidelity and asset usability, we introduce HairBench-3D, a benchmark built from public 3D hair assets with standardized alignment, rendering, resampling, and metrics for geometry, direction consistency, invisible-region completion, silhouette agreement, and collision. SAFE-Hair improves Chamfer distance from 3.74 mm to 3.28 mm, F-score from 77.9 to 81.7, invisible-region F-score from 66.1 to 69.8, and penetration ratio from 4.8% to 3.9% over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: SAFE-Hair 从单张肖像重建可直接用于造型/编辑/仿真的显式发丝资产，通过在标准 scalp-UV 域的持久毛囊上解码头发表示，并配套提出 HairBench-3D 评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有单视图 3D 头发重建方法多追求视觉合理性，而非产出可进入 grooming、编辑或仿真流程的发丝资产；同时缺乏同时衡量重建保真度与资产可用性的评测手段。
AI.method: 基于拟合模板头，将自监督图像特征投影到头皮（scalp-UV），用条件 Rectified Flow 模型生成潜空间头皮场，在固定毛囊集合上解码占用、段方向、长度分配与总长度；该表示在构造上保证发丝根植于头皮并带毛囊 ID 与 guide-family 元数据，可直接导出；另引入附着、碰撞与弯曲先验提升几何有效性，且无需逐受试者测试时优化。同时构建 HairBench-3D 基准（标准化对齐、渲染、重采样及几何、方向一致性、不可见区域补全、轮廓一致性、碰撞等指标）。
AI.result: 相较最强基线：Chamfer 距离 3.74 mm→3.28 mm，F-score 77.9→81.7，不可见区域 F-score 66.1→69.8，穿透率 4.8%→3.9%。
AI.conclusion: 以毛囊为中心的显式发丝表示结合先验约束，可在单视图条件下同时提升重建保真度与资产可用性，并为该任务提供标准化评测基准。

title: Watching Itself Watch: Self-Auditing Visual Reliance for Video Reasoning
summary: Video reasoning hinges on a small number of visually decisive tokens embedded in otherwise largely language-driven chains of thought. Yet prevailing post-training methods such as GRPO overlook this structure, assigning coarse trajectory-level rewards while requiring multiple rollouts and often costly external judges. We introduce Visually-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (VIOS), a post-training framework that identifies where a model under-utilizes visual evidence and concentrates learning at those positions. Our key insight is that a model can audit its own visual reliance: the divergence between its next-token distributions with and without the video reveals how strongly each prediction depends on the visual input. Measuring this reliance for both a student and an answer-privileged teacher exposes a per-token reliance gap, identifying positions where the teacher exploits visual evidence that the student overlooks. VIOS translates this signal into dense, targeted supervision through three complementary components: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher that co-evolves with the student, a contrastive objective that encourages predictions to depend on the video, and a reliance-gap gate that focuses learning on visually under-utilized tokens. Crucially, VIOS requires only a single on-policy rollout from a single model, without external rewards, judges, or larger teachers. Across 12 benchmarks spanning general, temporal, spatial, knowledge-intensive, and long-video understanding, VIOS consistently improves three model backbones and outperforms contemporary video-reasoning systems, while training in over 9x fewer steps, 60x fewer FLOPs, and 111x fewer generated tokens. Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/VIOS/

AI.tldr: VIOS 是一种视频推理后训练框架，利用模型对视频的"视觉依赖度"差异（学生与特权教师逐token对比）生成稠密监督，在无外部奖励/裁判/大模型教师条件下单次on-policy rollout显著提升性能并大幅降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: 视频推理的思维链主要依赖语言，只有少量视觉决定性token起作用；而GRPO等主流后训练方法只给轨迹级粗粒度奖励，需多rollout与昂贵外部裁判，忽略了这种关键位置结构。
AI.method: 核心洞察：比较模型"有/无视频"两种下一token分布的散度可量化视觉依赖度。VIOS计算学生与答案特权教师（EMA教师，与学生共同演化）的逐token依赖差距，定位教师利用而学生忽视视觉证据的位置，并通过三部分实现稠密监督：EMA教师、鼓励预测依赖视频的对比目标、聚焦视觉欠利用token的依赖差距门控。仅需单模型单次on-policy rollout。
AI.result: 在覆盖通用、时序、空间、知识密集与长视频理解的12个基准上，VIOS一致提升三个骨干模型并超越同类视频推理系统；训练步数减少9倍以上、FLOPs减少60倍、生成token减少111倍。
AI.conclusion: 以自蒸馏式的逐token视觉依赖差距替代粗粒度的轨迹级RL奖励，是高效、无需外部监督的视频推理后训练可行路径。

title: SurgTAP-3D: A Large-Scale Cross-Surgery Video Dataset with Contact-Aware 3D Motion Tracking
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO)
summary: Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/

AI.tldr: 提出SurgTAP-3D——大规模在体伪3D手术运动跟踪数据集与基准（520K帧、4,549动作片段、1.4M条2D/3D点轨迹），并给出可扩展的统一标注框架（接触区域提示、活动器械分割、动态BA、全局4D优化），在SurgPose、SurgT、STIR上建立器械与组织跟踪基准。
AI.motivation: 微创手术(MIS)的3D场景动态理解是迈向物理智能与自主手术系统的关键，但现有公开数据集在真实临床场景中的可扩展性与多样性不足；且标注通常只关注组织或器械其一，忽视器械-组织交互。这限制了AR引导以及依赖大规模高质量3D监督的VLA模型/世界模型等应用。
AI.method: 1) 构建SurgTAP-3D：涵盖机器人与手工操作、统一动作类别的在体视频；2) 设计统一的3D点跟踪标注框架，将未标定单目手术视频转换为结构化4D标注，流程包括接触区域提示(contact-region prompting)、活动器械分割、动态光束法平差(dynamic bundle adjustment)与全局4D精化；3) 该流水线将基础模型先验适配到手术视频，输出时序一致轨迹、伪尺度几何、相机位姿与器械掩码；数据保留遮挡、烟雾、出血、器械快速运动等真实难点；4) 在SurgPose、SurgT、STIR上构建覆盖器械与组织跟踪的综合基准，验证器械位移估计、可变形表面重建与基础模型微调。
AI.result: 数据集规模为520K帧、4,549个动作片段、1.4M条2D/3D点轨迹；大量实验与分析表明该数据集与标注框架在3D手术点跟踪、重建及手术动作理解上均有效。
AI.conclusion: SurgTAP-3D以可扩展的伪3D标注流水线填补了手术3D运动跟踪数据的空缺，统一了器械与组织（含交互）的4D监督，为3D跟踪、重建与动作理解提供基准，并支撑AR引导、VLA与世界模型等下游研究。

title: Dropping Tokens Without Dropping Them: Causal Attribution for Diabetic Retinopathy
summary: In this work, we investigate whether attention-based attribution maps in a vision transformer provide causal explanations for diabetic retinopathy (DR) classification. We introduce a principled decomposition of attention into two attribution maps: the contribution ($c_t$), which satisfies the completeness axiom in explainable artificial intelligence (xAI), and the pull ($p_t$), which quantifies causal explanations. We define an identity relating $c_t$ and $p_t$ that characterizes when $c_t$ fails to capture causality. We test whether each map is causally faithful on the MAPLES-DR dataset by dropping/inserting tokens, and report Necessity ($N$), Sufficiency ($Su$), and Faithfulness Correlation ($FC$). The pull $p_t$ achieves the highest causal alignment ($FC = 0.53$, $N = 0.71\%$, $Su = 3.0\%$), outperforming Attention Rollout, Grad-CAM, and AttnLRP. Occlusion retains better sufficiency ($Su = 1.6\%$) but is about 800 times slower. Furthermore, on MAPLES-DR, $p_t$ achieves $70\%$ of the average precision (AP) of HRDecoder, a state-of-the-art supervised lesion segmentation model, despite the absence of pixel-level supervision. Together, these findings show that the pull $p_t$ and the contribution $c_t$ form computationally efficient attribution maps for reliable causal interpretation in safety-critical medical diagnostics. The code and demo are available at https://github.com/pramath-haritz/dr-xai.

AI.tldr: 该文研究ViT中基于注意力的归因图能否对糖尿病视网膜病变(DR)分类提供因果解释，提出将注意力分解为满足完备性公理的contribution c_t与刻画因果的pull p_t，并在MAPLES-DR上验证p_t的因果忠实性优于多种主流方法。
AI.motivation: 注意力归因图在安全关键的医学诊断中被广泛使用，但其是否具备因果解释力缺乏严谨检验；同时现有xAI归因图（满足完备性公理者）未必等价于因果解释，二者关系需要明确刻画。
AI.method: 提出将注意力原理化分解为两个归因图：contribution c_t（满足xAI完备性公理）与pull p_t（度量因果解释），并给出联系二者的恒等式以刻画c_t在何时无法捕捉因果性。在MAPLES-DR数据集上通过token删除/插入进行因果忠实性测试，报告Necessity、Sufficiency与Faithfulness Correlation三项指标，与Attention Rollout、Grad-CAM、AttnLRP及Occlusion对比。
AI.result: pull p_t取得最高因果对齐（FC=0.53，N=0.71%，Su=3.0%），优于Attention Rollout、Grad-CAM与AttnLRP；Occlusion充分性更优（Su=1.6%）但速度慢约800倍；p_t在无像素级监督下达到HRDecoder（SOTA有监督病灶分割模型）平均精度AP的70%。
AI.conclusion: pull p_t与contribution c_t构成计算高效且可靠的因果解释归因图，适用于安全关键的医学诊断场景；完备性公理满足并不保证因果忠实性，需以p_t作为因果解释依据。

title: Single Image Super-Resolution via Semantic Prompt and Cross-Modal Training on Content Area
summary: Enhancing image quality through super-resolution is crucial in image and video processing. While contemporary deep learning models, such as CNNs and Transformers, excel in pixel-level enhancements, they often overlook the rich semantic context within images. To address this, we introduce a novel approach that synergizes pixel intensity with semantic information for superior detail recovery. Our method involves extracting semantic data, including textual descriptors and spatial positioning, and encoding this information. We also present a Cross-Modal Feature Fusion module for generating semantic feature maps via multimodal training, and a Prompt Traction Head to augment the backbone network with semantic insights, thereby refining image details. Our empirical results across various datasets validate the superiority of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出融合像素强度与语义信息的超分辨率方法，通过文本描述与空间定位等语义数据的编码、跨模态特征融合模块（Cross-Modal Feature Fusion）与提示牵引头（Prompt Traction Head）将语义洞见注入骨干网络，从而提升细节恢复质量，并在多数据集上验证其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有CNN与Transformer类超分模型擅长像素级增强，但忽视了图像中丰富的语义上下文，导致细节恢复受限。作者希望将语义信息与像素强度协同利用以改善重建质量。
AI.method: 1) 提取语义数据（文本描述与空间定位信息）并进行编码；2) 设计Cross-Modal Feature Fusion模块，通过多模态训练生成语义特征图；3) 设计Prompt Traction Head，将语义洞见注入骨干网络以精化图像细节。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法优于对比方案，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将语义上下文引入超分辨率流程可有效弥补纯像素级建模的不足，跨模态融合与提示机制是提升细节恢复的可行路径。

title: HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://kennethyangg.github.io/HIST3R/
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction with recurrent states enables long-video scene understanding under bounded memory, but turns reconstruction into a state-evolution problem: each incoming frame updates a compact scene memory on which all subsequent predictions depend, so unreliable updates overwrite historical context and accumulate into long-horizon geometric drift. We analyze CUT3R-style recurrent updates through a direction--magnitude decomposition, in which the magnitude sets the update gain, i.e., how strongly an observation is written into the state, and the direction encodes the geometric intent, i.e., where the update drives the state. This decomposition provides a unified view of CUT3R and its variants, revealing that existing training-free extensions perform magnitude-only control: they can attenuate an unreliable update but cannot correct its direction. We propose HIST3R, a training-free framework built on CUT3R that controls both components using history. HIST3R rectifies the update direction using locally consistent historical states, and modulates the update magnitude according to the visual discrepancy between the current observation and its history, suppressing redundant updates while preserving complementary evidence. Across camera pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video depth estimation, HIST3R consistently improves long-horizon performance while retaining the memory footprint and inference speed of CUT3R. With 1000 input frames, it reduces ATE by 23.87% on ScanNet and 33.65% on TUM-Dynamics relative to the strongest competing method; with 500 frames, it improves median reconstruction accuracy over the strongest CUT3R-based variant by 56.52% on 7-Scenes and 33.96% on NRGBD.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的HIST3R框架，将CUT3R式循环更新分解为方向与幅度，并用历史信息同时校正方向、调制幅度，在保持内存与速度的同时显著提升长视频3D重建性能。
AI.motivation: 流式3D重建依赖循环状态在有限内存下理解长视频，每个新帧都会更新紧凑的场景记忆，不可靠的更新会覆盖历史上下文并累积成长时序的几何漂移。作者分析发现，现有免训练扩展仅做"幅度控制"，只能衰减不可靠更新却无法纠正其方向，因此需要同时控制更新的两个分量。
AI.method: 对CUT3R式循环更新进行方向—幅度分解：幅度决定更新增益（观测写入状态的强度），方向编码几何意图（更新驱动状态的方向）。基于此统一视角，提出免训练框架HIST3R：利用局部一致的历史状态校正更新方向，并依据当前观测与其历史之间的视觉差异调制更新幅度，抑制冗余更新、保留互补证据。
AI.result: 在相机位姿估计、3D重建和视频深度估计任务上，HIST3R均持续提升长时序性能，同时保持CUT3R的内存占用与推理速度。1000帧输入时，相较于最强对比方法，ScanNet上ATE降低23.87%，TUM-Dynamics上降低33.65%；500帧输入时，相较于最强CUT3R变体，7-Scenes中位重建精度提升56.52%，NRGBD提升33.96%。
AI.conclusion: 方向—幅度分解为理解CUT3R及其变体提供了统一视角，表明方向校正与幅度调制需协同进行；HIST3R以免训练方式实现二者联合控制，在不增加内存与计算开销的前提下有效缓解长时序几何漂移，验证了历史信息驱动状态演化控制的有效性。

title: AnyBreak: Towards Jailbreaking Any T2I Model for Any Concept
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at ICME 2026
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in image generation and editing, yet this progress has also introduced significant security risks. Prior work has shown that adversarial prompt can induce the generation of Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content, including pornographic, violent, and graphic imagery. However, such attacks are typically mitigated by prompt filters and often rely on white-box assumptions. In this paper, we propose AnyBreak, a novel jailbreak framework that constructs adversarial images via multi-scale progressive semantic alignment. During the generation process, these adversarial images steer the generation trajectory in latent space towards unsafe data manifolds, enabling cross-modal transfer of malicious concepts from the text modality to the image modality. AnyBreak operates using only clean textual prompts and adversarial images at inference time, and can jailbreak any T2I models towards any malicious concepts in a fully black-box setting. We further introduce AnyBreak-V, an enhanced variant that incorporates a compensation term to bypass post-hoc safety checkers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnyBreak achieves high attack success rates while preserving visual fidelity and semantic consistency with the input prompts under black-box and clean-text constraints. Our findings reveal that existing T2I defense leave critical cross-modal attack surfaces insufficiently addressed. The code is available at https://github.com/luqi-glory/AnyBreak.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AnyBreak，一个通过多尺度渐进式语义对齐构建对抗图像的黑盒越狱框架，可在仅使用干净文本提示与对抗图像的条件下，将任意 T2I 模型诱导至任意恶意概念；增强版 AnyBreak-V 通过补偿项绕过事后安全检查器。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 模型存在被对抗提示诱导生成 NSFW 内容的安全风险，但此类攻击通常受提示过滤器限制且依赖白盒假设，跨模态攻击面未被充分研究。
AI.method: 构建对抗图像并与提示进行多尺度渐进式语义对齐，在生成过程中将潜空间生成轨迹导向不安全数据流形，实现恶意概念从文本模态到图像模态的跨模态迁移；仅需干净文本提示与对抗图像，全黑盒运行；AnyBreak-V 引入补偿项以规避事后安全检查器。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 AnyBreak 在黑盒与干净文本约束下取得高攻击成功率，同时保持视觉保真度及与输入提示的语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: 现有 T2I 防御对跨模态攻击面的覆盖不足，存在关键安全缺口。

title: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
summary: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.

AI.tldr: 提出S²D-FVO单目鱼眼视觉里程计框架，将球面光束法平差(SBA)与无监督深度学习结合，用切空间角度重投影残差和基于中值深度的尺度正则化改善尺度一致性与深度精度。
AI.motivation: 鱼眼相机视场大、单目配置简单，适合机器人定位与建图，但长轨迹下尺度漂移严重；无监督深度学习可缓解该问题，然而鱼眼图像强畸变使深度估计不准。
AI.method: 指出像素重投影残差不能均匀反映视线间角度偏差，且标量角度残差的一阶线性化对某一方向切向扰动不敏感；因此SBA采用由球面对数映射导出的切空间角度重投影残差，其在两个切向均保持敏感性且范数等于对应标量角度残差；并引入基于中值深度的尺度正则项约束重建尺度。SBA在无监督深度学习中替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠的相对位姿；训练好的深度网络反过来为SBA提供尺度参考。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集及两个新采集的大规模数据集上，该框架在深度估计与轨迹估计精度上优于代表性现有方法，并适用于不同相机模型。
AI.conclusion: SBA引导的无监督深度学习与深度网络提供的尺度参考形成互补闭环，有效提升单目鱼眼VO的尺度一致性与深度精度，具备跨相机模型的通用性。

title: RBA: A Read-out Basis Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Interactive OCTA Vessel Segmentation with SEEM
summary: Retinal disease monitoring with optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) relies on segmentation of vessels and the foveal avascular zone (FAZ). Promptable models such as SEEM (Segment Everything Everywhere All at Once) allow click-based refinement, but without adaptation SEEM segments thin vessels poorly and needs many clicks. Fully fine-tuning its 342 million parameters on a few hundred images is costly and risks overfitting, and parameter-efficient methods such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA) usually adapt only the encoder. Yet SEEM reads every candidate mask from one feature map at quarter resolution, too coarse for vessels one to three pixels wide. This study introduces the Read-out Basis Adapter (RBA), whose read-out branch generates 32 image-specific basis maps at half resolution. Each candidate accesses them through its own vector and a zero-initialised projection, so the model starts exactly as SEEM. The encoder branch, a standard rank-1 LoRA, supplies the information needed to tell arteries from veins. RBA adds 0.47 million trainable parameters. Under simulated error-driven clicks, with the ground truth used only to place them, RBA outperforms LoRA, Conv-LoRA andAdaptFormer on OCTA-500 3mmlarge vessels. Averaged over three seeds, it reaches an intersection over union (IoU) of 85.16% and a Dice score of 91.93%, 2.90 and 1.72 percentage points above Conv-LoRA. On the 6 mm subset, one run gives margins of 4.35 and 2.76 points. The gain extends to arteries, veins and ROSE-O but not to the FAZ. In SEEM, adaptation capacity pays more at the mask read-out than in the encoder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出读出基适配器（RBA），通过在SEEM的掩码读出分支生成半分辨率的32幅图像特定基图，实现血管分割的参数高效微调，仅增加0.47M可训练参数，在OCTA-500上优于LoRA、Conv-LoRA和AdaptFormer。
AI.motivation: OCTA视网膜疾病监测依赖血管与FAZ分割。SEEM等可提示模型支持点击式细化，但未适配时对细小血管分割效果差且需多次点击；完全微调3.42亿参数在小数据集上成本高且易过拟合；而LoRA等参数高效方法通常只适配编码器，而SEEM的候选掩码均由四分之一分辨率的单一特征图读出，对1–3像素宽的血管过于粗糙。
AI.method: 提出读出基适配器（RBA）：其读出分支生成32幅图像特定的半分辨率基图，每个候选掩码通过各自的向量及零初始化投影访问这些基图，使模型初始时与原始SEEM完全一致；编码器分支采用标准rank-1 LoRA，提供区分动脉与静脉所需的信息。RBA共增加0.47M可训练参数。
AI.result: 在模拟误差驱动点击（真值仅用于放置点击）条件下，RBA在OCTA-500 3mm大血管集上优于LoRA、Conv-LoRA与AdaptFormer。三随机种子平均IoU达85.16%、Dice达91.93%，分别比Conv-LoRA高2.90和1.72个百分点；在6mm子集上单次运行提升4.35和2.76个百分点。增益延伸至动脉、静脉及ROSE-O数据集，但对FAZ无效。
AI.conclusion: 在SEEM中，适配容量在掩码读出端的收益大于编码器端，RBA以极少参数实现了对细小血管的有效分割提升，为可提示分割模型的参数高效域适配提供了新思路。

title: MDA framework: multi-architecture domain adaptation for unsupervised person re-identification
summary: Unsupervised person re-identification not only faces the challenge of domain gaps, but existing methods also rarely support multiple network architectures. To tackle both issues, this paper proposes a multi-architecture auto-adaptive domain adaptation method: Mamba augmented multi-architecture domain adaptation framework. Specifically, this paper constructs the multi-architecture domain adaptation capability at two levels. At the first level, we propose a composite operator(MDA operator) that encapsulates Mamba as a component for enhancing domain adaptation. At the second level, based on this operator, we propose a Mamba-enhanced multi-architecture Domain Adaptation framework(MDA framework). Comprehensive experiments on person re-identification benchmarks validate the consistency and flexibility of the proposed framework. The MDA framework supports versatile deployment strategies without being confined to a single integration point. Under a single deployment configuration, it surpasses several SOTA methods. Moreover, it demonstrates substantial performance improvements across both CNN and Transformer architectures. When embedded into a CNN backbone, the framework achieves a 10.2% mAP improvement on the adaptation task from CUHK03 to Market-1501. Integrated with a Transformer backbone, it yields a 19.8% mAP improvement on the same task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mamba增强的多架构域适应框架（MDA），通过复合算子与框架两个层次赋予无监督行人重识别多种网络架构的域适应能力。
AI.motivation: 无监督行人重识别同时面临域间差异（域鸿沟）问题，且现有方法通常只适配单一网络架构，缺乏跨架构的通用性。
